strings.source: Session dates, selected instruments and measured practice summaries are stored locally. They help you return to an instrument and review your practice. Clearing this app's storage in Android Settings removes local history and preferences.
strings.translation: ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ତାରିଖ, ବାଛିଥିବା ବାଦ୍ୟଯନ୍ତ୍ର ଓ ମାପାଯାଇଥିବା ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ସାରାଂଶ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଭାବେ ସଞ୍ଚିତ ହୁଏ। ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବାଦ୍ୟଯନ୍ତ୍ରକୁ ଫେରିବା ଓ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ସମୀକ୍ଷାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ। Android ସେଟିଂସ୍‌ରେ ଏହି ଆପ୍‌ର ଷ୍ଟୋରେଜ୍ ସଫା କଲେ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଇତିହାସ ଓ ପସନ୍ଦ ହଟିଯାଏ।

strings.source: Microphone sound is analysed on your device to estimate pitch. Audio is not saved or uploaded. Microphone access stops when you leave an active tuning or practice screen. You can revoke access in Android Settings.
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ଅନୁମାନ ପାଇଁ ମାଇକ୍ରୋଫୋନ୍ ଶବ୍ଦ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଡିଭାଇସ୍‌ରେ ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ ହୁଏ। ଅଡିଓ ସଞ୍ଚୟ କିମ୍ବା ଅପଲୋଡ୍ ହୁଏନି। ସକ୍ରିୟ ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ ବା ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ସ୍କ୍ରିନ୍ ଛାଡ଼ିଲେ ମାଇକ୍ରୋଫୋନ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। Android ସେଟିଂସ୍‌ରେ ଅନୁମତି ଫେରାଇ ନେଇପାରିବେ।

strings.source: The full instrument collection, singing practice and Studio are available through one permanent purchase, with no recurring charge. Google Play handles payment and purchase restoration. Open Purchase and restore in Settings to restore your access. If you already own an older subscription, its management remains available through Google Play.
strings.translation: ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବାଦ୍ୟଯନ୍ତ୍ର ସଂଗ୍ରହ, ଗାୟନ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଓ ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ଥାୟୀ କ୍ରୟରେ ମିଳେ, ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତ ଦେୟ ନାହିଁ। Google Play ଦେୟ ଓ କ୍ରୟ ପୁନଃସ୍ଥାପନ ପରିଚାଳନା କରେ। ସୁବିଧା ପୁନଃସ୍ଥାପନ ପାଇଁ ସେଟିଂସ୍‌ରେ କ୍ରୟ ଓ ପୁନଃସ୍ଥାପନ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ। ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପୁରୁଣା ସଦସ୍ୟତା ଥିଲେ Google Play ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ତାହାର ପରିଚାଳନା ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ରହେ।

strings.source: Review access is active on this device.
strings.translation: ଏହି ଡିଭାଇସ୍‌ରେ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ପ୍ରବେଶ ସକ୍ରିୟ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Instrument tuning, voice practice and rhythm tools.
strings.translation: ବାଦ୍ୟଯନ୍ତ୍ର ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ, କଣ୍ଠସ୍ୱର ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଓ ଛନ୍ଦ ଉପକରଣ।

strings.source: Pitch readings depend on your microphone, room noise and instrument. Wait for a stable reading and tune gently. Singing feedback measures pitch and steadiness; it is not a medical assessment or a measurement of breath support.
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ପଠନ ମାଇକ୍ରୋଫୋନ୍, କୋଠରିର ଶବ୍ଦ ଓ ବାଦ୍ୟଯନ୍ତ୍ର ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ। ସ୍ଥିର ପଠନକୁ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଧୀରେ ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ। ଗାୟନ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ଓ ସ୍ଥିରତା ମାପେ; ଏହା ଚିକିତ୍ସା ମୂଲ୍ୟାୟନ କିମ୍ବା ଶ୍ୱାସ ସହାୟତାର ମାପ ନୁହେଁ।

strings.source: The free instruments remain available. Restore purchases if you expected access on this account.

strings.source: The microphone measures pitch in real time. Your audio stays on this device and is never recorded or uploaded.
strings.translation: ମାଇକ୍ରୋଫୋନ୍ ତତ୍କ୍ଷଣାତ୍ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ମାପେ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଅଡିଓ ଏହି ଡିଭାଇସ୍‌ରେ ରହେ ଓ କେବେ ବି ରେକର୍ଡ କିମ୍ବା ଅପଲୋଡ୍ ହୁଏନି।

strings.source: Check that your oud and strings are made for Turkish tuning. Do not raise an Arabic string set to these notes.

strings.source: Paused. The microphone is off and your last reading is kept.
strings.translation: ବିରାମରେ। ମାଇକ୍ରୋଫୋନ୍ ବନ୍ଦ ଅଛି ଓ ଶେଷ ପଠନ ରଖାଯାଇଛି।

strings.translation: ଆଧାର ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତା’ପରେ ନିଜ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: We could not load a tuning preset.

strings.translation: ଶୁଣିବା ବନ୍ଦ ଅଛି। ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେଲେ ପୁଣି ସୁର ମିଳାଇପାରିବେ।

strings.source: Almost there. Hold steady to confirm.
strings.translation: ପ୍ରାୟ ମିଳିଗଲା। ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରିବାକୁ ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.translation: କ୍ରୟ ବିନା ତିନୋଟି ବାଦ୍ୟଯନ୍ତ୍ର ମିଳେ। ଗୋଟିଏ କ୍ରୟରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସଂଗ୍ରହ, ଗାୟନ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଓ ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ଖୋଲେ।

strings.source: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are not saved or uploaded.
strings.translation: ମାଇକ୍ରୋଫୋନ୍ ଅଡିଓ ଏହି ଡିଭାଇସ୍‌ରେ ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ ହୁଏ। ରେକର୍ଡିଂ ସଞ୍ଚୟ କିମ୍ବା ଅପଲୋଡ୍ ହୁଏନି।

strings.source: Choose a concert pitch or enter a value from 415 to 466 Hz.
strings.translation: କନ୍‌ସର୍ଟ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା 415 ରୁ 466 Hz ମଧ୍ୟରେ ମାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Change displayed names for transposing instruments or capo shapes. Measured pitch and tuning frequency stay unchanged.
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରୀ ବାଦ୍ୟଯନ୍ତ୍ର ବା କାପୋ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ପାଇଁ ଦେଖାଯାଉଥିବା ନାମ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ। ମାପାଯାଇଥିବା ସ୍ୱର ଓ ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ ଆବୃତ୍ତି ବଦଳେନି।

strings.source: Review your sessions and measured progress with full access.
strings.translation: ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସୁବିଧା ସହ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଓ ମାପାଯାଇଥିବା ପ୍ରଗତି ସମୀକ୍ଷା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: We could not load this instrument.
The first beat is accented. Playback stops when you leave Studio.
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଜୋର ଦିଆଯାଏ। ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ଛାଡ଼ିଲେ ବାଦନ ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: No tuning presets are available for this instrument.
strings.translation: ଏହି ବାଦ୍ୟଯନ୍ତ୍ର ପାଇଁ ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ ପ୍ରିସେଟ୍ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: Metronome playback is unavailable. Try again.
strings.translation: ମେଟ୍ରୋନୋମ୍ ବାଦନ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ନୁହେଁ। ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Preview your rhythm setup. Playback and tap tempo are part of the one-time unlock.
strings.translation: ଛନ୍ଦ ସଜାଣ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ। ବାଦନ ଓ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ବେଗ ଏକକାଳୀନ କ୍ରୟର ଅଂଶ।

strings.source: Practice summaries stay on this device.
Tap again to set the tempo
strings.translation: ବେଗ ସ୍ଥିର କରିବାକୁ ପୁଣି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ

strings.source: An easy note, without a score
Pitch graph. Target %1$@, tolerance plus or minus %2$d cents. No measured pitch yet.
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ଗ୍ରାଫ୍। ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ %1$@, ସହନସୀମା ଯୁକ୍ତ ବା ବିଯୁକ୍ତ %2$d ସେଣ୍ଟ। ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ମାପାଯାଇନି।

strings.source: Measured pitch relative to each target. Current target %1$@; shaded band is plus or minus %2$d cents.
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ତୁଳନାରେ ମାପାଯାଇଥିବା ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା। ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ %1$@; ଛାୟାଯୁକ୍ତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଯୁକ୍ତ ବା ବିଯୁକ୍ତ %2$d ସେଣ୍ଟ।

strings.source: One clear note. Reduce background sound.
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ସ୍ୱର। ପୃଷ୍ଠଭୂମିର ଶବ୍ଦ କମାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing a little closer to the microphone.

strings.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଅଧିକ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Inside the band. Keep it steady.
A little higher. Follow the line.
A little lower. Follow the line.

strings.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଅଧିକ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Allow microphone access to practise, then try again.
strings.translation: ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ପାଇଁ ମାଇକ୍ରୋଫୋନ୍ ଅନୁମତି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତା’ପରେ ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Microphone capture stopped. Check access and try again.
strings.translation: ମାଇକ୍ରୋଫୋନ୍ ଇନ୍‌ପୁଟ୍ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଅନୁମତି ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରି ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Confirm full access to begin singing practice.
strings.translation: ଗାୟନ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଆରମ୍ଭ ପାଇଁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସୁବିଧା ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Singing practice is included in the one-time full unlock.
strings.translation: ଗାୟନ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଏକକାଳୀନ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କ୍ରୟରେ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ।

strings.source: Hear the target, then sing a comfortable, steady note.
strings.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତା’ପରେ ଆରାମରେ ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ୱର ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Listen first. Start when you are ready.
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେଲେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Try a longer, continuous note for a measured result.
strings.translation: ମାପାଯାଇଥିବା ଫଳ ପାଇଁ ଅଧିକ ଦୀର୍ଘ, ଲଗାତାର ସ୍ୱର ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: No clear voice detected. Move closer and try again.
strings.translation: ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କଣ୍ଠସ୍ୱର ମିଳିଲା ନାହିଁ। ପାଖକୁ ଆସି ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Pattern complete. Ready for the next step.
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ୟାସ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ।

strings.source: Hear the pattern, then sing each note in turn.
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତା’ପରେ କ୍ରମରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ୱର ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Payment is pending. Practice opens after Google Play confirms it.
strings.translation: ଦେୟ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ହେବା ଅପେକ୍ଷାରେ। Google Play ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କଲେ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଖୋଲିବ।

strings.source: Saved progress is unavailable. You can still start a fresh practice.
strings.translation: ସଞ୍ଚିତ ପ୍ରଗତି ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ନୁହେଁ। ତଥାପି ନୂଆ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିପାରିବେ।

strings.source: Your result is ready, but it could not be saved. Retry save to keep it.
strings.translation: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଫଳ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ, କିନ୍ତୁ ସଞ୍ଚୟ ହୋଇପାରିଲା ନାହିଁ। ରଖିବାକୁ ପୁଣି ସଞ୍ଚୟ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing each highlighted note. Follow your pitch line.
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଆଲୋକିତ ସ୍ୱର ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ। ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରର ରେଖା ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing the target. Follow your pitch line.
strings.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ। ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରର ରେଖା ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Practice stopped. Start again when you are ready.
strings.translation: ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେଲେ ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Target held. Ready for the next step.
strings.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ଧରିଲେ। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ।

strings.source: Try again. Keep your pitch inside the shaded band.
strings.translation: ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଛାୟାଯୁକ୍ତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Notes you reached in this walk.

strings.translation: ସହଜ ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ତଳକୁ ଓ ଉପରକୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଚାପ ପଡ଼ୁଥିବା ସ୍ୱର ଛାଡ଼ିଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସବୁଠାରୁ ମୋଟା ତାରର ସ୍ୱର ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ। ବଜାଇବାବେଳେ ଏହା ମୁହଁର ସବୁଠାରୁ ପାଖରେ ରହେ। ଏହାକୁ ତାର 6 କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ତାର ପାଇଁ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ଅଛି। ତାହା ବୁଲାଇଲେ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ବଦଳେ। Timbre ଶୁଣି କେଉଁ ଦିଗରେ ବୁଲାଇବେ ଜଣାଏ।

strings.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେରୀର ଛୋଟ ମେଣ୍ଢା ପାଇଁ ତିନି ସ୍ୱର ଦରକାର: ଖୋଲା ତାର 2 ହେଉଛି B, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ହେଉଛି A, ଓ ଖୋଲା ତାର 3 ହେଉଛି G। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ A ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା A।

strings.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: B A G A B B B: ଖୋଲା ତାର 2, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 3।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ଅଧା ହେଉଛି ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା। କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ବାଜେ।

strings.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ରୁ ତାର 1 କୁ ଯିବା ପାଇଁ ଅଳ୍ପ ଗତି ଦରକାର। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ରହିବାକୁ ବଜାଇବା ହାତ ତାର ପାଖରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା ତାର 1। ତାର ବଜାଇବାବେଳେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ରେ C ଓ D, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 1 ରେ E, F ଓ G।

strings.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁର Beethoven ଙ୍କ ନବମ ସିମ୍ଫୋନିରୁ ଆସିଛି। ଏଥିରେ C, D, E, F ଓ G ଅଛି, ଓ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସମୟରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ନିକଟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି, ଧୀରେ: E E F G G F E D।

strings.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତା’ପରେ: C C D E E D D।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ଶେଷରେ ଏକ ଲୟ ଅଛି: ଦୀର୍ଘ ସ୍ୱର, ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱର, ତା’ପରେ ଧରିଥିବା ସ୍ୱର। ଏକ-ଓ-ଦୁଇ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ଓ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ‘ଓ’ ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଶିଶୁଗୀତ C, D ଓ E ରେ ଚାଲେ, ତା’ପରେ G କୁ ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ। ଡିଆଁଟି ଖୋଲା ତାର 1 ରୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ।

strings.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ରେ D D D, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 1 ରେ E ଓ G।

strings.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଜୋତା ବାକ୍ସରେ ଚିଠି ହେଉଛି Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ, C ରେ ଏକ ଧୀର ବାଲାଡ୍। ମୁଖଡ଼ା ତାର 1 ଓ 2 ରେ ଅଛି; ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଅଂଶର ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଆନନ୍ଦର ଗୀତର ଦୀର୍ଘ-ଛୋଟ ଲୟ ଅଛି। ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଗୀତ, ଗୀତ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଅଂଶ: ତାର 2 ରେ C ଓ D, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 1 ରେ E, F ଓ G, ଓ ପୁଣି D।

strings.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ପୋଲ ପରି ବକ୍ର କରି ଅଗରେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ତଳ ତାରକୁ ଛୁଇଁବ ନାହିଁ। ଛୋଟ ନଖ ରଖିଲେ ଏହା ବହୁତ ସହଜ।

strings.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.

strings.translation: ମୋଟାରୁ ପତଳା ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ତାର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ନିଷ୍ପ୍ରଭ ଶବ୍ଦ ମାନେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ସେହି ତାରକୁ ଛୁଉଁଛି। ସଜାଡ଼ି ପୁଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.

strings.translation: E ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ରଖି ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ସେହି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ମେଜର୍ କରେ।

strings.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ ହେଉଛି E ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ପତଳା ତାର ଆଡ଼କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇବା: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଓ 3 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ।

strings.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.

strings.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: E ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ A ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଓ 3 ଏକାସାଙ୍ଗରେ ତାର 4 ଓ 3 କୁ ଯାଏ। ତା’ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 2 ରେ ରହେ। ହାତ ଖୁବ୍ କମ୍ ଘୁଞ୍ଚେ।

strings.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.

strings.translation: A ରୁ E କୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଘୁଞ୍ଚେ। ଉଠାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଭାବନ୍ତୁ, ତା’ପରେ ତିନୋଟିକୁ ଏକାସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 5 ଆଡ଼କୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.

strings.translation: ଡ୍ୟାଶବୋର୍ଡରେ ଧୂଳି ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ରେ କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ସଙ୍ଗୀତ। ପ୍ରତି ପଦ ଦୁଇ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ E ଓ ଦୁଇ A ରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ। ଏହି ବଦଳ ଏବେ ଶିଖିଲେ। ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଭାବି ଆଗୁଆ ଘୁଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ବାଜେ। ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତଳକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ଜୋରରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଚାରି।

strings.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.

strings.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭଟା ବେଳର ରେଡିଓ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: E ମାଇନର୍ ଓ A ରେ ଆରାମଦାୟକ ରେଗେ। ଗିଟାର୍ କେବଳ ‘ଓ’ ରେ ବାଜେ। ହାତ ତଳ-ଉପର ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ସଂଖ୍ୟାରେ ତାର ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପ୍ରତି ‘ଓ’ ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.translation: ବେସ୍ ଓ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟାରେ ତାଳ ରଖନ୍ତି। ଗିଟାର୍ ମଝିରେ, ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ।

strings.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.

strings.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C ସିଡ଼ି ପରି ଚଢ଼େ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ।

strings.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। ସେଠାରୁ ଝଙ୍କାର ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A minor to C: one finger
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଓ 2 ନିଜ ଜାଗାରେ ରହେ। କେବଳ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3, ତାର 3 ରୁ ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 କୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ରେ ହାତ ଖୋଲେ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। ସବୁ ଛଅ ତାର ବାଜେ।

strings.source: In G, which strings ring open?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: G ରେ କେଉଁ ତାର ଖୋଲା ବାଜେ?

strings.source: When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାଇଲେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ତାରର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରଥମେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଝଙ୍କାରରେ ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ପ୍ରଥମେ ବାଜେ, ତେଣୁ ବାକି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପାଇଁ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତେ ସମୟ ମିଳେ।

strings.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ସବୁଠାରୁ ପତଳା ତିନି ତାରରେ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ।

strings.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?

strings.translation: D ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଖୋଲା ତାର 4। ତାର 5 ଓ 6 ନିରବ ରହେ।

strings.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ମାଇନର୍ ପାଇଁ ତାର 1 ର ସ୍ୱର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 କୁ ଖସେ। ପୁଣି ସଜାନ୍ତୁ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 1 ରେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3 ରେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 2 ରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.

strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଗୀତର ଆଧାର। G ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ G, C ଓ D କର୍ଡ ମୁଖ୍ୟ କାମ କରେ। ଅସଂଖ୍ୟ ଲୋକଗୀତ ଓ ରକ୍ ଗୀତ କେବଳ ଏହି ତିନୋଟି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ।

strings.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.

strings.translation: ପୁଣି ପୁଣି ବାଜୁଥିବା କର୍ଡକ୍ରମକୁ ପ୍ରଗ୍ରେସନ୍ କୁହାଯାଏ। A ମାଇନର୍, C, G, D ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଭାବେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇ ଚଢ଼ିବା ସହ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ହୁଏ।

strings.translation: ଏକ ମିନିଟ୍‌ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ କ’ଣ ଗଣନ୍ତି?

strings.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.

strings.translation: ଗୁଡ଼ିର ପାଗ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: G, D, E ମାଇନର୍ ଓ C ରେ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପଫାୟାର୍ ପପ୍, ପୁଣି ପୁଣି। ଆଗୁଆ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ନିମ୍ନତମ ତାରର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରଥମେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.

strings.translation: D ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଖୋଲା ତାର 4, ତେଣୁ ତାର 5 ଓ 6 ନିରବ ରହେ।

strings.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.

strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 3 ହେଉଛି G। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ରଖିଲେ A ମିଳେ। ସମାନ ନିୟମ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ମିଳେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ରେ G ଓ A, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 2 ରେ B, C ଓ D।

strings.source: G up to D and back
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 6 (along) · title
strings.translation: G ରୁ D କୁ ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ

Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 4 ହେଉଛି D। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ହେଉଛି E ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ହେଉଛି F। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପହଞ୍ଚିବାକୁ ନେକ୍ ପଛରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତଳେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ତା’ପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3: E, ତା’ପରେ F।

strings.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 4 ଓ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର ସମାନ ନାମ କ’ଣ?

strings.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉଭୟ D, ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଅନ୍ତରରେ: ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରନାମ, ଗୋଟିଏ ଅନ୍ୟଠାରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 4 ରେ D, E ଓ F, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 3 ରେ G ଓ A।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 7 (along) · title

strings.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା C, ଯେଉଁଠୁ C ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା C।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଷରରୁ ସେହି ଅକ୍ଷରର ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରକୁ କ୍ରମେ ଚଢ଼େ। C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ କେବଳ ସାଧାରଣ ଅକ୍ଷରନାମ: C D E F G A B C।

strings.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2। ଧୀରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: How many different letter names are in C major?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ କେତେ ଭିନ୍ନ ଅକ୍ଷରନାମ ଅଛି?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: C D E F G A B, then C again an octave higher.

strings.translation: C D E F G A B, ତା’ପରେ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉଚ୍ଚରେ ପୁଣି C।

strings.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଆଧ୍ୟାତ୍ମିକ ଗୀତ ଜାଜ୍‌ର ମାନକ ଗୀତ ହେଲା। ଏଥିରେ ତାର 5, 4 ଓ 3 ରେ C, D, E, F ଓ G ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ।

strings.source: The opening: C, E, F, then open G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: C, E, F, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା G।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into a strong beat. Here beat one is silent, and C, E and F lead into a long G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଜୋର ମାତ୍ରା ପୂର୍ବର କିଛି ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପିକ୍‌ଅପ୍ କୁହାଯାଏ। ଏଠାରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ନିରବ, ଓ C, E, F ପରେ ଦୀର୍ଘ G ଆସେ।

strings.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମୁଖଡ଼ା: E E D C, ତା’ପରେ C E G G G F।

strings.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ଏକରେ ଜୋର। ଏହାର ସ୍ୱର ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: How many beats are in each bar here?

strings.source: A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ମୃଦୁ ଦୋଳନ ପରି: ଜୋର, ମୃଦୁ, ମୃଦୁ।

strings.source: The opening: D, G, B G, B, A. Open strings 4, 3 and 2, plus A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: D, G, B G, B, A। ଖୋଲା ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2, ସହିତ A।

strings.source: Then down: G, E, D, D.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତା’ପରେ ତଳକୁ: G, E, D, D।

strings.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ ଅଂଶ: ଖୋଲା B ରୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D କୁ, ତା’ପରେ B, G ଓ A ଦେଇ ତଳକୁ।

strings.source: Halogen is a Timbre Original: desert rock in D minor. Its riff uses the notes you just learned: open D, F at fret 3, open G, and C on string 5, fret 3. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାଲୋଜେନ୍ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: D ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ଡେଜର୍ଟ ରକ୍। ରିଫ୍‌ରେ ଏବେ ଶିଖିଥିବା ସ୍ୱର: ଖୋଲା D, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ F, ଖୋଲା G, ଓ ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ C। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ F, ଖୋଲା ତାର 3, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ C।

strings.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଛୋଟ F ଚାରି ତାରରେ ବାଜେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ତାର 1 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ସମତଳ ରହେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ, ଓ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 କୁ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପଟକୁ ଟିକିଏ କାତ କରନ୍ତୁ। କଠିନ ଧାରରେ ଦୁଇ ତାର ସହଜରେ ଚାପିହୁଏ। ତାର 2 ବାଜୁଛି କି ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି କର୍ଡକ୍ରମ A ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ ଧୀରେ ଚଢ଼ି ନୂଆ F ରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ। ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡ ଦୁଇଥର ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ଆଗୁଆ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଇଂରାଜୀ ସୁର 400 ବର୍ଷରୁ ଅଧିକ ପୁରୁଣା। ସବୁ କର୍ଡ ପରିଚିତ: A ମାଇନର୍, C, G, E ମାଇନର୍, F ଓ E। ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଥରେ, ତା’ପରେ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.translation: ଛୋଟ F ତାର 4 ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ସେଠାରୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ତାର 5 ଓ 6 ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶାର୍ପ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉଚ୍ଚ କରେ। ସବୁଜ ଆସ୍ତିନରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ ଓ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ଅଛି। ଶେଷଟି କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G ଶାର୍ପ, A, B: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ଓ 2, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା ତାର 2।

strings.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: A, C D, E F E, D B।

strings.translation: ଶାର୍ପ ମାନେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ। G ଶାର୍ପ, G ଓ A ମଝିରେ ରହେ।

Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡରେ ଆଉ ଏକ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ିହୁଏ, ଯାହା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଟାଣେ। D7, G କୁ ଯିବାକୁ ଚାହେଁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: 2 ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ; 1 ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ; 3 ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1880 ଦଶକର ଏହି ଆମେରିକୀୟ ବାଲାଡ୍ ପାଇଁ କେବଳ G ଓ D7 ଦରକାର। ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ପରି ଏହା ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଥରେ, ତା’ପରେ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କ୍ଲେମେଣ୍ଟାଇନ୍‌ର ସୁର ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ରେ ଅଛି। ଶେଷ ପଙ୍କ୍ତିରେ ପୁଣି F ଶାର୍ପ: ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

strings.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: G G G, ତଳକୁ ଖୋଲା D, ଉପରକୁ ଖୋଲା B।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D7 ର ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର G ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ। G ଆସିଲେ ସେହି ଟାଣ ମେଣ୍ଟେ।

strings.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି: A, ଖୋଲା D, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, A, ତା’ପରେ ମୂଳ G କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭୂତ ଆଲୋକ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: ଧୀର, ଗମ୍ଭୀର ବାଲାଡ୍। ପଦ A ମାଇନର୍, F, C ଓ E ରେ ଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଛୋଟ F ଏବେ ଗୀତରେ ବାଜେ। E ର G ଶାର୍ପ ସୁରକୁ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରାଏ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପଦର ଶେଷ କର୍ଡ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ। ମେଜର୍ ନା ମାଇନର୍?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାଲାଡ୍ ଝଙ୍କାର: ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ବଡ଼ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତୃତୀୟରେ ଆଉ ଥରେ, ଚତୁର୍ଥରେ ତଳ-ଉପର। ପ୍ରତି ଝଙ୍କାର ପରର ବିରାମ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗୀତର ଅଂଶ।

strings.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପଦର ଶେଷ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି: ଖୋଲା B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C, B, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ, B, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା E।

Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.

strings.translation: ନୂଆ କିଛି ନାହିଁ: ଛୋଟ F, D7 ଓ ଏହି ଏକକର ଦୁଇ ଗୀତ। ଆଗୁଆ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସୁରକୁ ଗାଇବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.

strings.translation: E7, A7, G7 ଓ B7, ସସ୍ କର୍ଡ, ଶଫଲ୍ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍।

strings.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: E ବଜାଇ ତାର 4 ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ। ବାଜୁଥିବା ଖୋଲା D ହେଉଛି ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର, ଯାହା ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ର ଟାଣ ଯୋଡ଼େ।

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ବଜାଇ ତାର 3 ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା G ବାଜେ, ଓ A, A7 ହୁଏ।

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G7 ନିମ୍ନ G ରଖି ଉପରେ F ଯୋଡ଼େ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 5 ରୁ B7 ସଜାନ୍ତୁ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ। ତାର 2 ଖୋଲା ବାଜେ।

strings.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: B7 ସବୁଠାରୁ ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ଭାବେ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡକୁ ନିଏ?

strings.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: B7, E ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ। E ମାଇନର୍ ବା E ରେ ତାହାର ଟାଣ ମେଣ୍ଟେ।

strings.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶଫଲ୍ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଅସମାନ ଭାଗ କରେ: ତଳକୁ ଦୀର୍ଘ ଝଙ୍କାର, ଉପରକୁ ଛୋଟ। ଏହା ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ର ହୃଦସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ। ଭାବନ୍ତୁ ହମ୍-ଟି, ଡମ୍-ଟି।

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅନେକ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଗୀତ ଗୋଟିଏ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଯୋଜନା ଅନୁସରଣ କରେ। E ରେ: ଚାରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ E7, ଦୁଇ A7, ଦୁଇ E7, ତା’ପରେ B7, A7, E7 ଓ B7 ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଗୋଟିଏ।

strings.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ କେତେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ E7 ଥାଏ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଚାରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଶୀଘ୍ର ବଦଳେ: B7, A7, E7, ତା’ପରେ B7, ଯାହା ଆରମ୍ଭକୁ ଫେରାଏ। ଆଗୁଆ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଶଫଲ୍ ଜାରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସସ୍ କର୍ଡ ମେଜର୍ ବା ମାଇନର୍ କରୁଥିବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପାଖ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ବଦଳାଏ। ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଖୋଲା ଓ ଅମୀମାଂସିତ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Dsus2 ପାଇଁ ତାର 1 ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ। Asus4 ପାଇଁ A ବଜାଇ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶିଳ୍ପାଞ୍ଚଳର ଶଫଲ୍ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: E ରେ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍, ଏବେ ବଜାଇଥିବା ଯୋଜନା ଉପରେ ଦୋଳାୟିତ ସୁର। ଦୁଇ ହାତରେ ଦୀର୍ଘ-ଛୋଟ ଲୟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା B: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍।

strings.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ G ରୁ G ଶାର୍ପକୁ ଯାଏ। କେଉଁଟି E7 ରେ ଅଛି?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: E7 ହେଉଛି E, G ଶାର୍ପ, B ଓ D। G ହେଉଛି ବ୍ଲୁ ସ୍ୱର: କର୍ଡ ସହ ଟାଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରି ତା’ପରେ ତାହା ଭିତରକୁ ଖସେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 5 (along) · title

strings.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ନବମ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, B7 ଉପରେ: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ D ଶାର୍ପ, ତା’ପରେ B।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୂଆ କିଛି ନାହିଁ: ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ, ସସ୍ କର୍ଡ ଓ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଶଫଲ୍। ପ୍ରତି ବଦଳରେ ଦୀର୍ଘ-ଛୋଟ ଦୋଳନ ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which chord uses all four fingers?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ କର୍ଡରେ ସବୁ ଚାରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଲାଗେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 “Power chords and riffs” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ଓ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଯୋଗ୍ୟ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ, ପାପୁଲିରେ ଶବ୍ଦ ରୋକିବା ଓ ନିଜର ରିଫ୍।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡରେ କେବଳ ମୂଳ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱର, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ପାଞ୍ଚ ଅକ୍ଷର ଉପରର ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ। ମେଜର୍ ବା ମାଇନର୍ ନୁହେଁ, ଜୋରରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦୃଢ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। E5 ହେଉଛି E ମାଇନର୍‌ର ନିମ୍ନ ଅଂଶ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ ଦୁଇ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 4 ଓ 3 କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା ତାର 5 ସହ ଏହା A5। କେବଳ ତାର 5, 4 ଓ 3 ରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which notes make a power chord?

strings.source: Rest the edge of your hand
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବଜାଇବା ହାତର ବାହାର ଧାର ତାର ଉପରେ, ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ସହ ମିଳିଥିବା ଜାଗାରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଝଙ୍କାର କଲେ ସ୍ୱର ଛୋଟ ଓ ଠସ୍‌ଠସ୍ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପାପୁଲିରେ ଶବ୍ଦ ରୋକିବାକୁ ହାତ କେଉଁଠି ରଖନ୍ତି?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ତାର ବାଜେ, କେବଳ ଛୋଟ ସମୟ ପାଇଁ। ଆଗକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚିଲେ ଶବ୍ଦ ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରକ୍‌ରେ ମ୍ୟୁଟ୍ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରୁ ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡକୁ ଯାଏ। ବଡ଼ ଝଙ୍କାର ପାଇଁ ପାପୁଲି ଉଠାଇ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ, ତା’ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ ତାର 5 ଓ 4 ରେ। ଏହା G5। ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇଲେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ନାମ ବଦଳେ।

strings.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ। ଏହା କେଉଁ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 6 ରେ ଉପରକୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: ଖୋଲା E, 1 ରେ F, 3 ରେ G, 5 ରେ A।

strings.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ତାର 5 ରୁ ମଧ୍ୟ କାମ କରେ। ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖିଲେ C5। ତାର 6 ନିରବ ରଖିବାକୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ର ଅଗରେ ଛୁଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରିଫ୍ ହେଉଛି ପୁଣି ପୁଣି ବାଜୁଥିବା ଛୋଟ, ମନଛୁଆଁ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ। ଏହା ଖୋଲା ନିମ୍ନ E କୁ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଫେରେ। ଟାଇଟ୍ ଶବ୍ଦ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ପାପୁଲି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା A।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ତାର 5 ରେ ଚଢ଼େ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ତା’ପରେ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ପୁଣି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ପାଖରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 5: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ପୁଣି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2।

strings.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.

strings.translation: G ରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ A। ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସହ କର୍ଡର ନାମ ବଦଳେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତଳଘରର ପାଗ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ରେ ଗ୍ୟାରେଜ୍ ରକ୍। ନିମ୍ନ ତାରର ରିଫ୍‌ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ, ତା’ପରେ ଏକ, ଦୁଇର ‘ଓ’ ଓ ଚାରିରେ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ। ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ପାପୁଲି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା A, ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ C, ଖୋଲା D, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G ଓ ଖୋଲା ନିମ୍ନ E।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C5 ଜାଣିଛନ୍ତି: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। ପୂରା ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇଲେ D5। G5 ମଧ୍ୟ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ, C5 ଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ନିମ୍ନ ତାରରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୂଆ କିଛି ନାହିଁ: ଖୋଲା ଓ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଯୋଗ୍ୟ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ, ପାପୁଲିରେ ଶବ୍ଦ ରୋକିବା ଓ ନିଜ ରିଫ୍। କ୍ଲିକ୍ ସହ ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମ୍ୟୁଟ୍ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। କେଉଁ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.

strings.translation: ତାର 5, A ରୁ ଚଢ଼େ: 2 ରେ B, 3 ରେ C।

strings.source: The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 “Barre chords and the pentatonic” · unit summary
strings.translation: F ବାରେ ଓ B ମାଇନର୍, A ମାଇନର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଏକକ ବାଦନ।

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପୂରା ବାରେ କର୍ଡ ଶିଖିବାକୁ କିଛି ସପ୍ତାହ ଲାଗେ, ତେଣୁ ଧୀରେ ଆଗାନ୍ତୁ। ଛୋଟ F ଜାଣିଛନ୍ତି। ପରେ ପାଞ୍ଚ ତାରର F, ତା’ପରେ ପୂରା ବାରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପାଞ୍ଚ ତାର ବାଜେ ଓ F ଅଧିକ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ବାରେ କର୍ଡ ପ୍ରଥମେ କଠିନ ଲାଗେ। କ’ଣ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Squeezing as hard as you can

strings.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଶକ୍ତି ଓ ଅନୁଭବ ଧୀରେ ବଢ଼େ। ଗୋଟିଏ ଲମ୍ବା, କଷ୍ଟଦାୟକ ଅଭ୍ୟାସଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ଦୈନିକ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଭଲ।

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ସବୁ ଛଅ ତାର ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ସମତଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, 3 ଓ 4 ତା’ଆଗରେ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ କରେ। F ହେଉଛି E କୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେବା।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନେକ୍‌କୁ ଧୀରେ ନିଜ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣିବା ପରି ବାହୁର ଓଜନରେ ବାରେ ଚାପ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କେବଳ ସ୍ଥିର ରଖେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 କୁ ଧାର ଉପରେ କାତ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 4 (along) · title

strings.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: F ବାରେ କେଉଁ ଖୋଲା ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ ହୁଏ?

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତାର 1 ରୁ 5 ଚାପେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, 3 ଓ 4 ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ କରେ। ତାର 6 ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାରେ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ନୁହନ୍ତି? କେବଳ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚାରି ତାର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ତାର 4 ଓ 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2।

strings.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E କୁ ବାରେ ସହ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ହୁଏ?

strings.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ଥାଏ। A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ A, C, D, E ଓ G। ଅସଂଖ୍ୟ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଓ ରକ୍ ଏକକ ବାଦନର ଏହି ଧ୍ୱନି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ତାରର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଚାପେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ଓ 8 ନିଅନ୍ତି। ପ୍ରତି ତାରରେ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର, ପ୍ରତି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌କୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

strings.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 6 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 8, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 5 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7।

strings.source: A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏକକ ବାଦନ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡର ସୁର। କିଛି ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ବିରାମ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତା’ପରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ମୂଳ A ରେ ଶେଷ କଲେ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣଚ୍ଛେଦ ପରି ଲାଗେ।

strings.source: Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-spotlight “Song spotlight: Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କାଚର ଉପଗ୍ରହ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ମାଇନର୍, F, C ଓ G ରେ ପାୱାର୍ ବାଲାଡ୍। ପୂରା F ବାରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ କର୍ଡ; ବିନ୍ୟାସ 1 ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଚକ୍ରରେ ମେଳ ଖାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଏକକ ବାଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପିକ୍ ବଦଳରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର ଟାଣି ବଜାଇବାକୁ ଫିଙ୍ଗର୍ପିକିଂ କୁହାଯାଏ। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବେସ୍ ତାର 6, 5 ଓ 4 ବଜାଏ, ଏବଂ ବେସ୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ପରି ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତାଳ ଦିଏ।

strings.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: କେବଳ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ତାର 6, 5 ଓ 4 କୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ତଳକୁ ଠେଲି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ ଧରନ୍ତୁ। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତାର 4 ରେ କର୍ଡର ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ମୂଳ, ପଞ୍ଚମ, ମୂଳ, ପଞ୍ଚମ: ଏହା ହେଉଛି ପାଳିକରି ବଜାଯାଉଥିବା ବେସ୍।

strings.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫିଙ୍ଗର୍ଷ୍ଟାଇଲ୍‌ରେ ସ୍ପାନିଶ୍ ନାମର ଅକ୍ଷର ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ: p ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, i ତର୍ଜନୀ, m ମଧ୍ୟମା, a ଅନାମିକା। ବଜାଇବା ପାଇଁ i କୁ ତାର 3, m କୁ ତାର 2 ଓ a କୁ ତାର 1 ଉପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: i, m, a: ତର୍ଜନୀ ତାର 3 ରେ, ମଧ୍ୟମା 2 ରେ, ଅନାମିକା 1 ରେ।

strings.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.

strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଚଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାହାର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଝିରେ m ତାର 2 ଓ i ତାର 3 ବଜାଏ: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, m, ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, i। ସହଜରେ ଚାଲିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଧୀରେ କରନ୍ତୁ।
