strings.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆର୍ପେଜିଓରେ କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ବଜାଯାଏ। ଏଠାରେ କ୍ରମ p, i, m, a, ତାପରେ ଫେରିବା ବେଳେ m, i। ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଛଅଟି ସ୍ୱର, ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୁଇଟି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 2 (along) · title

strings.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: a ତାର 1 ବଜାଇବା ପରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଆସେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉପରେ ପହଞ୍ଚି କ୍ରମ ଫେରେ: p, i, m, a, ତାପରେ ଫେରିବା ବେଳେ m ଓ i।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ: A ମାଇନର୍, F, C, G, ତାପରେ A ମାଇନର୍, F, E, A ମାଇନର୍। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରତି ନୂଆ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଧରେ: ତାର 5, 4, 5 ଓ 6।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାରଣ୍ଡାର ଆଲୋକ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: D ରେ ଏକ ଧୀର ଗୀତ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତାପରେ i, m ଓ a ଦ୍ୱାରା ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱର ଆସିବା ଯାଏଁ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: D ରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କେଉଁ ତାର ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଖୋଲା ତାର 4। ଏହି କର୍ଡରେ ତାର 5 ଓ 6 ନିରବ ରହନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ପାଳିକରି ବେସ୍, p-i-m-a, ଟ୍ରାଭିସ୍ ପିକିଂ ଓ ଧୀର ଗୀତ। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ତାଳ ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: In p-i-m-a, which letter is the thumb?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: p-i-m-a ରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କେଉଁ ଅକ୍ଷର?

strings.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 3?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ସ୍ୱର ମଝିରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 3 ବଜାଏ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · title

strings.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · unit summary
strings.translation: A ରେ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍, ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ, ବୁଗି ବେସ୍ ଧାରା, ଟର୍ନ୍‌ଆରାଉଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଥମ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଲିକ୍।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ କର୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପ୍ରଥମ, ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରେ ଗଢ଼ା। E ରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ E7, A7 ଓ B7। A କୁ ଗଲେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ A7, D7 ଓ E7 ହୁଏ।

strings.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E ରେ B7 ର ଯେଉଁ ଭୂମିକା, A ରେ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡର ସେହି ଭୂମିକା?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: E ଠାରୁ ଅକ୍ଷର ଗଣିଲେ ପଞ୍ଚମରେ B, ତେଣୁ B7। A ଠାରୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ଅକ୍ଷର E, ତେଣୁ E7 ତାହାର ସ୍ଥାନ ନିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A7 ର ଚାରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, D7 ର ଦୁଇ, A7 ର ଦୁଇ, ତାପରେ E7, D7, A7 ଓ E7 ର ଗୋଟିଏ ଲେଖାଏଁ। ଶେଷ E7 ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଆରମ୍ଭକୁ ଫେରାଇ ନିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 2 ରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ କର୍ଡକୁ ଯାଇ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଫେରନ୍ତି। A ରେ: A7, D7, A7, A7। ଏହା ଆରମ୍ଭରୁ ଗତି ଆଣେ।

strings.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 2 ର କର୍ଡ କ’ଣ?

strings.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: A ର ଚତୁର୍ଥ କର୍ଡ D7। ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 2 ରେ ସେଠାକୁ ଯାଇ ପୁଣି A7 କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ଯେକୌଣସି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ହୁଏ। E ରେ: E7, A7, E7, E7। ଶେଷ ପାଖରେ ଚାରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର କର୍ଡ B7 ପ୍ରତି ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁଗି ଧାରା କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଉପରକୁ ଯାଇ ପୁଣି ଫେରେ; ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇଥର, ଶଫଲ୍ ପରି ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ। A7 ଉପରେ A, C ଶାର୍ପ, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G ଯାଏଁ ଉଠି ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ ଫେରେ।

strings.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା A, ତାର 5 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ତାର 4 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଓ 4, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା G।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଯୋଡ଼ିର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରର ଲୟ କିପରି ଲାଗେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପୁଣି ସେହି ଶଫଲ୍: ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଏକ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ମାତ୍ରାର ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଏକ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.source: Move it to D and E
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସେହି ଧାରା ତାର 4 ରେ D ରୁ ଏବଂ ତାର 6 ରେ E ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। D7 ଉପରେ: D, F ଶାର୍ପ, A, B, C। E7 ଉପରେ: E, G ଶାର୍ପ, B, C ଶାର୍ପ, D।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 7 (along) · title

strings.source: Boogie, A to D and back
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 8 (along) · title
strings.translation: ବୁଗି, A ରୁ D ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ

strings.source: A lick that turns you around
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 11 ଓ 12 ରେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଟର୍ନ୍‌ଆରାଉଣ୍ଡ ଥାଏ: ଆରମ୍ଭକୁ ଫେରାଇ ନେଉଥିବା ଛୋଟ ଲିକ୍। ଏଠାରେ A ରୁ E ଯାଏଁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ କରି ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା ତାର।

strings.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 4: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ତାପରେ 3, ତାପରେ 2। E ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଦୁଇ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ। ଆଉ ଥରେ ବଜାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଏହା କାନକୁ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 1 କୁ ଫେରାଇ ନିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଦଶ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ସହ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 11 ଓ 12 ରେ ଲିକ୍ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଏଭଳି ପ୍ରତି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ଶେଷ କରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆପଣଙ୍କ A ମାଇନର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ A ର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ସହ ଖାପ ଖାଏ। ଏହାର C, A7 ର C ଶାର୍ପ ସହ ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଏବଂ ସେହି ଘର୍ଷଣ ହିଁ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ର ଧ୍ୱନି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ଥିରତା ଦିଏ?

strings.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: A ହେଉଛି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର। A ରେ ଶେଷ ହେଉଥିବା ଲିକ୍ ସ୍ଥିର ଲାଗେ; G ଓ C ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣତାର ଅନୁଭବ ଛାଡ଼େ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ର ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପରସ୍ପର କଥା ହୁଅନ୍ତି। ଲିକ୍ 1 କୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଭାବେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନିମ୍ନ A ରେ ଶେଷ ହେଉଥିବା ଲିକ୍ 2 ରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିଅନ୍ ଆଲୋକର ଲଣ୍ଡ୍ରି ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: ଗୋଟିଏ କର୍ଡ A7 ଉପରେ ଫଙ୍କ୍। ଏହାର ଆକର୍ଷକ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ C ରୁ C ଶାର୍ପକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରେ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଲିକ୍ ପରି ସେହି ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଓ ମୁଖଡ଼ା E7 କୁ ଯାଏ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ତାପରେ ତାର 2 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ଓ 2 ର C ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା E।

strings.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A7 ଉପରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର କର୍ଡ ସହ ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: A7 ହେଉଛି A, C ଶାର୍ପ, E ଓ G। ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସର C ଏହାର C ଶାର୍ପ ସହ ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଏବଂ ଆକର୍ଷକ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ଗୋଟିକରୁ ଅନ୍ୟଟିକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିଅନ୍ ଆଲୋକର ଲଣ୍ଡ୍ରିରେ ଶଫଲ୍ ନାହିଁ। ବୁଗି ଧାରାକୁ ସମାନ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ରେ ବଜାଇଲେ ତାହା A7 ତଳେ ବେସ୍ ଧାରା ହୁଏ: A, C ଶାର୍ପ, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, ଓ ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: A ଓ E ରେ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍, ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ, ବୁଗି ଧାରା, ଟର୍ନ୍‌ଆରାଉଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଲିକ୍। ଶଫଲ୍‌ର ଦୋଳାୟମାନ ଲୟ ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E ରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 2 ର କର୍ଡ କ’ଣ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · title

strings.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · unit summary
strings.translation: ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍, ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍, ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍, ବେଣ୍ଡ୍ ଓ ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ, ଏବଂ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ।

Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍‌ରେ କେବଳ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଯାଏ। ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାର ଝଙ୍କାରି ଚାଲେ।

strings.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 3 ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଧରି ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଓ ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖିଲେ

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବଳଠାରୁ ବେଗ ଓ ଠିକ୍ ସ୍ଥାନ ଅଧିକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଅଗ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ତାର ଝଙ୍କାରି ଚାଲିବ।

strings.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍‌ରେ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି। ଦୁଇଟି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାରରେ ରଖି ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଉପର ସ୍ୱରର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଟାଣି ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଛାଡ଼ିବା ବେଳେ ତାର ବଜାଇଦେବ।

strings.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 କୁ ଟାଣି ଛାଡ଼ି ଖୋଲା G ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଓ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଓ 3। ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ଟାଣି ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସିଧା ଉପରକୁ ଉଠାଇଲେ ସ୍ୱର ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। ଅଳ୍ପ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଟାଣି ଛାଡ଼ିଲେ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜିଉଠେ।

strings.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରିବାକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଚାପ ବଜାୟ ରଖି ସେହି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ନୂଆ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌କୁ ସରାନ୍ତୁ। ଚାପ ଧ୍ୱନିକୁ ଧରି ରଖେ; କେବଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3। ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନଉଠାଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 କୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ ବେଳେ କ’ଣ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ବଜାୟ ରଖେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଚାପ କମାଇଲେ ସ୍ୱର ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। ନୂଆ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସମାନ ଚାପ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 ପିକ୍ କରି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 କୁ ତଳକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବେଣ୍ଡ୍‌ରେ ତାରକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଠେଲି ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ବଢ଼ାଯାଏ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ବେଣ୍ଡ୍, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ସମାନ ବୃଦ୍ଧି, ଠିକ୍ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 ପରି ଶୁଣାଯିବା ଦରକାର।

strings.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9: ଏହା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବେଣ୍ଡ୍‌ର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର। ଏହାକୁ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦେଇ ମନେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ସେହି ତାରରେ ତାହା ପଛରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଓ 2। ଦରଜାର ଗୋଲ ହାତଲ ଘୁରାଇବା ପରି ମଣିବନ୍ଧ ଘୁରାଇ ତିନୋଟିକୁ ଛାତ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଠେଲନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବେଣ୍ଡ୍ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 ଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ଶୁଣାଯାଉଛି। ଏବେ କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟରେ ନପହଞ୍ଚିଥିବା ବେଣ୍ଡ୍ ବେସୁରା ଲାଗେ। ଶୁଣିଥିବା ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ମିଳିବା ଯାଏଁ ଠେଲନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର, ତାପରେ ଏକ ଛୋଟ ବେଣ୍ଡ୍। ସ୍ୱର ସମାନ ନା ଭିନ୍ନ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ହେଉଛି ଧରି ରଖାଯାଇଥିବା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଛୋଟ ବେଣ୍ଡ୍ କରି ଛାଡ଼ିବା, ଯାହା ଶୀଘ୍ର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ହୁଏ। ସ୍ୱର ସୁରରେ ରହିବା ପାଇଁ ଏହାକୁ ଅଳ୍ପ ଓ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗିଟାରର ବେକ ଉପରକୁ ସେହି ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ସ୍ୱର ପୁଣି ଆସେ। ବିନ୍ୟାସ 1 ଶେଷ ହେଉଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରୁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ 2 ଆରମ୍ଭ: ତାର 5, 4 ଓ 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, ତାର 6, 2 ଓ 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 8 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2।

strings.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ୟାସ 1 ର ସେହି ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ସ୍ୱର, A C D E G, ବେକର ଏକ ନୂଆ ସ୍ଥାନରେ।

strings.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ୟାସ 1 ରୁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ 2 କୁ ଯିବାକୁ ତାର 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 କୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ବିନ୍ୟାସ 2 ରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲା ବେଳକୁ ହାତ ଠିକ୍ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଥିବ।

strings.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଲୁଣିଆ ଜଳର ରବିବାର ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ଆରାମଦାୟକ ରେଗେ, ଯେଉଁଠି Am7 ଓ D7 ପାଳିକରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ନିଅନ୍ତି। ଦୁଇଟି ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ମିଳେ। ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍, ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍ ଓ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ କର୍ଡର ଏକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 2 (along) · title

strings.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: D7 ଉପରେ ବିନ୍ୟାସର ଏହି ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି କର୍ଡର ଅଂଶ?

strings.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D7 ହେଉଛି D, F ଶାର୍ପ, A ଓ C। ଏହାର ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର C ସ୍ଥିର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ; E ଓ G କେବଳ ମଝିରେ ଯାଆନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 4 (along) · title

strings.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 5 (along) · title
strings.translation: Am7 ଓ D7 ଉପରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଏକକ ବାଦନ

strings.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍, ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍, ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍, ବେଣ୍ଡ୍‌ର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ, ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ଓ ଦୁଇଟି ବିନ୍ୟାସ। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତାହାକୁ ଗାଇବା ପରି କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ବେଣ୍ଡ୍ କାହା ସହ ମିଳିବା ଦରକାର…

strings.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · unit summary
strings.translation: ବେକ ଉପରକୁ E ଓ A ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍, ନିକଟତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ଏବଂ A ରେ କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ।

Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆପଣଙ୍କ F ବାରେ ହେଉଛି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ବାରେ ସହ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ। ପୂରା ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଉପରକୁ ସରାଇଲେ ତାର 6 ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଅନୁସାରେ ନାମ ବଦଳେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ A।

strings.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ E-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ। କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ?

strings.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 6 ରେ E ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 1 ରେ F, 3 ରେ G, 5 ରେ A। ବାରେର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ କର୍ଡର ନାମ ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଉଠାଇ ବାରେକୁ ତାର 3 ଧରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା E ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ଏବଂ ସେହିଭଳି ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଏ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ A ମାଇନର୍।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title
strings.translation: A ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର

strings.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: B ମାଇନର୍ ଥିଲା ବାରେ ସହ A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ। A ମେଜର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଏ: ତାର 1 ରୁ 5 ଯାଏଁ ବାରେ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ସମତଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ। କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ?

strings.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 5 ରେ A ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 2 ରେ B, 3 ରେ C, 5 ରେ D।

strings.source: The minor A shape moves too
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଏ

strings.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ପାଇଁ B ମାଇନର୍‌ର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ: 2, 3 ଓ 4 ବାରେ ଆଗରେ A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତି। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଏହା C ମାଇନର୍।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ କର୍ଡ ତାର 6 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସହ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ, କିମ୍ବା ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସହ A ବିନ୍ୟାସ ହୋଇପାରେ। ହାତ ଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନର ନିକଟତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଆପଣ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G ବଜାଉଛନ୍ତି। ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିକଟ C କେଉଁଠି?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ରହି A ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G ରୁ C କୁ ଯିବାବେଳେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ବାରେରେ ରହେ। କେବଳ ତାହା ଆଗର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବଦଳନ୍ତି। ଏହା ସବୁଠାରୁ ସହଜ ବାରେ ବଦଳ।

strings.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ବିନ୍ୟାସର D କେଉଁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ଥାଏ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 5: ଖୋଲା A, 2 ରେ B, 3 ରେ C, 5 ରେ D।

strings.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · title
strings.translation: F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, D, A, E

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, D, A ଓ E ସବୁ A ର ଅନ୍ତର୍ଗତ। F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ବାରେ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟ ତିନୋଟିକୁ ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡ ଭାବେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେର F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ କେଉଁଠି ଥାଏ…

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 6: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ F, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବେକ ଉପରକୁ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ A ବିନ୍ୟାସର D, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ E ବିନ୍ୟାସର A, ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ A ବିନ୍ୟାସର E।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଇବାବେଳେ ବାରେକୁ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତେ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ, ନୂଆ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ। ସବୁବେଳେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ଧରିଲେ ହାତ କ୍ଲାନ୍ତ ହୁଏ ଓ ବଦଳ ଧୀର ହୁଏ।

strings.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତ କେତେବେଳେ ଚାପିବା ଦରକାର?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସ୍ଥାନରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ସରିବାବେଳେ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ। ଲଗାତାର ବଳ ଲଗାଇଲେ କେତେକ ମିନିଟ୍‌ରେ ହାତ କ୍ଲାନ୍ତ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ

strings.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବଦଳ ପୂର୍ବର ଶେଷ ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାରରେ ବାରେ ଉଠାଇ ଝଙ୍କାର ଜାରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା ତାର ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତେ ବାଜେ, ତାଳ ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏନାହିଁ, ଓ ଆପଣ ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ପ୍ରେ ରଙ୍ଗର ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟୋଦୟ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: E ରେ ଇଣ୍ଡି ପପ୍, E, B, C ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ ଓ A ଉପରେ। B ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ ଦୁହେଁ A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ, ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ବ୍ୟବଧାନରେ, ତେଣୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ହାତ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଅଧିକାଂଶ କାମ କରେ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେର C ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ କେଉଁଠି ଥାଏ…

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 5 ରେ A ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 2 ରେ B, 3 ରେ C, 4 ରେ C ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: E ଓ A ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍, ନିକଟତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାଛିବା ଓ ସହଜ ବଦଳ। କର୍ଡ ମଝିରେ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ମାନେ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · title

strings.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଫଙ୍କ୍‌ର ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ସ୍କ୍ରାଚ୍, ରେଗେ ଚପ୍, କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ବୁମ୍-ଚିକ୍ ଓ ସିଙ୍କୋପେଟେଡ୍ ପପ୍ ଝଙ୍କାର।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଚାରି ଭାଗ କରେ: ଏକ-ଇ-ଓ-ଆ, ଦୁଇ-ଇ-ଓ-ଆ। ଝଙ୍କାର କରୁଥିବା ହାତର ବେଗ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ହୁଏ, ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତଳ-ଉପର-ତଳ-ଉପର।

strings.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କେତୋଟି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଥାଏ?

strings.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏକ-ଇ-ଓ-ଆ: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାର ଚାରିଟି ସମାନ ଭାଗ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫଙ୍କ୍‌ରେ ନାଇନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ଖୁବ୍ ମାନେ। ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 6 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, ଏବଂ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ସମତଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାତକୁ ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ର ଲୟରେ ଚଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଝଙ୍କାର ସ୍ୱରହୀନ ଖସଖସିଆ ଟିକ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି ହେବ। କେବଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଇବା ଆଘାତରେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings

Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ନଚାପି ଛୁଇଁଲେ ତାର ଝଙ୍କାରିବା ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। ଝଙ୍କାର ଏକ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ତାଳବାଦ୍ୟ ପରି ଟିକ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆଘାତରେ ଚାପି ତୁରନ୍ତ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସ୍ୱର ଛୋଟ ରହିବ। ପୂରା E9 ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳକୁ ସରାଇଲେ D9 ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରେଗେ ଗିଟାର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଛୋଟ, ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ କର୍ଡରେ ଡ୍ରମ୍‌କୁ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ। କେବଳ ପତଳା ତାରରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ରୋକନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କେବଳ ଉପର ସ୍ୱରର ଚାରିଟି ତାର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏହି A ମାଇନର୍ ହେଉଛି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର A ମାଇନର୍ ବାରେର ଉପର ଅଂଶ: ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3, ବାକି ତାରରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ର ବାରେ।

strings.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ରେଗେ ଚପ୍ କେତେ ସମୟ ଝଙ୍କାରିବା ଦରକାର?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ। ଚପ୍ ଏକ ଛୋଟ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ଧ୍ୱନି; ତାହା ପରର ନୀରବତା ହିଁ ଲୟର ଅନୁଭବ ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ D ବାରେର ଉପର ଅଂଶ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ସମତଳ, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ଲୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ବାଣ୍ଟେ: ପ୍ରଥମ ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ବେସ୍ ସ୍ୱର, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥରେ ପତଳା ତାରର ଦ୍ରୁତ ଝଙ୍କାର। ବୁମ୍, ଚିକ୍, ବୁମ୍, ଚିକ୍।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 2 (along) · title

strings.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ବୁମ୍-ଚିକ୍‌ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କ’ଣ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A short strum of the thin strings
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ବୁମ୍ ଅନ୍ୟ ତାରରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: G ରେ ତାର 6, ତାପରେ ତାର 4। C ରେ ତାର 5, ତାପରେ 4। D ରେ ତାର 4, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା ତାର 5।

strings.source: Booms in G, C and D
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 6 (along) · title
strings.translation: G, C ଓ D ରେ ବୁମ୍ ସ୍ୱର

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍‌ରେ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ନଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଝଙ୍କାର ହୁଏ। ଏକରେ ତଳକୁ, ଦୁଇର ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଉପରକୁ, ତିନିର ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଉପରକୁ, ତାପରେ ଚାରିରେ ତଳ-ଉପର।

strings.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚାରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ହାତ କ’ଣ କରେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦୋଳନ କେବେ ଥାମେ ନାହିଁ। ଦୁଇରେ ହାତ ତାର ନଛୁଇଁ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ, ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାର ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପପ୍ ବାଦକମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଶେଷ ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାରରେ, ଚାରିର ‘ଓ’ ରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତି, ଫଳରେ ନୂଆ କର୍ଡ ଅଳ୍ପ ଆଗରୁ ଆସେ। ଏହା ଗୀତକୁ ଆଗେଇ ନିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · title

strings.source: The pop strum on four chords
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫୁଲଝରିର ଋତୁ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: C ରେ ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମର ଉତ୍ସାହଭରା ଗୀତ, C, G, A ମାଇନର୍ ଓ F ଉପରେ। ସିଙ୍କୋପେଟେଡ୍ ପପ୍ ଝଙ୍କାରରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଚାରିର ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଟିକେ ଆଗରୁ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E ଓ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଦୁଇଥର, ତାପରେ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଓ ତଳକୁ ପୁଣି D।

strings.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଯେପରି ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ନୂଆ କର୍ଡ ଝଙ୍କାରିବ

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାରରେ ସରିଲେ ହାତ ଟିକେ ଆଗରୁ ପହଞ୍ଚେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ପାଇଁ ନୂଆ କର୍ଡ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ଥାଏ।

strings.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ଫଙ୍କ୍‌ର ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍, ରେଗେ ଚପ୍, ବୁମ୍-ଚିକ୍ ଓ ସିଙ୍କୋପେଟେଡ୍ ପପ୍ ଝଙ୍କାର। ହାତର ଦୋଳନ ଜାରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ, କେବଳ କେଉଁ ତାର ଛୁଏ ତାହା ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · unit summary
strings.translation: କାପୋ, କାପୋ 2 ରେ G ଓ D ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ଏବଂ ପଦ ଓ ମୁଖଡ଼ା ସହ ସଜାଯାଇଥିବା ଓଃ! ସୁଜାନା।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କାପୋ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ସବୁ ତାର ଚାପି ଧରେ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଖୋଲା ତାର ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ, ଏବଂ ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡ ବିନ୍ୟାସଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟ ତାହା ସହ ଉପରକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: କାପୋ ଲଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ: ତାର 1 ଓ 2 ଖୋଲା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ E ଓ B।

strings.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ କାପୋ ଲଗାଇ ପୁଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ କାପୋ। G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବଜାଉଛନ୍ତି। କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ?

strings.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ A। ବିନ୍ୟାସ G ରହେ; କାପୋ ସହ ଧ୍ୱନି ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କାପୋ ଲଗାଇଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଜଣାଥିବା G, C ଓ D ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଭାବେ ଭାବନ୍ତୁ। ଏଠାର ଚିତ୍ରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଶୁଣାଯାଉଥିବା ପ୍ରକୃତ କର୍ଡର ନାମ ଦେଖାନ୍ତି, ତେଣୁ କାପୋ 2 ରେ G ବିନ୍ୟାସ A ଭାବେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ।

strings.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · title
strings.translation: କାପୋ 2 ରେ G ଓ D ବିନ୍ୟାସ

strings.source: The G family, two frets up
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କାପୋ 2 ରେ G, C, D ଓ E ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ A, D, E ଓ F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ ଭାବେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ସମାନ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ନୂଆ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର: A ମେଜର୍।

strings.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ କାପୋ। D ବିନ୍ୟାସ କିପରି ଶୁଣାଯାଏ…

strings.source: Two frets above D is E.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D ଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ E।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ବିନ୍ୟାସ ମଧ୍ୟ ସେହିଭଳି କାମ କରେ। କାପୋ 2 ରେ D, G ଓ A ବିନ୍ୟାସ E, A ଓ B ଭାବେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ: ସହଜ ଖୋଲା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ E ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଗୀତ ଦୁଇ ଅଂଶ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପାଳିକରି ଯାଆନ୍ତି। ପଦ କାହାଣୀ କହେ; ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଆକର୍ଷକ ଅଂଶକୁ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି କରେ। ଷ୍ଟିଫେନ୍ ଫଷ୍ଟର୍‌ଙ୍କ ଓଃ! ସୁଜାନା (1848) ରେ ଉଭୟ ଅଛି। କାପୋ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ: ଏହା G ରେ।

strings.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ ପୂର୍ବର ସ୍ୱର ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ: ଖୋଲା G, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D ଦୁଇଥର, ଓ ଖୋଲା E।

strings.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ଅଂଶ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ସମାନ ଶବ୍ଦ ସହ ଫେରେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କାହାଣୀ ଆଗେଇବା ସହ ପଦର ଶବ୍ଦ ବଦଳେ। ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଅପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ଫେରେ, ଏବଂ ଲୋକେ ତାହା ସହ ଗାଆନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପଦ ସହ G ଓ D7 ବୁମ୍-ଚିକ୍ ଶୈଳୀରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ଏକରେ ବେସ୍, ଦୁଇରେ ଝଙ୍କାର। G ର ତିନି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, D7 ର ଗୋଟିଏ, G ର ଦୁଇଟି, ତାପରେ D7 ଓ G।

Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମୁଖଡ଼ା ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇ ଖୋଲା E କୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ। ଏହାର କର୍ଡ C, G ଓ D7, ଏବଂ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଧା ପଦର ଶେଷ ସହ ମିଳେ।

strings.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C ଦୁଇଥର, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା E ତିନିଥର।

strings.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାପରେ ତଳକୁ: D ଦୁଇଥର, ଖୋଲା B, ଖୋଲା G, ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A।

strings.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ତିନୋଟି E ର ଲୟ ଛୋଟ, ଲମ୍ବା, ଛୋଟ। ଲମ୍ବାଟି କେଉଁଠି ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ମାତ୍ରା ଯାଏଁ ଝଙ୍କାରେ। ସେହି ଆଗୁଆ ଗତି ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପପ୍ ଝଙ୍କାର ପରି।

strings.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୀତ ସଜାଣି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରଣ କରେ କ’ଣ ଓ କେତେବେଳେ ବଜାଇବେ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଯୋଜନା: ଟ୍ରାଭିସ୍ ପିକିଂରେ ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭ, ପଦର ସୁର, ବୁମ୍-ଚିକ୍ ଝଙ୍କାରରେ ମୁଖଡ଼ା, ତାପରେ ଶେଷରେ ମୁଖଡ଼ାର ସୁର।

strings.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.

strings.translation: କଙ୍କର ରାସ୍ତାର ଟୁ-ଷ୍ଟେପ୍ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ରେ ନୃତ୍ୟଶାଳାର କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି, A, D ଓ E ଉପରେ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ କାପୋ ଲଗାଇ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଜଣା G, C ଓ D ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ଖୋଲା C, A, G, E କିମ୍ବା D ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ବେକ ଉପରକୁ ସରାଇ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରେ। ଯେକୌଣସି ଗୋଟିକରୁ ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ ବିନ୍ୟାସଗୁଡ଼ିକ C A G E D କ୍ରମରେ ଆସନ୍ତି, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିହୁଏ।

strings.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C, A, G, E ଓ D: ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ଖୋଲା ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଯାହା ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ବେକର ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G ରୁ ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ G ବାରେ। ତାର 6 ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡର ସେହି G।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D କୁ ପାଞ୍ଚ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ G। ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନଟ୍ ଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନ ପରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ ତାର 4 ଧରେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, 4 ଓ 3 ତାହା ଉପରେ D ତ୍ରିକୋଣ ପୁଣି ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତି।

strings.source: The D shape, string by string
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: Where is the D shape's root?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଖୋଲା ତାର 4। ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାହା ଧରେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର G। ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 8 ମଧ୍ୟ G।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର E ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର D ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ ଏକ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି: ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର G। ଦୁଇଟି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସରିବା ବେଳେ ତାହା ଉପରେ ନଜର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା C କୁ ସାତ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ G। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରହେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 8 ଧରେ, ଏବଂ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ତାର 4 ଓ 5 ଯାଏଁ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି।

strings.source: The C shape, string by string
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା C ପରି C ବିନ୍ୟାସର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ରହେ…

strings.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା C ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3। ଏଠାରେ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାହା ଧରେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 10 ର G।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 କୁ ତଳକୁ ସରାଇଲେ D, ଯାହାର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ। ନାମ ସବୁବେଳେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଅନୁସାରେ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: The A shape, and around again
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 10 ରେ ତାର 5 ରୁ 1 ଯାଏଁ ବାରେ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 12 ରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ, ଏବଂ ପୁଣି G।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ବିନ୍ୟାସ ପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 12 ରେ G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଫେରେ: ଖୋଲା G ଠାରୁ ଏକ ସପ୍ତକ ଉଚ୍ଚ। ସେଠାରୁ ପାଞ୍ଚ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ସମାନ କ୍ରମରେ ପୁଣି ଆସନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ବେକ ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ A ପରେ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଆସେ?

strings.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କ୍ରମ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ହୁଏ: C, A, G, E, D, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି C। A ପରେ G ଆସେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: CAGED ସହ ଦୂରକୁ ସରିବା କ୍ୱଚିତ୍ ଦରକାର। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ପାଖରେ G ହେଉଛି D ବିନ୍ୟାସ, C ହେଉଛି G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଓ D ହେଉଛି A ବିନ୍ୟାସ। ତିନି କର୍ଡ, ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ଥାନ।

strings.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: D-ବିନ୍ୟାସ G ର ଠିକ୍ ପାଖରେ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ C ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ର G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଓ 8 ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, ଠିକ୍ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ହାତ ଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · title

strings.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ ଧାରଣା ତଳେ ମଧ୍ୟ କାମ କରେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ E ବିନ୍ୟାସର G, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ A ବିନ୍ୟାସର C, ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ C ବିନ୍ୟାସର D।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଲଣ୍ଠନର ପାହାଡ଼ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: G, C ଓ D ରେ ନିଆଁ ଚାରିପାଖେ ମିଶି ଗାଇବା ଗୀତ। ମୁଖଡ଼ାକୁ ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡରେ, ତାପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ପାଖରେ, ତାପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ପାଖରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ସେହି ଗୀତ ବେକର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଯିବ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ପାଖରେ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ C ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ର G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଓ 8 ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, D-ବିନ୍ୟାସ G ଓ A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ D ର ଠିକ୍ ପାଖରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ସମସ୍ତ ପାଞ୍ଚ ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ G, ଏବଂ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ପାଖରେ G, C ଓ D। ପ୍ରତି ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲେ ତାହାର ନାମ କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଉପର ସ୍ୱରର ତାରରେ ତିନି-ସ୍ୱରର କର୍ଡ: ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍, ପ୍ରତି ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍, ଓ ଅତି ଅଳ୍ପ ଚଳନର କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ।

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କର୍ଡ: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର, ତୃତୀୟ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ। ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ରେ ଏହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଓ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ, ଏବଂ ବେକର ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନରେ କାମ କରେ।

strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ C ମେଜର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତି?
