strings.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର, ତୃତୀୟ, ପଞ୍ଚମ: C ରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଷର ଛାଡ଼ି E, ତାପରେ ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ଛାଡ଼ି G।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍ ହୁଏ। ତଳେ E ରଖିଲେ C ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9, 8 ଓ 8 ରେ ଥାଏ। ତଳେ G ରଖିଲେ ତାହା ଖୋଲା C ର ଉପର ଅଂଶ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ତାରରେ ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ତିନି ବିନ୍ୟାସରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, ପ୍ରତି ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍ ପାଇଁ ଗୋଟିଏ। G ଓ D ରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଶିଖିଲେ ଯେକୌଣସି ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ପାଇପାରିବେ।

strings.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, 3 ଓ 3 ର G ର ବିନ୍ୟାସ କାହା ସହ ସମାନ…

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉଭୟରେ ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ସବୁଠାରୁ ତଳେ: ତାର 3 ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ, ଅନ୍ୟ ଦୁଇଟି ସମାନ ସ୍ତରରେ। ସମାନ ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ପାଞ୍ଚ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ବ୍ୟବଧାନ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7, 7 ଓ 5 ର D ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର C ପରି ମୂଳ-ସ୍ଥିତି ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଅଛି। ତଳେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, 3 ଓ 2 ହେଉଛି ଖୋଲା D ର ଉପର ଅଂଶ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡର ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳକୁ ନେଲେ ମାଇନର୍ ହୁଏ। ଏହି ତାରରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, 1 ଓ 0 ର A ମାଇନର୍ ହେଉଛି ଖୋଲା A ମାଇନର୍‌ର ଉପର ଅଂଶ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ ବାରେ କଲେ ତଳେ C ସହ A ମାଇନର୍ ମିଳେ। ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତିନି ସ୍ୱର।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, 5 ଓ 3 ର E ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ତଳେ B ଥାଏ। ଏହା ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର A ମାଇନର୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପାଖରେ, ତେଣୁ ବଦଳ ଅତି ଛୋଟ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାତର ନିକଟତମ ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍ ବାଛିଲେ କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମରେ ଚଳନ ଅତି ଅଳ୍ପ ହୁଏ। G, E ମାଇନର୍, C ଓ D ସବୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରୁ 5 ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଅଛନ୍ତି।

strings.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, 3, 3 ର G ରୁ 4, 5, 3 ର E ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ଗଲେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଅପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ରହେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର B ଓ ତାର 1 ର G ସ୍ଥିର ରହନ୍ତି। କେବଳ ତାର 2 ର ସ୍ୱର D ରୁ E କୁ ଉଠେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସେହି ଚାରି କର୍ଡ ଉପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛନ୍ତି: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7, 8 ଓ 7 ରେ G, 9, 8 ଓ 7 ରେ E ମାଇନର୍, 9, 8 ଓ 8 ରେ C, ଏବଂ 7, 7 ଓ 5 ରେ D।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ବଜାଇଲେ ଆର୍ପେଜିଓ ହୁଏ। କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ ଭିତରେ ସେହି ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ନିଜସ୍ୱ ସୁର ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: A chord played one note at a time
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରରେ ବଜାଯାଉଥିବା କର୍ଡ

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଠାରେ ଉପର ସ୍ୱର G, G, G, F ଶାର୍ପ: ତଳେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରାୟ ସ୍ଥିର। ଦୁଇ କର୍ଡରେ ଥିବା ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ସାଧାରଣ ସ୍ୱର କୁହାଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ଏତେ ସୁଗମ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Did the top note go up or down?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଉପର ସ୍ୱର ଉଠିଲା ନା ତଳକୁ ଗଲା?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 7 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରୋଲର୍ ସ୍କେଟିଂ ପଡ଼ିଆ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: G, E ମାଇନର୍, C ଓ D ରେ ପୁରୁଣା ଶୈଳୀର ନୃତ୍ୟ ପପ୍, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରୁ 5 ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଚାରି ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ। ଉପର ସ୍ୱରର ତାରର ଛୋଟ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଗିଟାର ପରି ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଓ ସଂହତ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ରୋଲର୍ ସ୍କେଟିଂ ପଡ଼ିଆର କ୍ରମ G ର ପ୍ରଥମ, ଷଷ୍ଠ, ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ କର୍ଡ। ଷଷ୍ଠ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ?

strings.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6। 6 ର କର୍ଡ ମାଇନର୍: E ମାଇନର୍।

strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ, ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍, ଦୁଇ ସ୍ଥାନରେ G, E ମାଇନର୍, C ଓ D, ଏବଂ ଆର୍ପେଜିଓ। ପ୍ରତି ଚଳନ ଛୋଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…

strings.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · unit summary
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍, ମାଇନର୍ ଓ ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ, ଖୋଲା ଓ ବାରେ, ii–V–I, ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ସଙ୍ଗତ।

Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ। ଏହା ସାଧାରଣ ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡକୁ କୋମଳ ଓ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନିଳ କରେ। ଖୋଲା Cmaj7 ହେଉଛି C ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଉଠାଇବା।

strings.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: Cmaj7 ରେ C ସହ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ: C ର ଠିକ୍ ତଳେ B।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ F ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରେ କେବଳ ତାର 2 ଚାପନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା ତାର 1, E, ହେଉଛି F ର ମେଜର୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ। ଏହା ମୃଦୁ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ, ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଓ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳର ମଝିରେ। Am7 ହେଉଛି A ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଉଠାଇବା।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Dm7: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, ଏବଂ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ସମତଳ। Em7: କେବଳ ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2।

strings.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: Am7 ରେ A ମାଇନର୍ ସହ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ?

strings.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ: A ଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ G।

strings.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title
strings.translation: ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ତାର 5 ଧରି ତାର 1 ଯାଏଁ ରହେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 4, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3 ଓ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 ତାର 2 ଧରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Dm7 ହେଉଛି A ମାଇନର୍ ବାରେରୁ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାଇବା। D7 ହେଉଛି A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ, ଯେଉଁଠି ତାର 4 ଓ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ଥାଏ। ଉଭୟର ନାମ ତାର 5 ର ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆସେ।

strings.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ Dm7। ଏହାର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର କେଉଁଠି?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ କର୍ଡ ପରି ଏହାର ନାମ ତାର 5 ର ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆସେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଜାଜ୍‌ର ପ୍ରିୟ ଗତି: ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରର କର୍ଡ, ତାପରେ ପଞ୍ଚମ, ତାପରେ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରିବା। C ରେ Dm7, G7 ଓ Cmaj7।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ E7 ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ ଭାବେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ସମସ୍ତ ଛଅ ତାରରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, ତାର 5 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ ତାର 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2। ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 6 ରେ।

strings.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: C ପ୍ରଥମ, D ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ। D ଉପରେ ଗଢ଼ା ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ D ମାଇନର୍ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

strings.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଜାଜ୍ ବାଦକମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡକୁ କେବଳ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତେ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତି। ଝଙ୍କାର ବେଳେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ତୁରନ୍ତ ପରେ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ କର୍ଡରେ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଲୟ ଆସିବ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଗିଟାର ବାଦକ କମ୍ପିଂ କରନ୍ତି: ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଉତ୍ତର ଦେଉଥିବା ଛୋଟ କର୍ଡ। ଚାର୍ଲସ୍ଟନ୍ ଲୟ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ଓ ଦୁଇର ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ‘ଓ’ ରେ ବାଜେ, ତାପରେ ନୀରବ ସ୍ଥାନ ଛାଡ଼େ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ପଞ୍ଚମ, ପ୍ରଥମ ହେଉଛି Am7, D7 ଓ Gmaj7। Am7 ହେଉଛି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ E ମାଇନର୍ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ ବାରେ; Gmaj7 ତାର 5 ଛାଡ଼େ, ଏହାର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 6, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ଚେକ୍‌ଆଉଟ୍ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: C ରେ ଲୋ-ଫାଇ, Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 ଓ Am7 ଉପରେ। ଏହା ii–V–I ସହ ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବାକୁ ଷଷ୍ଠ କର୍ଡ। ବାରେ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ଓ ଚାର୍ଲସ୍ଟନ୍‌ରେ ସଙ୍ଗତ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5। G ଉପରେ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ G7।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ମେଜର୍, ମାଇନର୍ ଓ ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ, ଖୋଲା ଓ ବାରେ, ଏବଂ C ଓ G ରେ ii–V–I। କର୍ଡ ଛୋଟ ଓ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ?

Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · title

strings.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତକର G ମେଜର୍, ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ ଓ କର୍ଡ, ଏବଂ ଡୋରିଆନ୍ ଓ ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍ ମୋଡ୍।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୁଇଟି। ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ କ୍ରମରେ ଉଠେ। ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚା ମେଜର୍‌କୁ ତାହାର ଧ୍ୱନି ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଯାଏଁ ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ତାର 6, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ଠାରୁ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ତାର 6, 5 ଓ 4 ଦେଇ ଉଠେ।

strings.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 6: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ 5, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଓ 4। ତାର 5: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଓ 3, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଓ 2।

strings.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ତାପରେ ତାର 4: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, 4 ଓ 5। G ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କେଉଁଠି ଥାଏ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ: ପ୍ରଥମ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର 3 ରୁ 4। ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟଟି 7 ରୁ 8।

strings.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ଆଗେଇ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ: ତାର 3 ରେ A, B ଓ C, ତାର 2 ରେ D ଓ E, ତାର 1 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ G। ହାତର ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳେ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.

strings.translation: ଏହି ସ୍ଥିତିରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ, ତେଣୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର।

strings.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1839 ରେ ଲୋୱେଲ୍ ମେସନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ସଜାଯାଇଥିବା ବିଶ୍ୱକୁ ଆନନ୍ଦ ଗୀତ ଉପରୁ ସିଧା ତଳକୁ G ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଆପଣ ଆଗରୁ ଜାଣନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ଠାରୁ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌କୁ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ: G ହେଉଛି 1, A ହେଉଛି 2, ଏଭଳି F ଶାର୍ପ, 7 ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ। ସଙ୍ଗୀତଜ୍ଞମାନେ ଯେକୌଣସି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ସୁର ଓ କର୍ଡ ବିଷୟରେ କହିବାକୁ ଏହି ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି।

strings.source: In G major, which note is 5?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମରୁ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଗୋଟିଏ ଛାଡ଼ି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ଏକାଠି କଲେ ସେହି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର କର୍ଡ ମିଳେ। 1, 4 ଓ 5 ର କର୍ଡ ମେଜର୍; 2, 3 ଓ 6 ର ମାଇନର୍। G ରେ: G, C ଓ D, ତାପରେ A ମାଇନର୍, B ମାଇନର୍ ଓ E ମାଇନର୍।

strings.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ 6 ଉପରେ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ଗଢ଼େ?

strings.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଷଷ୍ଠ ସ୍ୱର E, ଏବଂ 2, 3 ଓ 6 ର କର୍ଡ ମାଇନର୍। E, G ଓ B ଏକାଠି କଲେ E ମାଇନର୍।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ର ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଇ A କୁ ମୂଳ ଭାବେ ଧରିଲେ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ମାଇନର୍ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ଏହା A ଡୋରିଆନ୍, G ମେଜର୍‌ର ଏକ ମୋଡ୍: ସମାନ ସ୍ଥାନ, ନୂଆ ଆରମ୍ଭ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 6, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର A ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ସେହି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଦେଇ ତାର 3 ର A ଯାଏଁ ଉଠନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର A ଡୋରିଆନ୍‌କୁ ସାଧାରଣ A ମାଇନର୍‌ଠାରୁ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ କରେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସାଧାରଣ A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ F ଥାଏ। ଡୋରିଆନ୍ G ମେଜର୍‌ର F ଶାର୍ପ ରଖେ: ମାଇନର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଏକ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 5 (along) · title

strings.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ D କୁ ମୂଳ ଭାବେ ଧରନ୍ତୁ। D ରୁ D ଯାଏଁ G ମେଜର୍‌ର ସ୍ୱର D ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍ ଗଢ଼େ: ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ। ଏହା ଲୋକସଙ୍ଗୀତ, ରକ୍ ଓ ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁରରେ ବହୁଳ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ।

strings.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର D ଠାରୁ ସମାନ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D ଯାଏଁ ଉଠନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: D ମେଜର୍‌ରେ C ଶାର୍ପ ଥାଏ। D ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍‌ରେ ଥାଏ…

strings.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳକୁ ନିଏ, ତେଣୁ G ମେଜର୍‌ର C ଏହାର ବିଶେଷ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ୱର ମୂଳ ହୋଇପାରେ। G ରୁ ମେଜର୍, A ରୁ ଡୋରିଆନ୍, D ରୁ ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍, E ରୁ ସାଧାରଣ ମାଇନର୍। ସମାନ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍, ଭିନ୍ନ ଭାବ।

strings.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାଟ ଦିନ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: G ରେ ଉତ୍ସାହଭରା ପପ୍, ପଶ୍ଚିମ ଆଫ୍ରିକାର ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଗିଟାର ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ହାଇଲାଇଫ୍‌ର ଦୋଳାୟମାନ ଲୟ ସହ। ଏହାର ଆକର୍ଷକ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ କେବଳ G ମେଜର୍ ସ୍ୱର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, ତେଣୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ଥିତିର ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଭିତରେ ରହେ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?

strings.translation: ହାଟ ଦିନର କର୍ଡ G, B ମାଇନର୍, C ଓ D। ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମରେ?

strings.translation: G ହେଉଛି 1, B ହେଉଛି 3, C ହେଉଛି 4 ଓ D ହେଉଛି 5। ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ 3 ର କର୍ଡ ମାଇନର୍: B ମାଇନର୍।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ B, ପୁଣି D, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର E, ତାପରେ D ଓ B।

strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍, କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ ଓ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍, ଟ୍ରିଲ୍, ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ଗଢ଼ିବା, ଏବଂ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଉପରେ ମଧୁର ଓ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ରଙ୍ଗ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 କୁ ସରାଇ A କୁ ମୂଳ ଭାବେ ଧରନ୍ତୁ: ଏହା ମଧୁର ଓ ମେଜର୍ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ତାହା A ମେଜର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍: A, B, C ଶାର୍ପ, E ଓ F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 6, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର A ଠାରୁ, ତାପରେ ତାର 5 ଓ 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଓ 4, ଏବଂ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A।

strings.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ମେଜର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍‌ରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: A, B, C ଶାର୍ପ, E, F ଶାର୍ପ

strings.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: A ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର, ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ବାଦ୍ ଦେଇ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ A, C, D, E ଓ G ଅଛି।

strings.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title
strings.translation: A ମେଜର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍, ଉପରକୁ ଓ ତଳକୁ

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର ଏହି ବିନ୍ୟାସ F ଶାର୍ପରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ହୁଏ। କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ମୂଳ ଭାବେ ଧରୁଛନ୍ତି, ତାହା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରଣ କରେ କେଉଁଟି ବଜାଉଛନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ବାଦକ ଏହି ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ ପସନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତି: ତାର 4 ରେ E ରୁ F ଶାର୍ପ, ତାର 3 ରେ A ରୁ B। ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରି ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟରେ ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 4: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ ତାର 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 6 କୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, B ରୁ C ଶାର୍ପକୁ, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3। ପିକ୍ କରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ନଉଠାଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 6 କୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · title
strings.translation: ଟ୍ରିଲ୍ ଓ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରି ପହଞ୍ଚିବା

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଟ୍ରିଲ୍ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଦୋଳେ: ଥରେ ପିକ୍, ତାପରେ ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ ଓ ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍ ବାରମ୍ବାର। ଦ୍ରୁତ କରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଓ 4। ଥରେ ପିକ୍ କରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ରେ ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ ଓ ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚାହୁଁଥିବା ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ପିକ୍ କରିବା ସହ ଉପରକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ହିଁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ: ଠିକ୍ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ସେଠାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରିବାବେଳେ କେଉଁଟି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ ମାତ୍ରାର ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ, ଯେପରି ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ଠିକ୍ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 7 (along) · title
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଉପରେ ଦୁଇ ବିନ୍ୟାସ କାମ କରେ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର ମେଜର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ମଧୁର; ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର ମାଇନର୍ କଠୋର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଭଲ ବାଦକ ଦୁଇଟି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଯିବାଆସିବା କରନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A7 ଉପରେ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଅଧିକ ମଧୁର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍‌ରେ A7 ର ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର C ଶାର୍ପ ଅଛି। ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସର C ତାହା ସହ ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ସେହି ଘର୍ଷଣ ହିଁ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ କଠୋର ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ପଚାରି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ମଧୁର ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ବେଳେ ହାତ ସରାନ୍ତୁ, ଓ ଉଭୟ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ A ରେ ଶେଷ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 7 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭଲ ଏକକ ବାଦନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଏ। ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ବଜାଇ ପ୍ରାୟ ସେତିକି ସମୟ ବିରାମ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ନୀରବତା ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 2 (along) · title

strings.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରାର ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ପରେ କେତେ ସମୟ ବିରାମ ନେଇପାରନ୍ତି?

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ ଭାବେ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ଦୁଇଥର ବଜାଇ କେବଳ ଶେଷ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ। ଶ୍ରୋତା ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ଶୁଣି ନୂଆ ମୋଡ଼ ପ୍ରତି ଆଗ୍ରହୀ ହୁଅନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ଧରି ରଖି ଅଳ୍ପ, ସମାନ ଠେଲା ଓ ଛାଡ଼ିବାରେ ଦୋଳାନ୍ତୁ। ପରିସର ଛୋଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ: ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ଟିକେ ଦୋଳିବ, ସୁରଠାରୁ ଦୂରେ ଯିବ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଗୀତ କେତୋଟି ଅଂଶରେ ଗଢ଼ା: କାହାଣୀ କହୁଥିବା ପଦ, ଆକର୍ଷକ ଅଂଶ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି କରୁଥିବା ମୁଖଡ଼ା, ଓ କେବେକେବେ ଭିନ୍ନତା ପାଇଁ ସଂଯୋଗ ଅଂଶ। ଯୋଜନା ଜାଣିଲେ ବାଟ ହରାଇବେ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.

strings.translation: ଅନେକ ପୁରୁଣା ଗୀତ AABA ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ: ଏକ ସୁର, ପୁଣି ସେହି ସୁର, ଏକ ଭିନ୍ନ ସଂଯୋଗ ଅଂଶ, ତାପରେ ଆଉଥରେ ସୁର। ପ୍ରତି ଅଂଶ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଆଠ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ; ଏଠାରେ ଚାରି।

strings.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.

strings.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
strings.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଜୁକ୍‌ବକ୍ସର ଚାନ୍ଦ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: AABA ଗଠନରେ ପଚାଶ ଦଶକର ଧୀର ନୃତ୍ୟ ଗୀତ, ଏକ ପଦ, ପୁଣି ସେହି ପଦ, F ରେ ସଂଯୋଗ ଅଂଶ, ତାପରେ ଆଉଥରେ ପଦ। ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ନୂଆ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଲୟରେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାର ସହ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.

strings.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖି ଚାରି ତାରରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ। A ମାଇନର୍ C ଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଝଙ୍କାର ବାଜୁଥିବା ବେଳେ ଅଦରକାରୀ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାଇ ନୂଆଟି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କର୍ଡକୁ ଆଗୁଆ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ତାର 3 ଓ 1 ଖୋଲା ଝଙ୍କାରନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ କର୍ଡର ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି F ସହ ସମାନ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରହେ?

strings.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.

strings.translation: ଉଭୟରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ରହେ। ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ତାହା ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: G7, the chord that leads home
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · title
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତୃତୀୟ। ଚାରିଟିରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A chord that wants to go home
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G7 ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ତାହା ପରେ C ବଜାଇଲେ ଟାଣ ମୁକୁଳେ। ସେହି ଆକର୍ଷଣ ପାଇଁ ଏତେ ଗୀତରେ C ପୂର୍ବରୁ G7 ଥାଏ।

strings.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହା ମୂଳରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ ନା ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଲାଗେ?

strings.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ତୃତୀୟ। ତାର 4 ଝଙ୍କାରିବା ପାଇଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବଙ୍କା କରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉଭୟ କର୍ଡରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରହେ। ତାହାକୁ ସ୍ଥିର ଆଧାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which one is G7, the one with more tension?

strings.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C, A ମାଇନର୍, F, G7 ଓ G ରେ ଶହ ଶହ ଗୀତ ବଜାଇପାରିବେ। ପ୍ରତି ବିନ୍ୟାସ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ତାଳ ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 “Strumming” · unit summary
strings.translation: ସ୍ଥିର ତଳମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାର, ତଳ-ଉପର ଓ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଶୈଳୀର ଝଙ୍କାର।

strings.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତଳକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ: 1, 2, 3, 4। ତର୍ଜନୀର ନଖ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ହାତ ଚଳିଚାଲେ।

strings.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ହାତ କ’ଣ କରିବା ଦରକାର?

strings.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.

strings.translation: ତାଳ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବାଠାରୁ କର୍ଡ ଟିକେ ବିଳମ୍ବରେ ଆସିବା ଭଲ। ତାର ଘର୍ଘର କଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଝଙ୍କାର ଜାରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗଣନ୍ତୁ 1 ଓ 2 ଓ 3 ଓ 4 ଓ। ସଂଖ୍ୟାରେ ତଳକୁ, ପ୍ରତି ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଉପରକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ହାତ କେବେ ଥାମେ ନାହିଁ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାର ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ତାର 1 ଓ 2 କୁ ଛୁଏ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ନରମ ଅଂଶରେ ତଳମୁହାଁଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ହାଲୁକା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1 ରେ ତଳ, 2 ରେ ତଳ-ଉପର, 3 ର ତଳମୁହାଁ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଉପର, ତଳ-ଉପର। ଛାଡ଼ିଥିବା ତଳମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାର ଏଥିରେ ଦୋଳାୟମାନ ଭାବ ଆଣେ।

strings.translation: C D E F G A B C। ଖୋଲା ତାର 3 ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ଦେଇ ଉଠନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ପ୍ରଥମ ତିନି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ଅଛି।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C, A ମାଇନର୍, F, G, G7, D ମାଇନର୍, E ମାଇନର୍, D, A ଓ E7। ପ୍ରଥମେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ତାପରେ ସ୍ଥିର ଝଙ୍କାର।

strings.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
