Ukulele · Unit 6 “Songs” · title

strings.source: Four public-domain songs with melody and chords.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 “Songs” · unit summary
strings.translation: ସୁର ଓ କର୍ଡ ସହ ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ଅଧିକାରର ଚାରି ଗୀତ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଷ୍ଟିଫେନ୍ ଫଷ୍ଟର୍ ଏହି ଗୀତ 1848 ରେ ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ଏହା ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଗଣାଯାଏ: 1 ଓ 2 ଓ। ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସ୍ୱର ଦ୍ରୁତ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍।

strings.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: C D E G, G A G E।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 5 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · title

strings.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1850 ର ଆଉ ଏକ ଫଷ୍ଟର୍ ଗୀତ। ସୁର G ଓ E ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଡେଇଁ ଚାଲେ, ଓ ଛୋଟ ଦୁଇ-ସ୍ୱରର ଡାକ ପ୍ରତି ଧାଡ଼ିକୁ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ।

strings.source: G G E G A G E.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G G E G A G E।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ର ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଗୀତ ପରି ଏହା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର C କୁ ଫେରେ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

strings.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1 ଉପରେ ଜୋର୍ ଦେଇ 1 2 3, 1 2 3 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍ ଲୟ। 1884 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଛପାଯାଇଥିବା “କ୍ଲେମେଣ୍ଟାଇନ୍” ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୋଳେ।

strings.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1, ଖୋଲା 3, ଖୋଲା 1, ତାପରେ ତାର 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ 1।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। F ସହ ଏଥିରେ ପୂରା ଗୀତ ବାଜେ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · title
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ସୁର 1896 ସୁଦ୍ଧା ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ପ୍ରତି ଧାଡ଼ି ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଶେଷ, ତେଣୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ତାହାର ପୂରା ଗଣନା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା 3, ତାର 2 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1, ଖୋଲା 1, ତାର 2 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତାର 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ଓ 3।

strings.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଧାଡ଼ି D, C ଶାର୍ପ, C ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ସେହି ସ୍ୱର କିପରି ଯାଆନ୍ତି?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Down one fret at a time
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1, ଖୋଲା।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · title
Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୀତରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରିବାବେଳେ ସୁର ଆପଣଙ୍କ ମନରେ କିମ୍ବା ସାଙ୍ଗଙ୍କ କଣ୍ଠରେ ଥାଏ। ସୁର ଯେଉଁଠି ମୋଡ଼ ନିଏ ସେଠାରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାଇ ଝଙ୍କାର ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: F ରେ ଥିବା ଗୀତ ସାଧାରଣତଃ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଗୀତ ନିଜ ମୂଳ କର୍ଡକୁ ଫେରେ। F ରେ ତାହା F।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · title
Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚାରି ଗୀତ, କେତୋଟି କର୍ଡ ଓ ତିନି ଝଙ୍କାର ଢାଞ୍ଚା। ଛୋଟ ସଙ୍ଗୀତାନୁଷ୍ଠାନ ପରି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ଗଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଚାଲୁ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବେ ଶେଷ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · title

strings.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · unit summary
strings.translation: B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍, D7, B ମାଇନର୍ ଓ G ମାଇନର୍, G, F ଓ D ରେ ବାଦନ, ଏବଂ ଗୀତକୁ ଯେକୌଣସି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନେବା।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ, ଓ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ।

strings.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ କର୍ଡରେ ତାର 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ର ସ୍ଥାନ B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ସହ ସମାନ?

strings.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: F ରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ଥାଏ। ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ସେଠାରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D7 and the key of G
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · title

strings.source: D7: a barre and one finger
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଓ ତାର 1, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ରେ G, C ଓ D7 କର୍ଡ ଅଧିକାଂଶ କାମ କରନ୍ତି, ଗମ୍ଭୀର ରଙ୍ଗ ପାଇଁ E ମାଇନର୍। G7 ଯେପରି C ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ, D7 ସେପରି G କୁ ଫେରାଏ।

strings.source: B minor and the key of D
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title
strings.translation: B ମାଇନର୍ ଓ D ରେ ବାଦନ

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ଯାଏଁ ପହଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: D ଓ B ମାଇନର୍ ଉଭୟ କେଉଁ ତାରର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଚାପନ୍ତି?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉଭୟ କର୍ଡ ତାର 3 ଓ 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଧରନ୍ତି। କେବଳ ବାହାରର ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବଦଳନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ରେ D, G ଓ A7 ଗୀତକୁ ଆଗେଇ ନିଅନ୍ତି, B ମାଇନର୍ ବିଷାଦର ରଙ୍ଗ ଯୋଡ଼େ। A7 ପାଇଁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୀତର କର୍ଡ ତାହାର ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପଦକ୍ରମ: I, IV ଓ V। ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳିଲେ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ସମାନ ରହେ। C ରେ C, F ଓ G7; G ରେ G, C ଓ D7; F ରେ F, B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ଓ C7।

strings.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: F ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: F, G, A, B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍। ଚତୁର୍ଥ ସ୍ୱର B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଗୀତ ବହୁତ ଉଚ୍ଚ କିମ୍ବା ନିମ୍ନ ହେଲେ ଅନ୍ୟ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ସମାନ ସଂଖ୍ୟା, ସମାନ ଗୀତ, କେବଳ କଣ୍ଠକୁ ଅଧିକ ମାନେ।

strings.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: D, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, A। A ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱର, ତେଣୁ A7 ହେଉଛି V କର୍ଡ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3, ଓ ତାର 1, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1। ତାର 4 ଖୋଲା ଝଙ୍କାରେ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ମାଇନର୍‌ର ପରିବାର D ମାଇନର୍, G ମାଇନର୍ ଓ A7। E7 ଯେପରି A ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ଟାଣେ, A7 ସେପରି D ମାଇନର୍ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରାଏ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍, D7, B ମାଇନର୍ ଓ G ମାଇନର୍, ଏବଂ C, G, F ଓ D ରେ ବାଦନ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ତାପରେ ସ୍ଥିର ଝଙ୍କାର।

strings.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

strings.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଚଙ୍କ୍, ବ୍ୟାକ୍‌ବିଟ୍ ସହ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଝଙ୍କାର, ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଓ ରାଗ୍‌ଟାଇମ୍ କର୍ଡ, 3-3-2 ରେ ଜୋର୍, ଏବଂ ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚଙ୍କ୍ ହେଉଛି ତୁରନ୍ତ ଥାମିଯାଉଥିବା ଝଙ୍କାର। ତଳକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ସେହି ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ ପାପୁଲିର ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ତାର ଉପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ: ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ପରି ଛୋଟ, ଶୁଷ୍କ ଟିକ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1 ରେ ତଳ, 2 ରେ ଚଙ୍କ୍, 3 ରେ ତଳ-ଉପର, 4 ରେ ଚଙ୍କ୍। ଡ୍ରମର୍ ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ବଜାଉଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଚଙ୍କ୍ ପଡ଼େ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରି ବ୍ୟାକ୍‌ବିଟ୍, ଯେଉଁଠି ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ବାଜେ। ସେଠାରେ ଚଙ୍କ୍ ଝଙ୍କାରକୁ ଡ୍ରମର୍ ପରି ଶକ୍ତି ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

strings.source: Swap one down for a chunk
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଝଙ୍କାର D, DU, UDU ନେଇ 2 ର ତଳମୁହାଁକୁ ଚଙ୍କ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଲୟ ସମାନ ରହେ; ତାହାରେ ବ୍ୟାକ୍‌ବିଟ୍ ଆସେ।

strings.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ଝଙ୍କାରରେ କେଉଁ ଚାଳନା ଚଙ୍କ୍ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା 1 ଝଙ୍କାରେ, ମାତ୍ରା 2 ରେ ଟିକ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି। ଅନ୍ୟ ସବୁ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଝଙ୍କାରର ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରହେ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

strings.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଅସମାନ ଭାବେ ବାଣ୍ଟେ: ଲମ୍ବା ତଳମୁହାଁ, ତାପରେ ଛୋଟ ଉପରମୁହାଁ। ଝଙ୍କାର ବେଳେ ହମ୍-ଟି, ଡମ୍-ଟି କୁହନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ପୁରୁଣା ୟୁକୁଲେଲେ ସୁରର ଦୋଳାୟମାନ ଲୟ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C, A7, D7, G7, ତାପରେ ମୂଳ C କୁ। ପ୍ରତି ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀକୁ ଟାଣେ, ଟାଣର ଏକ ଛୋଟ ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳ। ଶହେ ବର୍ଷ ପୂର୍ବେ ଅଗଣିତ ଗୀତରେ ଏହା ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୋଇଥିଲା।

strings.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏଠାରେ D7 କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ?

strings.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D7 ରୁ G, ଏବଂ G7 ରୁ ମୂଳ C କୁ ଯାଏ। ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରେ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ଥିର ତଳ-ଉପର ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଲୟରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ତିନୋଟିରେ ଅଧିକ ଜୋର୍ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ: 1, 2 ର ‘ଓ’, ଓ 4। ଜୋର୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକ 3, 3 ଓ 2 ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ବ୍ୟବଧାନରେ ପଡ଼ନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ଆଠ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ରେ 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି 1 ରେ ଜୋର୍।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାଞ୍ଜୋ ୟୁକୁଲେଲେରେ ଜର୍ଜ୍ ଫର୍ମ୍‌ବିଙ୍କ ସ୍ପ୍ଲିଟ୍ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରୋକ୍ ସେହି ତିନି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ବଡ଼ ଝଙ୍କାର ରଖେ, ମଝିରେ ଏକକ ତାର। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଜୋର୍ ଦେବା ଆୟତ୍ତ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ 1 ରେ ତଳ, ତାପରେ 2 ଓ 3 ରେ ତଳ-ଉପର: D, DU, DU। ଦୋଳନ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ହେବା ପାଇଁ 1 ରେ ଜୋର୍ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ କେତୋଟି ଝଙ୍କାର ଥାଏ?

strings.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: 1 ରେ ତଳ, ତାପରେ 2 ଓ 3 ରେ ତଳ-ଉପର: ଗୋଟିଏ ସହ ଦୁଇଟି ସହ ଦୁଇଟି।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ଚଙ୍କ୍, ଚଙ୍କ୍ ସହ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଝଙ୍କାର, ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍, 3-3-2 ଜୋର୍ ଓ ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍। ହାତ ଚଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଜୋର୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କଥା କହିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · title

strings.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ତାରକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ପ୍ରବାହମାନ ଢାଞ୍ଚା, ପାଳିକରି ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ଓ କର୍ଡ ଭିତରୁ ବଜାଯାଉଥିବା ସୁର।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 4 ରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତାର 3 ରେ ତର୍ଜନୀ, ତାର 2 ରେ ମଧ୍ୟମା ଓ ତାର 1 ରେ ଅନାମିକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ କେବଳ ନିଜ ତାର ବଜାଏ।

strings.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତର୍ଜନୀ, ମଧ୍ୟମା, ଅନାମିକା: ତାର 4, 3, 2 ଓ 1।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: 4 ରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, 3 ରେ ତର୍ଜନୀ, 2 ରେ ମଧ୍ୟମା, 1 ରେ ଅନାମିକା: ପ୍ରତି ତାରକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 4 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 4 ଉଚ୍ଚ G ହୋଇଥିବାରୁ ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଅଙ୍କାବଙ୍କା: ଉଚ୍ଚ, ନିମ୍ନ, ତାପରେ ଉପରକୁ। ସେହି ଝଲକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ବଜାଯାଉଥିବା ୟୁକୁଲେଲେର ଧ୍ୱନି।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 7 (along) · title
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍, F, C, G7, ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଲୟରେ

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 4, 3, 2 ଓ 1 ବଜାଇ 2 ଓ 3 ଦେଇ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତର୍ଜନୀ, ମଧ୍ୟମା, ଅନାମିକା, ମଧ୍ୟମା, ତର୍ଜନୀ। ଛଅ ସ୍ୱର ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 2 (along) · title

strings.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଅନାମିକା ତାର 1 ବଜାଇବା ପରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଆସେ?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉପରେ ପହଞ୍ଚି କ୍ରମ ଫେରେ: ତାର 1 ରେ ଅନାମିକା, ତାପରେ 2 ରେ ମଧ୍ୟମା ଓ 3 ରେ ତର୍ଜନୀ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ ନୂଆ କର୍ଡ ଧରନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ପ୍ରବାହ ଜାରି ରହେ; କେବଳ ତଳର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବଦଳେ।

strings.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 7 (along) · title
strings.translation: C, A ମାଇନର୍, D ମାଇନର୍, G7

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 3 ଓ 4 ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଦୋଳେ, ଅନ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ମଝିରେ ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ବଜାନ୍ତି। ଏହା ୟୁକୁଲେଲେର ଟ୍ରାଭିସ୍ ପିକିଂ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚାରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କ’ଣ କରେ?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଏକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ତାଳ ରଖେ, ଅନ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ମଝିର ସ୍ଥାନ ଭରନ୍ତି।

Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · title

strings.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କର୍ଡ ସୁରରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତ କର୍ଡ ଧରେ, ଆପଣ ତାହା ଭିତରୁ ସୁର ବଜାନ୍ତି। F ଧରିଲେ C, F ଓ A ଆଗରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତଳେ ଅଛନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: F ଧରନ୍ତୁ: ଖୋଲା ତାର 3, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1, ଖୋଲା ତାର 1। ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ଏହିଭଳି ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୁର କର୍ଡ ବାହାରକୁ ଗଲେ ଖାଲି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ। F ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ଧରେ, ସୁର ଫେରିଲେ ଉଠେ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 4 (along) · title

strings.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ଉପରେ ସୁରର D କେଉଁଠି?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍‌ର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଆଗରୁ ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର D ଧରିଛି। ସୁର ସିଧା କର୍ଡ ଭିତରେ ଯାଏ।

Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପଦ ମଝିରେ ପ୍ରବାହମାନ କର୍ଡ, ଓ କର୍ଡ ଭିତରେ ସୁର। ସୁରଟି 1829 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ନ୍ୟୁ ବ୍ରିଟେନ୍ ଭଜନ, ଜନ୍ ନ୍ୟୁଟନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଶବ୍ଦ ସହ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 2 (along) · title

strings.source: Why does the intro's last bar end on a long note?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭର ଶେଷ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରରେ କାହିଁକି ଶେଷ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: To leave room for the pickup
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ ପୂର୍ବର ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ସ୍ଥାନ ଛାଡ଼ିବାକୁ

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପଦ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ଆଗରୁ, ଆରମ୍ଭ ପୂର୍ବର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ଲମ୍ବା ଶେଷ ସ୍ୱର ସେହି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଖାଲି ରଖେ।

strings.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ପ୍ରତି ତାରକୁ ଏକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ଆଗପଛ ପ୍ରବାହ, ପାଳିକରି ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଓ କର୍ଡ ଭିତରେ ସୁର।

strings.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 “Campfire to stage” · unit summary
strings.translation: ୟୁକୁଲେଲେ ପାଇଁ ସଜାଯାଇଥିବା ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ଅଧିକାରର ଚାରି ଗୀତ, ଓ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ସାଥିରେ ନେଇ ଗାଇବାର ଉପାୟ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1918 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ନଦୀ କୂଳରେ ଗୀତ ଏକାଠି ଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ତିଆରି। ୟୁକୁଲେଲେରେ ଏହା G ରେ, G, C ଓ D7 ସହ, ଏବଂ ତାର 1, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର ଗସ୍ପେଲ୍ ରଙ୍ଗର A ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ନଦୀ କୂଳରେ: B, B, A ଶାର୍ପ, B, ତାପରେ A ଓ G।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · title
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସେସିଲ୍ ଶାର୍ପ ଏହି ଇଂରାଜୀ ଧୀର ଗୀତ 1906 ରେ ଛାପିଥିଲେ। F ରେ ଏହା F, B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍, C ଓ C7, G ମାଇନର୍ ଓ D ମାଇନର୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ଦୁଇଟି। ପଦ ମଝିରେ କର୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ବଜାଇ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ବିସ୍ତୃତ ଜଳରାଶି: ଖୋଲା ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ F ଦୁଇଥର, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା A।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଠାରେ ଅନେକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଅଧାରେ ବଦଳେ। ପଦକୁ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରାର ଅଧା ଭାଗରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ କର୍ଡ, ଓ ପ୍ରତି ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଟିକ୍‌ରେ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଝଙ୍କାର ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଗୀତର ବେଗରେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଚାରି। ସମସ୍ତେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସ୍ଥିର କରା ବେଗରେ ଏକାଠି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବେ।

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କର୍ଡ ଛୁଟିଗଲା? ଝଙ୍କାର ଜାରି ରଖି ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀଟି ଧରନ୍ତୁ। ଗାଉଥିବା ଲୋକେ ତାଳ ଅନୁସରନ୍ତି, ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ନୁହେଁ।

strings.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?

strings.translation: ଗୀତ ମଝିରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ ଭୁଲ୍ ହେଲା। ଏବେ କ’ଣ?

strings.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord

strings.translation: ଝଙ୍କାର ଜାରି ରଖି ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କର୍ଡ ଧରନ୍ତୁ

Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାଳ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଆଗେଇ ନିଏ। ଦରକାର ହେଲେ କର୍ଡ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ, ଲୟ କେବେ ନୁହେଁ।

strings.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଧାଡ଼ି ପୂର୍ବରୁ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ହଲାନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ‘ଶେଷ ଥର’ କୁହନ୍ତୁ। ଶେଷ ଧାଡ଼ି ଟିକେ ଧୀର କରି ଅନ୍ତିମ କର୍ଡ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମଲି ମାଲୋନ୍ 1876 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଏହା ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍: ମାତ୍ରା 1 ରେ ଜୋର୍ ଦେଇ ସୁରକୁ ଦୋଳିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। F ରେ ଏହା F, G ମାଇନର୍, C7, D ମାଇନର୍ ଓ G7 ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ।

strings.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଡବ୍ଲିନ୍‌ର ସୁନ୍ଦର ସହରରେ: ଖୋଲା ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର F ଚାରିଥର, ଖୋଲା A, ପୁଣି F।

strings.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ F କୁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ଟାଣେ?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C7 ହେଉଛି F ର V କର୍ଡ। ଏହାର ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର ସିଧା ମୂଳକୁ ଟାଣେ।

strings.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ନାଆ ବାହିବା ଗୀତ ଛଅ-ଆଠ ତାଳରେ: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଛଅ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗଣନା, ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ଦୋଳନ ପରି ଅନୁଭବ ହୁଏ। 1 2 3, 4 5 6 ଗଣି 1 ଓ 4 ରେ ଜୋର୍ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଛଅ-ଆଠ ତାଳରେ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରା କେଉଁଠି ପଡ଼େ?

strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
strings.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଛଅ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇଟି ତିନିର ଦଳରେ: 1 2 3, 4 5 6। ପ୍ରତି ଦଳର ପ୍ରଥମଟିରେ ଦୋଳନର ଜୋର୍ ଥାଏ।

strings.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
strings.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସବୁଠାରୁ ମୋଟା ତାରର ସ୍ୱର ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ। ବଜାଇବାବେଳେ ଏହା ମୁହଁର ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିକଟରେ ରହେ। ଏହାକୁ ତାର 4 କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).

strings.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.

strings.translation: ମୋଟାରୁ ପତଳା: E, A, D, G। ଗିଟାରର ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ଚାରି ତାର ସହ ମିଳେ, ଗୋଟିଏ ସପ୍ତକ ତଳେ। ମନେ ରଖିବାକୁ କୁହନ୍ତୁ: Every Amp Drives Grooves।

strings.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.

strings.translation: ତର୍ଜନୀ ଓ ମଧ୍ୟମାର ନରମ ଅଂଶରେ ପାଳିକରି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପିକ୍‌ଅପ୍ କିମ୍ବା ତାର 4 ଉପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
strings.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାରକୁ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଟାଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ଉପରକୁ ଓ ଦୂରକୁ ନୁହେଁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ମୋଟା ତାର ଉପରେ ଥାମେ। ଏହି ରେଷ୍ଟ୍ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରୋକ୍ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଓ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: B at fret 2 on string 3, open A, and G at fret 3 on string 4. Second finger for B, third for G.

strings.translation: ମେରୀର ଛୋଟ ମେଣ୍ଢା ପାଇଁ ତିନି ସ୍ୱର ଦରକାର: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର B, ଖୋଲା A, ଓ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G। B ପାଇଁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, G ପାଇଁ ତୃତୀୟ।

strings.translation: B A G A B B B: ତାର 3, ତାପରେ ତାର 4 ର G।

strings.source: Every chord is built on one note, its root. The root of an A chord is A. Bass players play roots so the band knows where home is.
strings.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରେ ଗଢ଼ା, ତାହାର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର। A କର୍ଡର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର A। ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ମୂଳ କେଉଁଠି ଜାଣିବା ପାଇଁ ବେସ୍ ବାଦକ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତି।

strings.translation: ଧରନ୍ତୁ, ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ, ଖୋଲା ତାର ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଗୀତ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍ ଥୋଡ଼ି ତଳେ ରଖିଲେ ବାମରୁ ଡାହାଣକୁ ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ G, D, A, E। G ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ଓ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର। E ସବୁଠୁ ପତଳା ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର; ଏହାକୁ ତାର 1 କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଉଠାଇ ରଖୁଥିବା ପତଳା କାଠର ଖିଲାଣ ହେଉଛି ବ୍ରିଜ୍। କେବଳ ତାରର ଚାପରେ ଏହା ଠିଆ ରହେ। ଢଳିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ବା ଯନ୍ତ୍ର ଦୋକାନର ସାହାଯ୍ୟରେ ସିଧା କରାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: E ସବୁଠୁ ପତଳା ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ତାର। E (1)ରୁ G (4) ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତାର ଗଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୋ ବ୍ୟବହାର ପୂର୍ବରୁ ତାର ଟାଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ଡାହାଣ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡର ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରେ ରଖି ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ। ଏହାକୁ ପିଜିକାଟୋ କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ ଗିଟାର୍ ପରି ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍‌କୁ କୋଳରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାର 2, Aକୁ ଟାଣି ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Now the thickest string, the G.

strings.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍‌ର ତଳ ଧାରକୁ ବାମ କଲାରବୋନ୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଲାଇ ଚିନ୍ ରେଷ୍ଟରେ ହନୁ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ମୁଣ୍ଡର ଓଜନ ଯନ୍ତ୍ରକୁ ଧରି ରଖେ। ଚାପି ଧରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍କ୍ରୋଲ୍‌କୁ ଆଗକୁ ଓ ବାମକୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ ଚଟାଣ ସହ ସମାନ୍ତରାଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ବାମ ହାତରେ ନେକ୍‌କୁ ଧରନ୍ତୁ; ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ସାମ୍ନାରେ ରହିବ। ମଣିବନ୍ଧ ସିଧା ଓ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଚିନ୍ ରେଷ୍ଟରେ ମୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ବିଶ୍ରାମ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ହାତ ଚାପି ଧରିଲେ ବା କାନ୍ଧ ଉଠାଇଲେ ଟାଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୁଏ, ଯାହା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ବେସୁରା କରେ।

strings.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍‌କୁ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଧରି D ତାର, ତାର 3କୁ ଟାଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କାଠର ଦଣ୍ଡ ଆପଣ ଧରୁଥିବା ଫ୍ରଗ୍‌ରୁ ଅଗ୍ରଭାଗ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରହେ। ମଝିରେ ଘୋଡ଼ା ଲୋମ ଟଣା ହୋଇଥାଏ। ଲୋମ ଓ ଦଣ୍ଡ ମଝିରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ପେନସିଲ୍ ପଶିବା ଯାଏଁ ପେଚ କଷନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ବଙ୍କା କରି ଫ୍ରଗ୍ ଓ ଦଣ୍ଡର ସଂଯୋଗ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ତା’ର ଅଗ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଅନ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଦଣ୍ଡ ଉପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉପରେ ବଙ୍କା ହୋଇ ଠିଆ ରହିବ। ପୂରା ହାତ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ବଙ୍କା ହୋଇ, ଫ୍ରଗ୍ ଓ ଦଣ୍ଡର ସଂଯୋଗରେ

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Flat on top of the stick
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରଗ୍‌ରେ ବଙ୍କା ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖିଲେ ହାତ ଢିଲା ରହେ ଓ ବୋର ସନ୍ତୁଳନ ରକ୍ଷା ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରୋଜିନ୍ ବିନା ଲୋମ ତାର ଉପରେ ଖସିଯାଏ, ଶବ୍ଦ ହୁଏନି। ବଜାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଲୋମରେ ରୋଜିନ୍ ଖଣ୍ଡ କିଛିଥର ଘଷନ୍ତୁ। ହାଲୁକା ପ୍ରଲେପ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ।

strings.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଓ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡର ମଝିରେ A ତାର ଉପରେ ବୋ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଧୀରେ ଡାହାଣକୁ ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ D ତାର। କହୁଣି ଟିକେ ଉଠାଇ ଧୀରେ ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 7 (along) · title

strings.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ: G, D, A, E। ପ୍ରତି ତାର ପୂର୍ବ ତାରଠାରୁ ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଉପରେ; ଏହାକୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କୁହାଯାଏ। ମନେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ: Good Dogs Always Eat।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଡାହାଣ କହୁଣି ବୋ କେଉଁ ତାରରେ ବାଜିବ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେ। G ପାଇଁ ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ, E ପାଇଁ ତଳକୁ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଶିଡ଼ିର ପାହାଚ ପରି ପ୍ରତି ତାରର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ଉଚ୍ଚତା ଅଛି।

strings.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G ତାରରେ ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ Dରେ। G ପାଇଁ କହୁଣି ସବୁଠୁ ଉଚ୍ଚରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ A, ପରେ E। ପ୍ରତିଟି ପାଇଁ କହୁଣି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ତର ତଳକୁ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ତାର ପାଇଁ କହୁଣି ସବୁଠୁ ଉଚ୍ଚରେ ରହେ?

strings.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ତାର ସବୁଠୁ ବାମରେ ଥାଏ, ତେଣୁ ସେଠାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବାକୁ ବାହୁ ଉଠେ। E ପାଇଁ ବାହୁ ସବୁଠୁ ତଳେ ରହେ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅର୍କେଷ୍ଟ୍ରା A ସହ ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତି। ପ୍ରତି ତାର ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ କେତେ ସେଣ୍ଟ ଦୂରରେ ଅଛି Timbre ଦେଖାଏ; 100 ସେଣ୍ଟ ହେଉଛି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ପିଆନୋର ସବୁଠୁ ଛୋଟ ଅନ୍ତର। A, ପରେ D, G ଓ Eର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଟେଲ୍‌ପିସ୍‌ର ଛୋଟ ପେଚଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଫାଇନ୍ ଟ୍ୟୁନର୍। ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ଘଣ୍ଟାକଣ୍ଟା ଦିଗରେ, ନିମ୍ନ କରିବାକୁ ବିପରୀତ ଦିଗରେ ବୁଲାନ୍ତୁ। ଚଉଠେ ଘେରା ବୁଲାଇବା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ।

strings.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ତାରର ସ୍ୱର ଟିକେ ନିମ୍ନ ଅଛି। କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ଅର୍ଥ ସ୍ୱର ଅତି ନିମ୍ନ। ଘଣ୍ଟାକଣ୍ଟା ଦିଗରେ ବୁଲାଇଲେ ତାର କଷି ହୁଏ ଓ ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫାଇନ୍ ଟ୍ୟୁନର୍ ଆଉ ବୁଲି ନପାରିଲେ ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଭିତରକୁ ଚାପି ଟିକେ ବୁଲାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଏହା ଅଟକି ରହିବ। ତାର ବହୁତ ବେସୁରା ଥିଲେ ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କୁ ପଚାରନ୍ତୁ; ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ଖସିପାରେ।

strings.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A ତାରର ସୁର ମିଳାଇ, ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ D, G ଓ E। ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସୁର ମିଳାଇ, ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସ୍ୱର ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କଲାରବୋନ୍‌ରେ ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍, ବୋ ଢିଲା ଧରି, ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଓ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡ ମଝିରେ ବୋ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏବେ ଏହି ଏକକର ସବୁକିଛି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚରୁ ନିମ୍ନକୁ ପ୍ରତି ଖୋଲା ତାରରେ ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which string do you tune first?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଅର୍କେଷ୍ଟ୍ରା A ସହ ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତି, ତେଣୁ ସେଠାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ପରେ ଅନ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ମେରୀର ଛୋଟ ମେଣ୍ଢା” A ତାରରେ ବାଜେ: ଖୋଲା A, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ B, ଆଉ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ C ଶାର୍ପ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଟାଣି, ପରେ ବୋରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା B।

strings.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା C ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C ଶାର୍ପ, B, A, B, ପରେ ତିନିଥର C ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · title

strings.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଲମ୍ବା, ସମାନ ବୋ ଚାଳନା, ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ତାର ବଦଳ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଛନ୍ଦ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଡାଉନ୍-ବୋରେ ଫ୍ରଗ୍‌ରୁ ଅଗ୍ରଭାଗ ଆଡ଼କୁ ବୋ ଡାହାଣକୁ ଟଣା ହୁଏ। ଅପ୍-ବୋରେ ତାହା ବାମକୁ ଫେରେ। ସ୍ୱରଲିପିରେ ଡାଉନ୍-ବୋ ଚିହ୍ନ ଛୋଟ ଟେବୁଲ୍ ପରି ଓ ଅପ୍-ବୋ ଚିହ୍ନ V ପରି।

strings.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଓ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡର ଶେଷ ମଝିରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ରେଳପଥରେ ଟ୍ରେନ୍ ପରି ବୋକୁ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ସହ ସମାନ୍ତରାଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Aରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଧୀର ଡାଉନ୍-ବୋ, ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଧୀର ଅପ୍-ବୋ। ଶେଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଶବ୍ଦ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ। ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ କମ୍ ବୋ ଦରକାର, ତେଣୁ ବୋର ମଝି ଅଧା ଭାଗ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ପ୍ରତି ଚାଳନାର ଦୈର୍ଘ୍ୟ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ। ଲମ୍ବା, ଧୀର ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଶବ୍ଦ କମି ନଯିବ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ନୋଟ୍ ପାଇଁ ଅଧିକ ବୋ ଦରକାର?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ସମୟ ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ଲମ୍ବା, ଧୀର ବୋ ଚାଳନା ଦରକାର।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର ବଦଳାଇବାକୁ ମଣିବନ୍ଧ ନୁହେଁ, କହୁଣିର ଉଚ୍ଚତା ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ। ବୋର ଦିଗ ବଦଳିବା ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନୂଆ ଉଚ୍ଚତାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A, E, A, E। କହୁଣିକୁ ଦୁଇ ଉଚ୍ଚତା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଦୋଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Gରୁ Aକୁ ଯିବାବେଳେ D ତାର ଛାଡ଼ିବାକୁ ହୁଏ, ତେଣୁ କହୁଣି ଅଧିକ ଚଳେ। ସହଜରେ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମଝି ତାରକୁ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୁଇଟି ବାଜେ। ବୋର ମଝି ପାଖରେ ଛୋଟ, ଦ୍ରୁତ ଚାଳନା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କେତେଟି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ବାଜେ?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ: ଗୋଟିଏ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍, ଦୁଇଟି ଏଇଥ୍, ପରେ ଦୁଇଟି କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍। ଫିଡଲ୍ ବାଦକମାନେ ଏହି ଛନ୍ଦ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି। ପ୍ରଥମେ କୁହନ୍ତୁ: ଲମ୍ବା, ଛୋଟ-ଛୋଟ, ଲମ୍ବା, ଲମ୍ବା।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ପର୍ଶ ବିନ୍ଦୁରେ ସିଧା ବୋ, କହୁଣିରୁ ତାର ବଦଳ ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ଛନ୍ଦ। ଏଠାରେ ତିନୋଟିକୁ ମିଶାଇବା।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · title
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବିନ୍ୟାସ: A ଓ E

strings.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, 2 ଓ 3 ରଖନ୍ତୁ, A ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଗୀତ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଯନ୍ତ୍ରରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ଶୁଣି ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରର ସ୍ଥାନ ଧରିବେ। ଶିଖିବାବେଳେ ଅନେକ ବାଦକ ଚିହ୍ନ ପାଇଁ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡରେ ପତଳା ଟେପ୍ ଲଗାନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ତାରର ପ୍ରଥମ ଟେପ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଅଗ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା B, Aଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ; ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଥାଏ। ତାର ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡକୁ ଛୁଇଁବା ଯାଏଁ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା A, ପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ B। Bର ସୁର ମିଳି ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ଯାଏଁ ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ ବା ନିମ୍ନ? ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ

strings.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Timbre 30 ସେଣ୍ଟ ଭିତରର ସ୍ୱର ଗ୍ରହଣ କରେ, ଯାହା ପ୍ରାୟ ଏକ ତୃତୀୟାଂଶ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ ଥିଲେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ସ୍କ୍ରୋଲ୍ ଆଡ଼କୁ, ନିମ୍ନ ଥିଲେ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟିକେ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: B, ଖୋଲା A, B। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାଇ ସେହି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ପୁଣି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା A, ପରେ B। କେତେ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି C ଶାର୍ପ ବଜାଏ, ଯାହା Bଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ; ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଠାରୁ ଫାଙ୍କ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏହି ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2 କୁହାଯାଏ, କାରଣ ଏହା ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ସ୍ଥାନ ପାଖରେ।

strings.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A, B, C ଶାର୍ପ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବଜାଇବାବେଳେ ପ୍ରଥମଟି ରଖିଥାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?

strings.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.

strings.translation: A, B, C ଶାର୍ପ, D। ପର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖିବାବେଳେ ଆଗଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ରଖିଥାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.

strings.translation: Dର ସୁର ମିଳିଲେ ଖୋଲା D ତାର ମଧ୍ୟ ତା’ ସହ କମ୍ପେ। ଦୁହିଁଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଏକ, ଆଠଟି ସ୍ୱର ଦୂରରେ: ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍। ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍‌ର ଭରପୂର ଶବ୍ଦ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.

strings.translation: D ମେଜର୍‌ରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଶାର୍ପ: F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ। ଦୁହିଁଟି ଉଚ୍ଚ 2।

strings.source: Lightly Row is an old German children's song. It walks up and down the D major scale on the D and A strings.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାଲୁକାରେ ନାଆ ବାହ ଏକ ପୁରୁଣା ଜର୍ମାନ୍ ଶିଶୁଗୀତ। ଏହା D ଓ A ତାରରେ D ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଉପର ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ତାରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି A, ଉଚ୍ଚ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ B ଓ ତୃତୀୟ C ବଜାଏ। ପୁଣି ସମାନ ବିନ୍ୟାସ। ବୋ ଧରିଥିବା ବାହୁ ସବୁଠୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ତରକୁ ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G, A, B, C। ପହଞ୍ଚିବା ପାଇଁ ବାମ କହୁଣି ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍ ତଳକୁ ଟିକେ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G ତାରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର A, ପରେ ଖୋଲା A ତାର। ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରନାମ, ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଦୂରରେ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ତାରରେ G, A, B, C ସହ D ତାରରେ D, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G ମିଶି G ମେଜର୍ ହୁଏ। ଏହା ଦୁଇ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପ୍ରଥମ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍; ପର ଏକକରେ ଏହା ପୂରା କରିବେ।

strings.source: Up the G major scale. Same shape on both strings.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଉପରକୁ। ଦୁଇ ତାରରେ ସମାନ ବିନ୍ୟାସ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବେଥୋଭେନ୍ 1824ରେ ନବମ ସିମ୍ଫୋନି ପାଇଁ ଏହି ସୁର ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ଏହା ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ପାଖାପାଖି ସ୍ୱରରେ ଚାଲେ, ତେଣୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଳିକରି ଚଳନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ ଶେଷରେ ଲମ୍ବା, ଛୋଟ, ଲମ୍ବା: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍, ଏଇଥ୍ ଓ ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍। ନୋଟ୍ ପରର ବିନ୍ଦୁ ତା’ ଅବଧିର ଅଧା ଯୋଡ଼େ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · title
Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ପୁରୁଣା ଆମେରିକୀୟ ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁର ଖୋଲା ତାରରେ ବଜାଇଥିବା ଛନ୍ଦରେ ଚାଲେ: ଲମ୍ବା, ଛୋଟ-ଛୋଟ, ଲମ୍ବା, ଲମ୍ବା। ଫିଡଲ୍ ବାଦକମାନେ ସବୁଠି ମିଳିତ ବାଦନରେ ଏହା ବଜାନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Which string does this tune never use?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁର କେଉଁ ତାର କେବେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେନି?

strings.source: It lives on the D, A and E strings.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା D, A ଓ E ତାରରେ ବାଜେ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

strings.source: Whole step, whole step, half step works on every string so far. Raise your bow arm for the low strings and let the octaves ring.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପ୍ରତି ତାରରେ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ। ନିମ୍ନ ତାର ପାଇଁ ବୋ ଧରିଥିବା ବାହୁ ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଅନୁରଣିତ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then A with open A.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଯାଞ୍ଚ: ଖୋଲା G ସହ G, ପରେ ଖୋଲା A ସହ A।

strings.source: In D major, which finger plays C sharp?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: D ମେଜର୍‌ରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି C ଶାର୍ପ ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: Move second finger to change keys: G major in two octaves, A minor and fiddle tunes.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 “Low 2 and high 2” · unit summary
strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳାଇବାକୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ: ଦୁଇ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍‌ରେ G ମେଜର୍, A ମାଇନର୍ ଓ ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁର।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Slide second finger back until it touches first. On the A string that's C natural, a half step below C sharp. Players call it low 2.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ପ୍ରଥମଟିକୁ ଛୁଇଁବା ଯାଏଁ ପଛକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। A ତାରରେ ଏହା C ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍, C ଶାର୍ପଠାରୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ। ଏହାକୁ ନିମ୍ନ 2 କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A, B, C, D। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରଥମକୁ ଛୁଏ; ତୃତୀୟ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଫାଙ୍କ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: High 2, low 2, high 2, low 2. Move only your second finger.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ 2, ନିମ୍ନ 2, ଉଚ୍ଚ 2, ନିମ୍ନ 2। କେବଳ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ।
