strings.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ A ତାରରେ C ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ଓ E ତାରରେ G ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ଦରକାର, ତେଣୁ ସେଠି ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ନିମ୍ନରେ ରହେ। G ଓ D ତାରରେ ଏହା ଉଚ୍ଚରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: The A string in G major: second finger low, touching first.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ A ତାର: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ନିମ୍ନରେ, ପ୍ରଥମକୁ ଛୁଇଁ।

strings.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ E ତାରରେ E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G। ପୁଣି ନିମ୍ନ 2।

strings.source: Where does second finger go on the E string in G major?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ E ତାରର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କେଉଁଠି ରହେ?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: G natural is a half step above F sharp, so second finger tucks right against first.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ F ଶାର୍ପଠାରୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ, ତେଣୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରଥମକୁ ଲାଗି ରହେ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Start on open G and climb to G on the E string: fifteen notes, two octaves. High 2 on the low strings, low 2 on the high ones.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା Gରୁ E ତାରର G ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଉପରକୁ: ପନ୍ଦରଟି ସ୍ୱର, ଦୁଇ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍। ନିମ୍ନ ତାରରେ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2, ଉଚ୍ଚ ତାରରେ ନିମ୍ନ 2।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A minor starts with first-finger A on the G string. Second finger is high on the G string for B, then low on the D string for F natural.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ G ତାରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର Aରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। B ପାଇଁ G ତାରରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଚ୍ଚରେ, ପରେ F ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ପାଇଁ D ତାରରେ ନିମ୍ନରେ।

strings.source: A minor, up. High 2 on the G string, low 2 on the D string.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ଉପରକୁ। G ତାରରେ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2, D ତାରରେ ନିମ୍ନ 2।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Its third note is a half step lower
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: It starts on a lower string
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A to C sounds dark; A to C sharp sounds bright. One half step changes the whole mood.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Aରୁ C ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ; Aରୁ C ଶାର୍ପ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ। ଗୋଟିଏ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ପୂରା ଭାବ ବଦଳାଏ।

Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This minuet comes from the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725. It's now credited to Christian Petzold. Count three beats to a bar.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ମିନୁଏଟ୍ 1725ରେ ବାଖ୍ ତାଙ୍କ ପତ୍ନୀ ଆନା ମାଗ୍‌ଡାଲେନାଙ୍କୁ ଦେଇଥିବା ଖାତାରୁ ଆସିଛି। ଏବେ ଏହାର ରଚୟିତା କ୍ରିଷ୍ଟିଆନ୍ ପେଟ୍‌ଜୋଲ୍ଡ ବୋଲି ମନାଯାଏ। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରା ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which C does the minuet use?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମିନୁଏଟ୍ G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ, ତେଣୁ C ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ଓ A ତାରରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ନିମ୍ନରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D ତାରରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2: Aରେ ନିମ୍ନ, Dରେ ଉଚ୍ଚ।

strings.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଧା ଉଚ୍ଚରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ: E ତାରରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି Bରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ। ପରେ ତୃତୀୟ, ପରେ ନିମ୍ନ 2।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କ ଆପାଲାଚିଆର ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁର। ଏହା Aରେ, କିନ୍ତୁ G ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ: A ତାରରେ C ଶାର୍ପ ପାଇଁ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2, E ତାରରେ G ପାଇଁ ନିମ୍ନ 2।

strings.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, F ଶାର୍ପ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ନିମ୍ନରେ, ପ୍ରଥମକୁ ଛୁଇଁ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁର E ତାରରେ କେଉଁ G ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ଶାର୍ପ ବଦଳରେ G ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କକୁ ପୁରୁଣା ଲୋକସଙ୍ଗୀତର ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୈନିକର ଆନନ୍ଦ 1700 ମସିହାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିବା ଶତାବ୍ଦୀରେ ସ୍କଟଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା ଓ ଏବେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଆମେରିକାର ନୃତ୍ୟରେ ବାଜେ। ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଂଶ A, F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ D, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ D ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଦୋଳେ।

strings.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା A, Dରେ ଉଚ୍ଚ-2 F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା D, F ଶାର୍ପ। ତାର ମଧ୍ୟରେ କହୁଣି ଦୋଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E ତାରରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି G ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସୈନିକର ଆନନ୍ଦ D ମେଜର୍‌ରେ, ତେଣୁ G ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍: Dରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ପାଇଁ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2, Eରେ G ପାଇଁ ନିମ୍ନ 2।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଅନୁସାରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳେ। ବଜାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଭାବନ୍ତୁ: ଉଚ୍ଚ 2 ନା ନିମ୍ନ 2, ଏବଂ କେଉଁ ତାରରେ?

strings.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: F ଶାର୍ପ, ପରେ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2 ନା ନିମ୍ନ 2?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ ନିମ୍ନ 2 ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2, ପରେ E ତାରରେ ନିମ୍ନ 2 ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ 2।

strings.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ମେଜର୍‌ରେ A ଓ E ତାରର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କେଉଁଠି ରହେ?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Low on A, high on E
strings.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 “Expression” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଜୋର ଓ ମୃଦୁ, ସ୍ଲର୍, ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋର ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭ ଓ ପୂରା ଆନନ୍ଦର ଗୀତ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାହୁର ଓଜନ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ, ବୋର ବେଗ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସ୍ପର୍ଶ ବିନ୍ଦୁକୁ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖକୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ତିନୋଟି ଏକାଠି କରନ୍ତୁ। ମୃଦୁ ପାଇଁ ଓଲଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରଲିପିରେ ଜୋର ପାଇଁ f, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ଫୋର୍ଟେ, ଓ ମୃଦୁ ପାଇଁ p, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ପିଆନୋ ଲେଖାଯାଏ। କ୍ରମେ ଜୋର ବଢ଼ିବା କ୍ରେଶେଣ୍ଡୋ; କମିବା ଡିମିନୁଏଣ୍ଡୋ।

strings.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ତାର ଅଧିକ ଓଜନ ଓ ବେଗ ସହେ, ତେଣୁ ଖସଖସିଆ ଶବ୍ଦ ବିନା ଅଧିକ ଜୋରରେ ବାଜେ।

strings.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇଥର: ଫୋର୍ଟେ, ପରେ ପିଆନୋ। ଶବ୍ଦର ଜୋର ବଦଳିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସୁର ମିଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (along) · title
strings.translation: ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର: ଜୋର ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ କମାନ୍ତୁ

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title
strings.translation: ହାଲୁକାରେ ନାଆ ବାହ, ମୃଦୁ ପରେ ଜୋର

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A curved line over notes is a slur: play them all in one bow. Your left hand changes notes while the bow keeps moving.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୋଟ୍ ଉପରର ବକ୍ର ରେଖା ସ୍ଲର୍: ସବୁ ସ୍ୱର ଗୋଟିଏ ବୋ ଚାଳନାରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ବୋ ଚାଲୁଥିବାବେଳେ ବାମ ହାତ ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳାଏ।

strings.source: Slur A to B in one down-bow, then B to A in one up-bow.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ଡାଉନ୍-ବୋରେ Aରୁ B, ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅପ୍-ବୋରେ Bରୁ A ସ୍ଲର୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Two notes in one bow means each gets half of it. Plan ahead and start a slur with enough bow left for both notes.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ବୋ ଚାଳନାରେ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ହେଲେ ପ୍ରତିଟି ଅଧା ପାଏ। ଆଗରୁ ଭାବନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ବୋ ବାକି ରଖି ସ୍ଲର୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: What does a slur tell you?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Play the notes in one bow

Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତୃତୀୟଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ। D ତାରରେ ଏହା A, ଖୋଲା A ତାର ସହ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱର। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବଙ୍କା ରଖି ହାତକୁ ତା’ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟିକେ ଢଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D ତାରରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର A, ଖୋଲା A, ପୁଣି ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଦୁହିଁଙ୍କ ସୁର ପୂରା ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର ବଦଳରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କାହିଁକି?

strings.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର ବଦଳ ଏଡ଼ାଏ, ନରମ ଶବ୍ଦ ଦିଏ

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Open strings are out of tune
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖା ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମକୁ ଏକ ତାରରେ ରଖେ ଓ ପାଖ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ମିଶେ। ଖୋଲା ତାର ଅଧିକ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଝଙ୍କାର ଦିଏ।

strings.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର D, ଚତୁର୍ଥର E, ପରେ ଖୋଲା E। ସୁର ମିଳୁଛି କି ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D to A on one string
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 5 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ଗୀତ ନ୍ୟୁ ବ୍ରିଟେନ୍ ନାମର ପୁରୁଣା ଆମେରିକୀୟ ସୁରରେ ଗାଯାଏ। ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସ୍ଲର୍। ପୂରା, ଧୀର ବୋ ଚାଳନାରେ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗାଇବା ପରି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Gରୁ B ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରିବାରେ ତାର ବଦଳେ। କହୁଣିରୁ ସହଜରେ ଦୋଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: Bରୁ G ପରି ଦ୍ରୁତ ଯୋଡ଼ି କିପରି ବୋରେ ବଜାଇବେ?

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ଅଲଗା ବୋ ଚାଳନା

strings.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସ୍ଲର୍, ତେଣୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ବୋ ଚାଳନାରେ ବାଜନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାର ଛୋଟ, ସମାନ ତରଙ୍ଗ, ଯାହା ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଜୀବନ୍ତ କରେ। ହାତ ଓ ବାହୁର ଗତିରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଅଗ ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ପଛକୁ ଗଡ଼ି ପୁଣି ଫେରେ, ବାରମ୍ବାର।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ବେସୁରା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଠିକ୍ କରିପାରେନି; ସୁର ମିଳିଥିବା ସ୍ୱରରେ କେବଳ ରଙ୍ଗ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଧିକାଂଶ ବାଦକ ଖୋଜିବା ବିନା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଠିକ୍ ସୁରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲା ପରେ ଏହା ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତି।

strings.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଅଗ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରଖି ଗଣ୍ଠି ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଧୀରେ ହାତ ସ୍କ୍ରୋଲ୍ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଓ ପଛକୁ ଦୋଳାନ୍ତୁ। ଛୋଟ ଓ ସମାନ ଗତି। ଏଠି ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ ନଜର ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।

strings.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ବିନା ବୋରେ ବଜାଇ ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ। ସେହି କେନ୍ଦ୍ରରୁ ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆର୍କାନସାସ୍ ଯାତ୍ରୀ 1847 ସୁଦ୍ଧା ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଫିଡଲ୍ ବାଦକ ଏହାର ଦ୍ରୁତତମ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ିରେ ସ୍ଲର୍ କରନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ସୁରକୁ ଚଞ୍ଚଳ କରେ। ଧୀରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ଯୋଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫିଡଲ୍ ବାଦକ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଯୋଡ଼ିକୁ କାହିଁକି ସ୍ଲର୍ କରନ୍ତି?

strings.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ବୋ କମ୍ ଲାଗେ, ଲୟରେ ଦୋଳନ ଆସେ

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଅଧିକ ଜୋର କରେ

strings.source: It keeps the strings in tune
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E ତାରରେ A, G, F ଶାର୍ପ, A: ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ନିମ୍ନ 2, ପ୍ରଥମ, ତୃତୀୟ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସବୁ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ: ସୁର ମିଳା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ସିଧା ବୋ, ସ୍ଲର୍ ଓ ଶବ୍ଦର ଜୋର ବଦଳ। ପିଆନୋରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ମଝିରେ ଜୋର ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଫୋର୍ଟେରେ ଶେଷ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି: ଖୋଲା A, ପରେ E ସହ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

Cello course · title

strings.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
strings.context: Cello course · course subtitle
strings.translation: ବସି, ବୋ ଚଳାଇ ଠିକ୍ ସୁରରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ଖୋଲା ତାରରୁ ରାଜହଂସ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · title

strings.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · unit summary
strings.translation: ବସନ୍ତୁ, ଏଣ୍ଡ୍‌ପିନ୍ ସ୍ଥିର କରନ୍ତୁ, ବୋ ଧରନ୍ତୁ, ଖୋଲା ତାର ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଗୀତ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · title

strings.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚକୁ ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ C, G, D ଓ A। C ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ଓ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର। A ସବୁଠୁ ପତଳା ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର; ଏହାକୁ ତାର 1 କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ଓ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର ତାର। A (1)ରୁ C (4) ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତାର ଗଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ତାର, C। ତା’ର ଗଭୀର ଝଙ୍କାର ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · title
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚେୟାରର ଆଗ ଧାର ପାଖରେ, ପାଦ ସମତଳ ଓ ଆଣ୍ଠୁ ଅଲଗା କରି ବସନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସହଜରେ ଠିଆ ହୋଇପାରିବେ। ଚେଲୋ ଆଣ୍ଠୁ ମଝିରେ ରହେ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚେଲୋର ଉପର ଧାର ଛାତିର ମଝି ହାଡ଼କୁ ଓ C ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ବାମ କାନ ପାଖକୁ ଆସିବା ଯାଏଁ ଏଣ୍ଡ୍‌ପିନ୍ ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ପେଚ କଷନ୍ତୁ। ଆଧାର ବା ପଟି ଏହାକୁ ଖସିବାରୁ ରୋକେ।

strings.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଚେଲୋର ଉପର ଧାର ଶରୀରର କେଉଁଠି ଲାଗେ?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଚେଲୋ ପଛକୁ ଢଳି ଛାତିରେ ଲାଗେ ଓ ଆଣ୍ଠୁ ଦୁଇ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରୁ ହାଲୁକା ସ୍ଥିର କରେ।

strings.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ସିଧା ବସି D, ପରେ G ଟାଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। କାନ୍ଧ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ବଙ୍କା କରି ମଧ୍ୟମାର ସାମ୍ନାରେ, ଫ୍ରଗ୍ ଓ ଦଣ୍ଡର ସଂଯୋଗ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଅଗ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଚାରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଦଣ୍ଡ ଉପରେ ରଖି ହାତର ଓଜନ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଓ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡ ମଝିରେ D ତାରରେ ବୋ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଧୀରେ ଡାହାଣକୁ ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ A ତାର। ପୂରା ବାହୁକୁ ଏହାର ଉଚ୍ଚତାକୁ ନେଇ ଧୀରେ ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ: C, G, D, A। ପ୍ରତି ତାର ପୂର୍ବଟିଠାରୁ ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଉପରେ, ଯାହାକୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କୁହାଯାଏ। ମନେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ: Cats Go Dancing Around।

strings.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଡାହାଣ ବାହୁ ବୋ କେଉଁ ତାରରେ ବାଜିବ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେ। ଶିଡ଼ିର ପାହାଚ ପରି ପ୍ରତି ତାର ପାଇଁ ବାହୁର ଅଲଗା ଉଚ୍ଚତା। କେବଳ ହାତ ନୁହେଁ, ପୂରା ବାହୁ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C ତାରରେ ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ Gରେ। ପ୍ରତି ଉଚ୍ଚତାରେ ବାହୁକୁ ସ୍ଥିର ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · title

strings.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅର୍କେଷ୍ଟ୍ରା A ସହ ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତି। ପ୍ରତି ତାର ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ କେତେ ସେଣ୍ଟ ଦୂରରେ ଅଛି Timbre ଦେଖାଏ; 100 ସେଣ୍ଟ ହେଉଛି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ପିଆନୋର ସବୁଠୁ ଛୋଟ ଅନ୍ତର। A, ପରେ D, G ଓ Cର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ D, G ଓ C। ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସୁର ମିଳାଇ, ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସ୍ୱର ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · challenge vc-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଣ୍ଡ୍‌ପିନ୍ ସ୍ଥିର କରି ସିଧା ବସନ୍ତୁ, ବୋ ଢିଲା ଧରି ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଓ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡ ମଝିରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏବେ ଏହି ଏକକର ସବୁକିଛି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେରୀର ଛୋଟ ମେଣ୍ଢା D ତାରରେ ବାଜେ: ଖୋଲା D, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର E, ଦୁଇ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର F ଶାର୍ପ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଟାଣି, ପରେ ବୋରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D ତାରରେ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା E।

strings.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: F ଶାର୍ପ, E, D, E, ପରେ ତିନିଥର F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Dରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଧୀର ଡାଉନ୍-ବୋ, ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଧୀର ଅପ୍-ବୋ। ଶେଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଶବ୍ଦ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D, A, D, A। ବାହୁକୁ ଦୁଇ ଉଚ୍ଚତା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଦୋଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Cରୁ Dକୁ ଯିବାବେଳେ G ତାର ଛାଡ଼ିବାକୁ ହୁଏ, ତେଣୁ ବାହୁ ଅଧିକ ଚଳେ। ସହଜରେ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମଝି ତାରକୁ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · title

strings.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: D ମେଜର୍ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ସୁର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ସଙ୍ଗୀତର ସବୁଠୁ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ପ୍ରଥମ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ ଖୋଲା ତାରଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର (ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର) ଉପରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୂରରେ ରହନ୍ତି। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ନେକ୍ ପଛରେ, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ସାମ୍ନାରେ।

strings.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D, ପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର E। Eର ସୁର ମିଳି ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ଯାଏଁ ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ ସମାନ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ଖୋଲା A, ପରେ B।

strings.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D, ପରେ E। କେତେ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର?

strings.source: First finger on D and A
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 7 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି F ଶାର୍ପ ବଜାଏ, Eଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ 1 ଓ 3 ମଝିର ନିଜ ସ୍ଥାନ ଉପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ହାତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ରହିବ।

strings.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D, E, F ଶାର୍ପ। ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବଜାଇବାବେଳେ ପ୍ରଥମଟି ରଖିଥାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: Eରୁ ପର ସ୍ୱର: କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାର ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର?

strings.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ନିଜ ସ୍ଥାନ ଉପରେ କାହିଁକି ରହେ?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଗୋଟିଏ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ସ୍ଥାନ। ଚାରିଟିକୁ ନିଜ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରଖିଲେ ପ୍ରତିଥର ସ୍ୱର ସେହି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ।

strings.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ ସମାନ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ଖୋଲା A, B, C ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି G ବଜାଏ, F ଶାର୍ପଠାରୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ। D, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G ହେଉଛି D ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଧା: ଖୋଲା, 1, 3, 4।

strings.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ତାରରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର G ଖୋଲା G ତାରଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉପରେ: ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରନାମ, ଆଠ ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ। ସୁର ମିଳିଲେ G ତାର ସାଥିରେ ଅନୁରଣିତ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର G, ଖୋଲା G, ପୁଣି ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର G। ଅନୁରଣନ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ତାରରେ D, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, ପରେ A ତାରରେ A, B, C ଶାର୍ପ, D। ସମାନ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଦୁଇଥର: ଖୋଲା, 1, 3, 4।

strings.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ତାରରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି D ମେଜର୍ ବଜାଏ?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1700 ମସିହାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିବା ଶତାବ୍ଦୀର ଏହି ଫରାସୀ ସୁରରେ କେବଳ ଶିଖିଥିବା ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି: D ତାରରେ D, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, ଓ A ତାରରେ A ଓ B।

strings.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି B ବଜାଏ?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ଓ A ତାରରେ ଖୋଲା, 1, 3, 4। ହାତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ରଖି ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଅନୁରଣିତ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଯାଞ୍ଚ: ଖୋଲା G ସହ G, ପରେ ଖୋଲା D ସହ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର D।

strings.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି C ଶାର୍ପ ବଜାଏ?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · title

strings.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ନିମ୍ନ ତାର, C ମେଜର୍ ଓ G ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍, ଏବଂ ତିନିଟି କ୍ଲାସିକ୍ ସୁର।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ତାରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି A, ତୃତୀୟ B ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ C ବଜାଏ। D ପରି ସମାନ ଦୂରତା। ବାହୁକୁ G ତାରର ଉଚ୍ଚତାରେ ସ୍ଥିର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ତାରରେ G, A, B, C ସହ D ତାରରେ D, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G ମିଶି G ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ହୁଏ। ଦୁଇ ତାରରେ ସମାନ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

strings.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: G ତାରରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି C ବଜାଏ?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C ତାରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି D, ତୃତୀୟ E ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ F ବଜାଏ। ମୋଟା ତାର ବଜାଇବାକୁ ଧୀର, ଓଜନ ଦିଆ ବୋ ଚାଳନା ଦରକାର।

strings.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C, D, E, F: ଖୋଲା, 1, 3, 4। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରକୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବାଜିବାର ସମୟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C ତାରରେ C, D, E, F ସହ G ତାରରେ G, A, B, C ମିଶି C ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ହୁଏ। ଏଥିରେ କୌଣସି ଶାର୍ପ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଉପରକୁ। ଉପରେ C ସହ ଖୋଲା C ତାରର ଅନୁରଣନ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି D ତାରରେ F ଶାର୍ପଠାରୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ F ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ଓ A ତାରରେ C ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ବଜାଏ। C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଦରକାର।

strings.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D, E, F, G: ଖୋଲା, 1, 2, 4। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରଥମ ପାଖରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: E, then second finger or third?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E, ପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ନା ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚେଲୋରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ନିଜ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ସ୍ଥାନ, ତେଣୁ F ପାଇଁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, F ଶାର୍ପ ପାଇଁ ତୃତୀୟ। C ତାରର F ଶାର୍ପ ପରି ହାତଠାରୁ ଆଗର ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ହାତ ପ୍ରସାରଣ ଦରକାର। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ସେହି ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ନଥିବା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବାଛେ।

strings.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍: F ଓ ଉପର C ପାଇଁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 7 (along) · title

strings.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 7 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବ୍ରାମ୍ସ 1868ରେ ଏହି ନାନାବାୟା ଗୀତ ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ଏହା G ଓ D ତାରରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୋଳେ। ଲମ୍ବା, ଧୀର ବୋ ଚଳାଇ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡକୁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେବାର ଅବକାଶ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G, F ଶାର୍ପ, E: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4, 3, 1। ଏହା ନାନାବାୟା ଗୀତର ଶୀର୍ଷ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଜହ୍ନ ଆଲୁଅରେ 1700 ମସିହାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିବା ଶତାବ୍ଦୀର ଫରାସୀ ଲୋକଗୀତ। ଏହା G ଓ D ତାରରେ ବାଜେ, ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ C।

strings.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D, C, B, A, G: ଖୋଲା D, ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4, 3, 1 ଓ ଖୋଲା G।

strings.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁରର କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଖୋଲା ତାର?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ତାରରେ ଖୋଲା, 1, 3, 4, ଓ F ଏବଂ C ନ୍ୟାଚୁରାଲ୍ ପାଇଁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ନିମ୍ନ ତାରରେ ଧୀର, ଓଜନ ଦିଆ ବୋ ଚାଳନା।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଯାଞ୍ଚ: ଖୋଲା C ସହ C, ପରେ ଖୋଲା G ସହ G।

strings.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟିରେ ଶାର୍ପ ନାହିଁ?

strings.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Cello · Unit 5 “Shifting basics” · title

strings.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 “Shifting basics” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚି, ଶୁଣି ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ରାଜହଂସ ଏବଂ ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପୋଜିସନ୍ ବଦଳରେ ପୂରା ହାତ ତାରର ନୂଆ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଯାଏ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଚାପ ହାଲୁକା କରି ନଉଠାଇ ତାରରେ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ; ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ମଧ୍ୟ ହାତ ସହ ଚଳୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ A ତାରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି D ବଜାଏ, ଯାହା ପ୍ରଥମ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବଜାଉଥିଲା। ନେକ୍ ଯେଉଁଠି ବଙ୍କା ହୋଇ ଯନ୍ତ୍ରର ଦେହରେ ମିଶେ, ସେଠି ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରହେ।

strings.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ B, ପରେ ସେହି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି Dକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇବାବେଳେ ଚାପ ହାଲୁକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପୂରା ହାତ ଏକାଠି ଘୁଞ୍ଚିଲେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଦୂରତା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟ ଠିକ୍ ସୁରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଉପରକୁ, ଫେରି, ପୁଣି ଉପରକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି D, ତୃତୀୟ E ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ F ବଜାଏ। ପ୍ରଥମ ପୋଜିସନ୍ ପରି ସମାନ ବିନ୍ୟାସ: ପ୍ରତି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ଏକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

strings.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D, E, F: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, 3, 4। ଏଠି ଉପରେ ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଟିକେ ପାଖାପାଖି।

strings.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା A, B, ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି Dକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ତୃତୀୟରେ E।

strings.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ତାରରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି E ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: Up to fourth position and back
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · title

strings.source: Check it with the open A
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ତାରରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି G ଓ ତୃତୀୟ A ବଜାଏ, ଖୋଲା A ତାର ସହ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱର। ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ବଜାଇ ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର G, ପରେ ତୃତୀୟର A, ଦୁଇଟି D ତାରରେ।

strings.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ର A, ଖୋଲା A, ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ର A। ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ପରି କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର E ବଜାଇ ସେହି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି Gକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ତିନି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, A ତାରର Bରୁ D ପରି ସମାନ ଦୂରତା।

strings.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର E, ପରେ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର G। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଚଳିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 7 (along) · title

Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରାଜହଂସ 1886ରେ କାମିଲ୍ ସାଁ-ସାଁସ୍ ଲେଖିଥିବା ପ୍ରାଣୀମାନଙ୍କ ଉତ୍ସବରୁ ଆସିଛି। ଏହା ତାହାର ଆରମ୍ଭ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ, ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ତଳେ ଓ ସରଳ କରାଯାଇଛି।

strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ଧୀର ବୋ ଦରକାର। ବୋକୁ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ରଖି ସମାନ ଭାବେ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଶେଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ନକମି ବାଜିବ।

strings.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G, F ଶାର୍ପ, B: Dରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ପରେ Gରେ ତୃତୀୟ।

strings.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରର ଶବ୍ଦ କମିବା କିପରି ରୋକିବେ?

strings.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହରେ ଖୋଲା A ପରେ ଉଚ୍ଚ D ଆସେ। A ବାଜୁଥିବାବେଳେ ହାତକୁ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ D ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: B, ଖୋଲା A, ପରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର D। A ବାଜୁଥିବାବେଳେ ଘୁଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: When is the easiest moment to shift?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: While an open string sounds, your left hand is free, so the shift can't be heard.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର ବାଜୁଥିବାବେଳେ ବାମ ହାତ ମୁକ୍ତ, ତେଣୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚିବାର ଶବ୍ଦ ଶୁଣାଯାଏନି।

Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଚାପ କମାଇ, ହାତ ଓ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଏକାଠି ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପହଞ୍ଚିଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା ତାର ଠିକ୍ ସୁର ଜଣାଇବ।

strings.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D ତାରରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ର A, ପରେ ଖୋଲା A। ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
strings.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ A ତାରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
strings.context: Mandolin course · course subtitle
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା ତାରରୁ ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁର ଓ ବ୍ଲୁଗ୍ରାସ୍ ଚପ୍ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · title

strings.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା ତାର ଚିହ୍ନି, ସୁର ମିଳାଇ ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ଖୋଲା ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ୍‌ରେ ଚାରି ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ଆଠ ତାର ଥାଏ; ଯୋଡ଼ାକୁ କୋର୍ସ କୁହାଯାଏ। ପ୍ରତି ଯୋଡ଼ାର ଦୁଇ ତାରର ସୁର ସମାନ ଓ ଏକାଠି ବାଜେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ଯୋଡ଼ାକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ତାର ଭାବନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମୁହଁ ପାଖର ଯୋଡ଼ା ସବୁଠୁ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର, ଯୋଡ଼ା 4। ଚଟାଣ ପାଖର ଯୋଡ଼ା ସବୁଠୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ, ଯୋଡ଼ା 1। ପାଠରେ ତାର 3 କହିଲେ ତୃତୀୟ ଯୋଡ଼ାକୁ ବୁଝାଏ।

strings.source: How do you play a pair?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Both strings at once, as one note
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ତାର ଏକାଠି, ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ପରି

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ତାର ପାଖାପାଖି, ତେଣୁ ପିକ୍‌ର ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଘାତ ଦୁଇଟିକୁ ଛୁଏ। ଏକାଠି ସେମାନେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଭରପୂର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଅନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନତମ ଯୋଡ଼ା, ଯୋଡ଼ା 4କୁ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାଇ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଯୋଡ଼ାର ସୁର ଟ୍ୟୁନର୍ ସହ ଓ ପରସ୍ପର ସହ ମିଳିବା ଦରକାର। ଦୁଇ ତାର ନମିଳିଲେ ଧୀର ଦୋଳନ ଶୁଣିବେ। ଗୋଟିଏ ତାରର ସୁର ମିଳାଇ ପରେ ସାଥି ତାରକୁ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଆଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 3, D ଯୋଡ଼ା। ଦୋଳନ ବନ୍ଦ ହେବା ଯାଏଁ ଦୁଇ ତାରର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏକ ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ଧୀର ଦୋଳନ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। କ’ଣ ଭୁଲ୍?

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସେହି ଦୋଳନକୁ ବିଟିଂ କୁହାଯାଏ: ଦୁଇ ତାରର ସ୍ୱର ଟିକେ ଅଲଗା। ଶବ୍ଦ ସମାନ ହେବା ଯାଏଁ ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ତଳକୁ ଢିଲା କରି ପରେ କଷି ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟକୁ ଆସନ୍ତୁ। ତଳୁ ଆସିଲେ ପରେ ତାର ଖସି ସ୍ୱର ନିମ୍ନ ହେବା କମେ।

strings.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 4, ପରେ ଯୋଡ଼ା 1। ପ୍ରତି ତାରକୁ ତଳୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଆଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ନରମ ଭାଗ ଓ ବଙ୍କା ତର୍ଜନୀର ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱ ମଝିରେ ପିକ୍ ଧରନ୍ତୁ। କେବଳ ଅଗ ବାହାରେ ରହୁ। ହାତରୁ ପାଣି ଝାଡ଼ିବା ପରି ମଣିବନ୍ଧ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: How much of the pick should show?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ ଅଗ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ଓ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଶବ୍ଦ ଦିଏ। ଅଧିକ ପିକ୍ ବାହାରେ ରହିଲେ ଯୋଡ଼ା ତାରରେ ଅଟକେ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ ଗତିରେ ଯୋଡ଼ାର ଦୁଇ ତାର ମଧ୍ୟଦେଇ ପିକ୍ ତଳକୁ ଚଳାଇ ତୁରନ୍ତ ପରେ ରୋକନ୍ତୁ। ପାପୁଲିର ମୂଳ ଭାଗ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ହାଲୁକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ାଗୁଡ଼ିକ G, D, A ଓ E। ମନେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ: Good Dogs Always Eat। ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍‌ର ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ ମଧ୍ୟ ସମାନ, ତେଣୁ ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁର ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ୍‌ରେ ସହଜରେ ମିଳେ।

strings.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ: G, D, A, E।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ ଉଚ୍ଚରୁ ନିମ୍ନ: E, A, D, G।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୁର ମିଳା ଯୋଡ଼ା, ଢିଲା ପିକ୍ ଧରଣ ଓ ଚାରି ଖୋଲା ସ୍ୱର। ପ୍ରତିଟି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ଯୋଡ଼ାର ଦୁଇ ତାର ଝଙ୍କାରୁ।

strings.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚତମ ଯୋଡ଼ା 1ରୁ ନିମ୍ନତମ ଯୋଡ଼ା 4 ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A, G, E, D। ନାମ ଶୁଣି ପ୍ରତି ଯୋଡ଼ା ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେରୀର ଛୋଟ ମେଣ୍ଢା D ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ବାଜେ: ଖୋଲା D, ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ର E, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4ର F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା E।

strings.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · title

strings.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ର ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପାଇଁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଶିଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ D ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଧାତୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ଏକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଅଗରେ ଯୋଡ଼ାର ଦୁଇ ତାର ଚାପନ୍ତୁ। ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ୍‌ର ତାର ଟାଣ ହୋଇ ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ଅଗ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ଯେତେ ଦରକାର ସେତେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ସବୁଠୁ କମ୍ ଚାପରେ ସବୁଠୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ସ୍ୱର ମିଳେ।

strings.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.

Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Mandolin frets are close together, so each finger covers two. First finger plays frets 1 and 2, second finger 3 and 4, third finger 5 and 6, little finger 7.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ୍ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ପାଖାପାଖି, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଦୁଇଟି ସମ୍ଭାଳେ। ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ଓ 2, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ 3 ଓ 4, ତୃତୀୟ 5 ଓ 6, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 7 ବଜାଏ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Each finger covers two frets on mandolin, so the second finger handles frets 3 and 4.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ସମ୍ଭାଳେ, ତେଣୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ 4ରେ ବାଜେ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: The A pair works the same way: open is A, fret 2 is B, fret 4 is C♯ and fret 5 is D. Your hand stays where it is.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ଯୋଡ଼ା ସମାନ ଭାବେ କାମ କରେ: ଖୋଲା A, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ରେ B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4ରେ C♯ ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5ରେ D। ହାତ ନିଜ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: Open, then first, second and third fingers on pair 2.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 2ରେ ଖୋଲା, ପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Join the two shapes and you have the D major scale: D, E, F♯, G on pair 3, then A, B, C♯, D on pair 2. It is home for a great many fiddle tunes.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଯୋଡ଼ିଲେ D ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍: ଯୋଡ଼ା 3ରେ D, E, F♯, G, ପରେ ଯୋଡ଼ା 2ରେ A, B, C♯, D। ଅନେକ ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁର ଏହି ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ରହେ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 3ର G ପରେ A ଆସେ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7କୁ ହାତ ବଢ଼ାଇବା ବଦଳରେ ଖୋଲା A ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Beethoven's melody uses only the first five notes of D major, on pairs 3 and 2. Keep your fingers hovering close to the strings between notes.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବେଥୋଭେନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ସୁର ଯୋଡ଼ା 3 ଓ 2ରେ D ମେଜର୍‌ର ପ୍ରଥମ ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ। ସ୍ୱର ମଝିରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ତାର ପାଖରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: F♯ and G on pair 3, then the open A pair.

strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 3ରେ F♯ ଓ G, ପରେ ଖୋଲା A ଯୋଡ଼ା।

strings.source: The first phrase stops on E and sounds unfinished. The second lands on D and sounds like home.

strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ Eରେ ଅଟକି ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଲାଗେ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟଟି Dରେ ପହଞ୍ଚି ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରିବା ପରି ଲାଗେ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · title
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: On the E pair, fret 2 is F♯, fret 3 is G and fret 5 is A. First, second and third fingers, just as before.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: E ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ର F♯, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3ର G ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5ର A। ପୂର୍ବ ପରି ପ୍ରଥମ, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Fret 3 sits in the second finger's zone, frets 3 and 4.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଅଞ୍ଚଳ, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ 4 ମଧ୍ୟରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: Fingers one, two and three on frets 2, 4 and 5, with open pairs in between. Play smoothly and let each note ring until the next.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, 4 ଓ 5ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ମଝିରେ ଖୋଲା ଯୋଡ଼ା। ସହଜରେ ବଜାଇ ପର ସ୍ୱର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Every other note of the scale: D, F♯, A, D.

strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 2ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ର B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3ର C ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4ର C♯।

strings.source: Alternate your pick in eighth notes and make long notes sing with tremolo.

strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ପିକ୍‌ର ଦିଗ ପାଳି କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଟ୍ରେମୋଲୋରେ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗାଇବା ପରି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Pick down on each beat and up on the and in between. Your hand swings like a pendulum, down, up, down, up, even when a note waits.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପିକ୍ ତଳକୁ ଓ ମଝିର “ଓ”ରେ ଉପରକୁ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ୱର ଅପେକ୍ଷା କଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ହାତ ଦୋଳକ ପରି ତଳ, ଉପର, ତଳ, ଉପର ଚାଲେ।

strings.source: Which stroke lands on the beat?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Down on the beat and up in between keeps your hand in time, like a drummer's sticks.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତଳକୁ ଓ ମଝିରେ ଉପରକୁ ବଜାଇଲେ ଡ୍ରମ୍‌ର କାଠି ପରି ହାତ ଲୟରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: When you move to another pair, your hand keeps its down-up swing. The forearm carries you across; the wrist keeps the beat.

strings.translation: ଅନ୍ୟ ଯୋଡ଼ାକୁ ଯିବାବେଳେ ହାତର ତଳ-ଉପର ଦୋଳନ ଚାଲିଥାଏ। ଅଗ୍ରବାହୁ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ନିଏ; ମଣିବନ୍ଧ ମାତ୍ରା ରଖେ।

strings.source: A mandolin note fades quickly. Tremolo keeps it singing: pick down and up fast and evenly on one pair, so the note sounds unbroken.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ୍‌ର ସ୍ୱର ଶୀଘ୍ର କମିଯାଏ। ଟ୍ରେମୋଲୋ ତାହାକୁ ଜାରି ରଖେ: ଏକ ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଓ ସମାନ ତଳ-ଉପର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସ୍ୱର ଅବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ଶୁଣାଯିବ।

strings.source: Keep the pick close to the strings and the strokes even. Speed comes later, once the motion is relaxed.
