strings.translation: ପିକ୍‌କୁ ତାର ପାଖରେ ଓ ଆଘାତ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଗତି ସହଜ ହେଲା ପରେ ବେଗ ଆସିବ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Start by counting four strokes to each beat. As it gets easier, stop counting and keep the motion quick and steady. The beat lives in your foot, not in your pick.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଚାରି ଆଘାତ ଗଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସହଜ ହେଲେ ଗଣନା ଛାଡ଼ି ଗତି ଦ୍ରୁତ ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ମାତ୍ରା ପାଦରେ ରହେ, ପିକ୍‌ରେ ନୁହେଁ।

strings.source: Amazing Grace moves in three beats to the bar. Tremolo through each long note and change notes right on the beat. Two notes are new: A and B on the G pair.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଚାଲେ। ପ୍ରତି ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଟ୍ରେମୋଲୋ କରି ଠିକ୍ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ। ଦୁଇଟି ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର: G ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ A ଓ B।

strings.source: Pair 4, fret 2 with your first finger, then fret 4 with your second.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 4, ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4।

strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ପିକ୍‌ର ଶବ୍ଦ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରା ସରିବା ବହୁ ପୂର୍ବରୁ କମିଯାଏ। ଟ୍ରେମୋଲୋ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ଶେଷ ଯାଏଁ ତାହାକୁ ବଜାଇ ରଖେ।

strings.source: Down on the beat, up in between, and tremolo whenever a note needs to last. Keep every stroke small.

strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତଳକୁ, ମଝିରେ ଉପରକୁ, ଓ ସ୍ୱର ଲମ୍ବା ରଖିବାକୁ ଟ୍ରେମୋଲୋ। ପ୍ରତି ଆଘାତ ଛୋଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G, D, C, E minor and A, then the short, choked chord that drives bluegrass.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · unit summary
strings.translation: G, D, C, E ମାଇନର୍ ଓ A, ପରେ ବ୍ଲୁଗ୍ରାସ୍‌କୁ ଆଗେଇ ନେଉଥିବା ଛୋଟ, ରୋକା ଶବ୍ଦର କର୍ଡ।

Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 2, second finger on fret 3 of pair 1. Pairs 4 and 3 ring open.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 2ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ, ଯୋଡ଼ା 1ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଯୋଡ଼ା 4 ଓ 3 ଖୋଲା ବାଜେ।

strings.source: Brush the pick down across all four pairs in one smooth motion, low to high. Small and light is enough; mandolin chords are bright.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚକୁ ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ଏକ ସହଜ ଗତିରେ ପିକ୍ ତଳକୁ ବୁଲାନ୍ତୁ। ଛୋଟ, ହାଲୁକା ଆଘାତ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ; ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ୍ କର୍ଡ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 4, second finger on fret 2 of pair 1. Pairs 3 and 2 ring open.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 4ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ, ଯୋଡ଼ା 1ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଯୋଡ଼ା 3 ଓ 2 ଖୋଲା ବାଜେ।

Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 3, second finger on fret 3 of pair 2. Pairs 4 and 1 ring open.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 3ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ, ଯୋଡ଼ା 2ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଯୋଡ଼ା 4 ଓ 1 ଖୋଲା ବାଜେ।

strings.source: From C, slide your second finger back to fret 2. The chord turns darker, though only one finger moved.

strings.translation: Cରୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। କେବଳ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବଦଳିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ କର୍ଡ ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Fret 2 on pairs 4 and 3, fret 4 on pair 2, fret 5 on pair 1: fingers one, two, three and four. No pair rings open.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 4 ଓ 3ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଯୋଡ଼ା 2ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ଯୋଡ଼ା 1ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5: ପ୍ରଥମ, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ତୃତୀୟ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। କୌଣସି ଯୋଡ଼ା ଖୋଲା ବାଜେନି।

strings.source: Why does it matter that no pair rings open?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ଯୋଡ଼ା ଖୋଲା ନବାଜିବା କାହିଁକି ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ?

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: You can silence it by easing off
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: It keeps the chord in tune
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: With every pair held down, relaxing your fingers stops the sound at once. That is the secret of the chop.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଯୋଡ଼ା ଚାପି ରଖିଥିଲେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଢିଲା କରିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ଶବ୍ଦ ଅଟକେ। ଚପ୍‌ର ରହସ୍ୟ ଏହି।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The chop is a short chord on beats 2 and 4. Strum down, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings without lifting them, so the sound stops right away.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚପ୍ ମାତ୍ରା 2 ଓ 4ରେ ଛୋଟ କର୍ଡ। ତଳକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି, ତାରରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ନଉଠାଇ ଚାପ କମାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଶବ୍ଦ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଅଟକିବ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Bass and guitar take beats 1 and 3. The mandolin answers on 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ ଓ ଗିଟାର୍ ମାତ୍ରା 1 ଓ 3 ନିଅନ୍ତି। ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ୍ ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ପରି 2 ଓ 4ରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Let the chord sound for only a moment. If it hangs on, relax your fingers sooner. Your fingertips stay touching the strings the whole time.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କର୍ଡକୁ କେବଳ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତେ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଲମ୍ବିଲେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଆଗରୁ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଅଗ ସବୁବେଳେ ତାରକୁ ଛୁଇଁ ରହିବ।

strings.source: Chops in G, C and D
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Your A shape works anywhere on the neck. Slide it up three frets for C and five frets for D. Keep all four fingers in place as you move.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ବିନ୍ୟାସ ନେକ୍‌ର ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନରେ କାମ କରେ। C ପାଇଁ ତିନି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍, D ପାଇଁ ପାଞ୍ଚ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। ଚାରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ରଖି ଘୁଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: G needs a new stretch: first finger fret 2 on pair 2, second finger fret 3 on pair 1, third finger fret 5 on pair 3, little finger fret 7 on pair 4.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ପାଇଁ ନୂଆ ପ୍ରସାରଣ: ଯୋଡ଼ା 2ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ, ଯୋଡ଼ା 1ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ଯୋଡ଼ା 3ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5ରେ ତୃତୀୟ, ଯୋଡ଼ା 4ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7ରେ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Strum open chords to learn the sound, then chop on 2 and 4 to drive the band. Keep the beat steady through every change.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶବ୍ଦ ଶିଖିବାକୁ ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଆଗେଇ ନେବାକୁ 2 ଓ 4ରେ ଚପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି ବଦଳରେ ମାତ୍ରା ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Your chop keeps ringing. What fixes it?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Lift your fingers off the neck
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Ease off with your fretting fingers sooner
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଚାପୁଥିବା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଚାପ ଆଗରୁ କମାନ୍ତୁ

strings.source: The chop is choked by the fretting hand. Relax the pressure but keep your fingertips on the strings.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତ ଚପ୍‌ର ଶବ୍ଦ ରୋକେ। ଚାପ କମାନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଅଗ ତାରରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · title

strings.source: Five traditional jam tunes, simplified, from Boil Them Cabbage Down to Old Joe Clark.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · unit summary
strings.translation: ବନ୍ଧାକୋବି ସିଝାଅରୁ ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ, ମିଳିତ ବାଦନର ପାଞ୍ଚ ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ସୁରର ସରଳ ରୂପ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This one lives on the E and A pairs and keeps coming back to F♯. Pick down on the beat and up in between, just like your eighth-note drills.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହା E ଓ A ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ବାଜି ବାରମ୍ବାର F♯କୁ ଫେରେ। ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ପରି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତଳକୁ ଓ ମଝିରେ ଉପରକୁ ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: F♯, G and A on pair 1 at frets 2, 3 and 5, then D on pair 2, fret 5.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ା 1ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, 3 ଓ 5ରେ F♯, G ଓ A, ପରେ ଯୋଡ଼ା 2ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5ରେ D।

strings.source: Where does the tune come to rest?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Like most tunes in D, it ends on D, the home note.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D ର ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସୁର ପରି, ଏହା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର D ରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The low part of Angeline the Baker uses only D, E, F♯, A and B. Both parts end on A instead of D, which sends the tune around again.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଞ୍ଜେଲିନ୍ ଦ ବେକର୍‌ର ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର ଅଂଶରେ କେବଳ D, E, F♯, A ଓ B ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ। ଉଭୟ ଅଂଶ D ବଦଳରେ A ରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ, ଫଳରେ ସୁରଟି ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେବାକୁ ଚାହେଁ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 2 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: Which note do both parts end on?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଉଭୟ ଅଂଶ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ?

strings.source: Ending on A instead of D leaves the tune hanging, so it rolls straight into the next time through.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D ବଦଳରେ A ରେ ଶେଷ କଲେ ସୁରଟି ଅସମାପ୍ତ ଲାଗେ, ତେଣୁ ଏହା ସିଧା ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତିକୁ ଯାଏ।

Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Soldier's Joy was in print in Scotland by 1780 and has filled American jams ever since. Its first part bounces between D, F♯ and A.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୈନିକର ଆନନ୍ଦ 1780 ସୁଦ୍ଧା ସ୍କଟଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରେ ଛାପା ହୋଇଥିଲା ଏବଂ ସେବେଠାରୁ ଆମେରିକାର ମିଳିତ ବାଦନରେ ବହୁଳ ଭାବେ ବଜାଯାଉଛି। ଏହାର ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଂଶ D, F♯ ଓ A ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଘୂରିବୁଲେ।

strings.source: Open A pair, pair 3 fret 4, open D, then fret 4 again.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା A ତାର ଯୋଡ଼ି, ଯୋଡ଼ି 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ଖୋଲା D, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4।

strings.source: D, F♯ and A together spell which chord?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: D, F♯ ଓ A ଏକାଠି କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ଗଠନ କରନ୍ତି?

strings.source: D, F♯ and A are the three notes of D major. Fiddle tunes often trace their chords like this.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D, F♯ ଓ A ହେଉଛି D ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡର ତିନିଟି ସ୍ୱର। ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରାୟ ଏହିପରି ନିଜ କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତି।

Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର ଅଂଶ, ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ଅଂଶ

strings.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆର୍କାନସାସ୍ ଯାତ୍ରୀ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରରେ G ତାର ଯୋଡ଼ିରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ, ତାପରେ E ଯୋଡ଼ିକୁ ଡେଇଁ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଅନୁସାରେ ତଳକୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଉଥିବା ଅଂଶ ବଜାଏ। ଏହା 1840 ଦଶକ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଛାପା ହୋଇଥିଲା।

strings.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ି 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଓ 4, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା D ତାର ଯୋଡ଼ି।

strings.source: Where does the high part begin?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ଅଂଶ କେଉଁଠାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: On A, fret 5 of the E pair
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: E ତାର ଯୋଡ଼ିର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ ଥିବା A ରୁ

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା ଯୋଡ଼ି 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ ଥିବା A ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ, ତାପରେ G, F♯ ଓ E ଦେଇ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (along) · title

strings.source: A new key and a twist
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ନୂଆ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ଏକ ମୋଡ଼

strings.source: Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କ A ରେ ଅଛି, ତେଣୁ C♯ ଓ G♯ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବେ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶରେ G♯ ତଳକୁ ଯାଇ E ତାର ଯୋଡ଼ିର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର ସାଧାରଣ G ହୁଏ। ଏହି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ସୁରଟିକୁ ଓଲ୍ଡ-ଟାଇମ୍ ଶୈଳୀର ଧ୍ୱନି ଦିଏ।

strings.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ି 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 6 ରେ G♯; ଖୋଲା A ତାର ଯୋଡ଼ି; ତାପରେ ଯୋଡ଼ି 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G।

strings.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶକୁ ଓଲ୍ଡ-ଟାଇମ୍ ଶୈଳୀର ଧ୍ୱନି ଦିଏ?

strings.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: A ମେଜର୍‌ରେ G♯ ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ। ତାହାକୁ G କୁ ତଳକୁ ଆଣିଲେ ଓଲ୍ଡ-ଟାଇମ୍ ଓ ବ୍ଲୁଗ୍ରାସ୍ ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଉଥିବା ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି ମିଳେ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସୁରକୁ ସମାନ ବେଗରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। କୌଣସି ସ୍ୱର ଭୁଲ୍ ହେଲେ ପିକ୍ ଧରିଥିବା ହାତ ଚଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଯୋଗ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରକୃତ ମିଳିତ ବାଦନ ଏହିପରି ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 3 (along) · title
strings.translation: ଆଞ୍ଜେଲିନ୍ ଦ ବେକର୍, ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର ଅଂଶ

strings.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସୁରରେ G♯ ବଦଳରେ G ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ?

strings.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କ A ରେ ଅଛି କିନ୍ତୁ ଏହାର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶରେ G ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ। ସେହି ତଳକୁ ଆସିଥିବା ସ୍ୱର ଏହାର ବିଶେଷ ପରିଚୟ।

strings.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · unit summary
strings.translation: ସୁରକୁ ବ୍ଲୁଗ୍ରାସ୍ ଶୈଳୀ ଦେବା ପାଇଁ ବାମ ହାତର କୌଶଳ ଓ ଡାହାଣ ହାତର ପ୍ରବାହମୟ ବାଦନ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ସେହି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଉପର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌କୁ ସରାଇବା ବେଳେ ଚାପ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ପିକ୍ ଆଘାତ ବିନା ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ। ହାଲୁକା, ସମାନ ଚାପ ହିଁ କୌଶଳ।

strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title

strings.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.

strings.translation: କେବଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାଯାଏ। ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରିବା ବେଳେ ତାର ଉପରେ ଚାପ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ନହେଲେ ବାଟରେ ସ୍ୱର ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଯିବ।

strings.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର ଯୋଡ଼ିକୁ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଅଗକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ପିକ୍ ଆଘାତ ବିନା, କେବଳ ଏହି ଆଘାତରେ ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ।

Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହାର ଓଲଟା: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖି ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାଇବା ବେଳେ ଅଳ୍ପ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ। ସେହି ଟାଣ ଖୋଲା ତାରର ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ବଜାଏ।

strings.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ ଅଳଙ୍କାର ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁରକୁ ଜୀବନ୍ତ କରେ। ଏଠାରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କ‌ର ଆରମ୍ଭର ଦୁଇଟି ସାଧାରଣ A ସ୍ୱର A, B, A ହୁଏ: ଏକ ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ ଓ ଏକ ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍।

strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ A କୁ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, B କୁ ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍ କରି A କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ ପିକ୍ ଆଘାତ, ତିନିଟି ସ୍ୱର।

strings.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
strings.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କ୍ରସ୍ପିକିଂରେ ତିନିଟି ତାର ଯୋଡ଼ିରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତ ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ ବଜାଯାଏ, ଫଳରେ କର୍ଡ ଲହରି ପରି ଶୁଭେ। ଆଠଟି ସ୍ୱର ତିନି, ତିନି ଓ ଦୁଇ ଭାଗରେ ବିଭକ୍ତ ହୁଏ।

strings.translation: ଆଠଟି ସ୍ୱରର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନିଟି ସ୍ୱରର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି କଲେ ପ୍ରତିଥର ଜୋର ପଡ଼ୁଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳେ। ଏହା ହିଁ ସେହି ପ୍ରବାହମୟ ଅନୁଭବ।

strings.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାଞ୍ଜୋରେ ଚାରୋଟି ପୂରା ଲମ୍ବର ତାର ଓ ଏକ ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାର ଥାଏ, ଯାହା ନେକ୍‌ର କିଛି ଉପରୁ ନିଜ ଛୋଟ ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ ଖୁଣ୍ଟିଠାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ସେହି ଛୋଟ ତାର ବାଞ୍ଜୋର ବିଶେଷ ଧ୍ୱନି।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ହେଉଛି ଚଟାଣର ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିକଟରେ ଥିବା ପତଳା ତାର। ତାର 2, 3 ଓ 4 କ୍ରମେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ମୁହଁ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଅଛନ୍ତି। ଉପରେ ଥିବା ଛୋଟ ତାରଟି ହେଉଛି ତାର 5।

strings.source: Which string is the short one?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାର ତାର 4 ପାଖରେ ଅଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ; ଏହାର ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ନେକ୍‌ର ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରେ ଥାଏ।

strings.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଚଟାଣର ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିକଟରେ ଥିବା ପତଳା ତାର 1 କୁ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ ଛୋଟ ତାର, ତାର 5। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଏହାକୁ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାଞ୍ଜୋର ମାନକ ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ ହେଉଛି ଓପେନ୍ G। ତାର 4 ରୁ ତାର 1 ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ହେଉଛି D, G, B, D, ଏବଂ ଛୋଟ ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରଟି ଉଚ୍ଚ G। ଖୋଲା ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କଲେ G କର୍ଡ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: What chord do the open strings make?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ଗଠନ କରନ୍ତି?

strings.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G, B ଓ D ହେଉଛି G କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱର। ସେଥିପାଇଁ ଏହି ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂକୁ ଓପେନ୍ G କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Bluegrass banjo uses a plastic thumb pick and two metal finger picks, on index and middle. The finger picks point down, curving the same way as your fingertips.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବ୍ଲୁଗ୍ରାସ୍ ବାଞ୍ଜୋରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ପ୍ଲାଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ପିକ୍ ଓ ତର୍ଜନୀ ଓ ମଧ୍ୟମାରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଧାତୁ ପିକ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପିକ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ତଳକୁ ମୁହାଁଇଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଅଗ ପରି ବଙ୍କା ଥାଏ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: For now your thumb plays strings 3, 4 and 5, your index plays string 2 and your middle plays string 1. Rest your ring and little fingers lightly on the head.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 3, 4 ଓ 5, ତର୍ଜନୀ ତାର 2 ଏବଂ ମଧ୍ୟମା ତାର 1 ବଜାଇବ। ଅନାମିକା ଓ କନିଷ୍ଠାକୁ ବାଞ୍ଜୋର ଝିଲ୍ଲୀ ଉପରେ ହାଲୁକା ଭାବେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Thumb takes strings 3, 4 and 5, index takes string 2 and middle takes string 1.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 3, 4 ଓ 5, ତର୍ଜନୀ ତାର 2 ଏବଂ ମଧ୍ୟମା ତାର 1 ବଜାଏ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The fifth string is a drone: you play it open, between melody notes, and it rings over everything. In these lessons you never fret it.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାର ନିରନ୍ତର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଏ: ସୁରର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଝିରେ ଏହାକୁ ଖୋଲା ବଜାନ୍ତି, ଏବଂ ଏହା ସବୁ ଉପରେ ଝଙ୍କୃତ ହୁଏ। ଏହି ପାଠଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଏହାକୁ କେବେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ଦବାଇବେ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: First string 5, then string 1. Which is higher?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମେ ତାର 5, ତାପରେ ତାର 1। କେଉଁଟିର ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ?

strings.source: Why does the fifth string sound so high?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରର ସ୍ୱର ଏତେ ଉଚ୍ଚ କାହିଁକି?

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: It is short and tuned to high G
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା ଛୋଟ ଏବଂ ଉଚ୍ଚ G ରେ ଟ୍ୟୁନ୍ ହୋଇଛି

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Being short lets it hold a high G. It sits on top of the melody like a bell.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ ହୋଇଥିବାରୁ ଏହା ଉଚ୍ଚ G ଧରିପାରେ। ଏହା ଘଣ୍ଟି ପରି ସୁର ଉପରେ ଶୁଭେ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 4 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · title

strings.source: Tuned to open G, picks on, thumb ready for the drone. Play each string cleanly and let it ring.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଓପେନ୍ G ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ, ପିକ୍ ପିନ୍ଧିଛନ୍ତି, ନିରନ୍ତର ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ତାର ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଝଙ୍କୃତ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: B, high G, low D, high D, G. Find each string by its note.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: B, ଉଚ୍ଚ G, ନିମ୍ନ D, ଉଚ୍ଚ D, G। ସ୍ୱର ଅନୁସାରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ତାର ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: String 3, then string 5. Which is higher?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ତାର 3, ତାପରେ ତାର 5। କେଉଁଟିର ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ?

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger frets the A; your thumb picks string 3.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · song bjo-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେରୀର ଛୋଟ ମେଣ୍ଢା ପାଇଁ ତିନିଟି ସ୍ୱର ଦରକାର: ଖୋଲା ତାର 2 ହେଉଛି B, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ହେଉଛି A ଏବଂ ଖୋଲା ତାର 3 ହେଉଛି G। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି A କୁ ଦବାଏ; ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 3 ବଜାଏ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · title

strings.source: The right-hand patterns behind the rolling bluegrass sound: pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · unit summary
strings.translation: ବ୍ଲୁଗ୍ରାସ୍‌ର ପ୍ରବାହମୟ ଧ୍ୱନି ତିଆରି କରୁଥିବା ଡାହାଣ ହାତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ: ପିଞ୍ଚ, ବଦଳୁଥିବା ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଓ ଫର୍ୱାର୍ଡ ରୋଲ୍।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A pinch is your thumb and middle finger plucking at the same moment, on strings 5 and 1. It sounds like a little two-note chord and often starts or ends a phrase.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପିଞ୍ଚ ହେଉଛି ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଓ ମଧ୍ୟମାରେ ତାର 5 ଓ 1 କୁ ଏକ ସମୟରେ ବଜାଇବା। ଏହା ଏକ ଛୋଟ ଦୁଇ-ସ୍ୱରର କର୍ଡ ପରି ଶୁଭେ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରାୟ ଏକ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟାଂଶର ଆରମ୍ଭ କିମ୍ବା ଶେଷରେ ଆସେ।

strings.source: Pinch, or one note at a time?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: Which strings does a pinch play?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Thumb on the short fifth string and middle on string 1, at the same moment.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଓ ତାର 1 ରେ ମଧ୍ୟମା, ଏକ ସମୟରେ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତର୍ଜନୀ, ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ମଧ୍ୟମା

strings.source: This roll is eight even notes: thumb on 3, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1, then thumb on 4, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ରୋଲ୍‌ରେ ସମାନ ସମୟାନ୍ତରରେ ଆଠଟି ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ରେ, ତର୍ଜନୀ 2 ରେ, ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 5 ରେ, ମଧ୍ୟମା 1 ରେ; ତାପରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 ରେ, ତର୍ଜନୀ 2 ରେ, ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 5 ରେ, ମଧ୍ୟମା 1 ରେ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 3 (along) · title

strings.source: Which finger plays every other note?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଗୋଟିଏ ଛାଡ଼ି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle: the thumb plays every other note, which gives the roll its name.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତର୍ଜନୀ, ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ମଧ୍ୟମା: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଗୋଟିଏ ଛାଡ଼ି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଏ, ତେଣୁ ରୋଲ୍‌ର ଏହି ନାମ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The forward roll moves one way, thumb then index then middle, over and over. Eight notes make thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫର୍ୱାର୍ଡ ରୋଲ୍ ଏକ ଦିଗରେ ଯାଏ: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତାପରେ ତର୍ଜନୀ, ତାପରେ ମଧ୍ୟମା, ବାରମ୍ବାର। ଆଠଟି ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତର୍ଜନୀ, ମଧ୍ୟମା ଦୁଇଥର, ତାପରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତର୍ଜନୀ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 2 (along) · title

strings.source: How does a forward roll fit into eight notes?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଫର୍ୱାର୍ଡ ରୋଲ୍ ଆଠଟି ସ୍ୱରରେ କିପରି ବସେ?

strings.source: Thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index. The accent shifts as it goes, which makes the rolling sound.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତର୍ଜନୀ, ମଧ୍ୟମା ଦୁଇଥର, ତାପରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତର୍ଜନୀ। ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ିବା ସହ ଜୋର ପଡ଼ୁଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳେ, ଯାହା ପ୍ରବାହମୟ ଧ୍ୱନି ତିଆରି କରେ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A roll is only as good as its timing. Keep all eight notes even, like a ticking clock, and land the first note of each bar right on the beat.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

strings.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 3. Strings 4 and 1 ring open. Leave the fifth string out; its G clashes with D7.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ତାର 4 ଓ 1 ଖୋଲା ବାଜେ। ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରକୁ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ; ଏହାର G ସ୍ୱର D7 ସହ ମେଳ ଖାଏ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: The full D7, if you like

strings.source: The two-finger D7 has no F sharp. Add your little finger at fret 4 of string 1 and all four notes of D7 ring. Either shape works in the songs; the full one sounds richer.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ-ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର D7 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ନାହିଁ। ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ କନିଷ୍ଠା ଯୋଡ଼ିଲେ D7 ର ଚାରୋଟିଯାକ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ। ଗୀତଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଯେକୌଣସି ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଚାଲେ; ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣଟି ଅଧିକ ପରିପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶୁଭେ।

strings.source: G is home, C steps away and D7 pulls you back. Change on the first beat of each bar and keep your right hand moving.

strings.translation: G ହେଉଛି ଘର, C ଦୂରକୁ ଯାଏ ଏବଂ D7 ପୁଣି ଫେରାଇ ଆଣେ। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଡାହାଣ ହାତ ଚଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D7 contains C, which leans down to B in the G chord. That pull is why so many songs end D7 to G.

strings.source: A tune named for a mountain pass
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Cumberland Gap is the pass early settlers took into Kentucky. The tune climbs to E and F♯ on string 1, so your second and fourth fingers get busy.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କମ୍ବରଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଗ୍ୟାପ୍ ସେହି ଗିରିପଥ, ଯାହା ଦେଇ ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ବସତି ସ୍ଥାପନକାରୀମାନେ କେଣ୍ଟକିକୁ ଯାଇଥିଲେ। ସୁରଟି ତାର 1 ର E ଓ F♯ କୁ ଉଠେ, ତେଣୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ କାମ କରିବାକୁ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, then open.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା।

strings.source: Where do you play F♯ in this tune?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: F♯ is four frets above the open D of string 1. The fifth string is never fretted here.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଖୋଲା D ଠାରୁ ଚାରି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ F♯ ଅଛି। ଏଠାରେ ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରକୁ କେବେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ଦବାଯାଏ ନାହିଁ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · title
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Shady Grove has the dark, old sound players call mountain minor. It comes to rest on A instead of G, and the high G of the fifth string sings against it.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶେଡି ଗ୍ରୋଭ୍‌ରେ ସେହି ଗମ୍ଭୀର, ପୁରୁଣା ଧ୍ୱନି ଅଛି, ଯାହାକୁ ବାଦକମାନେ ମାଉଣ୍ଟେନ୍ ମାଇନର୍ କୁହନ୍ତି। ଏହା G ବଦଳରେ A ରେ ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏ, ଏବଂ ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରର ଉଚ୍ଚ G ତାହା ସହ ଝଙ୍କୃତ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: String 3 fret 2, string 2 open, string 1 open, string 1 fret 2.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଖୋଲା ତାର 2, ଖୋଲା ତାର 1, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: Which tune comes to rest on A instead of G?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସୁର G ବଦଳରେ A ରେ ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏ?

strings.source: Shady Grove is in mountain minor, centered on A. The others come home to G.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଶେଡି ଗ୍ରୋଭ୍ ମାଉଣ୍ଟେନ୍ ମାଇନର୍ ଶୈଳୀରେ ଅଛି, ଯାହାର କେନ୍ଦ୍ର A। ଅନ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର G କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Sound notes with the fretting hand, then use them in Old Joe Clark.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 “Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତରେ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କ‌ରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାରକୁ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଅଗକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ପିକ୍ ଆଘାତ ବିନା, କେବଳ ଏହି ଆଘାତରେ ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ।

strings.source: Pick string 3 open, then hammer fret 2 with your second finger.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 3 କୁ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: How many times do you pick for a hammer-on?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The pick sounds the first note. The second comes from your finger striking the string.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପିକ୍ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଏ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ତାର ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଆଘାତରୁ ଆସେ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 5 (along) · title

strings.source: Fret a note, pick it, then pull your finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open string, so a second note sounds without the pick.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏକ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ଧରି ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାଇବା ବେଳେ ଅଳ୍ପ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ। ସେହି ଟାଣ ଖୋଲା ତାରକୁ ବଜାଏ, ତେଣୁ ପିକ୍ ବିନା ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ।

strings.source: Pick string 1 at fret 2, then pull off to open.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍ କରି ଖୋଲା ତାର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which way does your finger move in a pull-off?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Along the string to the next fret
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Lifting straight up only stops the note. A small sideways flick plucks the open string.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସିଧା ଉପରକୁ ଉଠାଇଲେ କେବଳ ସ୍ୱର ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। ଅଳ୍ପ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଟାଣିଲେ ଖୋଲା ତାର ବାଜେ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Fret string 3 at fret 2, pick it, and slide the same finger up to fret 4 while pressing. A to B in one smooth glide is a classic banjo sound.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 3 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦବାଇ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଚାପ ରଖି ସେହି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 କୁ ସରାନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ ମସୃଣ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍‌ରେ A ରୁ B କୁ ଯିବା ବାଞ୍ଜୋର ଚିରପରିଚିତ ଧ୍ୱନି।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍‌ରେ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜି ରହିବା ପାଇଁ କ’ଣ ଦରକାର?

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressing as you glide, or the note dies on the way.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କେବଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାଯାଏ। ସରାଇବା ବେଳେ ଚାପ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ନହେଲେ ବାଟରେ ସ୍ୱର ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଯିବ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 4 (along) · title

Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Old Joe Clark is in G, but its second part uses F instead of F♯, on string 1 at fret 3. That lowered note gives the tune its old-time sound.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କ G ରେ ଅଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶରେ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ F♯ ବଦଳରେ F ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ। ସେହି ତଳକୁ ଆସିଥିବା ସ୍ୱର ସୁରଟିକୁ ଓଲ୍ଡ-ଟାଇମ୍ ଶୈଳୀର ଧ୍ୱନି ଦିଏ।

strings.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, open. Try hammering from 2 to 3.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଖୋଲା। 2 ରୁ 3 କୁ ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍ କରି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time color?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶକୁ ଓଲ୍ଡ-ଟାଇମ୍ ଶୈଳୀ ଦିଏ?

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: G major uses F♯. Lowering it to F gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ F♯ ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ। ତାହାକୁ F କୁ ତଳକୁ ଆଣିଲେ ଓଲ୍ଡ-ଟାଇମ୍ ଓ ବ୍ଲୁଗ୍ରାସ୍ ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଉଥିବା ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି ମିଳେ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides, then Old Joe Clark. Pick only where you need to and let your fretting hand do the rest.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍, ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍ ଓ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍, ତାପରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଜୋ କ୍ଲାର୍କ। ଯେଉଁଠି ଦରକାର କେବଳ ସେଠି ପିକ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ବାକି କାମ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତକୁ କରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which move glides a fretted note up to a higher fret?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ କୌଶଳରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ଧରା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଉପର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌କୁ ସରାଯାଏ?

strings.source: A different right hand: strike down with a fingernail and catch the drone with your thumb.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 “Clawhammer” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଡାହାଣ ହାତର ଭିନ୍ନ ଶୈଳୀ: ନଖରେ ତଳମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ନିରନ୍ତର ସ୍ୱରର ତାର ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Clawhammer uses no picks. Curl your hand into a loose claw and strike down on a string with the back of your index or middle fingernail, moving from the wrist and forearm.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କ୍ଲହାମର୍‌ରେ ପିକ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ। ହାତକୁ ଢିଲା ପଞ୍ଝା ପରି ବଙ୍କା କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ କଚଟି ଓ ବାହୁର ତଳ ଭାଗ ଚଳାଇ ତର୍ଜନୀ କିମ୍ବା ମଧ୍ୟମାର ନଖର ପିଠି ପଟରେ ତାରକୁ ତଳମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: As your hand strikes, the thumb comes to rest on the fifth string. On the next beat it pushes through that string as your hand lifts.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାତ ଆଘାତ କଲାବେଳେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାର ଉପରେ ରହେ। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ହାତ ଉଠିବା ବେଳେ ଏହା ସେହି ତାରକୁ ଠେଲି ପାର୍ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: Which way does your fingernail move in clawhammer?

strings.source: The basic clawhammer rhythm sounds like its name. Bum: strike one note on the beat. Dit: brush down across the strings. Ty: your thumb plays string 5.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କ୍ଲହାମର୍‌ର ମୂଳ ଛନ୍ଦ ଏହାର ନାମ ପରି ଶୁଭେ। ବମ୍: ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଆଘାତ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଡିଟ୍: ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ତଳମୁଖୀ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଟି: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 5 ବଜାଏ।

strings.source: Which part of bum-ditty does the thumb play?
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ବମ୍-ଡିଟିର କେଉଁ ଅଂଶ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବଜାଏ?

strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.

strings.translation: ବମ୍ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ସ୍ୱର, ଡିଟ୍ ହେଉଛି ଝଙ୍କାର ଏବଂ ଟି ହେଉଛି ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ବାଦନ।

strings.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କ୍ଲହାମର୍‌ରେ ସୁରର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବମ୍ ଆଘାତରେ ପଡ଼େ। ଝଙ୍କାର ଓ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ବାଦନ ମଝିର ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ ପୂରଣ କରେ, ତେଣୁ ସୁର ଓ ଛନ୍ଦ ଏକାଠି ଶୁଭେ।

strings.source: Skip to My Lou was a party game in the 1840s. In clawhammer each melody note is a bum, followed by a brush and the thumb on string 5.
strings.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍କିପ୍ ଟୁ ମାଇ ଲୁ 1840 ଦଶକରେ ଏକ ଆସରର ଖେଳ ଥିଲା। କ୍ଲହାମର୍‌ରେ ସୁରର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ୱର ଏକ ବମ୍, ତାପରେ ଝଙ୍କାର ଓ ତାର 5 ରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ବାଦନ ଆସେ।

strings.translation: କ୍ଲହାମର୍‌ର ସବୁକିଛି ବମ୍-ଡିଟିକୁ ଫେରେ। ହାତର ଗତି ଢିଲା ଓ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ସୁର ନିଜେ ଗଢ଼ିଉଠିବ।

strings.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · unit summary
strings.translation: ବଡ଼ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରଠାରୁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ, ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚିହ୍ନନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · title

strings.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର କେତେ ଉଚ୍ଚ କିମ୍ବା ନିମ୍ନ ଶୁଭେ, ତାହା ହେଉଛି ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା। କୀବୋର୍ଡରେ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱର ବାମ ପଟେ ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ଡାହାଣ ପଟେ ଥାଏ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ କାନ ଏହି ତଫାତ ଜାଣିସାରିଛି; ଏଠାରେ ତାହାକୁ ଆହୁରି ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ କରିବେ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ ହେଲେ ସୁର ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ। ଏହା ନିମ୍ନ ହେଲେ ସୁର ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ। ଶୁଣିବା ବେଳେ ହାତରେ ସେହି ଦିଗକୁ ପବନରେ ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Does the second note go up or down?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ କି ତଳକୁ?

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର ଯେତେ ନିକଟ, ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଅଲଗା ଚିହ୍ନିବା ସେତେ କଠିନ। ଉତ୍ତର ଦେବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ୱର ଶେଷ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଠିକ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଭୁଲ୍, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଉତ୍ତର ଆପଣଙ୍କ କାନକୁ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରାଏ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନୁହନ୍ତି? ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ସରାଇ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ନିଜ ସ୍ୱର ଉଠୁଛି କି ଓହ୍ଲାଉଛି ଅନୁଭବ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଶରୀର ଦିଗଟି ଜାଣେ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · title

strings.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅନେକ ସୁର ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯାଏ: ଏକ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ଏହି ଗତି ମସୃଣ ଓ ନିକଟ ଶୁଭେ। ଡେଇଁବା ବଦଳରେ ହାଲୁକା ଉଠିବା କିମ୍ବା ଓହ୍ଲାଇବା ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜୁଥିବା ବେଳେ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ମନରେ ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାପରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଉଚ୍ଚତାକୁ ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖି ଦେଖିବା ପରି ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ତୁଳନା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ହେଉଛି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ଯାହାକୁ ସେମିଟୋନ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ କୁହାଯାଏ: କୀବୋର୍ଡର ଏକ କୀରୁ ଠିକ୍ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କୀ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ। ଏହା ଏକ ଅତି ଛୋଟ ଗତି, ଏବଂ ଆପଣ ଏହାକୁ ଶୁଣି ଚିହ୍ନିବା ଶିଖିପାରିବେ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅତି ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଅନୁଭବ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଠିକ୍ ଥାଏ। ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ନିଜ ଉତ୍ତରକୁ ନିଜେ ସନ୍ଦେହ କରି ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବଡ଼ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ଡିଆଁ, ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଓ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ଉଚ୍ଚ ଓ ନିମ୍ନ, ସବୁ ମିଶିଛି। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକଟି ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଥରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · title

strings.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର କେବେ ସମାନ ହୁଏ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନିଜ କଣ୍ଠ କିମ୍ବା ବାଦ୍ୟରେ ଏକ ସ୍ୱର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · title

strings.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱରର ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ଠିକ୍ ସମାନ ହେଲେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମିଳନ୍ତି। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରଟି ଠିକ୍ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ମିଳୁଛି, ନା ତାହାଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା ହେଉଛି ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଦୁଇଟି କଣ୍ଠ ଠିକ୍ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତି। ତାହାକୁ କ’ଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ୟୁନିସନ୍‌ରେ ଗାଇବା ଅର୍ଥ ଠିକ୍ ସେହି ଏକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଗାଇବା।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ମିଳାଇବାକୁ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ସ୍ୱରଟିକୁ ମନରେ ପୁଣି ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ କି ନିମ୍ନ, Timbre ଦେଖାଏ। ଠିକ୍ ମିଳିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ସରାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶୁଣିଥିବା ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୁର ଭୁଲ୍ ହେଲେ ଅଟକନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ। ଠିକ୍ ସୁର ମିଳିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଧୀରେ ଉପରକୁ କିମ୍ବା ତଳକୁ ସ୍ୱର ସରାନ୍ତୁ। ଏହି ସରାଇବା ଦ୍ୱାରା କାନ ଓ କଣ୍ଠ ଏକମତ ହେବା ଶିଖନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସ୍ୱରଟିକୁ ମନେମନେ ପୁଣି ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ। ସଙ୍ଗୀତଜ୍ଞମାନେ ଏହାକୁ ଅଡିଏସନ୍ କୁହନ୍ତି: ବାସ୍ତବରେ ବାଜୁ ନ ଥିବା ସଙ୍ଗୀତକୁ ମନରେ ଶୁଣିବା। ଭଲ ଶ୍ରବଣ ଦକ୍ଷତାର ଏହା ମୂଳ।

strings.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ କ୍ରମରେ ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଥମଟି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟଟିକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ। ସେଠାକୁ ଯିବା ପାଇଁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱର ଉଠୁଛି କି ଓହ୍ଲାଉଛି ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସେହି କ୍ରମରେ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ କି ଭିନ୍ନ, ଏକକ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ା। ଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପୂରା ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ସରାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · title

strings.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ଓ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ବଡ଼ ଡିଆଁ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଠିକ୍ ପର ଚାବିକୁ ଯାଏ। ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମଝିରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଚାବି ଛାଡ଼େ, ତେଣୁ ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ଦୁହିଁଟି କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି ପରି, କିନ୍ତୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଟିକେ ବଡ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.translation: କେତେ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମିଶି ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ହୁଏ?

strings.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଗୋଟିଏ ଚାବି ଛାଡ଼େ, ତେଣୁ ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସଙ୍ଗୀତଜ୍ଞ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱର ଗତିକୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କୁହନ୍ତି, କାରଣ ଏହା Cରୁ D ପରି ପର ଅକ୍ଷରକୁ ଯାଏ। ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମାଇନର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ; ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମେଜର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ।

strings.translation: E ଓ F ମଝିରେ ଚାବି ନାହିଁ: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ତେଣୁ ମାଇନର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ।

strings.source: C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Cରୁ D ମଝିର କଳା ଚାବି ଛାଡ଼େ: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ତେଣୁ ମେଜର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ।

strings.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି ପର ଅକ୍ଷରକୁ ଯାଏ। ଡିଆଁ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଷର ଛାଡ଼େ, ଯେପରି D ଛାଡ଼ି Cରୁ E। ସେହି ଅନ୍ତରକୁ ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କୁହାଯାଏ। ଡିଆଁ କ୍ରମିକ ଗତିଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଖୋଲା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ଚାରି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଓ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ମାଇନର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ତିନି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଓ ଟିକେ ବିଷାଦମୟ। ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳତା ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.

strings.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଓ ତୃତୀୟ, ଉପର ଓ ତଳକୁ। ପ୍ରଥମେ କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି ନା ଡିଆଁ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ଠିକ୍ ଆକାର।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · title

strings.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · unit summary
strings.translation: ୟୁନିସନ୍, ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍, ପଞ୍ଚମ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ, ପ୍ରତିଟି ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣେଇ ପାରୁଥିବା ସୁର ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ା।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରର ଦୂରତା। ୟୁନିସନ୍‌ରେ ଦୂରତା ନାହିଁ: ସମାନ ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇଥର। ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଷରରୁ ଉପରର ସମାନ ଅକ୍ଷରକୁ ଯାଏ, Cରୁ C ପରି। ଏହା ଏକ ସ୍ୱର ପରି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅଧିକ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଜିଙ୍ଗଲ ବେଲ୍ସ ଏକ ସ୍ୱରର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି, ୟୁନିସନ୍‌ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଟେକ୍ ମି ଆଉଟ୍ ଟୁ ଦ ବଲ୍ ଗେମ୍ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଧ୍ୱନି ମନେ ପକାଇବାକୁ ପ୍ରତି ଆରମ୍ଭ ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: Why is it called an octave?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: eight letter names, counting both ends.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରାନ୍ତକୁ ଗଣି ଆଠ ସ୍ୱରନାମ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · title

strings.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପରଫେକ୍ଟ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସାତ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, Cରୁ G ଉପରକୁ ପରି। ଖୋଲା ଓ ଦୃଢ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ମିଟିମିଟି ଛୋଟ ତାରା ପ୍ରଥମ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ପରେ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପାଞ୍ଚ ଅକ୍ଷର ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: D, E, F, G, A। Dରୁ A ସାତ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · title

strings.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପରଫେକ୍ଟ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପାଞ୍ଚ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, Cରୁ F ଉପରକୁ ପରି। ଧ୍ୟାନ ଆକର୍ଷଣର ଡାକ ପରି ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ ଯାଇ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦୁହିଁଟି ଖୋଲା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ପଞ୍ଚମ ବଡ଼ ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ଲାଗେ। ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଗକୁ ଯିବାକୁ ଚାହିଁବା ପରି ଲାଗେ। ସନ୍ଦେହ ଥିଲେ ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସୁର ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A fifth spans seven half steps; a fourth spans five.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପଞ୍ଚମ ସାତ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର; ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପାଞ୍ଚ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଉପର ବା ତଳକୁ ଗଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ନାମ ସମାନ। Gରୁ C ତଳକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ପଞ୍ଚମ। ଦିଗ ନୁହେଁ, ଦୂରତାର ଆକାର ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ଏକାଠି ବାଜିଲେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ। ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଏକ ଶବ୍ଦରେ ମିଶେ। ପଞ୍ଚମ ଫମ୍ପା ଓ ଦୃଢ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଖୋଲା, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅସ୍ଥିର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତଳକୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: Gରୁ C।
