Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, rising, falling and together. If you get stuck, hum the tune for each.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ୟୁନିସନ୍, ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍, ପଞ୍ଚମ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ, ଉପରକୁ, ତଳକୁ ଓ ଏକାଠି। ଅଟକିଲେ ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସୁର ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · title

strings.source: Thirds, sixths and seconds in their major and minor sizes.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · unit summary
strings.translation: ତୃତୀୟ, ଷଷ୍ଠ ଓ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍ ଆକାର।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସନ୍ଥମାନେ ଆଗେଇ ଆସିଲେ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ, ଦୃଢ଼ ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ସବୁଜ ଆସ୍ତିନ ନରମ, ବିଷାଦମୟ ମାଇନର୍ ତୃତୀୟରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଧ୍ୱନି ମନେ ରଖିବାକୁ ଦୁଇଟି ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: How many half steps are in a minor third?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ତିନି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, Aରୁ C ପରି। ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ଚାରି।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · title

strings.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ଷଷ୍ଠ ନଅ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର; ମାଇ ବନି ଲାଇଜ୍ ଓଭର୍ ଦ ଓସନ୍ ଏଥିରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ମାଇନର୍ ଷଷ୍ଠ ଆଠ ଓ ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଦ ଏଣ୍ଟର୍‌ଟେନର୍ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଆରମ୍ଭ ସ୍ୱର ପରେ ଏହି ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: C up to A is which interval?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: C to A spans nine half steps: a major sixth.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Cରୁ A ନଅ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର: ମେଜର୍ ଷଷ୍ଠ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେର୍ ଜାକ୍ ମେଜର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ ଯାଇ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଫ୍ୟୁର୍ ଏଲିଜେ ମାଇନର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ତଳ-ଉପର ଦୋଳି ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଛୋଟ ଆକାର, ବଡ଼ ତଫାତ।

strings.source: Which interval is a half step?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: A minor second is one half step. A major second is two.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଏକ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ମେଜର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଦୁଇ।

strings.source: Sing or play the rocking half step: E, D♯, E.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦୋଳାୟମାନ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: E, D♯, E।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଆକାର ବିଚାର କରନ୍ତୁ: କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି, ଛୋଟ ଡିଆଁ ବା ବଡ଼ ଡିଆଁ। ପରେ ରଙ୍ଗ: ମେଜର୍ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ, ମାଇନର୍ ଗମ୍ଭୀର। ଏକ କଠିନ ଅନୁମାନଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ସହଜ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ଭଲ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Minor intervals sound darker than their major partners.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ସମକକ୍ଷ ମେଜର୍‌ଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Seconds, thirds and sixths, major and minor, mixed with the fourths and fifths you already know.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ତୃତୀୟ ଓ ଷଷ୍ଠ, ପରିଚିତ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସହ ମିଶି।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · title

strings.source: Hear major and minor chords, then diminished, augmented and dominant seventh.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · unit summary
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍, ପରେ ଡିମିନିଶ୍ଡ, ଅଗମେଣ୍ଟେଡ୍ ଓ ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତିନି ବା ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱର ଏକାଠି ବାଜିଲେ କର୍ଡ ହୁଏ। ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ମାଇନର୍ କର୍ଡ ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର। ଦୁହିଁଙ୍କ ମଝି ସ୍ୱର ମାତ୍ର ଅଲଗା।

strings.source: A major chord turns minor. How many of its notes change?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ମାଇନର୍ ହେଲେ କେତେ ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳେ?

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Only the middle note, the third, drops a half step: C E G becomes C E♭ G.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କେବଳ ମଝି ସ୍ୱର, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ତୃତୀୟ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ: C E G ହୁଏ C E♭ G।

strings.source: Sing or play back the chord's notes, low to high.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ନିମ୍ନରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Unsure? Focus on the middle note. In a major chord it sits four half steps above the bottom. In minor it sits one half step lower, which darkens everything.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସନ୍ଦେହ ଅଛି? ମଝି ସ୍ୱରରେ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡରେ ଏହା ତଳ ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ଚାରି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ। ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ, ଯାହା ପୂରା କର୍ଡକୁ ଗମ୍ଭୀର କରେ।

strings.source: Which notes spell a C minor chord?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ C ମାଇନର୍ କର୍ଡ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Lower the middle note of C major by a half step: E becomes E♭.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍‌ର ମଝି ସ୍ୱର ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳକୁ କରନ୍ତୁ: E ହୁଏ E♭।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A diminished chord stacks two minor thirds and sounds tight and uneasy. An augmented chord stacks two major thirds and sounds stretched, like a question left hanging.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଡିମିନିଶ୍ଡ କର୍ଡ ଦୁଇଟି ମାଇନର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରାଉପରି ରଖେ ଓ ଟାଣ ଭରା, ଅସ୍ଥିର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଅଗମେଣ୍ଟେଡ୍ କର୍ଡ ଦୁଇଟି ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ରଖେ ଓ ଉତ୍ତର ଅପେକ୍ଷାର ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ପରି ପ୍ରସାରିତ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Which kind of chord is this?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: Which chord stacks two major thirds?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ କର୍ଡରେ ଦୁଇ ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ଉପରାଉପରି ଥାଏ?

strings.source: A major third plus a major third, like C E G♯, makes an augmented chord.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ସହ ଆଉ ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ, ଯେପରି C E G♯, ମିଶି ଅଗମେଣ୍ଟେଡ୍ କର୍ଡ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ହେଉଛି ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ଉପରେ ଆଉ ଏକ ସ୍ୱର: କର୍ଡର ନାମ ଦେଉଥିବା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ମାଇନର୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ। ଏହା ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ରଙ୍ଗର ଓ ଅସ୍ଥିର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: G7 is G major (G B D) plus F, a minor seventh above G.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G7 ହେଉଛି G ମେଜର୍ (G B D) ସହ F, ଯାହା Gଠାରୁ ମାଇନର୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Major, minor, diminished, augmented and dominant seventh: bright, dark, tight, stretched, restless. Name the color, then the chord.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍, ମାଇନର୍, ଡିମିନିଶ୍ଡ, ଅଗମେଣ୍ଟେଡ୍ ଓ ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ: ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ, ଗମ୍ଭୀର, ଟାଣ ଭରା, ପ୍ରସାରିତ, ଅସ୍ଥିର। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଭାବ, ପରେ କର୍ଡର ନାମ କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 “Scale degrees” · title

strings.source: Hear each note's place in a key, from do, the home note, to ti.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 “Scale degrees” · unit summary
strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର doରୁ ti ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ, ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରର ଟୋନାଲିଟି ଭିତରେ ସ୍ଥାନ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · title
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Every key has a home note called the tonic. Singers call it do. Here you'll hear a chord that sets the key, then a single note to place.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଟୋନାଲିଟିରେ ଏକ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଥାଏ, ଯାହାକୁ ଟୋନିକ୍ କୁହାଯାଏ। ଗାୟକ ଏହାକୁ do କୁହନ୍ତି। ଏଠି ପ୍ରଥମେ ଟୋନାଲିଟି ସ୍ଥିର କରୁଥିବା କର୍ଡ, ପରେ ସ୍ଥାନ ଚିହ୍ନିବାକୁ ଏକ ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣିବେ।

strings.source: Is the last note do, the home note?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ସ୍ୱରଟି do, ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର କି?

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: The notes of a major scale are do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, then do again. Each is a scale degree, numbered from do: do is 1, re is 2, up to ti, 7.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ସ୍ୱର do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, ପୁଣି do। ପ୍ରତିଟି ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଏକ ସ୍ଥାନ, doରୁ ଗଣାଯାଏ: do ହେଉଛି 1, re 2, ti ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ 7।

strings.source: Which scale degree is the last note?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: Sing or play do, re, mi in C major: C, D, E.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ do, re, mi ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: C, D, E।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · title
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Do, mi and sol are the notes of the home chord, so they sound stable and at rest. Mi sounds sweet, sol sounds strong and open, and do sounds finished.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Do, mi ଓ sol ମୂଳ କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱର, ତେଣୁ ସ୍ଥିର ଓ ଶାନ୍ତ ଶୁଣାଯାନ୍ତି। Mi ମଧୁର, sol ଦୃଢ଼ ଓ ଖୋଲା, do ସମାପ୍ତି ପରି ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: In C major, which note is sol?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Count up from do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: doରୁ ଉପରକୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol।

strings.source: Sing or play do, mi, sol in G major: G, B, D.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ do, mi, sol ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: G, B, D।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · title

strings.source: Re, fa, la and ti sound unfinished. Ti sits a half step below do and pulls hard upward. Fa leans down to mi. Re and la want to step to a neighbor.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Re, fa, la ଓ ti ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶୁଣାଯାନ୍ତି। Ti doଠାରୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ ଓ ଉପରକୁ ଜୋରରେ ଟାଣେ। Fa ତଳକୁ mi ଆଡ଼କୁ ଯାଏ। Re ଓ la ପଡ଼ୋଶୀ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯିବାକୁ ଚାହାନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: Which note pulls most strongly up to do?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର do ଆଡ଼କୁ ସବୁଠୁ ଜୋରରେ ଟାଣେ?

strings.source: Ti sits just a half step below do, so it leans hard toward it.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Ti doଠାରୁ ମାତ୍ର ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ, ତେଣୁ ତା’ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଦୃଢ଼ ଟାଣ ଥାଏ।

strings.source: Sing or play ti rising to do in C major: B, then C.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ tiରୁ doକୁ ଉଠି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: B, ପରେ C।

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · title

strings.source: Set the key with a cadence
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 1 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ସମାପନ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର କରନ୍ତୁ

strings.source: A cadence is a short chord pattern that ends a phrase. Hearing one sets the key firmly. Sing do quietly to yourself, then measure the new note from there.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାପନ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ ଏକ ଛୋଟ କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ, ଯାହା ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ଶେଷ କରେ। ଏହା ଶୁଣିଲେ ଟୋନାଲିଟି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ହୁଏ। ନିଜେ ମୃଦୁ do ଗାଇ ସେଠାରୁ ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱରର ଦୂରତା ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Why play a cadence before the note?
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସମାପନ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ କାହିଁକି ବଜାଯାଏ?

strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The chords point to do, so you can hear every other note in relation to it.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କର୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ doକୁ ସୂଚାନ୍ତି, ତେଣୁ ଅନ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରକୁ ତା’ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ଶୁଣିପାରିବେ।

strings.source: Sing or play up the scale from do in C major: C, D, E, F, G.
strings.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ doରୁ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଉପରକୁ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: C, D, E, F, G।

strings.source: Music names its notes with just seven letters: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. After G the alphabet starts again at A, a little higher each time around.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ କେବଳ ସାତ ଅକ୍ଷରରେ ସ୍ୱରର ନାମ: A, B, C, D, E, F, G। G ପରେ ପୁଣି Aରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ, ପ୍ରତି ଚକ୍ରରେ ଟିକେ ଉଚ୍ଚ।

strings.translation: ତଳକୁ ଯିବାବେଳେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣମାଳା C, B, A, ପରେ G।

strings.source: Moving forward through the letters, A to B to C, the notes go up. Moving backward, they go down. The letters loop like the hours on a clock.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅକ୍ଷରରେ ଆଗକୁ Aରୁ Bରୁ C ଯାଇଲେ ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ ହୁଏ। ପଛକୁ ଯାଇଲେ ନିମ୍ନ ହୁଏ। ଘଡ଼ିର ଘଣ୍ଟା ପରି ଅକ୍ଷରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Notes that share a letter sound alike even when one is higher. The distance from one C to the next C is an octave. The higher note vibrates exactly twice as fast.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ ଅକ୍ଷରର ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଉଚ୍ଚ ହେଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସଦୃଶ ଶୁଣାଯାନ୍ତି। ଗୋଟିଏ Cରୁ ପର Cର ଦୂରତା ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍। ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ଠିକ୍ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ବେଗରେ କମ୍ପେ।

strings.source: Notes carry a number that tells you which octave they're in. Middle C, near the center of a piano, is C4. The number goes up by one at every C.

strings.source: A keyboard's black keys come in groups of two and three. They're your map. C is the white key just left of each group of two.

strings.source: It's the right-hand key of the pair, just above D: D♯.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା ଯୋଡ଼ିର ଡାହାଣ କୀ, D ର ଠିକ୍ ଉପରେ: D♯।

strings.source: Play or sing C, C♯, D: two half steps up.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C, C♯, D ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ।

strings.source: A whole step equals two half steps: it skips exactly one key. C to D is a whole step, with C♯ in between. E to F♯ is too.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ସହ ସମାନ: ଠିକ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ କୀ ଛାଡ଼େ। C ରୁ D ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ମଝିରେ C♯। E ରୁ F♯ ମଧ୍ୟ ସେପରି।

strings.source: What is a whole step above C?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: C ଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ କ’ଣ ଅଛି?

strings.source: C to D skips one key, C♯.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ରୁ D ଗୋଟିଏ କୀ C♯ କୁ ଛାଡ଼େ।

strings.source: What is a whole step above E?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E ଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ କ’ଣ ଅଛି?

strings.source: E to F is only a half step, so a whole step up is F♯.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: E ରୁ F କେବଳ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ତେଣୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ F♯।

strings.source: What is a whole step above B?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: B ଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ କ’ଣ ଅଛି?

strings.source: B to C is a half step, so a whole step up is C♯.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: B ରୁ C ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ତେଣୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ C♯।

strings.source: What is a whole step below F?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: F ଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ କ’ଣ ଅଛି?

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: F down to E is a half step; one more key down is E♭.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: F ରୁ ତଳ E ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର; ଆଉ ଏକ କୀ ତଳେ E♭।

strings.source: Play or sing two whole steps up from E: E, F♯, G♯.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E ଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: E, F♯, G♯।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · title
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Two names for the same pitch are called enharmonic. C♯ and D♭ are one key with two names. Which name you use depends on the key you're in.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାର ଦୁଇ ନାମକୁ ସମସ୍ୱରୀ କୁହାଯାଏ। C♯ ଓ D♭ ଗୋଟିଏ କୀର ଦୁଇ ନାମ। କେଉଁ ନାମ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବେ, ତାହା ଗୀତର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ।

strings.source: Which pair names the same key?

strings.source: C♯ is a half step above C; D♭ is a half step below D. Same key.

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: White keys can have sharp or flat names as well. E and F are a half step apart, so E♯ is the same key as F, and F♭ is the same key as E.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଧଳା କୀର ମଧ୍ୟ ଶାର୍ପ ବା ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ନାମ ଥାଇପାରେ। E ଓ F ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ତେଣୁ E♯ ଓ F ଏକେ କୀ; F♭ ଓ E ଏକେ କୀ।

strings.source: E♯ is a half step above E, which is F.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: E♯, E ଠାରୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ F।

strings.translation: C ର ଆଉ ଏକ ନାମ କ’ଣ?

Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.translation: A ଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ କ’ଣ ଅଛି?

strings.source: A to B skips one key, A♯.

strings.source: It's the top key of the group of three, just below B: A♯, also called B♭.

strings.translation: ଏହା ତିନୋଟିର ଦଳର ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ କୀ, B ର ଠିକ୍ ତଳେ: A♯, ଯାହାକୁ B♭ ମଧ୍ୟ କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.translation: D ଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ କ’ଣ ଅଛି?

strings.source: D to C skips one key, C♯.

strings.source: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on a line or in a space. The higher a note sits, the higher it sounds.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ରେ ଲେଖାଯାଏ: ପାଞ୍ଚ ରେଖା, ମଝିରେ ଚାରି ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ। ସ୍ୱର ରେଖା ଉପରେ ବା ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରହେ। ସ୍ୱର ଯେତେ ଉପରେ ରହେ, ସେତେ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: How many lines does a staff have?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Five lines, with four spaces between them.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପାଞ୍ଚ ରେଖା, ମଝିରେ ଚାରି ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: It sits higher on the staff, so it sounds higher.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ରେ ଅଧିକ ଉପରେ ଅଛି, ତେଣୁ ଅଧିକ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Moving up one letter moves from a line to the next space, or from a space to the next line. Notes on neighboring lines are two letters apart.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ ରେଖାରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ବା ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ରେଖାକୁ ଯାଏ। ପାଖାପାଖି ରେଖାର ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରନାମ ବ୍ୟବଧାନରେ ଅଛି।

strings.translation: ରେଖା ଉପରର ସ୍ୱର ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଉଠିଲେ କେଉଁଠି ପହଞ୍ଚେ?

Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରନାମ କ୍ରମେ ବଦଳେ: ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ।

strings.source: The treble clef, or G clef, curls around the second line from the bottom. That line is the G above middle C. Higher instruments and voices read it.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ବା G କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ତଳୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ରେଖା ଚାରିପାଖରେ ବୁଲିଛି। ସେହି ରେଖା ମଧ୍ୟ C ର ଉପର G। ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ବାଦ୍ୟ ଓ କଣ୍ଠ ପାଇଁ ଏହା ପଢ଼ାଯାଏ।

strings.source: The treble clef curls around that line to mark G.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ଚିହ୍ନାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ସେହି ରେଖା ଚାରିପାଖରେ ବୁଲିଛି।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: From bottom to top, the treble staff's lines are E, G, B, D, F. Remember them as Every Good Boy Does Fine.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତଳୁ ଉପରକୁ ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ରେଖାଗୁଡ଼ିକ E, G, B, D, F। Every Good Boy Does Fine ର ଆଦ୍ୟକ୍ଷର ଭାବେ ମନେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The bottom line is E, the Every of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତଳ ରେଖା E, Every Good Boy Does Fine ର Every।

strings.source: The middle line is B, the Boy of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମଝି ରେଖା B, Every Good Boy Does Fine ର Boy।

strings.source: The top line is F, the Fine of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉପର ରେଖା F, Every Good Boy Does Fine ର Fine।

strings.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତଳୁ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ରେଖା D, Every Good Boy Does Fine ର Does।

strings.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତଳ ତିନି ରେଖା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: E, G, B।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଚାରି ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ ତଳୁ ଉପରକୁ ଏକ ଶବ୍ଦ ଗଢ଼େ: F, A, C, E। ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନରେ FACE ଲେଖାହୁଏ।

strings.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତଳ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ F, FACE ର ପ୍ରଥମ ଅକ୍ଷର।

strings.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତଳୁ ତୃତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ C: F, A, C।

strings.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତଳୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ A: F, A।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏକାଠି କଲେ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍ E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F ରେ ଉଠେ: ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ଉପର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ।

strings.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉପର ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ E, FACE ର ଶେଷ ଅକ୍ଷର।

strings.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତଳୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ରେଖା G, ଯେଉଁଠି ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ବୁଲିଛି।

strings.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତଳୁ ଉପରକୁ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନର ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: F, A, C, E।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଉପରେ ବା ତଳେ ଗଲେ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖା ନାମକ ଛୋଟ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ରେଖା ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌କୁ ବଢ଼ାଏ। ମଧ୍ୟ C ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ତଳେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ତଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ C।

strings.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D ସବୁଠୁ ତଳ ରେଖାର ଠିକ୍ ତଳ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରହେ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସବୁଠୁ ଉପର ରେଖା ପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଚାଲେ। G ସେହି ରେଖାର ଠିକ୍ ଉପରେ, A ତାହା ଉପରର ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଉପର ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ A।

strings.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତଳକୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ C, ତାହା ତଳେ B, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ A।

strings.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମଧ୍ୟ C, ତାପରେ D ଓ E ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରୁ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌କୁ ଉଠି।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର ବାଦ୍ୟ ଓ କଣ୍ଠ ବେସ୍ ବା F କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ପଢ଼ନ୍ତି। ଏହାର ଦୁଇ ବିନ୍ଦୁ ତଳୁ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ରେଖାର ଦୁଇ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରେ ରହି, ମଧ୍ୟ C ର ତଳ F କୁ ଚିହ୍ନାଏ।

strings.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍‌ର ବିନ୍ଦୁ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଚିହ୍ନାଏ?

strings.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ହେଉଛି F କ୍ଲେଫ୍: ଏହାର ବିନ୍ଦୁ F ରେଖାର ଦୁଇ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରେ ଅଛି।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ରେଖା ତଳୁ ଉପରକୁ G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always। ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass।

strings.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ତଳ ରେଖା G, Good Boys Do Fine Always ର Good।

strings.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତଳୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ C: All Cows।

strings.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଉପର ରେଖା A, Good Boys Do Fine Always ର Always।

strings.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: On a ledger line above the staff
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମଧ୍ୟ C ବେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଉପର ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ, ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ତଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ରହେ।

strings.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍‌ର ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: A, C, E, G।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖା ଓ ଦୁଇ କ୍ଲେଫ୍। ମନେରଖିବା ବାକ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଦେଖିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଚିହ୍ନିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍‌ରେ ତଳୁ ତୃତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ E: All Cows Eat।

strings.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମଧ୍ୟ C, ତାପରେ E, G ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନର C ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · title

strings.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · unit summary
strings.translation: ହୋଲ୍‌ରୁ ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଅବଧି, ବିନ୍ଦୁ ଓ ବିରାମ, ଏବଂ 4/4, 3/4 ଓ 6/8 ମାତ୍ରାବିନ୍ୟାସ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା ହେଉଛି ସେହି ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ, ଯାହା ସହ ପାଦ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତି। ମାତ୍ରା ମିଶି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ହୁଏ, ଯାହାକୁ ବାର୍ ବା ମେଜର୍ (measure) କୁହାଯାଏ। ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା ଥାଏ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଜୋରରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 1, 2, 3, 4। ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା 1 ସାଧାରଣତଃ ସବୁଠୁ ଜୋର ଲାଗେ। ସେଥିରେ ଟିକେ ଅଧିକ ଜୋର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: What's another word for a bar?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବାର୍ ଓ ମେଜର୍ (measure) ଉଭୟର ଅର୍ଥ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ମାତ୍ରା ସାଧାରଣତଃ ସବୁଠୁ ଜୋର ଲାଗେ?

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା 1 ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରେ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରଲିପିର ଆକାର ସ୍ୱର କେତେ ସମୟ ରହିବ କୁହେ। ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି, ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ଓ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ।

strings.source: How many beats does a half note last?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରେ।

strings.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ କେତୋଟି କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ଭରେ?

strings.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ଚାରିଟିରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରେ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା, ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ, କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅବଧିର ଯୋଗ ଠିକ୍ ଥିଲେ ଏକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଭିନ୍ନ ଅବଧି ମିଶିପାରେ। ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ସହ ଦୁଇ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା ଭରେ: 2 + 1 + 1।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · title

strings.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୁଇଟି। 1 ଓ 2 ଓ 3 ଓ 4 ଓ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିରେ “ଓ” କହି।

strings.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

strings.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରାର ଏକ ଚତୁର୍ଥାଂଶ ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଚାରିଟି। 1 ଇ ଓ ଆ, 2 ଇ ଓ ଆ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେତୋଟି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ସହ ସମାନ?

strings.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା; ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଚାରି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ରହେ।

strings.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ କେତୋଟି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ଭରେ?

strings.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୁଇଟି, ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା: ଆଠଟି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ପରର ବିନ୍ଦୁ ତାହାର ଅବଧିର ଅଧା ଯୋଡ଼େ। ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା, ତେଣୁ ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ହାଫ୍ ତିନି। ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ଦେଢ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ।

strings.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦୁଇର ଅଧା ଏକ, ତେଣୁ ବିନ୍ଦୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ଯୋଡ଼େ: 2 + 1 = 3।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିରାମ ମାପା ନୀରବତା। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଅବଧିର ସମାନ ବିରାମ ଅଛି: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ବିରାମ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା, ହାଫ୍ ବିରାମ ଦୁଇ। ସେଥିରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗଣୁଥାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା; ବିନ୍ଦୁ ତାହାର ଅଧା ଯୋଡ଼େ।

strings.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଛି। ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ କ’ଣ ଭରିବ?

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, ତେଣୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ବାକି: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ବିରାମ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରଚନାର ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଉପର-ତଳ ଥିବା ଦୁଇ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ତାଳ ଚିହ୍ନ। ଉପର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ମାତ୍ରା ଗଣେ। ତଳ ସଂଖ୍ୟା କେଉଁ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା ପାଏ କୁହେ: 4 ଅର୍ଥ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍।

strings.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: 4/4 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ କେତେ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍-ନୋଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ଅଛି?

strings.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉପର 4 ଅର୍ଥ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା; ତଳ 4 ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ କରେ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 3/4 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍-ନୋଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ଥାଏ। 1 ରେ ଜୋର ଦେଇ 1, 2, 3 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍‌ର ଦୋଳନ।

strings.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍ ସାଧାରଣତଃ କେଉଁ ତାଳ ଚିହ୍ନରେ ଥାଏ?

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 6/8 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଛଅ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍, ତିନିଟି ଲେଖାଏଁ ଦୁଇ ଦଳରେ। ଏହା ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ପରି ଲାଗେ, ପ୍ରତିଟି ତିନି ଭାଗରେ: 1 2 3, 4 5 6।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Two beats, each split in three
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Three beats, each split in two
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ 1 2 3, 4 5 6 ରେ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀବଦ୍ଧ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଦୁଇ ଜୋର ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ ଅନୁଭବ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: 3/4 ରେ କେଉଁ ଗୋଟିଏ ନୋଟ୍ ପୂରା ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରେ?

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତିନି ମାତ୍ରା: ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ (2) ସହ ତାହାର ବିନ୍ଦୁ (1)।

strings.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଅବଧି, ବିନ୍ଦୁ, ବିରାମ ଓ ତାଳ ଚିହ୍ନ ଏକାଠି। ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କଲାବେଳେ ଜୋରରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ; ଆପଣଙ୍କ କଣ୍ଠ ହାତକୁ ଠିକ୍ ଲୟରେ ରଖେ।

strings.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କେତୋଟି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ରହେ?

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ-ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ଢାଞ୍ଚା, ଚାରି ମେଜର୍ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଚିହ୍ନ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍କେଲ୍ ହେଉଛି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉପରର ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ କ୍ରମରେ ଉଠୁଥିବା ସ୍ୱର ସମୂହ। C ମେଜର୍ କେବଳ ଧଳା କୀ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C।

strings.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ କେତୋଟି ଭିନ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଅଛି?

strings.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସାତଟି ସ୍ୱରନାମ, ତାପରେ ପ୍ରଥମଟି ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉପରେ ଫେରେ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ପାଖାପାଖି ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। କେବଳ E ରୁ F ଓ B ରୁ C ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ଏହି ଅସମାନ ବ୍ୟବଧାନ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌କୁ ତାହାର ସ୍ୱରରୂପ ଦିଏ।

strings.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?

strings.source: C to D and F to G
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: C ରୁ D ଓ F ରୁ G

strings.source: E to F and B to C
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: E ରୁ F ଓ B ରୁ C

strings.source: D to E and A to B
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: D ରୁ E ଓ A ରୁ B

strings.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.

strings.translation: E ଓ F, ଏବଂ B ଓ C ମଝିରେ କଳା କୀ ନାହିଁ।

strings.translation: ଟୋନିକ୍ କୁହାଯାଉଥିବା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଅନୁସାରେ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ନାମ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · title
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଏକ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଅନୁସରେ: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ। ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଏହା ଅନୁସରିଲେ ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଗଢ଼ିବେ।

strings.source: W W H W W W H

strings.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ।

strings.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.

strings.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ତାପରେ 3 ରୁ 4 ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ; ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ତାପରେ 7 ରୁ 8 ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

strings.translation: D ମେଜର୍‌ର ପ୍ରଥମ ଚାରି ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

strings.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.

strings.translation: G ରୁ ନିୟମ ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ: G, A, B, C, D, E, ତାପରେ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ F♯ ଏବଂ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର G। G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଶାର୍ପ: F♯।

strings.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ F ବଦଳରେ F♯ କାହିଁକି ଦରକାର?

strings.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ରୁ ନିୟମ ଲଗାଇଲେ D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D ମିଳେ। D ମେଜର୍‌ରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଶାର୍ପ: F♯ ଓ C♯।

strings.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.

strings.translation: F ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ A ଠାରୁ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦରକାର, ତେଣୁ B ନୁହେଁ, B♭। F ମେଜର୍: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F। ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍: B♭।

strings.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତିଥର F♯ ଲେଖିବା ବଦଳରେ G ମେଜର୍ ସଙ୍ଗୀତର ପ୍ରତି ଧାଡ଼ି ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଶାର୍ପ ଦିଆଯାଏ। ଏହା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଚିହ୍ନ: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ସବୁବେଳେ ଶାର୍ପ ବା ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ହେବ, ତାହା କୁହେ।

strings.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଚିହ୍ନରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଶାର୍ପ, F♯ ଅଛି। ଏହା କେଉଁ ମେଜର୍ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର?

strings.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: କେବଳ F♯ ଥିବା ମେଜର୍ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ହେଉଛି G ମେଜର୍।

strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଚିହ୍ନରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍, B♭ ଅଛି। ଏହା କେଉଁ ମେଜର୍ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର?

strings.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.

strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ତୃତୀୟ, ଷଷ୍ଠ ଓ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍ ଆକାରରେ ଥାଏ। ମାଇନର୍ ସବୁବେଳେ ମେଜର୍‌ଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଛୋଟ।

strings.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.

strings.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡରେ ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ତିନି ସ୍ୱର ସଜେ। ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଷର ଛାଡ଼ି ପରଟି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପୁଣି ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ। C, D ଛାଡ଼ି E, F ଛାଡ଼ି G: C E G।

strings.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.

strings.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡର ତଳେ ଚାରି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ, ଉପରେ ମାଇନର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ଥାଏ। C E G ମେଜର୍। F A C ଓ G B D ମଧ୍ୟ ସେପରି।

strings.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.

strings.translation: ତୃତୀୟ ଦୁଇଟିର କ୍ରମ ଓଲଟାଇଲେ ମାଇନର୍: ତଳେ ମାଇନର୍, ଉପରେ ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ। C ମେଜର୍‌ର ମଝି ସ୍ୱର ତଳକୁ କଲେ C ମାଇନର୍: C E♭ G।

strings.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.

strings.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ii–V–I ଜାଜ୍‌ର ସବୁଠାରୁ ପ୍ରଚଳିତ କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ। C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ D ମାଇନର୍, G, C। ପ୍ରତି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ପରଟିକୁ ଏକ ପଞ୍ଚମ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ମୂଳ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଫେରିବା ଭଳି ଲାଗେ।

strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ବାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର କର୍ଡ ଯୋଜନା, ଯାହା ଅଗଣିତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍, ରକ୍ ଓ ଜାଜ୍ ସୁରର ଆଧାର। ଏଥିରେ I, IV, V ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ; ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ରଙ୍ଗ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ସବୁ ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ।

Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.

strings.translation: I ର ଚାରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ। IV ର ଦୁଇ, I ର ଦୁଇ। V ର ଗୋଟିଏ, IV ର ଗୋଟିଏ, I ର ଦୁଇ। ପୁଣି ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି। A ରେ: A7 ଚାରିଥର, D7 ଦୁଇଥର, A7 ଦୁଇଥର, E7, D7, A7 ଦୁଇଥର।

strings.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
strings.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଯେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟକୁ ଶେଷ କରେ, ତାହା ସମାପନ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ—ବିରାମଚିହ୍ନ ପରି। V ରୁ I ସବୁଠାରୁ ଦୃଢ଼, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣଚ୍ଛେଦ ପରି। ଏହାକୁ ଅଥେଣ୍ଟିକ୍ ସମାପନ କୁହାଯାଏ।

strings.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.

strings.translation: IV ରୁ I ହେଉଛି ପ୍ଲେଗାଲ୍ ସମାପନ, ଅନେକ ସ୍ତୁତିଗୀତ ଶେଷର ମୃଦୁ ଆମେନ୍। V ରେ ଅଟକିବା ହାଫ୍ ସମାପନ, କମା ପରି। V ରୁ vi ଡିସେପ୍ଟିଭ୍: ମୂଳ କର୍ଡ ଆଶା କରି ଅପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶିତ ମୋଡ଼ ପାଆନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଟିପକୁ ସ୍କ୍ରିନ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ଉପରେ ରଖି ପ୍ରତି କ୍ଲିକ୍‌ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଡ୍ରମ୍ ଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ପରି କାଚରୁ ଫେରି ଉଠୁ। କ୍ଲିକ୍ ସହ ଛୁଇଁବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ନୁହେଁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଘଣ୍ଟାର ଟିକ୍‌ଟିକ୍ ପରି ମାତ୍ରାର ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସମାନ ବ୍ୟବଧାନ ରହେ।

strings.source: How many clicks did you hear?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · title
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଦଳ ଥାଏ। କ୍ଲିକ୍ ସହ ଜୋରରେ 1, 2, 3, 4 ଗଣି ପୁଣି 1 ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସଂଖ୍ୟା କହିଲେ ହାତ ଠିକ୍ ସମୟ ରଖିପାରେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ହେଉଛି ମାତ୍ରାର ଗୋଟିଏ ଦଳ। ଏଠାରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା, 4/4 ଭାବେ ଲେଖାଯାଏ। ମାତ୍ରା 1 ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରେ, ତେଣୁ ଗଣିବାବେଳେ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଜୋର କ୍ଲିକ୍‌ଟି ମାତ୍ରା 1। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ କେତେ ମାତ୍ରା?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ କେଉଁ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ପୁଣି 1 ରୁ ଗଣନା ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · title
strings.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ଅଧିକ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର

strings.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ରହୁଥିବା ସ୍ୱର କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍। ଚାରିଟି ମିଶି 4/4 ର ଏକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରେ। ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରିବା ମାନେ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରିବା।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ କେବଳ 1 ଓ 3 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରାର ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍। ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ଗଣୁଥାନ୍ତୁ; ଛାଡ଼ିଥିବା ମାତ୍ରା ମଧ୍ୟ ଚାଲିଥାଏ।

strings.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଆପଣ 1 ଓ 3 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତି। 2 ଓ 4 ରେ କ’ଣ ହୁଏ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା କେବେ ଅଟକେ ନାହିଁ। ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ନକରୁଥିବା ମାତ୍ରା ମଧ୍ୟ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ। 1 ରେ ଥରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରି ମନେମନେ 2, 3, 4 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ 1 ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ଆସେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · title

strings.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା କେତେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଚାଲେ, ତାହା ଲୟର ବେଗ। ଏହାକୁ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍‌ର ମାତ୍ରା ବା bpm ରେ ଗଣାଯାଏ। 60 bpm ରେ ଘଣ୍ଟା ପରି ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା।

strings.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: 60 bpm ରେ କେତେ ସମୟରେ ମାତ୍ରା ଆସେ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: 60 ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ 60 ମାତ୍ରା ମାନେ ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ରୁତ ଲୟରେ ଅଧିକ ନୁହେଁ, କମ୍ ପରିଶ୍ରମ ଦରକାର। ହାତ ଢିଲା ରଖି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଗଣ୍ଠିରୁ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, କଚଟି ବା କାନ୍ଧରୁ ନୁହେଁ।

strings.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଲୟର ବେଗ ବଢ଼ିଲେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କିପରି ହେବା ଉଚିତ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Wait a little behind the click
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ, ଢିଲା ଗତି ଅଧିକ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଓ ସମାନ ରଖିବା ସହଜ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · title

strings.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଆହ୍ୱାନରେ ମାତ୍ରା, ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ଓ ଲୟର ବେଗ ମିଶିଛି। ସାରାବେଳେ ଜୋରରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ଛୋଟ ଓ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ନୋଟ୍ 4/4 ର ପୂରା ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ରହେ?

strings.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ 4/4 ର ପୂରା ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ରହେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: bpm ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍‌ର ମାତ୍ରା ଗଣେ, ତେଣୁ 90 bpm ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ଦେଢ଼ ମାତ୍ରା।

strings.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 “Eighth notes” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଦୁଇ ଭାଗ କରି “ଓ” ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · title
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୁଇଟି। ଆଠଟି ମିଶି 4/4 ର ଏକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ସଂଖ୍ୟା, ଠିକ୍ ମଝିରେ “ଓ” କୁହନ୍ତୁ: 1 ଓ 2 ଓ 3 ଓ 4 ଓ। ପ୍ରତି ଶବ୍ଦରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା, ତେଣୁ ଦୁଇଟି ମିଶି ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରା ଭରେ।

strings.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଜୋର କ୍ଲିକ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମାତ୍ରା। କେତେ ମାତ୍ରା ଶୁଣିଲେ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · title
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏବେ କେତେକ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍, କେତେକରେ ଦୁଇଟି। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ “ଓ” କହୁଥାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେଉଁଠି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରୁନାହାନ୍ତି ସେଠି ମଧ୍ୟ।

strings.source: How do you count this pattern?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା 1 ରେ ଦୁଇ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍: 1 ଓ। ମାତ୍ରା 2, 3, 4 ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଲେଖାଏଁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · title
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବା “ଓ” ଉପରେ ପଡ଼େ। ନୂଆ ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଥରେ ଜୋରରେ ତାହାର ଗଣନା କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ଗଣନା ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚା ସହ ମିଳେ?

strings.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା 1 ଓ 3 ରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଲେଖାଏଁ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍; 2 ଓ 4 ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ।

Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା 1 ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍, 2 ଓ 3 ରେ ଦୁଇଟି, 4 ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ।
