Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଓ” ମାତ୍ରା ଦୁଇଟିର ଠିକ୍ ମଝିରେ ପଡ଼ିବା ଉଚିତ। ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଘୋଡ଼ା ଦୌଡ଼ ପରି ଶୁଣାଗଲେ ଧୀର କରି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ସହ ଗଣନା କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅସମାନ ଶୁଣାଯାଉଛି। କ’ଣ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?

strings.source: Slow down and count out loud
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Speed up until it smooths out
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଧୀର କଲେ ପ୍ରତି “ଓ” କୁ ମଝିରେ ରଖିବାକୁ ସମୟ ମିଳେ। ଗଣନା ତାହାକୁ ସେଠି ରଖେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ମଝିରେ କାଚର ଠିକ୍ ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଛୋଟ, ହାଲୁକା ଗତିକୁ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଲୟରେ ସମାନ ରଖିବା ସହଜ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · title

strings.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଆହ୍ୱାନରେ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ମିଶିଛି। ପ୍ରତି ଢାଞ୍ଚାର ଗଣନା ଥରେ କହି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ; ପ୍ରତି “ଓ” ଠିକ୍ ମଝିରେ ରହୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · title

strings.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଇଚ୍ଛାକୃତ ବିରାମ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · title
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିରାମ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସମୟର ନୀରବତା। ଆପଣ ଏହାକୁ ଗଣନ୍ତି, କେବଳ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ। କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ବିରାମ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ।

strings.source: What do you do on a rest?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବିରାମ ସ୍ୱର ପରି ସମୟ ନିଏ। ଏହାକୁ ଗଣିଲେ ନିଜ ସ୍ଥାନ ଜାଣିପାରନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା 1 ଖାଲି ରଖିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ କଠିନ ବିରାମ। 1 ରେ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ହଲାଇ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ବିନା ତାହାକୁ ଅନୁଭବ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ 2 ରେ ଯୋଗ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · title
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ବିରାମ ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ। 1 ଓ 2 ଓ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, 2 ରେ ବିରାମ ଦେଇ ତାହାର “ଓ” ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ମାତ୍ରା 3 ଆଡ଼କୁ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଠେଲା ପରି ଲାଗେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା ମାତ୍ରା 2 ଓ 3 ର ଠିକ୍ ମଝିରେ, 2 ର “ଓ” ରେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · title
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିରେ ଜୋର ସ୍ୱର ରଖେ, ଯେଉଁଠି କାନ ଆଶା କରେ ନାହିଁ। ଏହା ଛନ୍ଦକୁ ଆଗକୁ ଟାଣେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚା 1, 2 ର “ଓ” ଏବଂ 4 ରେ ପଡ଼େ। 1 ଓ 2 ଓ 3 ଓ 4 ଓ ଗଣି କେବଳ ସେହି ତିନି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କ୍ଲିକ୍‌କୁ 1 ରୁ 8 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ। ଜୋର କ୍ଲିକ୍ କେଉଁଠି ପଡ଼େ?

strings.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.

strings.translation: ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍ ଜୋରକୁ ମାତ୍ରାଠାରୁ “ଓ” ବା ଦୁର୍ବଳ ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ସରାଏ।

strings.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଫ୍‌ବିଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିର “ଓ”। ସଂଖ୍ୟାରେ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ହଲାଇ କେବଳ “ଓ” ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ରେଗେ ଗିଟାର୍‌ର ଚପ୍ ପରି।

strings.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ କ୍ଲିକ୍ ମାତ୍ରା 1। ଜୋର କ୍ଲିକ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟାରେ ନା “ଓ” ରେ?

strings.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଅଫ୍‌ବିଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିର ଠିକ୍ ଅଧାରେ, ପ୍ରତି “ଓ” ରେ ପଡ଼େ।

strings.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଆହ୍ୱାନରେ ବିରାମ, ଏକାକୀ “ଓ”, ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍ ଓ ଅଫ୍‌ବିଟ୍ ମିଶିଛି। ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ନକଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଜୋରରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: 2 ର “ଓ” ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରି 3 ଛାଡ଼ିଲେ ଜୋର ମାତ୍ରାଠାରୁ ହଟେ।

Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · title

strings.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଟାଇ ଓ ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ଛନ୍ଦରେ ମାତ୍ରା ପାର କରି ସ୍ୱର ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · title
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଟାଇ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ୁଥିବା ବକ୍ର ରେଖା। ପ୍ରଥମଟି ବଜାଇ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟଟିର ସମୟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଧରନ୍ତୁ; ତେଣୁ ଯୋଡ଼ା ସ୍ୱରରେ ନୂଆ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରା 2 ସହ 3 ଟାଇରେ ଯୋଡ଼ା। 3 ରେ କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଟାଇ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଲମ୍ବା କରେ। ଆପଣ 3 ଗଣନ୍ତି, କିନ୍ତୁ ମାତ୍ରା 2 ର ସ୍ୱର ଚାଲିଥାଏ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 2 ର “ଓ” କୁ ମାତ୍ରା 3 ସହ ଟାଇ କରନ୍ତୁ। “ଓ” ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରି ସ୍ୱର ବାଜୁଥିବାବେଳେ ମାତ୍ରା 3 କୁ ଯିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ଲେଖା ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · title
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୋଟ୍ ପରର ବିନ୍ଦୁ ତାହାର ଅଧା ସମୟ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା, ତେଣୁ ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ତିନି। 1 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍, 2 ଓ 3 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, 4 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍।

strings.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା। ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ କେତେ ସମୟ?

strings.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାର ଅଧା ହେଉଛି ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା। ଯୋଡ଼ିଲେ ଦେଢ଼ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦେଢ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପର ସ୍ୱର “ଓ” ରେ ପଡ଼େ। 1 ଓ 2 ଓ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 1 ରେ, ତାପରେ 2 ର “ଓ” ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍।

strings.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏକକ 3 ରେ ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚା ବିରାମ ସହ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରିଥିଲେ। ବିନ୍ଦୁ ଦେଲେ କ’ଣ ବଦଳେ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ସେହି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ପଡ଼େ। କେବଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱରର ଅବଧି ବଦଳେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · title
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍, ପରେ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍

strings.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା ଭରେ: ଲମ୍ବା, ଛୋଟ। 1 ଓ 2 ଓ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ; 1 ଓ 2 ର “ଓ” ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍।

strings.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ମିଶି କେତେ ସମୟ ରହେ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

strings.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁଟି ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ପରି ସମୟ ରହେ?

strings.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ସହ ଟାଇ କରା କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁ ପରି ଟାଇ ମଧ୍ୟ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା ଯୋଡ଼େ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · title

strings.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଆହ୍ୱାନରେ ଟାଇ ଓ ବିନ୍ଦୁ ମିଶିଛି। ପ୍ରତି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଜୋରରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ; ଧରି ରଖା ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟ ପୂରା ସମୟ ନିଏ।

strings.source: How long is a dotted half note?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା; ବିନ୍ଦୁ ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ଯୋଡ଼େ।

strings.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଟାଇ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। କେତେଥର ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରିବେ?

strings.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରି ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟର ସମୟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · title

strings.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · unit summary
strings.translation: ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ତିନି ଭାଗ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌କୁ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · title

strings.source: Triplets split the beat in three
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍‌ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତିନି ସମାନ ସ୍ୱର ରହେ। 1-ଟ୍ରିପ୍-ଲେଟ୍, 2-ଟ୍ରିପ୍-ଲେଟ୍ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ; ପ୍ରତି ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ ଖଣ୍ଡ ସମାନ ସମୟ।

strings.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କେତୋଟି ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍ ସ୍ୱର ରହେ?

strings.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ତିନି ସମାନ ଭାଗ କରେ।

strings.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

strings.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଦୁଇ ଭାଗ କରେ; ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍ ତିନି ଭାଗ। ମାତ୍ରା ନିଜେ ବଦଳେ ନାହିଁ। କେବଳ ଭାଗ କରିବା ପଦ୍ଧତି ବଦଳେ।

strings.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତିନି ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ ଖଣ୍ଡ ମାନେ ତିନି ସ୍ୱର: ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · title
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଯୋଡ଼ି ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ ହୁଏ। “ଓ” ବିଳମ୍ବରେ, ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍‌ର ଶେଷ ଭାଗରେ ଆସେ। ଡୁ-ବା, ଡୁ-ବା ଭାବନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1-ଟ୍ରିପ୍-ଲେଟ୍ ଗଣି କେବଳ “1” ଓ “ଲେଟ୍” ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ମଝିର ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନଟି ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍।

strings.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ “ଓ” କୁ ଶେଷ ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବିଳମ୍ବ କରେ, ଯାହା ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ ଦୋଳନ ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · title
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଜାଜ୍ ଡ୍ରମର୍ ରାଇଡ୍ ସିମ୍ବଲ୍‌ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତି: 1, 2, ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ “ଓ”, 3, 4, ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ “ଓ”। ଶୁଣାଯାଏ ଡିଙ୍ଗ୍, ଡିଙ୍ଗ୍-ଆ ଡିଙ୍ଗ୍ ପରି।

strings.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ “ଓ” ମାତ୍ରାର ଶେଷ ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସମାନ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ସମାନ ଭାଗ କରେ; ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ ହୁଏ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଗୋଟିଏ, ପରେ ଅନ୍ୟଟି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରି ତଫାତ ଅନୁଭବ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · title

strings.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଆହ୍ୱାନରେ ଟ୍ରିପ୍ଲେଟ୍, ସମାନ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ମିଶିଛି। ଭାଗ କରିବା ପଦ୍ଧତି ବଦଳିଲେ ବି ମାତ୍ରା ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ପ୍ରତି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଯୋଡ଼ିକୁ କିପରି କରେ?

strings.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଲମ୍ବା ହୁଏ, “ଓ” ବିଳମ୍ବରେ ଆସେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 “Other meters” · title

strings.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 “Other meters” · unit summary
strings.translation: ତିନିରେ ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍, ଦୁଇରେ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ, 6/8 ରେ ଦୋଳନ ଓ ଜୋରର ସ୍ଥାନ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · title

strings.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 3/4 ର ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରା: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି—ଏକରେ ଜୋର। ଏହା ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍। 1, 2, 3 ଗଣି 1 କୁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରୁ ଦୁଇଟି ଭରେ। 1 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍, 2 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, 3 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍। ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍‌ର ବଡ଼ ଓ ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ପରି ଲାଗେ।

strings.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାଳ ଚିହ୍ନର ଉପର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ କେତେ ମାତ୍ରା ଅଛି, କୁହେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · title
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 2/4 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା: ଏକରେ ଜୋର, ପରେ ଦୁଇ—ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ କରୁଥିବା ପାଦ ପରି। ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଶୀଘ୍ର ସରେ, ତେଣୁ ମାତ୍ରା 1 ବାରମ୍ବାର ଆସେ।

strings.source: Which meter feels like a march?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ମାତ୍ରା ବିନ୍ୟାସ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ପରି ଲାଗେ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା ବାମ, ଡାହାଣ, ବାମ, ଡାହାଣ ସହ ମିଳେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · title
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 6/8 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ଛଅ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ତିନିଟିଆ ଦୁଇ ଦଳରେ: ଏକ ଦୁଇ ତିନି ଚାରି ପାଞ୍ଚ ଛଅ—ଏକ ଓ ଚାରିରେ ଜୋର। ଦୁଇଟି ବଡ଼ ଦୋଳାୟିତ ମାତ୍ରା ପରି ଲାଗେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: କୌଣସି ଢାଞ୍ଚା ବିନା ଛଅ ସମାନ ମାତ୍ରା

strings.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଛଅ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ତିନିଟିଆ ଦୁଇ ଦଳରେ ପଡ଼େ, ତେଣୁ ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ଅନୁଭବ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 6/8 ର ଏକ ପ୍ରିୟ ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ, ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ: 1, 3, 4, 6 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍। ଶିଶୁଶୟନ ଗୀତ ବା ନାବିକଙ୍କ ଗୀତ ପରି ଦୋଳେ।

strings.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଛଅ କ୍ଲିକ୍। ଏହା କେଉଁ ମାତ୍ରା ବିନ୍ୟାସ?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · title
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଖପାଖର ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଜୋରରେ ବଜାଇଥିବା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଆକ୍ସେଣ୍ଟ ବା ଜୋର ଥାଏ। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ସମାନ ରହିଲେ ବି ଜୋରର ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଇଲେ ଅନୁଭୂତି ବଦଳେ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆଠଟିଯାକ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗଣି କେବଳ ଜୋର ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍: 1, 2 ର “ଓ”, ଏବଂ 4। ଏହି 3-3-2 ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଅନେକ ପପ୍ ଓ ଲାଟିନ୍ ସଙ୍ଗୀତକୁ ଆଗେଇ ନିଏ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଆକ୍ସେଣ୍ଟ ଜୋର ବିଷୟରେ, ଅବଧି ନୁହେଁ। କେବଳ ସ୍ୱରଟିକୁ ଅଧିକ ଜୋରରେ ବଜାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ରକ୍, ପପ୍ ଓ ସୋଲ୍ ମାତ୍ରା 2 ଓ 4 ରେ ଜୋର ଦିଅନ୍ତି। ଏହା ବ୍ୟାକ୍‌ବିଟ୍। ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ଗଣି ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ପରି କେବଳ 2 ଓ 4 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ କ୍ଲିକ୍ ମାତ୍ରା 1। ଜୋର କ୍ଲିକ୍ କେଉଁଠି?

strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · title

strings.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଆହ୍ୱାନରେ ମାତ୍ରା ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଓ ଜୋର ବଦଳେ। ପ୍ରତି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ମନେମନେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଗଣି ମାତ୍ରା 1 ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
strings.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଛଅ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍, ତିନିଟିଆ ଦୁଇ ଦଳର ଅନୁଭୂତି।

strings.context: Singing course · title

strings.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
strings.context: Singing course · course subtitle
strings.translation: ନିଜ କଣ୍ଠ ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ, ଠିକ୍ ସୁରରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · title

strings.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · unit summary
strings.translation: ସିଧା ଠିଆ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ, ତଳ ପେଟ ଯାଏଁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ୱର ଧରି ଗୀତ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପାଦ ଦୁଇଟିକୁ ନିତମ୍ବର ପ୍ରସ୍ଥ ଅନୁସାରେ ଫାଙ୍କ କରି, ଆଣ୍ଠୁ ଢିଲା ରଖି ଠିଆ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ। କାନ୍ଧ ତଳକୁ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ, ମୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ସୂତା ଉଠାଉଛି ପରି ଭାବନ୍ତୁ। ହନୁ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପେଟରେ ହାତ ରଖି ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପେଟ ଓ ତଳ ପଞ୍ଜରା ପ୍ରସାରିତ ହେବ, କାନ୍ଧ ସ୍ଥିର ରହିବ। ଏହି ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ କଣ୍ଠକୁ ଶକ୍ତି ଦିଏ।

strings.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଲେ କ’ଣ ଚଳିବା ଉଚିତ?

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ପଞ୍ଜରା ଓ ପେଟ ପ୍ରସାରିତ କରେ। କାନ୍ଧ ଉଠାଇଲେ ବେକ ଓ ଗଳା ଟାଣ ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Timbre ସ୍ୱରର ନାମ ଶୁଣେ, ତେଣୁ ତଳ ବା ଉଚ୍ଚ C ଉଭୟ ଗ୍ରହଣଯୋଗ୍ୟ। ଯେଉଁ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ସହଜ ଲାଗେ ତାହା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ, କେବେ ଜୋର କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଇ ସହଜ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍‌ରେ “ଆ” କହି C ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ଥିର ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପୁଣି ଥରେ: ସିଧା ଠିଆ ହୋଇ ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗୁଞ୍ଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଧରିବା ମାନେ ଏକ ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାରେ ରଖିବା। ନଅଟକି ଆଇନାରେ ବାଷ୍ପ କରିବା ପରି ଧୀରେ ଓ ସମାନ ଭାବେ ବାୟୁ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: “ଆ” କହି C ଗାଇ ସୁର ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଦୋଳି କମିଯାଉଛି। କ’ଣ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସ୍ଥିର ବାୟୁ ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଏ। ଅଧିକ ଜୋର ଓ ଟାଣ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣକୁ କଠିନ କରେ।

strings.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏବେ E। ସେହି ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ, ସେହି ସହଜ “ଆ”।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହନୁ ତଳକୁ ଛାଡ଼ି, ଜିଭ ଟିପ୍ ତଳ ଦାନ୍ତ ପଛରେ ରଖି “ଆ” ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ। ଶବ୍ଦ ଚାପି ନହୋଇ ସହଜରେ ବାହାରେ।

strings.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏଥର G। ହନୁ ତଳକୁ ଛାଡ଼ି “ଆ” ଖୋଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ମିଳାଇବା ମାନେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ଗାଇବା। ଶୁଣି କ୍ଷଣେ ମନରେ ସ୍ୱରଟି ଭାବନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ମୃଦୁ ଗାଇ ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ଯାଏଁ ସଜାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E ମୃଦୁ ଗାଇ ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସଜାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ମାନେ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ତଳେ; ଉଚ୍ଚ ମାନେ ଉପରେ। ନିମ୍ନ ହେଲେ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ, ଉଚ୍ଚ ହେଲେ ଧୀରେ ତଳକୁ ଆଣନ୍ତୁ। ଛୋଟ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଭଲ କାମ କରେ।

strings.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: Timbre କହୁଛି ସ୍ୱର ନିମ୍ନ। କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ମାନେ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ତଳେ, ତେଣୁ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ସାମାନ୍ୟ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏଥର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର: D, ପରେ G। ମଝିରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଓଠ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାଇବା ମୃଦୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି। ଓଠ ଓ ନାକରେ ହାଲୁକା କମ୍ପନ ଅନୁଭବ ହେବା ଉଚିତ। ମୃଦୁ ଓ ସହଜ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C, E, G ଗୋଟିଏ ଗୋଟିଏ କରି ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ। ହାଲୁକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଓଠ ଢିଲା ବନ୍ଦ କରି ଫୁଙ୍କନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ମୋଟରବୋଟ୍ ଭଳି କମ୍ପେ; ପରେ କଣ୍ଠସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ। କଣ୍ଠ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେବାବେଳେ ଏହା ଗଳାକୁ ଢିଲା ରଖେ।

strings.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G, E, ପରେ C ରେ ଓଠ କମ୍ପନ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଓଠ ଅଟକିଲେ ଗାଲକୁ ହାଲୁକା ଚାପନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଟାଣ ବା ଖରଖର ଲାଗୁଛି। କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
strings.translation: ଅଟକି ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନେଇ ମୃଦୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବେ

strings.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଟାଣ ଲାଗିବା ମାନେ ଜୋର କମାଇବାର ସଙ୍କେତ। ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନେଇ ଅଳ୍ପ ପାଣି ପିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପୁଣି ହାଲୁକା ଭାବେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସିଧା ଠିଆ ହୋଇ ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ମୃଦୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। କଣ୍ଠ କ୍ଲାନ୍ତ ଲାଗିଲେ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ମଝିରେ ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E, ପରେ G। ଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକଟି ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Sharp is over the target pitch; flat is under it.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ ମାନେ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରେ; ନିମ୍ନ ମାନେ ତଳେ।

strings.source: Sing D softly, then adjust until it settles.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D ମୃଦୁ ଗାଇ ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସଜାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 7 (along) · title

strings.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: E, D and C, each a step from the next. Sing it where it feels easy; Timbre hears the right note in any octave.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ମେରୀର ଛୋଟ ମେଣ୍ଢା” ପାଇଁ E, D, C ତିନି ସ୍ୱର ଦରକାର, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱରରେ। ସହଜ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ; Timbre ଯେକୌଣସି ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍‌ରେ ଠିକ୍ ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣେ।

strings.source: E, D, C: three steps down to home.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E, D, C: ତିନି ସ୍ୱର ତଳକୁ ଯାଇ ମୂଳରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ।

strings.source: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.

strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 “Pitch matching” · title

strings.source: Hear a note, sing it back, and move by small steps.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 “Pitch matching” · unit summary
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣି ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଅଳ୍ପ ଅଳ୍ପ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ଆଗେଇ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · title
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a second. That pause lets your voice aim for the pitch instead of hunting for it.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ କ୍ଷଣେ ମନରେ ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ। ଏହି ବିରାମ କଣ୍ଠକୁ ସ୍ୱର ଖୋଜି ବୁଲିବା ବଦଳରେ ତାହା ଆଡ଼କୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।

strings.source: Hear D in your head, then sing it.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Hear F in your head, then sing it.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Your first try lands flat. What next?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଚେଷ୍ଟା ନିମ୍ନରେ ପଡ଼ିଲା। ପରେ କ’ଣ?

strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନରେ ସ୍ୱର ଶୀଘ୍ର ମିଳେ। ଧୀରେ ଉଠାଇ ସ୍ଥିର ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: କ୍ରମରେ ତିନି ସ୍ୱର: D, F, A।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · title
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ୟୁନିସନ୍ ମାନେ ଠିକ୍ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାରେ ଦୁଇ ଶବ୍ଦ। ମିଳିଲେ ସେମାନେ ଏକ ହୋଇଯାନ୍ତି; ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଅମେଳ ହେଲେ କମ୍ପନ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇଥର ଗାଇବାକୁ କ୍ଷଣେ ବାୟୁ ରୋକି, ମୃଦୁ “ଦା” ରେ ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। ମଝିରେ ସ୍ୱର ଖସାନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: “ଦା” ରେ E ତିନିଥର ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତିଥର ଅତି ଛୋଟ ବିରାମ ସହ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · title
strings.translation: କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱର ଗତି ଓ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର

strings.source: A step is the next note
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 1 (explain) · title
strings.translation: କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି ମାନେ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯିବା

strings.source: A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କ୍ରମିକ ଗତିରେ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଉପର ବା ତଳକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି। ଠିକ୍ ସୁରରେ ଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ଓ ସହଜ ଗତି।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: Did it go up or down?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, E ରୁ F ପରି, ମଝିରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ନାହିଁ। C ଓ D ପରି ଅଧିକାଂଶ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ସ୍ୱର ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୂରରେ: ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

strings.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ F, ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Hear each note in your head first, start softly, and adjust in small moves. Give repeated notes a fresh start.

strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମେ ମନରେ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣି ମୃଦୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଛୋଟ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନରେ ସଜାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ। ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନୂଆ ଆରମ୍ଭ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Hear G in your head, then sing it.

strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 “Scales” · unit summary
strings.translation: do-re-mi, ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଓ ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Solfege gives each step of the scale a syllable: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do is home, wherever the scale starts.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୋଲଫେଜ୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଧ୍ୱନି ଦିଏ: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do। ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଯେଉଁଠୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେଉ, do ମୂଳ ସ୍ଥାନ।

strings.source: Sing do, re, mi on C, D, E.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C, D, E ରେ do, re, mi ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which syllable is home, the first step of the scale?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ଧ୍ୱନି ମୂଳ ସ୍ଥାନ, ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର?

strings.source: Do is the first step and the note a scale comes back to.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Do ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ଏବଂ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଫେରିଆସୁଥିବା ସ୍ୱର।

strings.source: Now back down: mi, re, do.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: the first five steps carry many simple tunes. Sing them up and back down on one breath if it feels easy.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: ପ୍ରଥମ ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ଅନେକ ସହଜ ସୁରର ଆଧାର। ସହଜ ଲାଗିଲେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଶ୍ୱାସରେ ଉପରକୁ ଓ ତଳକୁ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C up to G.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C ରୁ G ଉପରକୁ।

strings.source: Between which two steps is there a half step?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ମଝିରେ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର?

Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Mi to fa (E to F) is a half step. The other steps from do to sol are whole steps.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Mi ରୁ fa (E ରୁ F) ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। do ରୁ sol ର ଅନ୍ୟ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

strings.source: Sol back down to do: G down to C.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Sol ରୁ do ତଳକୁ: G ରୁ C।

Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The major scale runs from do up to the next do: eight notes. Mi to fa and ti to do are half steps; every other step is a whole step.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ do ରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ do ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ: ଆଠ ସ୍ୱର। Mi ରୁ fa ଓ ti ରୁ do ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର; ଅନ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତି କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

strings.source: Do to do: C up to the next C.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Do ରୁ do: C ରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ C ଉପରକୁ।

strings.source: Where are the half steps in a major scale?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Mi-fa and ti-do are half steps. That pattern gives the major scale its sound.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Mi-fa ଓ ti-do ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚା ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ଧ୍ୱନି ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Take a low breath before you start so you don't run out near the top. Let high notes get lighter, not louder, and keep your jaw loose.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଉପରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲେ ସରି ନଯାଏ। ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ହାଲୁକା ହେଉ, ଅଧିକ ଜୋର ନୁହେଁ; ହନୁ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C ରୁ C ତଳକୁ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱର ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସୁର ତଳକୁ ଖସି ନଯାଏ।

strings.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.

strings.translation: do-re-mi-re-do ପରି ଛୋଟ ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଶୀଘ୍ର ସୁରର ସଠିକତା ବଢ଼ାଏ। ଥରେ ଗାଇ ପୁଣି ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ, ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ବାଟ ଦେଖାଉ।

strings.translation: C-D-E-D-C ଗାଇ ସେହି ଢାଞ୍ଚା ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ। ଏବେ ଶୀର୍ଷ ସ୍ୱର କ’ଣ?

strings.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

strings.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.

strings.translation: do ରୁ do ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ କେତୋଟି ସ୍ୱର?

strings.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.

strings.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: ଆଠ ସ୍ୱର, ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରାନ୍ତରେ do।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · unit summary
strings.translation: ତୃତୀୟ, ପଞ୍ଚମ ଓ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍‌ରେ ଡେଇଁ ଠିକ୍ ସୁରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରର ଦୂରତା। ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ଛାଡ଼ିଲେ ତୃତୀୟ ମିଳେ, do ରୁ mi ପରି। do ଛାଡ଼ିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ମନରେ mi ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Do ରୁ mi ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ: C, E, C।

strings.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Do ରୁ sol ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ସ୍ୱର, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ଖୋଲା ଓ ଦୃଢ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ମଝିର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଭାବି ସିଧା sol କୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.

strings.translation: Do ରୁ sol ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ: C, G, C।

strings.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Do, mi, sol: ଦୁଇ ତୃତୀୟ ମିଶି ପଞ୍ଚମ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରାନ୍ତ ଗଣିଲେ do ରୁ sol କେତୋଟି ସ୍କେଲ୍ ସ୍ୱର?

strings.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର, ତେଣୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ do ରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ do କୁ ଆଠ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ। ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରର ନାମ ସମାନ; ଏତେ ଭଲ ମିଶନ୍ତି ଯେ ପ୍ରାୟ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରି ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଡିଆଁ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଇ ଥୋଡ଼ି ସମତଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଶୀର୍ଷ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ହାଲୁକା ଓ ସହଜ ଭାବନ୍ତୁ, ଉପରକୁ ଟାଣିବା ପରି ନୁହେଁ।

strings.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C, ପରେ G, ପରେ ଉଚ୍ଚ C। G କୁ ମଝି ପାହାଚ ଭାବେ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍‌ର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ଏତେ ଭଲ କାହିଁକି ମିଶେ?

strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଉପର ସ୍ୱର ତଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଠିକ୍ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ବେଗରେ କମ୍ପେ, ତେଣୁ ତରଙ୍ଗଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମିଳିଯାଏ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 7 (along) · title
strings.translation: ଡିଆଁ ମାରନ୍ତୁ, କ୍ରମେ ସ୍ୱର ତଳକୁ ଆଣନ୍ତୁ

strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · title

strings.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରତି ଡିଆଁ ମନରେ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ। ଶୀର୍ଷ ସ୍ୱରରେ ହାଲୁକା ପହଞ୍ଚି କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

strings.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ do, sol, mi, do: ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ।

strings.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: do ରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ do କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର?

Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.translation: Do ରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ do ଆଠ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ସ୍ୱର: ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍।

strings.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.

strings.translation: ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ଅଧିକାରର ପାଞ୍ଚ ସୁର, କେବଳ ଧୁନ୍, ସହଜ ବେଗରେ।

Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଧୁନ୍ ଉପରକୁ ଡେଇଁ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରେ। “ଲୁ” ରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ନୂଆ କରି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭର ଡିଆଁ: C ରୁ G ଉପରକୁ, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱର A କୁ, ପୁଣି G।

strings.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମଝି ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟ ଉପରକୁ ନା ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ?

Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବେଥୋଭେନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ନବମ ସିମ୍ଫୋନିର ଏହି ଧୁନ୍ ପ୍ରାୟ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଚାଲେ। ସିଡ଼ି ଚଢ଼ିବା ଓ ଓହ୍ଲାଇବା ପରି ସୁଗମ ଓ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଧୁନ୍‌ର ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର: F ରୁ C ଉପରକୁ।

strings.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟ ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ। କିପରି ଲାଗେ?

strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ଅଧିକ ସମୟ ଧରାଯାଏ, ପରେ ଏକ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱର ଶେଷ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନିଏ।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ସ୍କଟିଶ୍ ଧୁନ୍ ପ୍ରଥମ ପୂରା ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ପୂର୍ବର ଏକ ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ତାହାକୁ ହାଲୁକା ଗାଇ ପର ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତୃତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଉପରକୁ: F, A, C, ତାପରେ D।

strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: The loudest note of a song
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A note before the first full bar

strings.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1800 ମସିହାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିବା ଶତାବ୍ଦୀର ପ୍ରଥମ ଭାଗର ଏହି ଆମେରିକୀୟ ସ୍ତୁତିଗୀତ 3/4 ରେ: 1, 2, 3 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ। ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ପରେ ପ୍ରାୟ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଯୋଡ଼ି ଆସେ, ତେଣୁ ଯୋଡ଼ିଟି ହାଲୁକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦ୍ରୁତ ମୋଡ଼: F, ଉପରେ A, ପୁଣି F।

strings.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ସ୍ତୁତିଗୀତର ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ କେତେ ମାତ୍ରା?

strings.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା 3/4 ରେ: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରା, 1 ରେ ଜୋର।

Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1800 ମସିହାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିବା ଶତାବ୍ଦୀର ଏହି ଆମେରିକୀୟ ଲୋକଗୀତ ବଡ଼ ଡିଆଁ ସହ ଧୀରେ ଚାଲେ। ପ୍ରତି ବିରାମରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରତି ଡିଆଁ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭର ଡିଆଁ: ନିମ୍ନ G ରୁ C ଉପରକୁ। ଯେକୌଣସି ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଗ୍ରହଣଯୋଗ୍ୟ।

strings.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ବଡ଼ ଡିଆଁ: G ରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ C, ପରେ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ତଳକୁ।

strings.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Never; sing it in one breath

strings.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.

strings.translation: ବିରାମ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟର ଶେଷ ଚିହ୍ନାଏ। ସେଠି ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଲେ ପ୍ରତି ଧାଡ଼ି ପୂରା ଶ୍ୱାସ ସହାୟତା ପାଏ।

strings.translation: ପାଞ୍ଚ ସୁର କ୍ରମରେ, ପ୍ରତିଟିର ଗୋଟିଏ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟ। ପ୍ରତି ବିରାମରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ନୂଆ କରି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାୟୁର ଧାରା ବଦଳିଲେ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ଖସେ। ନିମ୍ନ, ସମାନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ରଖି ଆରମ୍ଭରୁ ଶେଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର କେନ୍ଦ୍ରରେ ରହୁଥିବା ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Hold G and keep it centered.

strings.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶ୍ୱାସ ସରିଲେ ସ୍ୱର ପ୍ରାୟ ନିମ୍ନକୁ ଖସେ। ପୂରା ସରିବା ଟିକେ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଅଟକି ପୁଣି ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?

strings.translation: ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ଶେଷରେ ନିମ୍ନ ହେଉଛି। କ’ଣ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?

strings.source: End the note sooner and breathe

strings.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଟିକେ ଆଗରୁ ଶେଷ କରି ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେବା

Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.

strings.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାର ମୃଦୁ, ନିୟମିତ ତରଙ୍ଗ, ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ପ୍ରାୟ ପାଞ୍ଚରୁ ସାତଥର। ଏହା ଢିଲା ଗଳା ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ଶ୍ୱାସରୁ ହୁଏ, ହଲାଇବାରୁ ନୁହେଁ।

strings.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.

strings.translation: କଣ୍ଠ ମୁକ୍ତ ଓ ଶ୍ୱାସ ସହାୟତାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ହେଲେ ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ଆସେ। ହନୁ ବା ପେଟରୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ କଲେ ଅସ୍ଥିର କମ୍ପନ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ଚେଷ୍ଟା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସିଧା, ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ୱର ଧରିବା ଶିଖନ୍ତୁ। କଣ୍ଠ ଢିଲା ଓ ଶ୍ୱାସ ସହାୟତାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ହେଲେ ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ପ୍ରାୟ ନିଜେ ଆସେ।

strings.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ସିଧା, ସ୍ଥିର A। ତରଙ୍ଗ ନୁହେଁ, କେବଳ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ରେଖା।

strings.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଡାଇନାମିକ୍ସ ମାନେ କେତେ ଜୋର ବା ମୃଦୁ ଗାଆନ୍ତି। ଗଳା କସି ନୁହେଁ, ଅଧିକ ଶ୍ୱାସଶକ୍ତିରେ ଜୋର ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ସ୍ଥିର ରହିବା ଉଚିତ।

strings.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E ମୃଦୁ ଗାଇ ପରେ ସେହି ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାରେ ଜୋରରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.

strings.translation: ଅଧିକ ଚାପରେ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ବଢ଼ିପାରେ, ଅତି ମୃଦୁ ସ୍ୱର ତଳକୁ ଖସିପାରେ। ଉଭୟ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ସ୍ୱର ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
strings.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ଶ୍ୱାସରେ ମୃଦୁରୁ ଜୋର, ପୁଣି ମୃଦୁ କରନ୍ତୁ। ମୃଦୁ ଭାବେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ନରମଭାବେ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ କମାନ୍ତୁ; ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ସମାନ ରହୁ।

strings.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.

strings.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.

strings.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1877 ରେ Thomas Edison ନୂଆ ଫୋନୋଗ୍ରାଫ୍ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ଏହି ଛଡ଼ା କହିଥିଲେ। ସୁରରେ ତାର 2 ର C ଓ D, ପରେ ଖୋଲା E, ଏବଂ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G।

strings.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: E D C D E E E: ଖୋଲା ତାର 1, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ 1, ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D D D। ପରେ ଖୋଲା E, ଏବଂ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଧୁନ୍ ପ୍ରଥମେ 1761 ରେ ଫ୍ରାନ୍ସରେ ଛପା ହୋଇଥିଲା; ପରେ Mozart ଏହାର ବାରଟି ରୂପାନ୍ତର ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ଏହା ଉପରକୁ ଡେଇଁ ତାର 2 ଓ 3 ରେ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ତଳକୁ ଆସେ।

strings.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D କୁ ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁ, ଖୋଲା E, ପୁଣି D।

strings.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଯୋଡ଼ିରେ ତଳକୁ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, ଖୋଲା B, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ଖୋଲା G।
