strings.translation: ବର୍ଣ୍ଣମାଳା ଗୀତ ଓ “ବା ବା କଳା ମେଣ୍ଢା” ଉଭୟ ଏହି ଫରାସୀ ଧୁନ୍ ନେଇଛନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବେଥୋଭେନ୍ 1824 ରେ ନବମ ସିମ୍ଫୋନି ଶେଷ କରିଥିଲେ; ଏହି ଧୁନ୍ ଏବେ ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ସଂଘର ସଙ୍ଗୀତ। ଏଠାରେ ମଝି ଅଂଶ ସହ ପୂରା ସୁର ବଜାଇବେ।

strings.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: E E F G G F E D, କ୍ରମେ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମଝି ଅଂଶରେ E ଓ F ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ଭାଗ କରନ୍ତି। ଏକ, ଦୁଇ-ଓ, ତିନି, ଚାରି ଗଣି ଦୁଇରେ E ଓ “ଓ” ରେ F ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମଝି ଅଂଶ: ତାର 1 ରେ ଦ୍ରୁତ E F ଯୋଡ଼ି, ପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଖୋଲା G କୁ ତଳକୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଫ୍ରେର୍ ଜାକ୍” ଏକ ଫରାସୀ ରାଉଣ୍ଡ, ପ୍ରଥମେ ପ୍ରାୟ 1780 ରେ ଛପା: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ବାଦକ ଦୁଇ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ପରେ ସେହି ସୁର ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତି, ଅଂଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମିଶିଯାଏ।

strings.source: In a round, the second player…
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସମସ୍ତେ ସେହି ଧୁନ୍ ବଜାନ୍ତି, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଟିକେ ପରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତି। ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପରସ୍ପର ଉପରେ ମିଳିବା ପାଇଁ ଗଢ଼ା।

strings.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦ୍ରୁତ ଅଂଶ: ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ରେ D E D C, ପରେ B ଓ G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 4 (along) · title

strings.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଭାଗ ଖୋଲା G ରୁ ତାର 4 ର ଖୋଲା D କୁ ତଳକୁ ଯାଇ ପୁଣି ଫେରେ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: James Lord Pierpont 1857 ରେ ଏହାକୁ “ଏକ ଘୋଡ଼ାର ଖୋଲା ବରଫଗାଡ଼ି” ନାମରେ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଥିଲେ। ତାର 1 ଓ 2 ରେ ଏହାର ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ମୁଖଡ଼ା ବଜାଇବେ।

strings.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ତାର 2 ର C ଓ D କୁ ତଳକୁ, ପୁଣି ମୂଳ E।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସେହି ବାକ୍ୟରେ C ଦେଢ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ଗୁଞ୍ଜେ, D ଚାରିର “ଓ” ରେ ଆସେ। ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଚାରି-ଓ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଧାଡ଼ି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର F ରେ ରହି ପରେ ଖୋଲା E ରେ ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

strings.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Louis Armstrong 1938 ରେ ରେକର୍ଡ କରିବା ପରେ ଏହି ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଆଧ୍ୟାତ୍ମିକ ଗୀତ ଜାଜ୍‌ର ପ୍ରଚଳିତ ଗୀତ ହେଲା। ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ରେ C, D, E, F, G ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ।

strings.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: ତାର 2 ର C, ପରେ ତାର 1 ରେ ଉପରକୁ E, F, G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · title
Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଠି ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ନାହିଁ: ଏହି ଏକକର ଛଅଟିଯାକ ସୁର, ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ। କାନରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ଚିହ୍ନି ନାମ କୁହନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · title

strings.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଶିବିର ନିଆଁପାଖ ଗୀତ ଓ ଏକ ସମୁଦ୍ର ଗୀତ, ସବୁଠାରୁ ସହଜଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଝଙ୍କାର ପାଇଁ ସରଳ କର୍ଡ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Stephen Foster 1848 ରେ ଏହି ଗୀତ ପ୍ରକାଶ କଲେ; କାଲିଫର୍ନିଆ ଯାଉଥିବା ସୁନାସନ୍ଧାନୀ ଏହାକୁ ନିଜ ଗୀତ କଲେ। ପଦ ତାର 3, 2, 1 ରେ।

strings.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଖୋଲା E, ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ ଖୋଲା G ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A।

strings.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ: B B A A, ପରେ ମୂଳ ଖୋଲା G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G ମୂଳ ସ୍ଥାନ ପରି ଲାଗେ, D7 ତାହା ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ। ପଦରେ G ତିନି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, D7 ଗୋଟିଏ, G ଦୁଇ, ପରେ D7 ଓ G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Stephen Foster 1850 ରେ, “ଓଃ! ସୁଜାନା”ର ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ପରେ, ଏହି ଦୌଡ଼ ଗୀତ ଲେଖିଲେ। ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ଓ ସେହି ଦୁଇ କର୍ଡ ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ।

strings.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D D B D, ଉପରେ ଖୋଲା E, ପରେ D ଓ B। ତାର 2 ଓ 1।

strings.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଧାଡ଼ିରେ ଦୁଇଥର ଦ୍ରୁତ B ପରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରା ଗୁଞ୍ଜୁଥିବା A ଆସେ। A ଥରେ ଟାଣି ବଜାଇ ଗୁଞ୍ଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଖେତ ଗୀତ ପ୍ରଥମେ 1917 ରେ ଛପା ହେଲା, କିନ୍ତୁ ବହୁ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଲୋକେ ଏହାର ଭିନ୍ନ ରୂପ ଗାଉଥିଲେ। ଧୁନ୍ ତାର 4 ର D ଓ E ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G ତିନିଥର, ତଳକୁ ଖୋଲା D, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର E, ପୁଣି D।

strings.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପରେ ଉପରକୁ: ଖୋଲା B ଦୁଇଥର, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ପୁଣି ମୂଳ ଖୋଲା G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଠାରେ ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା, ତେଣୁ ଝଙ୍କାର ଗଣନା ଏକ, ଦୁଇ। କ୍ରମ G, G, C, G, ପରେ G, D7, G, G। ଆଗୁଆ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବ୍ରିଟିଶ୍ ସୈନିକମାନେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଆମେରିକୀୟ ଉପନିବେଶବାସୀଙ୍କୁ ଥଟ୍ଟା କରିବାକୁ ଏହା ଗାଇଲେ। ବିପ୍ଳବ ଶେଷ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଆମେରିକୀୟମାନେ ଏହାକୁ ନିଜର କରିନେଲେ।

strings.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C C D E, C E D, ପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଖୋଲା G କୁ ତଳକୁ।

strings.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଧା B ରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ। କିପରି ଲାଗେ?

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: B ଠିକ୍ C ତଳେ ରହି ତାହା ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଧା C ରେ ପହଞ୍ଚି ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ।

strings.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଧାଡ଼ି: ତାର 1 ର F ରୁ ତଳକୁ, ଖୋଲା G କୁ ଖସି ପୁଣି C କୁ ଚଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମୁଖଡ଼ା ନିମ୍ନରେ: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ଖୋଲା B, ପରେ ତାର 4 ର F ଓ E, ତାର 5 ର C।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: George Poulton 1861 ରେ ଏହି ଗାଥାଗୀତ ପ୍ରକାଶ କଲେ। ପ୍ରାୟ ଏକ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀ ପରେ ଏହାର ଧୁନ୍ “ଲଭ୍ ମି ଟେଣ୍ଡର୍”ର ସୁର ହେଲା।

strings.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: C କୁ ଉପରେ, ଖୋଲା B କୁ ତଳେ ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ; ପରେ D, A କୁ ତଳେ, ପୁଣି D।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଅରା ଲି” ଏକ ଧୀର ଗାଥାଗୀତ। ପର ସ୍ୱର ବାଜିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସୁଗମ ଭାବେ ମିଶେ।

strings.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ ଅଂଶ: ଖୋଲା E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର F, ପରେ ତଳକୁ D, A, ପୁଣି D।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଉତ୍ତର ଇଂଲଣ୍ଡର ଏହି ଗୀତ ସମୁଦ୍ରକୁ ଯାଇଥିବା ବବି ଶାଫ୍ଟୋ ବିଷୟରେ। 1805 ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଗୀତିକା ଛପା ଥିଲା, 1770 ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଫିଡଲ୍ ବାଦକ ନୃତ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ଧୁନ୍ ବଜାଉଥିଲେ।

strings.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପୁଣି B ଓ ଖୋଲା G, ପରେ B, D, ପୁଣି B।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଧାଡ଼ି F ଶାର୍ପକୁ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ: ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, କନିଷ୍ଠାରେ। ପ୍ରଥମ ଚାରି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ ହାତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ଥାଏ।

strings.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, A, ତଳକୁ F ଶାର୍ପ, ପୁଣି ଉପରକୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ତିନି ଧାଡ଼ି ସମାନ ଭାବେ ଶେଷ: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର, ପରେ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରାର ଗୋଟିଏ। Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · title

strings.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପଦ ପାଇଁ “ଓଃ! ସୁଜାନା”ର ସେହି ଦୁଇ କର୍ଡ: G ଦୁଇ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, D7 ଦୁଇ, G ଦୁଇ, ପରେ D7 ଓ G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ବା କର୍ଡ ନାହିଁ: ଏହି ଏକକର ଛଅଟିଯାକ ଗୀତ କ୍ରମରେ, ପ୍ରତିଟି ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · title

strings.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg ଓ Beethoven ଙ୍କ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଧୁନ୍।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Johann Pachelbel ଏହି କାନନ୍ 300 ବର୍ଷରୁ ଅଧିକ ପୂର୍ବେ ଲେଖିଲେ। ବେସ୍ ସାରାବେଳେ ସେହି ଆଠ ସ୍ୱର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି କରେ, ଉପରେ ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍ ଧୁନ୍ ବୁଣେ।

strings.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉପରେ ବେସ୍: D, A, B, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, D, G, A।

strings.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Plays a new tune each time
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏପରି ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତ ବେସ୍‌କୁ ଗ୍ରାଉଣ୍ଡ୍ କୁହାଯାଏ। ରଚନାର ଅନ୍ୟ ସବୁକିଛି ଏହା ଉପରେ ଗଢ଼ାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 4 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଶାର୍ପ ନିଜ ଅକ୍ଷରର ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ। ଧୁନ୍‌ରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର C ଶାର୍ପ ଓ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର F ଶାର୍ପ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟଟି କନିଷ୍ଠାରେ ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍ ଧାଡ଼ି: ତାର 1 ର F ଶାର୍ପରୁ ତଳକୁ, ପୁଣି C ଶାର୍ପକୁ ଉପରକୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 7 (along) · title

Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Antonín Dvořák ନ୍ୟୁୟର୍କରେ ରହୁଥିବାବେଳେ 1893 ରେ “ନୂଆ ଜଗତରୁ” ସିମ୍ଫୋନିରେ ଇଂଲିଶ୍ ହର୍ନ୍ ପାଇଁ ଏହି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଧୁନ୍ ଲେଖିଲେ।

strings.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ପୁଣି E, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର D ଓ C।

strings.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ଓ ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଏକ, ଦୁଇ-ଓ, ତିନି ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇର “ଓ” ରେ।

strings.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ: D, E, D, ପରେ C ରେ ସ୍ଥିର ହୋଇ ଗୁଞ୍ଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 7 (along) · title

Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Johannes Brahms 1868 ରେ ବନ୍ଧୁଙ୍କ ନବଜାତ ପୁଅ ପାଇଁ ଏହି ଶିଶୁଶୟନ ଗୀତ ଲେଖିଲେ। ଦୋଳି ପରି ତିନିରେ ଦୋଳେ: ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର, ପରେ ଦୁଇ ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ ଖୋଲା B ଓ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D ମଝିରେ ଦୋଳେ।

strings.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଖୋଲା G, ପରେ ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉପରେ: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବାଖ୍ ପତ୍ନୀ Anna Magdalena ଙ୍କୁ ଦେଇଥିବା 1725 ର ଖାତାରେ ଏହି ମିନୁଏଟ୍ ଅଛି। ଗବେଷକ ଏବେ ଏହାକୁ ତାଙ୍କ ସହସଙ୍ଗୀତକାର Christian Petzold ଙ୍କ ରଚନା ବୋଲି ମାନନ୍ତି।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପରେ ଖୋଲା G ରୁ ଚଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ: A, B, C, D। ପରେ ଦୁଇଥର ଖୋଲା G।

strings.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମିନୁଏଟ୍ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାର ନୃତ୍ୟ। ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଲମ୍ବା ମାତ୍ରା, ପରେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଯୋଡ଼ିରେ: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ-ଓ, ତିନି-ଓ।

strings.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ପୁଣି ତାର 2 ର C ଓ D, ପରେ ତାର 1 ର E, F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ G।

strings.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ: A B A G, ପରେ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ପୁଣି ମୂଳ G।

strings.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶ ନିମ୍ନରୁ: ଖୋଲା B, A, ଖୋଲା D, ପରେ ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର C ଶାର୍ପ ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର B, ଖୋଲା A।

strings.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Grieg 1875 ରେ Peer Gynt ନାଟକ ପାଇଁ ଏହା ଲେଖିଲେ। ରାଜାଙ୍କ ସଭାରେ ଟ୍ରୋଲ୍‌ମାନଙ୍କ ଚିତ୍ର ଆଣେ; ମୃଦୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ବେଗ ବଢ଼େ।

strings.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 6 ରୁ ଚଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଖୋଲା A, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର B।

strings.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଲୁଚିଲୁଚି ଚାଲିବା ଅଂଶ: ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର A ଶାର୍ପ, ପରେ ଖୋଲା A ସହ ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର F।

strings.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: A ଶାର୍ପ A ଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ, A ଖୋଲା ତାର 5। ତେଣୁ A ଶାର୍ପ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1।

strings.source: Beethoven wrote this piano piece in 1810, but it wasn't published until 1867, forty years after he died. This simplified version keeps the famous opening.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବେଥୋଭେନ୍ 1810 ରେ ଏହି ପିଆନୋ ରଚନା ଲେଖିଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ତାଙ୍କ ମୃତ୍ୟୁର ଚାଳିଶ ବର୍ଷ ପରେ 1867 ରେ ପ୍ରକାଶିତ ହେଲା। ଏହି ସରଳ ରୂପରେ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ଆରମ୍ଭଟି ରହିଛି।

strings.source: Rock between open E and D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, then walk down B, D, C to A.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E ଓ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର D ଶାର୍ପ ମଝିରେ ଦୋଳନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ B, D, C ହୋଇ A କୁ ତଳକୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Each bar has three beats. After the long A comes a short rest, then three quick notes climb: C, E, A. Lift your finger for the rest, but keep counting.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରା। ଲମ୍ବା A ପରେ ଛୋଟ ବିରାମ, ତାପରେ ତିନି ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱର ଚଢ଼େ: C, E, A। ବିରାମରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଗଣୁଥାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A, then C on string 5, E and A. Then B, E, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, and B.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A, ପରେ ତାର 5 ର C, E ଓ A। ପରେ B, E, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର G ଶାର୍ପ, ଏବଂ B।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 6 (along) · title

strings.source: The middle: each phrase dips to a low note, then steps down. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମଝି ଅଂଶ: ପ୍ରତି ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯାଇ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ତଳକୁ ଆସେ। E G F E, D F E D, C E D C।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new notes: the six themes from this unit, from Pachelbel to Beethoven, each a little faster than before.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ନାହିଁ: Pachelbel ରୁ Beethoven ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଏହି ଏକକର ଛଅ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଧୁନ୍, ପ୍ରତିଟି ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: Which of these pieces is in three?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: A minuet is a dance in three. The Canon and the trolls' march both count in four.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମିନୁଏଟ୍ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାର ନୃତ୍ୟ। କାନନ୍ ଓ ଟ୍ରୋଲ୍‌ମାନଙ୍କ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ଉଭୟ ଚାରିରେ ଗଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 “Hymns and Americana” · title

strings.source: A Gold Rush ballad, two beloved hymns and a Shaker song from America's songbook.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 “Hymns and Americana” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଆମେରିକାର ଗୀତ ସଂକଳନରୁ ସୁନା ଖୋଜା ଯୁଗର ଗାଥାଗୀତ, ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରିୟ ସ୍ତୁତିଗୀତ ଓ ଏକ ଶେକର୍ ଗୀତ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This American song was published in 1884 and looks back to the California Gold Rush of 1849. It's in three, on strings 3, 2 and 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1884 ରେ ପ୍ରକାଶିତ ଏହି ଆମେରିକୀୟ ଗୀତ 1849 ର କାଲିଫର୍ନିଆ ସୁନା ଖୋଜା ଯୁଗକୁ ମନେପକାଏ। ତାର 3, 2, 1 ରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ।

strings.source: Clementine starts with two quick notes before beat one. What are they called?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: “କ୍ଲେମେଣ୍ଟାଇନ୍” ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଦୁଇ ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କ’ଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?

strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they fall on the and of beat three.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଜୋର ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ନେଉଥିବା କିଛି ସ୍ୱର ଆରମ୍ଭର ଅପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ। ଏଠାରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ତୃତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାର “ଓ” ରେ ପଡ଼େ।

strings.source: The turn in the middle: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D, then back up to F.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମଝି ମୋଡ଼: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, D କୁ ତଳେ, ପୁଣି F କୁ ଉପରେ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: John Newton wrote the words in 1779. The tune, called New Britain, was first printed in 1829 and joined to his words in 1835.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: John Newton 1779 ରେ ଗୀତିକା ଲେଖିଲେ। “ନ୍ୟୁ ବ୍ରିଟେନ୍” ସୁର ପ୍ରଥମେ 1829 ରେ ଛପା ହୋଇ 1835 ରେ ତାଙ୍କ ଗୀତିକା ସହ ମିଶିଲା।

strings.source: The high line: up to D at fret 3 on string 2, then B G, B A, G E D.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ ଧାଡ଼ି: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D କୁ ଉପରେ, ପରେ B G, B A, G E D।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · title
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these American words in 1831, to a tune Britain already sang as God Save the King.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Samuel Francis Smith 1831 ରେ ଏହି ଆମେରିକୀୟ ଗୀତିକା ଲେଖିଲେ, ଯେଉଁ ସୁରରେ ବ୍ରିଟେନ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ “ଈଶ୍ୱର ରାଜାଙ୍କୁ ରକ୍ଷା କରନ୍ତୁ” ଗାଉଥିଲା।

strings.source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁ ସ୍ୱରର ଅଧା ସମୟ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ଦେଢ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ଗୁଞ୍ଜେ, G ଦୁଇର “ଓ” ରେ ଆସେ, A ତିନିରେ ପଡ଼େ।

strings.source: The last line: B C B A G, then B C D, up to open E, and down C B A G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଧାଡ଼ି: B C B A G, ପରେ B C D, ଖୋଲା E କୁ ଉପରେ, ତଳକୁ C B A G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Joseph Brackett wrote Simple Gifts in 1848 for the Shakers, who danced as they sang. Aaron Copland later built part of his ballet Appalachian Spring around it.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Joseph Brackett 1848 ରେ ଗାଇବା ସହ ନାଚୁଥିବା ଶେକର୍‌ମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ “ସରଳ ଉପହାର” ଲେଖିଲେ। ପରେ Aaron Copland ଏହା ଆଧାରରେ Appalachian Spring ବାଲେର ଏକ ଅଂଶ ଗଢ଼ିଲେ।

strings.source: The second part starts high: G at fret 3 on string 1, then E D, and E F E D C.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶ ଉଚ୍ଚରୁ: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ପରେ E D, ଏବଂ E F E D C।

strings.source: Two notes share each beat in this tune. How do you count them?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁରରେ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରା ଭାଗ କରନ୍ତି। କିପରି ଗଣିବେ?

strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Two even notes per beat are eighth notes. Say the number on the first and "and" on the second.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାର ଦୁଇ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱର ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍। ପ୍ରଥମରେ ସଂଖ୍ୟା, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟରେ “ଓ” କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: No new ideas: the four songs from this unit, each a little faster than before. Three of them sway in three. Simple Gifts dances in four.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ଏହି ଏକକର ଚାରି ଗୀତ, ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ। ତିନିଟି ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୋଳେ। “ସରଳ ଉପହାର” ଚାରିରେ ନାଚେ।

strings.source: Makes it half again as long

Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half. The note after it is usually quick, to fill out the beat.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦେଢ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ। ମାତ୍ରା ପୂରଣ ପାଇଁ ପର ସ୍ୱର ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଦ୍ରୁତ।

strings.source: Carols and a New Year's song, in two, three, four and six.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 “Holiday and celebration” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଚାରି ଓ ଛଅରେ କ୍ୟାରୋଲ୍ ଓ ନବବର୍ଷ ଗୀତ।

strings.source: This tune was printed in 1582 in Piae Cantiones, a songbook from Finland, as a song about spring. John Mason Neale gave it Christmas words in 1853.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1582 ରେ ଫିନଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡର Piae Cantiones ଗୀତସଂକଳନରେ ଏହି ସୁର ବସନ୍ତ ଗୀତ ଭାବେ ଛପା ହେଲା। John Mason Neale 1853 ରେ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟମାସ ଗୀତିକା ଦେଲେ।

strings.source: The last line climbs from open D on string 4: E, F sharp at fret 4, open G, then A.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ଧାଡ଼ି ତାର 4 ର ଖୋଲା D ରୁ ଚଢ଼େ: E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା G, ପରେ A।

strings.source: Then from D at fret 3 on string 2, step down to G, touch C, and land on G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D ରୁ G କୁ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ତଳକୁ, C ଛୁଇଁ G ରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ସଭାଘର ସଜାଅ” 1700 ମସିହାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିବା ଶତାବ୍ଦୀର ୱେଲ୍ସ ନବବର୍ଷ ପୂର୍ବସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ଗୀତ Nos Galan ରୁ ଆସିଛି। ଇଂରାଜୀ ଗୀତିକା 1862 ରେ ଆସିଲା।

strings.source: The third line climbs: C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, D, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତୃତୀୟ ଧାଡ଼ି ଚଢ଼େ: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର C ଶାର୍ପ, D, ପରେ ତାର 1 ର E, F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 3 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: A7 needs two fingers on fret 2: finger 1 on string 4, finger 3 on string 2. Start your strum on string 5. That C sharp on string 2 is the one the melody climbs through.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A7 ପାଇଁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦୁଇ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ତାର 4 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, ତାର 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3। ତାର 5 ରୁ ଝଙ୍କାର ଆରମ୍ଭ। ତାର 2 ର ସେହି C ଶାର୍ପ ଦେଇ ଧୁନ୍ ଚଢ଼େ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

strings.source: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This carol comes from England's West Country, where singers went door to door on winter nights and hoped for a treat in return.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି କ୍ୟାରୋଲ୍ ଇଂଲଣ୍ଡର ପଶ୍ଚିମାଞ୍ଚଳରୁ, ଯେଉଁଠି ଗାୟକମାନେ ଶୀତରାତିରେ ଦୁଆରେ ଦୁଆରେ ଗାଇ ବଦଳରେ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଆଶା କରୁଥିଲେ।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2 and open string 4 are both D. How far apart are they?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ ଖୋଲା ତାର 4 ଉଭୟ D। ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଦୂରତା କେତେ?

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: An octave is the same letter, eight steps higher or lower. The two Ds blend, but one sounds brighter.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ସମାନ ଅକ୍ଷରର ସ୍ୱର, ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଆଠ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରେ ବା ତଳେ। ଦୁଇ D ମିଶନ୍ତି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅଧିକ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: B A G, then leap from D at fret 3 on string 2 down to open D. Then E, A, F sharp, G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: B A G, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D ରୁ ଖୋଲା D କୁ ତଳକୁ ଡିଆଁ। ପରେ E, A, F ଶାର୍ପ, G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Auld lang syne is Scots for old long since, meaning days gone by. Robert Burns sent the words to a songbook in 1788, and this melody was printed with them in 1799.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Auld lang syne ସ୍କଟ୍ସ ଭାଷାରେ ବିତିଯାଇଥିବା ପୁରୁଣା ଦିନ। Robert Burns 1788 ରେ ଗୀତିକା ଏକ ସଂକଳନକୁ ପଠାଇଲେ; 1799 ରେ ଏହି ଧୁନ୍ ସହ ଛପା ହେଲା।

strings.source: The chorus reaches up: B, D, open E, then G at fret 3 on string 1. Back down: D, B B G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ: B, D, ଖୋଲା E, ପରେ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G। ତଳକୁ: D, B B G।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lowell Mason arranged this tune in 1839, borrowing phrases from Handel's Messiah. It opens with a G major scale, straight down from G to G.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Lowell Mason 1839 ରେ Handel ଙ୍କ Messiah ର କିଛି ଖଣ୍ଡ ନେଇ ଏହି ସୁର ସଜାଇଲେ। ଆରମ୍ଭରେ G ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍, G ରୁ G ସିଧା ତଳକୁ।

strings.source: This carol counts in two. In bar one, G fills beat one, F sharp takes most of beat two, and E slips in at the very end.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି କ୍ୟାରୋଲ୍ ଦୁଇରେ ଗଣାଯାଏ। ପ୍ରଥମ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ G ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ଭରେ, F ଶାର୍ପ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟର ଅଧିକାଂଶ ନିଏ, E ଠିକ୍ ଶେଷରେ ଆସେ।

strings.source: The middle repeats open B and steps up to D, then repeats A at fret 2 on string 3 and steps up to C.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ମଝି ଅଂଶ ଖୋଲା B ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି କରି D କୁ ଚଢ଼େ, ପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି କରି C କୁ ଚଢ଼େ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Franz Xaver Gruber wrote Silent Night in 1818 for Christmas Eve in Oberndorf, Austria. At its first performance, the only accompaniment was a guitar.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Franz Xaver Gruber 1818 ରେ ଅଷ୍ଟ୍ରିଆର ଓବେର୍ଣ୍ଡର୍ଫ୍‌ର ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟମାସ ପୂର୍ବସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ପାଇଁ “ନୀରବ ରାତି” ଲେଖିଲେ। ପ୍ରଥମ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତିରେ କେବଳ ଗିଟାର୍ ସଙ୍ଗତ ଥିଲା।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Silent Night is in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, grouped one-two-three, four-five-six. Each group sways like one slow beat.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ନୀରବ ରାତି” 6/8 ରେ: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଛଅ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗଣନା, ଏକ-ଦୁଇ-ତିନି, ଚାରି-ପାଞ୍ଚ-ଛଅ ଦଳରେ। ପ୍ରତି ଦଳ ଗୋଟିଏ ଧୀର ମାତ୍ରା ପରି ଦୋଳେ।

strings.source: The ending climbs to G at fret 3 on string 1, rings on F sharp, then walks down to open D.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G କୁ ଚଢ଼ି F ଶାର୍ପରେ ଗୁଞ୍ଜେ, ପରେ ଖୋଲା D କୁ ତଳକୁ ଆସେ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: D uses the top four strings. Finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3. Strum from open string 4.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚାରି ତାର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 1, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3। ଖୋଲା ତାର 4 ରୁ ଝଙ୍କାର।

strings.source: Joseph Mohr (1818), English by John Freeman Young (1859)
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
strings.translation: Joseph Mohr (1818), ଇଂରାଜୀ ରୂପାନ୍ତର John Freeman Young (1859)

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new ideas: six songs in two, three, four and six, each a little faster than before. Feel where every bar begins.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଚାରି ଓ ଛଅରେ ଛଅ ଗୀତ, ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ଆରମ୍ଭ ଅନୁଭବ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: Silent Night is in 6/8. How are its six counts grouped?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: “ନୀରବ ରାତି” 6/8 ରେ। ତାହାର ଛଅ ଗଣନା କିପରି ଦଳବଦ୍ଧ?

strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: 6/8 sways in two big beats, each split into three: one-two-three, four-five-six.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: 6/8 ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୋଳେ, ପ୍ରତିଟି ତିନି ଭାଗ: ଏକ-ଦୁଇ-ତିନି, ଚାରି-ପାଞ୍ଚ-ଛଅ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 “Classical themes II” · title

strings.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs: rests, minor keys, a wide range and third position.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 “Classical themes II” · unit summary
strings.translation: Mozart ଙ୍କ ଦୁଇ ଧୁନ୍ ଓ ଦୁଇ ପୁରୁଣା ସୁର: ବିରାମ, ମାଇନର୍ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର, ବିସ୍ତୃତ ସ୍ୱରସୀମା ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ପୋଜିସନ୍।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · title
Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Mozart finished this serenade for strings in 1787. Its opening leaps up through the notes of a G chord, then answers with the notes of D7.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Mozart 1787 ରେ ତାରବାଦ୍ୟର ଏହି ସେରେନେଡ୍ ଶେଷ କଲେ। ଆରମ୍ଭ G କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ, ପରେ D7 ର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: A rest is a silent beat. Touch the string with your fretting fingers so the silence is crisp, then come back in exactly on time.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିରାମ ନୀରବ ମାତ୍ରା। ନୀରବତା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରିବାକୁ ତାର ଧରୁଥିବା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର ଛୁଅନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The answer: C at fret 1 on string 2, A at fret 2 on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, then open D.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଉତ୍ତର: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ପରେ ଖୋଲା D।

strings.source: The opening climbs through a chord. Major or minor?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ ଏକ କର୍ଡ ଦେଇ ଚଢ଼େ। ମେଜର୍ ନା ମାଇନର୍?

strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Greensleeves was sung in England by the 1580s, and Shakespeare mentions it in The Merry Wives of Windsor. Here it's in E minor, low and dark.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: 1580 ଦଶକ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଇଂଲଣ୍ଡରେ “ସବୁଜ ଆସ୍ତିନ” ଗାଯାଉଥିଲା; Shakespeare The Merry Wives of Windsor ରେ ଏହାର ଉଲ୍ଲେଖ କରନ୍ତି। ଏଠାରେ E ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ, ନିମ୍ନ ଓ ଗମ୍ଭୀର।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: In E minor, D sharp sits one fret below E and pulls toward it. Find D sharp at string 4, fret 1, and C sharp at string 5, fret 4.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: E ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ D ଶାର୍ପ E ଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ, ତାହା ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ। ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ D ଶାର୍ପ; ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ C ଶାର୍ପ ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Each half ends: G, F sharp, E, then D sharp, C sharp, D sharp, and home to E.

strings.source: This melody was first printed in George Petrie's collection of Irish music in 1855. The words of Danny Boy were set to it much later, in 1913.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଧୁନ୍ ପ୍ରଥମେ 1855 ରେ George Petrie ଙ୍କ ଆଇରିଶ୍ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ସଂକଳନରେ ଛପା ହେଲା। ବହୁ ପରେ, 1913 ରେ “ଡାନି ବୟ୍”ର ଗୀତିକା ସହ ମିଶିଲା।

strings.source: The high point: three As, up to F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, then E E D B D, A F sharp D.

strings.translation: ଶୀର୍ଷ ସ୍ଥାନ: ତିନି A, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପକୁ ଉପରେ, ପରେ E E D B D, A F ଶାର୍ପ D।

strings.source: Mozart finished his Symphony No. 40 in 1788. It's one of only two symphonies he wrote in a minor key, and it opens with this restless, sighing theme.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Mozart 1788 ରେ ସିମ୍ଫୋନି ନଂ. 40 ଶେଷ କଲେ। ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ଲେଖିଥିବା ତାଙ୍କ କେବଳ ଦୁଇ ସିମ୍ଫୋନିର ଗୋଟିଏ; ଏହି ଅଶାନ୍ତ, ନିଶ୍ୱାସପରି ଧୁନ୍‌ରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ।

strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Slide your hand up so finger 1 rests at fret 3. Each finger now covers one fret: 3, 4, 5 and 6. Move your thumb up too, behind finger 2.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ହାତ ଉପରକୁ ସରାଇ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏବେ ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍: 3, 4, 5, 6। ବୁଢ଼ାଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ମଧ୍ୟ ଉପରକୁ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ପଛରେ।

strings.source: In third position, which finger plays fret 3?
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ତୃତୀୟ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ବଜାଏ?

strings.source: A position is named for where finger 1 sits. In third position, finger 1 plays fret 3 and finger 4 reaches fret 6.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ର ସ୍ଥାନ ଅନୁସାରେ ପୋଜିସନ୍‌ର ନାମ। ତୃତୀୟରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ବଜାଏ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 6 ପହଞ୍ଚେ।

strings.source: E flat at fret 4 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then finger 4 up to B flat at fret 6 on string 1.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର E ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 ଉପରକୁ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 6 ର B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍।

strings.source: The last phrase: F sharp, reaching finger 1 back to fret 2. Then E flat, D, C at fret 5 on string 3, and B flat.
strings.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ବାକ୍ୟ: F ଶାର୍ପ ପାଇଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ପଛକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2। ପରେ E ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍, D, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର C, ଏବଂ B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍।

strings.source: D sharp sits one fret below E. That half step pulls hard toward home, which is why Greensleeves uses it at every cadence.

strings.source: Kite Weather is bright, easy pop: four chords on a loop, G, D, E minor and C, at a relaxed 88 beats per minute. Listen for the hook jumping up to F sharp in its second bar.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-kite-weather “Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

strings.source: Porchlight drifts along at 70 beats per minute. A ballad is a slow song that tells a story, so give every chord room to ring. Listen for the long note that closes each line.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-porchlight “Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ବାରଣ୍ଡାର ଆଲୋକ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 70 ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଭାସେ। ଗାଥାଗୀତ ଧୀର ଗତିରେ କାହାଣୀ କୁହେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡକୁ ଗୁଞ୍ଜିବାର ଅବକାଶ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି ଧାଡ଼ି ଶେଷର ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Does this phrase end at home?

strings.source: Moth and Ember is the kind of song a whole room stomps along to: heavy downstrokes, a chant of a hook, 96 beats per minute. It starts dark in A minor and brightens on D.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ପତଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଅଙ୍ଗାର” ସହ ପୂରା ଘର ପାଦ ଥାପେ: ଭାରୀ ତଳମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ, ସମବେତ ଆକର୍ଷକ ଧୁନ୍, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 96 ମାତ୍ରା। A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଆରମ୍ଭ, D ରେ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ।

strings.source: Climb A minor: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E. Then step back down.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ ଚଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, ଖୋଲା E। ପରେ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ତଳକୁ।

strings.source: Low Tide Radio is laid-back reggae at 80 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on the and of each beat, a short chop called a skank, while bass and drums hold the beat.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଭଟା ବେଳର ରେଡିଓ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 80 ମାତ୍ରାର ଆରାମଦାୟକ ରେଗେ। ବେସ୍ ଓ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ଧରନ୍ତି; ଗିଟାର୍ କେବଳ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାର “ଓ” ରେ ସ୍କାଙ୍କ୍ ନାମକ ଛୋଟ ଚପ୍ ବଜାଏ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Strum down on each and, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings so the chord stops. Chk, chk, chk, chk. The silence between chops is half the groove.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି “ଓ” ରେ ତଳକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ତାର ଧରୁଥିବା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି କର୍ଡ ଅଟକେ। ଚକ୍, ଚକ୍, ଚକ୍, ଚକ୍। ଚପ୍ ମଝିର ନୀରବତା ଅଧା ଗ୍ରୁଭ୍।

strings.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର C ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା B, ପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · title

strings.source: Dust on the Dashboard rolls along at 100 beats per minute. Country players split the bar: boom, a bass note on beats one and three, then chick, a strum on two and four.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଡ୍ୟାଶବୋର୍ଡରେ ଧୂଳି” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 100 ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଚାଲେ। କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ବାଦକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭାଗ କରନ୍ତି: ଏକ ଓ ତିନିରେ ବୁମ୍, ବେସ୍ ସ୍ୱର; ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରିରେ ଚିକ୍, ଝଙ୍କାର।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ଝଙ୍କାର

strings.source: On boom, pick only the chord's lowest note, its root: open string 5 for A, open string 4 for D, open string 6 for E. On chick, brush the thinner strings.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବୁମ୍‌ରେ କେବଳ କର୍ଡର ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: A ପାଇଁ ଖୋଲା ତାର 5, D ପାଇଁ 4, E ପାଇଁ 6। ଚିକ୍‌ରେ ପତଳା ତାର ଝଙ୍କାର।

strings.source: Which string is the boom for a D chord?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: D's root is open string 4, the same string a D strum starts from.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D ର ମୂଳ ଖୋଲା ତାର 4, ଯେଉଁଠୁ D ଝଙ୍କାର ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ।

strings.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ଖୋଲା B, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର C ଶାର୍ପ, ପରେ ଖୋଲା E ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · title
Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new chords or notes: the five songs from this unit, each a touch faster. Name each hook by ear, then play.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୂଆ କର୍ଡ ବା ସ୍ୱର ନାହିଁ: ଏହି ଏକକର ପାଞ୍ଚ ଗୀତ, ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ। କାନରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆକର୍ଷକ ଧୁନ୍ ଚିହ୍ନି ନାମ କୁହନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which song's hook starts like this?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ ଗୀତର ଆକର୍ଷକ ଧୁନ୍ ଏପରି ଆରମ୍ଭ?

strings.source: In reggae, where does the guitar chop?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: On the and of each beat
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The skank lands between the beats, while bass and drums hold the downbeats.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସ୍କାଙ୍କ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିରେ ପଡ଼େ, ବେସ୍ ଓ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ମାତ୍ରା ଧରନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 “Three-chord sing-alongs” · title

strings.source: Five songs on three chords each: a campfire chorus, a country two-step, a waltz, easy reggae and bedroom pop.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 “Three-chord sing-alongs” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତିଟି ତିନି କର୍ଡର ପାଞ୍ଚ ଗୀତ: ନିଆଁପାଖ ମୁଖଡ଼ା, କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ଟୁ-ଷ୍ଟେପ୍, ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍, ସହଜ ରେଗେ ଓ ବେଡ୍‌ରୁମ୍ ପପ୍।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-lantern-hill “Lantern Hill” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-lantern-hill “Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lantern Hill is a campfire song on three chords, G, C and D, at 92 beats per minute. The chorus is made for a crowd, so by the second time around, sing it out.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-lantern-hill “Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଲଣ୍ଠନର ପାହାଡ଼” G, C, D ତିନି କର୍ଡର ନିଆଁପାଖ ଗୀତ, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 92 ମାତ୍ରା। ମୁଖଡ଼ା ସମୂହ ପାଇଁ, ତେଣୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟଥର ଆସିଲେ ଖୋଲି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then G at fret 3 on string 1 and back down.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-lantern-hill “Lantern Hill” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପୁଣି ଖୋଲା E, ପରେ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ଓ ତଳକୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is dance-hall country in A at 116 beats per minute. Pick the root on one and three, strum on two and four, and add a quick up after each strum.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “କଙ୍କର ରାସ୍ତାର ଟୁ-ଷ୍ଟେପ୍” A ରେ ନୃତ୍ୟସଭା କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 116 ମାତ୍ରା। ଏକ ଓ ତିନିରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର, ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରିରେ ଝଙ୍କାର; ପ୍ରତି ଝଙ୍କାର ପରେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଉପରମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ।

strings.source: In a two-step, where do the bass notes fall?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The bass walks with the dancers' feet on one and three; the strums fill two and four.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ବେସ୍ ନର୍ତ୍ତକଙ୍କ ପାଦ ସହ ଏକ ଓ ତିନିରେ ଚାଲେ; ଝଙ୍କାର ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରି ଭରେ।

strings.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, then C sharp at fret 2 and A on string 3.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର C ଶାର୍ପ ଓ ତାର 3 ର A।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-first-frost “First Frost” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-first-frost “First Frost” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: First Frost counts in three at 108 beats per minute: one, two, three, with the weight on one. D, G and A carry it all, and every line ends on a long, held note.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-first-frost “First Frost” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ପ୍ରଥମ ତୁଷାର” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 108 ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତିନିରେ ଗଣାଯାଏ: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଏକରେ ଜୋର। D, G, A ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଧରନ୍ତି; ପ୍ରତି ଧାଡ଼ି ଲମ୍ବା ଧରା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଶେଷ।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, D at fret 3 on string 2, twice. Then E, F sharp at fret 2, E, D and A.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-first-frost “First Frost” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଦୁଇଥର। ପରେ E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, E, D ଓ A।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Hammock Season is easy reggae in C at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on beats two and four: one short, bright upstroke on the top strings, then silence.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଝୁଲାର ଋତୁ” C ରେ ସହଜ ରେଗେ, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 76 ମାତ୍ରା। ଗିଟାର୍ କେବଳ ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରିରେ: ଉଚ୍ଚ ତାରରେ ଛୋଟ, ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଉପରମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ, ପରେ ନୀରବତା।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Brush up across strings 1 to 3, then relax your fretting hand so the chord stops at once. Chk on two, chk on four. The quiet beats are what make it sway.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ରୁ 3 ରେ ଉପରକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ଧରା ହାତ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି କର୍ଡ ସଙ୍ଗେସଙ୍ଗେ ଅଟକେ। ଦୁଇରେ ଚକ୍, ଚାରିରେ ଚକ୍। ନୀରବ ମାତ୍ରା ଦୋଳନ ଆଣେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars is soft bedroom pop at 84 beats per minute: E minor, C and G, strummed light. Most lines start just after the beat, so let them float in.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଅନ୍ଧାରରେ ଚମକୁଥିବା ତାରା” ମୃଦୁ ବେଡ୍‌ରୁମ୍ ପପ୍, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 84 ମାତ୍ରା: E ମାଇନର୍, C, G ହାଲୁକା ଝଙ୍କାର। ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଧାଡ଼ି ମାତ୍ରାର ଠିକ୍ ପରେ ଆସେ; ସହଜରେ ଭାସିଆସୁ।

strings.source: Open E twice, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E ଦୁଇଥର, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଖୋଲା E, ପୁଣି G, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D।

strings.source: E minor, C and G share one note. Which?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E ମାଇନର୍, C ଓ G ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ସମାନ। କେଉଁଟି?

strings.source: E minor is E, G and B; C is C, E and G; G is G, B and D. G sits in all three, so the changes feel smooth.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: E ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ E, G, B; C ରେ C, E, G; G ରେ G, B, D। G ତିନୋଟିରେ ଅଛି, ତେଣୁ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ସୁଗମ ଲାଗେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · title

strings.source: In reggae, where does the guitar play?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Reggae's guitar answers the beat: a short upstroke on two and four, silence in between.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ରେଗେ ଗିଟାର୍ ମାତ୍ରାର ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ: ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରିରେ ଛୋଟ ଉପରମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ, ମଝିରେ ନୀରବତା।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 “Four-chord pop anthems” · title

strings.source: The four-chord loop five ways: two summer anthems, a roller-rink bop, a pop song in 6/8 and a stadium chorus.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 “Four-chord pop anthems” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଚାରି କର୍ଡର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ପାଞ୍ଚ ଭାବେ: ଦୁଇ ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମ ଗୀତ, ସ୍କେଟିଂ ପପ୍, 6/8 ପପ୍ ଓ ଷ୍ଟାଡିୟମ୍ ମୁଖଡ଼ା।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Sparkler Season rides the most famous loop in pop: C, G, A minor and F, the one, five, six and four of C. Hundreds of hits share these chords; a new tune and new words make each one its own.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଫୁଲଝରିର ଋତୁ” ପପ୍‌ର ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ କ୍ରମରେ: C, G, A ମାଇନର୍, F—C ର ଏକ, ପାଞ୍ଚ, ଛଅ, ଚାରି। ଶହଶହ ଲୋକପ୍ରିୟ ଗୀତରେ ଏହି କର୍ଡ; ନୂଆ ଧୁନ୍ ଓ ଗୀତିକା ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର କରେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: The mini F covers strings 4 to 1: finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1, finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଛୋଟ F ତାର 4 ରୁ 1 ଢାଙ୍କେ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ସମତଳ; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
