Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Roller Rink is bright dance pop at 120 beats per minute: G, E minor, C and D, the one, six, four and five. Strum even eighths and feel the kick drum land on every beat.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ରୋଲର୍ ସ୍କେଟିଂ ପଡ଼ିଆ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 120 ମାତ୍ରାର ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ନୃତ୍ୟ ପପ୍: G, E ମାଇନର୍, C, D—ଏକ, ଛଅ, ଚାରି, ପାଞ୍ଚ। ସମାନ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାର କିକ୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ଅନୁଭବ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1 three times, F sharp at fret 2, open E.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ତିନିଥର, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D at 80 beats per minute. Big strum on one, let it ring, then build on three and four. The half-time beat makes it feel huge.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ପ୍ରତିଧ୍ୱନିର ଗିରିଖାତ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 80 ମାତ୍ରାରେ E ମାଇନର୍, C, G, D ବଜାଏ। ଏକରେ ବଡ଼ ଝଙ୍କାର ଗୁଞ୍ଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତିନି ଓ ଚାରିରେ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ। ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ-ଗତି ମାତ୍ରା ବିଶାଳ ଅନୁଭବ ଦିଏ।

strings.source: Kite Weather plays G, D, E minor and C. Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D. What changed?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: “ଗୁଡ଼ିର ପାଗ”ରେ G, D, E ମାଇନର୍, C। “ପ୍ରତିଧ୍ୱନିର ଗିରିଖାତ”ରେ E ମାଇନର୍, C, G, D। କ’ଣ ବଦଳିଲା?

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Same four chords, same key. Starting on E minor puts the sad chord first, so the loop sounds darker.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ସେହି ଚାରି କର୍ଡ, ସେହି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର। E ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ ବିଷାଦ କର୍ଡ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଆସେ, ତେଣୁ କ୍ରମ ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then G again and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ଓ ଖୋଲା E, ଦୁଇଥର। ପରେ ପୁଣି G ଓ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଦୁଇଥର।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-open-windows “Open Windows” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-open-windows “Open Windows” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Open Windows sways in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: six quick counts felt as two big swings. C, F, A minor and G roll under a chorus that opens wide.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-open-windows “Open Windows” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଖୋଲା ଝରକା” 6/8 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 120 ଗଣନାରେ ଦୋଳେ: ଛଅ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗଣନାରେ ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ଦୋଳନ। C, F, A ମାଇନର୍, G ଉପରେ ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଖୋଲିଯାଏ।

strings.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, E, G at fret 3, E, G, then C.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-open-windows “Open Windows” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର F, E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, E, G, ପରେ C।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Scoreboard Lights is a stadium anthem in D at 100 beats per minute: D, A, B minor and G, the same one, five, six, four loop in a new key. Drive steady eighths.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ସ୍କୋରବୋର୍ଡର ଆଲୋକ” D ରେ ଷ୍ଟାଡିୟମ୍ ଗୀତ, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 100 ମାତ୍ରା: D, A, B ମାଇନର୍, G—ନୂଆ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ସେହି ଏକ, ପାଞ୍ଚ, ଛଅ, ଚାରି କ୍ରମ। ସ୍ଥିର ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: This B minor uses the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1. The full barre comes later.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି B ମାଇନର୍ କେବଳ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚାରି ତାର: ତାର 4 ଓ 3 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ତାର 2 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତାର 1 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2। ପୂରା ବାରେ ପରେ ଆସିବ।

strings.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, D at fret 3 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp, open E.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ଖୋଲା B, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପରେ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · title

strings.source: Which of these is the four-chord loop in C?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁଟି C ର ଚାରି କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ?

strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The one, five, six and four of C are C, G, A minor and F.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: C ର ଏକ, ପାଞ୍ଚ, ଛଅ, ଚାରି ହେଉଛି C, G, A ମାଇନର୍, F।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 “Sevenths, sus and swing” · title

strings.source: Blues, a waltz, 6/8 folk, lo-fi and funk, with seventh chords, sus chords and swung rhythms.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 “Sevenths, sus and swing” · unit summary
strings.translation: ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ, ସସ୍ କର୍ଡ ଓ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଛନ୍ଦରେ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍, ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍, 6/8 ଲୋକସୁର, ଲୋ-ଫାଇ ଓ ଫଙ୍କ୍।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a blues at 80 beats per minute: twelve bars of E7, A7 and B7, strummed long-short. The melody swings the same way, so lean into every long note.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଶିଳ୍ପାଞ୍ଚଳର ଶଫଲ୍” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 80 ମାତ୍ରାର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍: E7, A7, B7 ର ବାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ ଝଙ୍କାର। ଧୁନ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ସେପରି ଦୋଳେ, ପ୍ରତି ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଖୋଲା E ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ। ପରେ ତାର 3 ର G ଓ G ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା B କୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-carousel-at-closing-time “Carousel at Closing Time” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-carousel-at-closing-time “Carousel at Closing Time” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Carousel at Closing Time turns in three, like a fairground ride winding down: oom-pah-pah at 96 beats per minute. Count one, two, three, with the weight on one.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-carousel-at-closing-time “Carousel at Closing Time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ବନ୍ଦ ବେଳର ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣିଦୋଳି” ମେଳାର ଧୀର ହେଉଥିବା ଦୋଳି ପରି ତିନିରେ ଘୂରେ: ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 96 ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଉମ୍-ପା-ପା। ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି ଗଣି ଏକରେ ଜୋର।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, A on string 3, then C sharp at fret 2, open E and G at fret 3 on string 1.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-carousel-at-closing-time “Carousel at Closing Time” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ତାର 3 ର A, ପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର C ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E ଓ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Cedar Smoke sways in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, felt as two big beats, one-two-three, four-five-six. At 100 counts a minute it rocks like a slow boat.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଦେବଦାରୁ ଧୂଆଁ” 6/8 ରେ ଦୋଳେ: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ଛଅ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗଣନାରେ ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରା—ଏକ-ଦୁଇ-ତିନି, ଚାରି-ପାଞ୍ଚ-ଛଅ। ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 100 ଗଣନାରେ ଧୀର ଡଙ୍ଗା ପରି ଦୋଳେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Bar four holds Dsus4: a D chord with your little finger on string 1, fret 3. It hangs in the air. Bar eight drops to plain D, and the song lands.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ Dsus4: D କର୍ଡରେ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ କନିଷ୍ଠା। ଏହା ଝୁଲିରହିବାର ଅନୁଭବ ଦିଏ। ଅଷ୍ଟମ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ସାଧାରଣ D କୁ ଆସି ଗୀତ ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏ।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E on string 1, and down again.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଖୋଲା B ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ; ପରେ ତାର 1 ର ଖୋଲା E, ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rain on the Skylight is lo-fi: soft seventh chords over a lazy, swung beat at 72 beats per minute. Strum down on one, then down-up on three, the up a little late.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଛାତ ଝରକାରେ ବର୍ଷା” ଲୋ-ଫାଇ: ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 72 ମାତ୍ରାର ଅଳସୁଆ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଉପରେ ମୃଦୁ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ। ଏକରେ ତଳକୁ, ତିନିରେ ତଳ-ଉପର ଝଙ୍କାର; ଉପରଟି ଟିକେ ବିଳମ୍ବରେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted. Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted. For Dm7, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 lies flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Am7 ହେଉଛି A ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଉଠାଇବା। Cmaj7 ହେଉଛି C ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଉଠାଇବା। Dm7 ପାଇଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ସମତଳ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Neon Laundromat stays on one chord, A7, the whole way through. A vamp like this lives on rhythm: tight, choppy strums at 96 beats per minute and a hook that dodges the beat.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ନିଅନ୍ ଲଣ୍ଡ୍ରିଘର” ସାରାବେଳେ ଗୋଟିଏ କର୍ଡ A7 ରେ ରହେ। ଏପରି ଭ୍ୟାମ୍ପ୍ ଛନ୍ଦରେ ବଞ୍ଚେ: ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 96 ମାତ୍ରାର ଆଟସାଟ ଛୋଟ ଝଙ୍କାର ଓ ମାତ୍ରା ଏଡ଼ାଉଥିବା ଆକର୍ଷକ ଧୁନ୍।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Funk players call beat one the one. Hit it hard, keep your strumming hand swinging in eighths, and ease your fingers off after each strum so it goes chk.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫଙ୍କ୍ ବାଦକ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାକୁ “ଏକ” କୁହନ୍ତି। ଜୋରରେ ବଜାଇ ଝଙ୍କାର ହାତ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ରେ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ; ପ୍ରତି ଝଙ୍କାର ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଢିଲା କରି ଚକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3, then back down.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ଓ 2 ର C ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · challenge orig-seventh-chord-set “Swing and sevenths set” · title

strings.source: How many quick counts fill a bar of 6/8?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · challenge orig-seventh-chord-set “Swing and sevenths set” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: 6/8 ର ଏକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ କେତେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗଣନା?

strings.source: 6/8 has six eighth-note counts, felt as two groups of three.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 4 · challenge orig-seventh-chord-set “Swing and sevenths set” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: 6/8 ରେ ଛଅ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗଣନା, ତିନିଟିଆ ଦୁଇ ଦଳର ଅନୁଭୂତି।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 “Grooves and seventh chords” · title

strings.source: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, a 6/8 slow dance and bedroom pop, on seventh chords that make a groove glow.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 “Grooves and seventh chords” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଗ୍ରୁଭ୍‌କୁ ଚମକାଉଥିବା ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡରେ ଲୋ-ଫାଇ, ୱାନ୍-ଡ୍ରପ୍ ରେଗେ, ଫଙ୍କ୍, 6/8 ଧୀର ନୃତ୍ୟ ଓ ବେଡ୍‌ରୁମ୍ ପପ୍।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-late-checkout “Late Checkout” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-late-checkout “Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Late Checkout is lo-fi at 72 beats per minute: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7 on a loop. Strum down on one, then down-up on three with the up a little late, and swing the tune the same way.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-late-checkout “Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ଚେକ୍‌ଆଉଟ୍” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 72 ମାତ୍ରାର ଲୋ-ଫାଇ: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7, Am7 ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି। ଏକରେ ତଳକୁ, ତିନିରେ ତଳ-ଉପର, ଉପରଟି ଟିକେ ବିଳମ୍ବରେ। ଧୁନ୍‌କୁ ସେପରି ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G7 is G with string 1 at fret 1 instead of fret 3: fingers 3 and 2 on strings 6 and 5, finger 1 on string 1. It leans hard toward C.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-late-checkout “Late Checkout” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: G7 ହେଉଛି G, କିନ୍ତୁ ତାର 1 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ବଦଳରେ 1: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 2 ତାର 6 ଓ 5 ରେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 1 ରେ। C ଆଡ଼କୁ ଦୃଢ଼ ଟାଣେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Saltwater Sunday is reggae in A minor at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays a double chop on two and four, chk-a, chk-a, while the drums drop their weight on three.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଲୁଣିଆ ଜଳର ରବିବାର” A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 76 ମାତ୍ରାର ରେଗେ। ଗିଟାର୍ ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରିରେ ଦୁଇଥର ଚପ୍—ଚକ୍-ଆ, ଚକ୍-ଆ—ଡ୍ରମ୍ ତିନିରେ ଜୋର ଦିଏ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: D7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1, finger 3 on string 1, fret 2. Am7 to D7 and back is the sunny, minor-but-bright sound of the whole song.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: D7: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 1, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2। Am7 ରୁ D7 ଓ ଫେରିବା ପୂରା ଗୀତର ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ମାଇନର୍ ଧ୍ୱନି।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Pocket Change is funk at 100 beats per minute: a vamp on Em7, with A7 for the chorus. Your strumming hand never stops moving in eighths; only some strokes ring.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ପକେଟ୍‌ର ଖୁଚୁରା” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 100 ମାତ୍ରାର ଫଙ୍କ୍: Em7 ଭ୍ୟାମ୍ପ୍, ମୁଖଡ଼ାରେ A7। ଝଙ୍କାର ହାତ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ରେ କେବେ ଅଟକେ ନାହିଁ; କେବଳ କିଛି ଆଘାତ ଗୁଞ୍ଜେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Between the strokes that ring, lay your fretting fingers lightly across the strings and keep strumming: the muted strokes go chk. Press down only for the hits.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଗୁଞ୍ଜୁଥିବା ଆଘାତ ମଝିରେ ଧରା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର ଉପରେ ହାଲୁକା ରଖି ଝଙ୍କାର ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ: ମ୍ୟୁଟ୍ ଆଘାତ ଚକ୍ କରେ। କେବଳ ଗୁଞ୍ଜୁଥିବା ଆଘାତ ପାଇଁ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2. Twice.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ଓ 2 ର C ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ। ଦୁଇଥର।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Kitchen Slow Dance is a soul ballad in 6/8 at 108 counts a minute, two slow sways a bar. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 and G7 carry the verse; Fmaj7 and Em7 open up the chorus.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ରୋଷେଇଘରର ଧୀର ନୃତ୍ୟ” 6/8 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 108 ଗଣନାର ସୋଲ୍ ଗାଥାଗୀତ, ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ପିଛା ଦୁଇ ଧୀର ଦୋଳନ। Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7, G7 ପଦକୁ ଧରନ୍ତି; Fmaj7, Em7 ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଖୋଲନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Fmaj7 ଛୋଟ F, କିନ୍ତୁ ତାର 1 ଖୋଲା। Em7 ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2; ଅନ୍ୟ ସବୁ ତାର ଖୋଲା।

strings.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then open B.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, E, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପୁଣି ଖୋଲା E, ପରେ ଖୋଲା B।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Houseplants is soft bedroom pop at 88 beats per minute: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 and D. Seventh chords make it dreamy. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଘରର ଗଛ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 88 ମାତ୍ରାର ମୃଦୁ ବେଡ୍‌ରୁମ୍ ପପ୍: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7, D। ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନିଳ କରେ। ଏକରେ ଥରେ ଝଙ୍କାର, ପରେ “ଓ” ଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ମୃଦୁ ଉପରମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Gmaj7 is G with string 1 at fret 2 instead of fret 3. Bm7 puts three fingers at fret 2, on strings 5, 3 and 1, and lets strings 4 and 2 ring open.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Gmaj7 ହେଉଛି G, କିନ୍ତୁ ତାର 1 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ବଦଳରେ 2। Bm7 ତାର 5, 3, 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତିନି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖେ; ତାର 4 ଓ 2 ଖୋଲା ଗୁଞ୍ଜେ।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2 and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ଓ ଖୋଲା E, ଦୁଇଥର; ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D ଓ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · challenge orig-groove-set “Groove set” · title

strings.source: Which chord has a major seventh?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · challenge orig-groove-set “Groove set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Originals · Unit 5 · challenge orig-groove-set “Groove set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Cmaj7 adds B, a half step under C. G7 and Am7 add a flat seventh, a whole step under the root.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 5 · challenge orig-groove-set “Groove set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Cmaj7 ରେ C ଠାରୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ B ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ। G7 ଓ Am7 ମୂଳଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ସପ୍ତମ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 “Riffs, power chords and throwbacks” · title
strings.translation: ରିଫ୍, ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ ଓ ପୁରୁଣା ଶୈଳୀ

strings.source: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf and heartland rock, with power chords, a riff and sus chords.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 “Riffs, power chords and throwbacks” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ, ରିଫ୍ ଓ ସସ୍ କର୍ଡରେ ପଙ୍କ୍, ଗାରାଜ୍ ରକ୍, ଡୁ-ୱପ୍, ସର୍ଫ୍ ଓ ହାର୍ଟଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ରକ୍।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-static-on-channel-nine “Static on Channel Nine” · title
Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-static-on-channel-nine “Static on Channel Nine” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Static on Channel Nine is punk: four power chords, palm-muted eighths, 104 beats per minute. The verse mutters on low notes; the chorus is a gang shout, so dig in.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-static-on-channel-nine “Static on Channel Nine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ୍ ନଅରେ ଝିରିଝିରି” ପଙ୍କ୍: ଚାରି ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ, ପାପୁଲିରେ ମ୍ୟୁଟ୍ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 104 ମାତ୍ରା। ପଦ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରରେ ବୁଡ଼ବୁଡ଼ାଏ; ମୁଖଡ଼ା ସମୂହ ଡାକ, ତେଣୁ ଜୋର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp at fret 2 and D again.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-static-on-channel-nine “Static on Channel Nine” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ତଳକୁ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ ପୁଣି D।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · title
Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Basement Weather is garage rock at 92 beats per minute: a riff on the low strings, then power chords that punch back. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep the riff tight.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ତଳଘରର ପାଗ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 92 ମାତ୍ରାର ଗାରାଜ୍ ରକ୍: ନିମ୍ନ ତାରରେ ରିଫ୍, ପରେ ଜୋର ଉତ୍ତରରେ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ। ରିଫ୍ ଆଟସାଟ ରଖିବାକୁ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ପାପୁଲି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open string 5, C at fret 3 on the same string, then open string 4, and back.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 5, ସେହି ତାରର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର C, ପରେ ଖୋଲା ତାର 4, ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 6, open A, G again, then open low E.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଖୋଲା A, ପୁଣି G, ପରେ ଖୋଲା ନିମ୍ନ E।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Answer the riff with power chords on one, the and of two, and four: A5, G5, C5, D5. Between hits, ease your fretting fingers off so the chords stop short.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏକ, ଦୁଇର “ଓ” ଓ ଚାରିରେ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡରେ ରିଫ୍‌କୁ ଉତ୍ତର: A5, G5, C5, D5। ଆଘାତ ମଝିରେ ଧରା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଢିଲା କରି କର୍ଡ ଶୀଘ୍ର ରୋକନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Jukebox Moon is a slow dance in 1950s doo-wop style: C, A minor, F and G7, around and around, at 72 beats per minute. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-jukebox-moon “Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଜୁକ୍‌ବକ୍ସର ଚାନ୍ଦ” 1950 ଦଶକର ଡୁ-ୱପ୍ ଶୈଳୀର ଧୀର ନୃତ୍ୟ: C, A ମାଇନର୍, F, G7 ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 72 ମାତ୍ରା। ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରା ଝଙ୍କାର; ନୂଆ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଉପରମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ।

strings.source: Open G, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then D and C. Next, A at fret 2 on string 3 and back up.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-jukebox-moon “Jukebox Moon” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, ଖୋଲା E, ପରେ D ଓ C। ତାପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ପୁଣି ଉପରକୁ।

Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Boardwalk Comet is surf rock: a twangy melody over A minor, G, F and E, galloping along at 104 beats per minute. Picture reverb, salt spray and a wave about to break.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ସମୁଦ୍ରପଥର ଧୂମକେତୁ” ସର୍ଫ୍ ରକ୍: A ମାଇନର୍, G, F, E ଉପରେ ଟ୍ୱାଙ୍ଗ୍ ଧୁନ୍, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 104 ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୌଡ଼େ। ପ୍ରତିଧ୍ୱନି, ଲୁଣିଆ ଛିଟା ଓ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବାକୁ ଥିବା ଢେଉ ଭାବନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A on string 3, C at fret 1, open E and back down. Then open B, D at fret 3, and up to G on string 1.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର A, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, ଖୋଲା E ଓ ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ। ପରେ ଖୋଲା B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ତାର 1 ର G କୁ ଉପରକୁ।

strings.source: Over the E chord the tune plays G sharp, not G. Where is G sharp on string 3?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: E କର୍ଡ ଉପରେ ଧୁନ୍ G ନୁହେଁ, G ଶାର୍ପ ବଜାଏ। ତାର 3 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ କେଉଁଠି?

strings.source: G is open string 3, so G sharp is one fret up. It leans hard toward A, the home note.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G ଖୋଲା ତାର 3, ତେଣୁ G ଶାର୍ପ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ। ଏହା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର A ଆଡ଼କୁ ଦୃଢ଼ ଟାଣେ।

strings.source: Mile Marker Zero is open-road rock at 100 beats per minute: big ringing chords and a chorus for driving with the windows down. Listen for D lifting to Dsus4 and back.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଶୂନ୍ୟ ମାଇଲ୍ ଚିହ୍ନ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 100 ମାତ୍ରାର ଖୋଲା ରାସ୍ତା ରକ୍: ବଡ଼ ଗୁଞ୍ଜୁଥିବା କର୍ଡ ଓ ଝରକା ଖୋଲି ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଲାଇବାର ମୁଖଡ଼ା। D ରୁ Dsus4 କୁ ଉଠି ଫେରିବା ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Asus4 is A with your little finger added on string 2, fret 3. Like Dsus4, it leans forward and wants to fall back home.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Asus4 ହେଉଛି A ରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ କନିଷ୍ଠା ଯୋଡ଼ିବା। Dsus4 ପରି ଏହା ଆଗକୁ ଟାଣି ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରିବାକୁ ଚାହେଁ।

strings.source: F sharp at fret 2 and G at fret 3 on string 1, then down to D at fret 3 on string 2.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D କୁ ତଳକୁ।

strings.source: Last Bell is punk-pop at 152 beats per minute: C5, G5, A5 and F5, the four-chord loop as power chords. All downstrokes in steady eighths, palm resting on the strings by the bridge.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-last-bell “Last Bell” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଶେଷ ଘଣ୍ଟି” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 152 ମାତ୍ରାର ପଙ୍କ୍-ପପ୍: C5, G5, A5, F5—ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡରେ ଚାରି କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ। ସ୍ଥିର ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ରେ ସବୁ ତଳମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ, ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖ ତାରରେ ପାପୁଲି।

strings.source: F5 is the G5 shape two frets lower: finger 1 on string 6, fret 1, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 3.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-last-bell “Last Bell” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: F5 ହେଉଛି G5 ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 6, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ତାର 5 ଓ 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, open E and D.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-last-bell “Last Bell” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ଓ ଖୋଲା E, ଦୁଇଥର। ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D ଦୁଇଥର, ଖୋଲା E ଓ D।

Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Copper Wire is built on a riff: a short, catchy line on the low strings that the whole band locks onto. It runs at 112 beats per minute in E, with power chords in the chorus.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ତମ୍ବା ତାର” ରିଫ୍ ଉପରେ ଗଢ଼ା: ନିମ୍ନ ତାରର ଛୋଟ, ମନେରହୁଥିବା ଧୁନ୍ ସହ ପୂରା ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ମିଶେ। E ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 112 ମାତ୍ରା; ମୁଖଡ଼ାରେ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ।

strings.source: Open string 6 twice, G at fret 3, open E, open string 5, G again, then open E.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 6 ଦୁଇଥର, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଖୋଲା E, ଖୋଲା ତାର 5, ପୁଣି G, ପରେ ଖୋଲା E।

strings.source: The second bar turns around: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G at fret 3 on string 6, open A.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଫେରେ: ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର B, ଖୋଲା A, ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଖୋଲା A।

Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-cold-lake “Cold Lake” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Cold Lake is dark alternative rock in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E5, C5, G5 and D5. Keep the verse quiet and low so the chorus can open up.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-cold-lake “Cold Lake” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଶୀତଳ ହ୍ରଦ” 6/8 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 120 ଗଣନାର ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଅଲ୍ଟର୍ନେଟିଭ୍ ରକ୍: E5, C5, G5, D5। ପଦ ମୃଦୁ ଓ ନିମ୍ନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଖୋଲିପାରେ।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Let each ring.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-cold-lake “Cold Lake” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଖୋଲା E, ପୁଣି G, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D। ପ୍ରତିଟି ଗୁଞ୍ଜୁ।

strings.source: Parking Lot Cathedral is indie rock at 128 beats per minute: D5, A5, B5 and G5, the four-chord loop again, now as power chords. Big, open, driving eighths.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-parking-lot-cathedral “Parking Lot Cathedral” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ପାର୍କିଂ ପଡ଼ିଆର ଗିର୍ଜା” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 128 ମାତ୍ରାର ଇଣ୍ଡି ରକ୍: D5, A5, B5, G5—ପୁଣି ଚାରି କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ, ଏବେ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡରେ। ବଡ଼, ଖୋଲା, ଆଗକୁ ନେଉଥିବା ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍।

strings.source: B5 is the A5 shape moved up two frets: finger 1 on string 5, fret 2, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 3 at fret 4.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-parking-lot-cathedral “Parking Lot Cathedral” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: B5 ହେଉଛି A5 ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2; ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ତାର 4 ଓ 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, open E.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-parking-lot-cathedral “Parking Lot Cathedral” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D ଦୁଇଥର, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଖୋଲା E।

strings.source: Halogen is desert rock in D minor at 104 beats per minute: a hypnotic riff on strings 4 and 5, a low, steady voice, then F5, C5 and G5 opening up the chorus.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-halogen “Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ହାଲୋଜେନ୍” D ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 104 ମାତ୍ରାର ଡେଜର୍ଟ ରକ୍: ତାର 4 ଓ 5 ରେ ମୋହକ ରିଫ୍, ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ଥିର କଣ୍ଠ, ପରେ F5, C5, G5 ରେ ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଖୋଲେ।

strings.source: Open string 4 twice, F at fret 3, open D, open string 3, F again, then open D.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-halogen “Halogen” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 4 ଦୁଇଥର, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର F, ଖୋଲା D, ଖୋଲା ତାର 3, ପୁଣି F, ପରେ ଖୋଲା D।

strings.source: A power chord is a root and its fifth, with no third, so it is neither major nor minor.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 7 · challenge orig-power-chord-set “Power-chord set” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡରେ ମୂଳ ଓ ତାହାର ପଞ୍ଚମ ଥାଏ, ତୃତୀୟ ନଥାଏ; ତେଣୁ ମେଜର୍ ବା ମାଇନର୍ କୌଣସିଟି ନୁହେଁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 “Story songs and slow burners” · title
strings.translation: କାହାଣୀ ଗୀତ ଓ ଧୀରେ ଗଢ଼ୁଥିବା ସୁର

strings.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in A minor.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 “Story songs and slow burners” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଗାଥାଗୀତ, 6/8 ସମୁଦ୍ର କାହାଣୀ, ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ସ ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍, ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଲୋକଝଙ୍କାର ଓ A ମାଇନର୍‌ର ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଗୀତ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Letters in a Shoebox tells a story in C at 72 beats per minute. The verse walks C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F and G, a chain of chords that has carried ballads for centuries.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଜୋତା ବାକ୍ସରେ ଚିଠି” C ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 72 ମାତ୍ରାରେ କାହାଣୀ କୁହେ। ପଦ C, G, A ମାଇନର୍, E ମାଇନର୍, F, C, F, G ରେ ଚାଲେ—ଶତାବ୍ଦୀ ଧରି ଗାଥାଗୀତକୁ ଧରିଥିବା କର୍ଡ ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳ।

strings.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, G at fret 3, then D again.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର F, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ପୁଣି D।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Keeper's Daughter is a story song in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E minor, D, C and B7. Three verses tell the story, and the chorus answers each one.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ରକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ ଝିଅ” 6/8 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 120 ଗଣନାର କାହାଣୀ ଗୀତ: E ମାଇନର୍, D, C, B7। ତିନି ପଦ କାହାଣୀ କୁହେ, ମୁଖଡ଼ା ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ।

strings.source: Open B, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, then C at fret 1 on string 2, E and C.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B, ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଖୋଲା E, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, E ଓ C।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Snow Globe Town is a quick waltz in G at 120 beats per minute, like a music box: one strong beat, two light ones. G, D, E minor and C, with B7 in the bridge.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ତୁଷାର କାଚଗୋଲାର ସହର” G ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 120 ମାତ୍ରାର ଦ୍ରୁତ ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍, ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ସ ପରି: ଗୋଟିଏ ଜୋର, ଦୁଇ ହାଲୁକା ମାତ୍ରା। G, D, E ମାଇନର୍, C; ସଂଯୋଗ ଅଂଶରେ B7।

strings.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, D, C, then open B: a slow fall, like snow.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, D, C, ପରେ ଖୋଲା B: ତୁଷାର ପରି ଧୀରେ ଖସିବା।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Thistle and Thread is a bright folk strummer in A at 116 beats per minute. Asus4 and Asus2 decorate the A chord: change one finger and the chord sparkles.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “କଣ୍ଟାଫୁଲ ଓ ସୂତା” A ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 116 ମାତ୍ରାର ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଲୋକଝଙ୍କାର। Asus4 ଓ Asus2 A କର୍ଡକୁ ସଜାନ୍ତି: ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବଦଳାଇଲେ କର୍ଡ ଚମକେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: From A, put finger 4 on string 2, fret 3 for Asus4. Lift the finger off string 2 and let it ring open for Asus2. Both fall back to A.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ରୁ Asus4 ପାଇଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 କୁ ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। Asus2 ପାଇଁ ତାର 2 ର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାଇ ଖୋଲା ଗୁଞ୍ଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଉଭୟ A କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତି।

strings.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, E twice, C sharp, open B, then A.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, E ଦୁଇଥର, C ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା B, ପରେ A।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Ghost Light is a slow, dark ballad in A minor at 70 beats per minute. The verse sinks from A minor through F and C to E major, which pulls hard back to A minor.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଭୂତ ଆଲୋକ” A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 70 ମାତ୍ରାର ଧୀର, ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଗାଥାଗୀତ। ପଦ A ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ F ଓ C ଦେଇ E ମେଜର୍‌କୁ ଖସେ, ଯାହା A ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ଦୃଢ଼ ଟାଣେ।

strings.source: E major in A minor brings one new note. Which?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ E ମେଜର୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ଆଣେ। କେଉଁଟି?

strings.source: A minor's own notes have G. E major needs G sharp, a half step under A, so it leans hard toward home.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: A ମାଇନର୍‌ର ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରରେ G ଅଛି। E ମେଜର୍‌କୁ G ଶାର୍ପ ଦରକାର, A ଠାରୁ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ତଳେ, ତେଣୁ ମୂଳକୁ ଦୃଢ଼ ଟାଣେ।

strings.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Hold each long.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର F, ଖୋଲା E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D। ପ୍ରତିଟି ଲମ୍ବା ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · title

strings.source: How many beats fill a bar of 3/4?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: 3/4 counts one, two, three, with the weight on one: the waltz.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: 3/4 ରେ ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି ଗଣାଯାଏ, ଏକରେ ଜୋର: ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 “Barres and big finishes” · title

strings.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change, with F and B minor barres.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 “Barres and big finishes” · unit summary
strings.translation: F ଓ B ମାଇନର୍ ବାରେରେ ଇଣ୍ଡି ପପ୍, ପାୱାର୍ ଗାଥାଗୀତ, ହାଇଲାଇଫ୍, ନିଓ-ସୋଲ୍ ଓ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳୁଥିବା ସମବେତ ଗୀତ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · title

strings.source: Late Bus Home is indie pop for the ride back through a sleeping city: D, B minor, G and A at 100 beats per minute. Each line starts just after the beat, so wait a breath.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଘରକୁ ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ବସ୍” ଶୋଇଥିବା ସହର ଦେଇ ଫେରିବାର ଇଣ୍ଡି ପପ୍: ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 100 ମାତ୍ରାରେ D, B ମାଇନର୍, G, A। ପ୍ରତି ଧାଡ଼ି ମାତ୍ରାର ଟିକେ ପରେ, କ୍ଷଣେ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Play the full B minor barre at fret 2 if you can. If not, use the top four strings: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପାରିଲେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ପୂରା B ମାଇନର୍ ବାରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ନହେଲେ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚାରି ତାର: ତାର 4 ଓ 3 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ତାର 2 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତାର 1 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2।

strings.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, D at fret 3 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପରେ ଖୋଲା E ଓ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Glass Satellites is a slow, soaring ballad at 76 beats per minute: A minor, F, C and G. Strum big on one and let it ring, then build on three and four.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “କାଚର ଉପଗ୍ରହ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 76 ମାତ୍ରାର ଧୀର, ଉଡ଼ନ୍ତା ଗାଥାଗୀତ: A ମାଇନର୍, F, C, G। ଏକରେ ବଡ଼ ଝଙ୍କାର ଗୁଞ୍ଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତିନି ଓ ଚାରିରେ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1 and build an E shape in front of it. Not there yet? Use the mini F on the top four strings for now.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ଛଅଟିଯାକ ତାର ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ସମତଳ ରଖି ଆଗରେ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ। ଏଯାଏଁ ହେଉନି? ଏବେ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚାରି ତାରର ଛୋଟ F ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, open E twice, D at fret 3, C again, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର C, ଖୋଲା E ଦୁଇଥର, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପୁଣି C, ପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Market Day borrows from highlife, the bright guitar pop of Ghana and Nigeria: G, B minor, C and D at 104 beats per minute. The hook bounces off the beat, so keep your body moving.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ହାଟ ଦିନ” ଘାନା ଓ ନାଇଜେରିଆର ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଗିଟାର୍ ପପ୍ ହାଇଲାଇଫ୍‌ରୁ ପ୍ରେରିତ: ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 104 ମାତ୍ରାରେ G, B ମାଇନର୍, C, D। ଆକର୍ଷକ ଧୁନ୍ ମାତ୍ରାଠାରୁ ହଟି ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ; ଦେହ ଚଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, D again, open E, then back to D and B.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଖୋଲା B, ପୁଣି D, ଖୋଲା E, ପରେ D ଓ B କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Bar two keeps bar one's rhythm but swaps one note. Why?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ପ୍ରଥମର ଛନ୍ଦ ରଖି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳାଏ। କାହିଁକି?

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Bar two moves E up to F sharp, a note of B minor. Same rhythm, new chord, new note.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ E କୁ B ମାଇନର୍‌ର ସ୍ୱର F ଶାର୍ପକୁ ଉଠାଏ। ସେହି ଛନ୍ଦ, ନୂଆ କର୍ଡ, ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Velvet Hour is neo-soul at 74 beats per minute: four lush seventh chords stepping down, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 and Cmaj7. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ମଖମଲି ବେଳା” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 74 ମାତ୍ରାର ନିଓ-ସୋଲ୍: Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7, Cmaj7 ଚାରି ସମୃଦ୍ଧ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ। ଏକରେ ଥରେ ଝଙ୍କାର, ପରେ “ଓ” ରେ ମୃଦୁ ଉପରମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open. Dm7 and Cmaj7 you know from Rain on the Skylight.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Fmaj7 ଛୋଟ F, ତାର 1 ଖୋଲା। Em7 ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଅନ୍ୟ ସବୁ ଖୋଲା। “ଛାତ ଝରକାରେ ବର୍ଷା”ରୁ Dm7 ଓ Cmaj7 ଜାଣିଛନ୍ତି।

strings.source: The chords walk down F, E, D. Where does the loop land?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କର୍ଡ F, E, D ରେ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ। କ୍ରମ କେଉଁଠି ପହଞ୍ଚେ?

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Each chord sits one step below the last, and the walk ends on C, the home chord.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ପୂର୍ବ କର୍ଡର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ତଳେ; ଯାତ୍ରା ମୂଳ କର୍ଡ C ରେ ଶେଷ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · title

strings.source: An anthem with a key change
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Rooftop Choir is a stadium-sized anthem at 92 beats per minute. You play the chorus in C, then one bar of A lifts everything a whole step, and the chorus returns in D.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଛାତ ଉପରର ଗାୟକଦଳ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 92 ମାତ୍ରାର ଷ୍ଟାଡିୟମ୍ ମାପର ଗୀତ। C ରେ ମୁଖଡ଼ା, ପରେ A ର ଏକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ସବୁକୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉଠାଏ, ମୁଖଡ଼ା D ରେ ଫେରେ।

strings.source: A key change up a whole step moves every note up…
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ ବଦଳିଲେ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଉଠେ…

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A whole step is two half steps, and each fret is a half step. C becomes D, and G becomes A.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ପ୍ରତି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। C ହୁଏ D, G ହୁଏ A।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 4 (along) · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 6 (along) · title
Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · title

strings.source: Which chord lifts Rooftop Choir from C into D?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ “ଛାତ ଉପରର ଗାୟକଦଳ”କୁ C ରୁ D କୁ ଉଠାଏ?

strings.source: A leads home to D. Landing on it turns the whole song toward the new key.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: A ମୂଳ D କୁ ନିଏ। ସେଥିରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲେ ପୂରା ଗୀତ ନୂଆ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଆଡ଼କୁ ମୁହାଁଏ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 “Barre chords and syncopation” · title

strings.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, with five new barre chords.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 “Barre chords and syncopation” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପାଞ୍ଚ ନୂଆ ବାରେ କର୍ଡରେ ସିନ୍ଥ୍-ପପ୍, ଗସ୍ପେଲ୍-ପପ୍, ଗମ୍ଭୀର ପପ୍, ଇଣ୍ଡି ପପ୍ ଓ 6/8 ସମାପ୍ତି।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Slow Motion Strobe is synth-pop at 118 beats per minute: F sharp minor, D, A and E. The strum is pushed: two of its hits land on the and, just before the beat.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଧୀର ଗତିର ଝଲକ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 118 ମାତ୍ରାର ସିନ୍ଥ୍-ପପ୍: F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, D, A, E। ଝଙ୍କାର ଆଗୁଆ: ଦୁଇ ଆଘାତ ମାତ୍ରାର ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବ “ଓ” ରେ ପଡ଼େ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Barre finger 1 across all six strings at fret 2, then put fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 4: the E minor shape, moved up two frets.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଛଅଟିଯାକ ତାର ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ବାରେ; ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ତାର 5 ଓ 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ: E ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Bright Side of the Block is a gospel-pop sing-along in D at 100 beats per minute: D, F sharp minor, G and A. Clap on two and four and sing the chorus like the whole street joins in.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ପଡ଼ାର ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱ” D ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 100 ମାତ୍ରାର ସମବେତ ଗସ୍ପେଲ୍-ପପ୍: D, F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, G, A। ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରିରେ ତାଳି, ପୂରା ରାସ୍ତା ସାଥିରେ ଗାଉଛି ପରି ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 2, then build an A minor shape two frets up with fingers 2, 3 and 4. Leave string 6 silent.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 5 ରୁ 1 ଯାଏଁ ବାରେ; ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, 3, 4 ରେ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ। ତାର 6 ନୀରବ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, E, G, then E.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, E, G, ପରେ E।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Over You Soon is dark pop in B minor at 84 beats per minute: B minor, G, D and A. Strum once on one, then soft ups on the ands, and keep it hushed.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ଶୀଘ୍ର ତୁମକୁ ଭୁଲିଯିବି” B ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 84 ମାତ୍ରାର ଗମ୍ଭୀର ପପ୍: B ମାଇନର୍, G, D, A। ଏକରେ ଥରେ ଝଙ୍କାର, ପରେ “ଓ” ରେ ମୃଦୁ ଉପରମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ; ନରମ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp, open E and D.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର F ଶାର୍ପ, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ପରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E ଓ D।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ସ୍ପ୍ରେ ରଙ୍ଗର ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟୋଦୟ” ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 124 ମାତ୍ରାର ଇଣ୍ଡି ପପ୍: E, B, C ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, A—ଦୁଇ ବାରେ ସହ ଚାରି କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ। ସ୍ଥିର ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ରେ ଆଗେଇ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: B is an A shape barred at fret 2: finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, three fingers at fret 4. C sharp minor is an A minor shape barred at fret 4.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: B ହେଉଛି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A ବାରେ ବିନ୍ୟାସ: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 5 ରୁ 1 ଉପରେ, ତିନି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ। C ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ A ମାଇନର୍ ବାରେ।

strings.source: G sharp at fret 4 on string 1, F sharp, open E, open B, then D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, C sharp, D sharp.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର G ଶାର୍ପ, F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E, ଖୋଲା B, ପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ର D ଶାର୍ପ, C ଶାର୍ପ, D ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Constellation Prize closes the course: an anthem in 6/8 at 126 counts a minute, in F. F and B flat are both barres, with C and D minor between them.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: “ନକ୍ଷତ୍ରମଣ୍ଡଳର ପୁରସ୍କାର” ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଶେଷ କରେ: F ରେ 6/8 ର ସମବେତ ଗୀତ, ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍ 126 ଗଣନା। F ଓ B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ଉଭୟ ବାରେ, ମଝିରେ C ଓ D ମାଇନର୍।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 1, then put fingers 2, 3 and 4 on strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 3. Leave string 6 silent.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 5 ରୁ 1 ଯାଏଁ ବାରେ; ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, 3, 4 ତାର 4, 3, 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। ତାର 6 ନୀରବ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, F at fret 1 on string 1 twice, G at fret 3, F twice, open E, then F.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର F ଦୁଇଥର, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, F ଦୁଇଥର, ଖୋଲା E, ପରେ F।

strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · title

strings.source: F sharp minor is which shape, barred at fret 2?
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ବାରେ କରି ହୁଏ?

strings.source: Barre at fret 2 and the E minor shape sits in front of your first finger: F sharp minor.
strings.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ବାରେ କଲେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଆଗରେ E ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ରହେ: F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍।

Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This tune began as a spiritual. In the 1890s railroad crews in the Midwest gave it new words, and Carl Sandburg printed it in 1927. It climbs from low B up to D on string 2.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁର ଆଧ୍ୟାତ୍ମିକ ଗୀତରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। 1890 ଦଶକରେ ମଧ୍ୟପଶ୍ଚିମର ରେଳ କର୍ମୀ ନୂଆ ଗୀତିକା ଦେଲେ, Carl Sandburg 1927 ରେ ଛାପିଲେ। ନିମ୍ନ B ରୁ ତାର 2 ର D କୁ ଚଢ଼େ।

strings.source: The first line: open D, E, four open Gs, a dip to B on string 5, then home to G.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଧାଡ଼ି: ଖୋଲା D, E, ଚାରିଥର ଖୋଲା G, ତାର 5 ର B କୁ ତଳେ, ପୁଣି ମୂଳ G।

strings.source: The words She'll be come before beat one. What are they?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: She'll be ଶବ୍ଦ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଆସେ। ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ କ’ଣ?

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they run up to the word com-.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଜୋର ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ନେଉଥିବା କିଛି ସ୍ୱର ଆରମ୍ଭର ଅପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ। ଏଠାରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ com- ଶବ୍ଦ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଯାଏ।

strings.source: Three chords: G, C and D7
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 5 (explain) · title
strings.translation: ତିନି କର୍ଡ: G, C ଓ D7

strings.source: Most of the song sits on G. D7 comes at the end of the second line, and C colors the fourth. Change on the word that starts the bar.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଗୀତ G ରେ ରହେ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଧାଡ଼ି ଶେଷରେ D7, ଚତୁର୍ଥରେ C ରଙ୍ଗ ଆଣେ। ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରୁଥିବା ଶବ୍ଦରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This African American spiritual is older than the Civil War and was first printed in 1918. Its line ain't gonna study war no more became a song of the peace movement.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଆଫ୍ରିକୀୟ-ଆମେରିକୀୟ ଆଧ୍ୟାତ୍ମିକ ଗୀତ ଗୃହଯୁଦ୍ଧରୁ ପୁରୁଣା, ପ୍ରଥମେ 1918 ରେ ଛପା। ଏହାର ain't gonna study war no more ଧାଡ଼ି ଶାନ୍ତି ଆନ୍ଦୋଳନର ଗୀତ ହେଲା।

strings.source: Lay down my burden: open B, a drop to open D, then up through E, G and A to B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Lay down my burden: ଖୋଲା B, ଖୋଲା D କୁ ତଳେ, ପରେ E, G, A ଦେଇ B କୁ ଉପରେ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: A ଶାର୍ପ A ଓ B ମଝିରେ, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। ଏହା ଖୋଲା B କୁ ଉଠେ, ଗସ୍ପେଲ୍‌ର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ରଙ୍ଗର ଉତ୍ଥାନ।

strings.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp at fret 3, B, then A and G.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର A ଶାର୍ପ, B, ପରେ A ଓ G।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · title

strings.source: The high road and the low road
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This Scottish song was first printed in 1841. The low road is often heard as the road a soldier's spirit takes home, faster than the living on the high road.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ସ୍କଟିଶ୍ ଗୀତ ପ୍ରଥମେ 1841 ରେ ଛପା। ନିମ୍ନ ପଥକୁ ପ୍ରାୟ ସୈନିକଙ୍କ ଆତ୍ମା ଘରକୁ ଫେରିବା ପଥ ଭାବେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ, ଉଚ୍ଚ ପଥର ଜୀବିତଙ୍କଠାରୁ ଶୀଘ୍ର।

strings.source: By yon bonnie banks: open D, then G, G, A, B and back down to G.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: By yon bonnie banks: ଖୋଲା D, ପରେ G, G, A, B, ପୁଣି G କୁ ତଳକୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: This tune moves in quarter notes and pairs of eighths. Count one, two-and, three, four-and, and the lilt comes by itself.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁରରେ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ଯୋଡ଼ା ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଛି। ଏକ, ଦୁଇ-ଓ, ତିନି, ଚାରି-ଓ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ; ଛନ୍ଦର ଦୋଳନ ଆପେ ଆସିବ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This song was printed in 1876 and credited in 1884 to James Yorkston of Edinburgh. It is now Dublin's unofficial anthem, and Molly and her cart stand as a statue in the city.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଗୀତ 1876 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା; 1884 ରେ ଏଡିନବର୍ଗର James Yorkston ଙ୍କୁ ରଚୟିତା ଭାବେ ଶ୍ରେୟ ଦିଆଗଲା। ଏବେ ଏହା ଡବ୍ଲିନ୍‌ର ପରିଚୟ ବହନ କରୁଥିବା ଅନୌପଚାରିକ ଗୀତ। ସହରରେ ମଲି ଓ ତାଙ୍କ ଠେଲାଗାଡ଼ିର ପ୍ରତିମୂର୍ତ୍ତି ଅଛି।

strings.source: In Dublin's fair city: open D, four open Gs, up to open B and back to G.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: In Dublin's fair city: ଖୋଲା D, ଚାରିଥର ଖୋଲା G, ଉପରକୁ ଖୋଲା B ଓ ପୁଣି G।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Count one, two, three and lean on one. In many bars the middle note is long: one, two, and a quick note just before the next one.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି ଗଣି ଏକ ଉପରେ ଜୋର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଅନେକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ମଝି ସ୍ୱର ଲମ୍ବା: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ଓ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଏକର ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଏକ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Cecil Sharp collected and published this ballad in 1906, from verses that go back to the 1700s. Play it slowly and let every long note ring.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Cecil Sharp 1906 ରେ ଏହି ଗାଥାଗୀତ ସଂଗ୍ରହ ଓ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଥିଲେ; ଏହାର ପଦଗୁଡ଼ିକ 1700 ମସିହାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିବା ଶତାବ୍ଦୀର। ଧୀରେ ବଜାଇ ପ୍ରତି ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: up from open D to B, then gently back down to D.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: ଖୋଲା D ଠାରୁ B କୁ ଉଠି, ମୃଦୁ ଭାବେ ପୁଣି D କୁ ଓହ୍ଲାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Wide rings for two beats and two for two and a half. Keep counting while the string rings, so the next word lands on time.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Wide ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା ଓ two ଅଢ଼େଇ ମାତ୍ରା ଧରି ବାଜେ। ତାର ବାଜୁଥିବା ବେଳେ ଗଣୁଥାନ୍ତୁ, ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଶବ୍ଦ ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ଆସେ।

strings.source: Which word holds over two notes in the first verse?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ପଦରେ କେଉଁ ଶବ୍ଦ ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର ଉପରେ ଗାଯାଏ?

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: Fly starts on C and slides down to a long A. Singers call one syllable over several notes a melisma.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Fly C ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇ ଲମ୍ବା A କୁ ଖସେ। ଗୋଟିଏ ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ ଖଣ୍ଡକୁ ଅନେକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଗାଇବାକୁ ଗାୟକମାନେ ମେଲିସ୍ମା କୁହନ୍ତି।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: No new notes: the five songs from this unit, one after another, a little faster than before. Name each one from its first notes.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ନାହିଁ: ଏହି ଏକକର ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ଗୀତ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ, ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ। ଆରମ୍ଭ ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣି ପ୍ରତିଟିର ନାମ କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 “Ballads and carols” · title

strings.source: A Welsh lullaby, a Highland boat song and three carols, in German, Latin and English.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 “Ballads and carols” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଏକ ୱେଲ୍‌ଶ ନାନାବାୟା ଗୀତ, ହାଇଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡର ନୌକାଗୀତ ଓ ଜର୍ମାନ, ଲାଟିନ୍, ଇଂରାଜୀରେ ତିନୋଟି କ୍ୟାରଲ୍।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The tune Ar Hyd y Nos was printed in Wales in 1784, and Harold Boulton wrote these English words in 1884. One phrase comes three times, with a higher one in the middle.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Ar Hyd y Nos ସୁରଟି ୱେଲ୍ସରେ 1784 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା; Harold Boulton 1884 ରେ ଏହି ଇଂରାଜୀ କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ତିନିଥର ଆସେ, ମଝିରେ ଅଧିକ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଏକ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ।

strings.source: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: open G, down to F sharp and E, then G, A, G, F sharp and D.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: ଖୋଲା G, ତଳକୁ F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ E, ତାପରେ G, A, G, F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ D।

strings.source: Which phrase of the verse climbs highest?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପଦର କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ସବୁଠୁ ଉଚ୍ଚକୁ ଯାଏ?

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: The third phrase, soft the drowsy hours, rises to C, D and E. The other three phrases share one tune.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ soft the drowsy hours C, D ଓ E କୁ ଉଠେ। ଅନ୍ୟ ତିନୋଟି ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡର ସୁର ସମାନ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Harold Boulton set these words in 1884 to a Highland rowing tune collected by Anne MacLeod. They tell of Bonnie Prince Charlie escaping to the Isle of Skye in 1746.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Anne MacLeod ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରିଥିବା ହାଇଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡର ଆହୁଲା ଚାଳନା ସୁରରେ Harold Boulton 1884 ରେ ଏହି କଥା ବସାଇଥିଲେ। ଏଥିରେ 1746 ରେ Bonnie Prince Charlie ସ୍କାଇ ଦ୍ୱୀପକୁ ପଳାଇବା କଥା ଅଛି।

strings.source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଗୀତ ଛଅ-ଆଠ ଛନ୍ଦରେ ଦୋଳେ: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରା, ପ୍ରତିଟିର ତିନି ଭାଗ। ଏକ-ଦୁଇ-ତିନି, ଚାରି-ପାଞ୍ଚ-ଛଅ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ଆହୁଲା ଟାଣି ପୁଣି ଫେରାଇବା ପରି।

strings.source: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: open D, E, D, three open Gs, then A, B, A and up to D.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: ଖୋଲା D, E, D, ତିନିଥର ଖୋଲା G, ତାପରେ A, B, A ଓ ଉପରକୁ D।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Ernst Anschütz wrote these words in Leipzig in 1824, to a much older folk tune. You'll sing them in German, the language they were written in.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Ernst Anschütz 1824 ରେ ଲାଇପ୍‌ଜିଗ୍‌ରେ ଅଧିକ ପୁରୁଣା ଏକ ଲୋକସୁର ପାଇଁ ଏହି କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ଆପଣ ଏହାକୁ ମୂଳ ରଚନାର ଭାଷା ଜର୍ମାନରେ ଗାଇବେ।

strings.source: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: open D, three open Gs, then A at fret 2 and three open Bs.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: ଖୋଲା D, ତିନିଥର ଖୋଲା G, ତାପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A ଓ ତିନିଥର ଖୋଲା B।

strings.source: Tan-nen is a dotted note and a very short one, then baum rings on. Say the words as you tap, and the rhythm follows.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Tan-nen ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅତି ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱର; ତାପରେ baum ଲମ୍ବା ବାଜେ। ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କଲାବେଳେ କଥା କୁହନ୍ତୁ, ଛନ୍ଦ ଆପେ ମିଳିଯିବ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: The Latin hymn Adeste Fideles was printed with this tune in 1751, and Frederick Oakeley's English words followed in 1841. You'll sing a verse in each language.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଲାଟିନ୍ ସ୍ତୋତ୍ର Adeste Fideles ଏହି ସୁର ସହ 1751 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା; Frederick Oakeley ଙ୍କ ଇଂରାଜୀ କଥା 1841 ରେ ଆସିଲା। ଆପଣ ପ୍ରତି ଭାଷାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ପଦ ଗାଇବେ।

strings.source: O come, all ye faithful: open G twice, down to open D, back to G, A, and D again.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: O come, all ye faithful: ଖୋଲା G ଦୁଇଥର, ତଳକୁ ଖୋଲା D, ପୁଣି G, A, ଓ ଆଉଥରେ D।

strings.source: How many times does the refrain sing O come, let us adore him?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମୁଖଡ଼ାରେ O come, let us adore him କେତେଥର ଗାଯାଏ?

strings.source: Three times, each a little higher, before Christ the Lord brings the tune home.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତିନିଥର, ପ୍ରତିଥର ଟିକେ ଉଚ୍ଚରେ; ତାପରେ Christ the Lord ସୁରକୁ ମୂଳ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଫେରାଏ।

strings.source: Latin hymn (1751); English words Frederick Oakeley (1841)
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
strings.translation: ଲାଟିନ୍ ସ୍ତୋତ୍ର (1751); ଇଂରାଜୀ କଥା Frederick Oakeley (1841)

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This carol was first printed in 1823, in a collection of old Christmas carols. Its tune walks up the scale and back, which is why it is so easy to remember.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି କ୍ୟାରଲ୍ ପ୍ରଥମେ 1823 ରେ ପୁରୁଣା କ୍ରିସ୍‌ମାସ୍ କ୍ୟାରଲ୍ ସଂଗ୍ରହରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଏହାର ସୁର ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଉପରକୁ ଓ ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଏତେ ସହଜରେ ମନେ ରହେ।

strings.source: Up the D scale: F sharp and E, open D, then E, F sharp, open G, A, open B, C sharp at fret 2 and D.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଉପରକୁ: F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ E, ଖୋଲା D, ତାପରେ E, F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା G, A, ଖୋଲା B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ C ଶାର୍ପ ଓ D।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: The tune starts with two quick notes, F sharp and E, before beat one. Then a long D and a run of eighths climb to A.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୁରଟି ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଦୁଇଟି ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱର F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ E ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ତାପରେ ଲମ୍ବା D ଓ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ର କ୍ରମ A କୁ ଉଠେ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 6 (along) · title
