Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Five songs from this unit: two ballads and three carols. No new notes, just one after another, each a little faster than before.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଏକକର ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ଗୀତ: ଦୁଇ ଗାଥାଗୀତ ଓ ତିନି କ୍ୟାରଲ୍। ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱର ନାହିଁ; ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ, ପ୍ରତିଟି ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ।

strings.source: Which of these counts in six?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଛଅ ଗଣନାରେ ଚାଲେ?

strings.source: The Skye Boat Song rocks in six-eight. O Christmas Tree is in three, and All Through the Night in four.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦ ସ୍କାଇ ବୋଟ୍ ସଙ୍ଗ୍ ଛଅ-ଆଠ ଛନ୍ଦରେ ଦୋଳେ। ଓ କ୍ରିସ୍‌ମାସ୍ ଟ୍ରି ତିନି ଓ ଅଲ୍ ଥ୍ରୁ ଦ ନାଇଟ୍ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଚାଲେ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 “Pipes, waltzes and dances” · title

strings.source: A pipe march, a Russian folk dance, the Blue Danube and the can-can.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 “Pipes, waltzes and dances” · unit summary
strings.translation: ବ୍ୟାଗ୍‌ପାଇପ୍ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ, ରୁଷୀୟ ଲୋକନୃତ୍ୟ, ବ୍ଲୁ ଡାନ୍ୟୁବ୍ ଓ କ୍ୟାନ୍-କ୍ୟାନ୍।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: This Scottish march was in print by 1878, and pipe bands play it all over the world. Pipers play it without words, and so will you.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ସ୍କଟିଶ୍ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ 1878 ସୁଦ୍ଧା ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇସାରିଥିଲା; ସାରା ବିଶ୍ୱର ପାଇପ୍ ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଏହା ବଜାନ୍ତି। ବ୍ୟାଗ୍‌ପାଇପ୍ ବାଦକମାନେ କଥା ବିନା ବଜାନ୍ତି; ଆପଣ ମଧ୍ୟ ସେପରି କରିବେ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: A dotted note and a quick one give a march its snap: long, then short. In the first bar, the second D is long and E slips in just before beat two.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱର ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚକୁ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ଛନ୍ଦ ଦିଏ: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଲମ୍ବା, ପରେ ଛୋଟ। ପ୍ରଥମ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ D ଲମ୍ବା; ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାର ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ E ଆସେ।

strings.source: Up the D chord: open D twice, E, F sharp at fret 4, D, F sharp, A, then D on string 2.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: D କର୍ଡରେ ଉପରକୁ: ଖୋଲା D ଦୁଇଥର, E, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, D, F ଶାର୍ପ, A, ତାପରେ ତାର 2 ରେ D।

strings.source: Nikolay Nekrasov's poem about traveling peddlers was printed in 1861, and this folk tune was published with it in 1898. A video game made it famous worldwide almost a century later.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଭ୍ରମଣକାରୀ ଫେରିବାଲାଙ୍କ ବିଷୟରେ Nikolay Nekrasov ଙ୍କ କବିତା 1861 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା; 1898 ରେ ତାହା ସହ ଏହି ଲୋକସୁର ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଇଲା। ପ୍ରାୟ ଏକ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀ ପରେ ଏକ ଭିଡିଓ ଗେମ୍ ଏହାକୁ ବିଶ୍ୱପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ କଲା।

strings.source: The opening: open B, down to F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, up G and A, then G, F sharp, E.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: ଖୋଲା B, ତଳକୁ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, ଉପରକୁ G ଓ A, ତାପରେ G, F ଶାର୍ପ, E।

strings.source: The second half reaches higher: A, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then down D, C, B and G.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଧା ଅଧିକ ଉଚ୍ଚକୁ ଯାଏ: A, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C, ଖୋଲା E, ତାପରେ ତଳକୁ D, C, B ଓ G।

strings.source: This tune is in E minor. Which note sounds like home?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁର E ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ। କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ମୂଳ ସ୍ଥାନ ପରି ଲାଗେ?

strings.source: Both halves end on E, the home note of E minor. You hear it as the place the tune settles.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦୁଇ ଅଧା E ରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ, ଯାହା E ମାଇନର୍‌ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର। ସୁରଟି ସେଠାରେ ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନେବା ପରି ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Johann Strauss II first performed this waltz in Vienna in 1867, and Vienna still plays it every New Year's Day. Its tune climbs a chord, then answers with two high notes.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Johann Strauss II ପ୍ରଥମେ 1867 ରେ ଭିଏନାରେ ଏହି ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍ ପରିବେଷଣ କରିଥିଲେ; ଭିଏନା ଏବେ ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତି ନବବର୍ଷ ଦିନ ଏହା ବଜାଏ। ସୁରଟି କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଉଠି ଦୁଇଟି ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ।

strings.source: G at fret 3 on string 6 twice, B on string 5, open D, then leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2 and down to open B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G ଦୁଇଥର, ତାର 5 ରେ B, ଖୋଲା D, ତାପରେ ଡେଇଁ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D ଓ ତଳକୁ ଖୋଲା B।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Each phrase starts low on the bass strings and leaps up an octave. Look at the high note before you play the low ones, so your hand knows where it's going.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ବେସ୍ ତାରର ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉଠେ। ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ସ୍ଥାନ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ହାତ ଗନ୍ତବ୍ୟ ଜାଣିପାରେ।

strings.source: Jacques Offenbach wrote this galop for his 1858 operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Paris dance halls later made it the music of the can-can.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Jacques Offenbach 1858 ର ଲଘୁ ଅପେରା Orpheus in the Underworld ପାଇଁ ଏହି ଗ୍ୟାଲପ୍ ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ପରେ ପ୍ୟାରିସ୍‌ର ନୃତ୍ୟଶାଳାରେ ଏହା କ୍ୟାନ୍-କ୍ୟାନ୍‌ର ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ହେଲା।

strings.source: A long open G, then A, C, B, A, and two Ds at fret 3 on string 2.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏକ ଲମ୍ବା ଖୋଲା G, ତାପରେ A, C, B, A, ଓ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଦୁଇଥର D।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Most of the tune runs in eighth notes. Keep the pick small and alternate down and up, so you never fall behind.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୁରର ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ଚାଲେ। ପିକ୍‌ର ଚଳନ ଛୋଟ ରଖି ତଳ-ଉପର କ୍ରମରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ପଛରେ ପଡ଼ିବେନି।

strings.source: The big run: open G, leap to G at fret 3 on string 1, then step all the way down to A.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ବଡ଼ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ: ଖୋଲା G, ଡେଇଁ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G, ତାପରେ ପାହାଚ ପରି A ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଓହ୍ଲାନ୍ତୁ।

Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Four tunes from this unit: a pipe march, a Russian folk song, a Viennese waltz and a French galop. Each one a little faster than before.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଏକକର ଚାରି ସୁର: ବ୍ୟାଗ୍‌ପାଇପ୍ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ, ରୁଷୀୟ ଲୋକଗୀତ, ଭିଏନାର ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍ ଓ ଫରାସୀ ଗ୍ୟାଲପ୍। ପ୍ରତିଟି ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: Which of these is a waltz, in three?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାର ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍?

strings.source: A waltz counts one, two, three. The can-can and the pipe march both count in four.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍‌ରେ ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି ଗଣାଯାଏ। କ୍ୟାନ୍-କ୍ୟାନ୍ ଓ ବ୍ୟାଗ୍‌ପାଇପ୍ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ଦୁହିଁରେ ଚାରି ଗଣାଯାଏ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 “Ragtime, marches and the stage” · title

strings.source: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet and Grieg: syncopation, six-eight and key changes.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 “Ragtime, marches and the stage” · unit summary
strings.translation: ଜପ୍ଲିନ୍, ସୁସା, ବିଜେ ଓ ଗ୍ରିଗ୍: ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍, ଛଅ-ଆଠ ଛନ୍ଦ ଓ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Scott Joplin published The Entertainer in 1902, and a 1973 film made it famous again. In ragtime the tune leans off the beat while the bass keeps steady time.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Scott Joplin 1902 ରେ ଦ ଏଣ୍ଟର୍‌ଟେନର୍ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଥିଲେ; 1973 ର ଏକ ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ର ଏହାକୁ ପୁଣି ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ କଲା। ରାଗ୍‌ଟାଇମ୍‌ରେ ବେସ୍ ସ୍ଥିର ଲୟ ରଖେ, ସୁରର ଜୋର ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିରେ ପଡ଼େ।

strings.source: Open D, D sharp at fret 1, E at fret 2 on string 4, then leap to C at fret 1 on string 2 and back, three times.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ D ଶାର୍ପ, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ E, ତାପରେ ଡେଇଁ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ, ତିନିଥର।

strings.source: Syncopation puts the accent between the beats. In the opening, each C lands on an and. Count one-and-two-and and feel the C pull ahead.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍‌ରେ ଜୋର ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିରେ ପଡ଼େ। ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ପ୍ରତି C “ଓ” ଉପରେ ପଡ଼େ। ଏକ-ଓ-ଦୁଇ-ଓ ଗଣି C ଆଗକୁ ଟାଣୁଥିବା ଅନୁଭବ କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The ending run circles C, D and E on strings 2 and 1, then lands through B and D on C.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଶେଷ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ରେ C, D ଓ E ଚାରିପାଖରେ ବୁଲି, B ଓ D ଦେଇ C ରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ।

Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: John Philip Sousa published The Liberty Bell in 1893, and a British TV comedy later made it its theme. It's in six-eight: two big beats a bar, like left, right.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: John Philip Sousa 1893 ରେ ଦ ଲିବର୍ଟି ବେଲ୍ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଥିଲେ; ପରେ ଏକ ବ୍ରିଟିଶ୍ ଟିଭି ହାସ୍ୟ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଏହାକୁ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁର କଲା। ଏହା ଛଅ-ଆଠ ଛନ୍ଦରେ: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରା, ବାମ, ଡାହାଣ ପରି।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: Many beats start with a short silence. Stop the string with your fretting hand, then come back in on the next eighth.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅନେକ ମାତ୍ରା ଛୋଟ ନୀରବତାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତରେ ତାରର ଶବ୍ଦ ରୋକି, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ପୁଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then up to G on string 1 and down D, D, B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B ତିନିଥର, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ A ଶାର୍ପ, ପୁଣି B, ତାପରେ ତାର 1 ରେ G କୁ ଉଠି ତଳକୁ D, D, B।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 5 (along) · title

Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Georges Bizet's opera Carmen opened in Paris in 1875. Its prelude starts with this festive march, then plays the tune of the famous Toreador Song.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Georges Bizet ଙ୍କ ଅପେରା କାର୍ମେନ୍ 1875 ରେ ପ୍ୟାରିସ୍‌ରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ମଞ୍ଚସ୍ଥ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଏହାର ପ୍ରିଲ୍ୟୁଡ୍ ଏହି ଉତ୍ସବମୁଖର ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇ ପରେ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ଟୋରେଆଡୋର୍ ସଙ୍ଗ୍‌ର ସୁର ବଜାଏ।

strings.source: Four As at fret 2 on string 3, then down to E at fret 2 on string 4, open D and E.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଚାରିଥର A, ତାପରେ ତଳକୁ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ E, ଖୋଲା D ଓ E।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: The march is in A major, with C sharp and G sharp. The Toreador tune moves to F major, with B flat at fret 3 on string 3. Watch for the change.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚଟି A ମେଜର୍‌ରେ, C ଶାର୍ପ ଓ G ଶାର୍ପ ସହ। ଟୋରେଆଡୋର୍ ସୁର F ମେଜର୍‌କୁ ଯାଏ, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ସହ। ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନକୁ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 5 (along) · title

strings.source: What happens at the end of the Toreador tune?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

strings.source: It climbs to a long E
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: It climbs to a long high E, the note that leads back home to A major for the march.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଏହା ଏକ ଲମ୍ବା ଉଚ୍ଚ E କୁ ଉଠେ; ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ପାଇଁ ପୁଣି ମୂଳ A ମେଜର୍‌କୁ ଫେରାଏ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Edvard Grieg wrote Morning Mood in 1875 for the play Peer Gynt. The flute plays the theme, the oboe answers, and the music climbs like the rising sun.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Edvard Grieg 1875 ରେ Peer Gynt ନାଟକ ପାଇଁ ମର୍ନିଂ ମୁଡ୍ ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ବଂଶୀ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁର ବଜାଏ, ଓବୋ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ, ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଉଦିତ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ ପରି ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 2 (explain) · title

strings.source: The theme uses just G, A, B, D and E. A five-note scale like this is called pentatonic, and it sounds calm and open.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁରରେ କେବଳ G, A, B, D ଓ E ଅଛି। ଏପରି ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ସ୍କେଲ୍‌କୁ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ କୁହାଯାଏ; ଏହା ଶାନ୍ତ ଓ ମୁକ୍ତ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then back up A and B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D, ଖୋଲା B, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A, ଖୋଲା G, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି ଉପରକୁ A ଓ B।

strings.source: How many different notes does the theme use?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁରରେ କେତୋଟି ଭିନ୍ନ ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି?

strings.source: G, A, B, D and E: a pentatonic scale. There is no C and no F sharp in the whole theme.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G, A, B, D ଓ E: ଏକ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍। ପୂରା ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁରରେ C କିମ୍ବା F ଶାର୍ପ ନାହିଁ।

strings.source: The four pieces from this unit, back to back: ragtime, a march, an opera prelude and a sunrise. Each a little faster than before.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଏକକର ଚାରି ରଚନା ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ: ରାଗ୍‌ଟାଇମ୍, ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ, ଅପେରା ପ୍ରିଲ୍ୟୁଡ୍ ଓ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟୋଦୟ। ପ୍ରତିଟି ପୂର୍ବଠାରୁ ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ।

strings.source: Which of these pieces uses only five notes in its theme?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ରଚନାଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କାହାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁରରେ କେବଳ ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି?

strings.source: Morning Mood's theme is pentatonic: G, A, B, D and E. The others use many more.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ମର୍ନିଂ ମୁଡ୍‌ର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁର ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍: G, A, B, D ଓ E। ଅନ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 “Carols by candlelight” · title

strings.source: Four Christmas carols to sing by candlelight: Wesley and Mendelssohn, a lullaby, and two tunes from America.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 “Carols by candlelight” · unit summary
strings.translation: ମହମବତି ଆଲୁଅରେ ଗାଇବାକୁ ଚାରି କ୍ରିସ୍‌ମାସ୍ କ୍ୟାରଲ୍: ୱେସ୍‌ଲି ଓ ମେଣ୍ଡେଲ୍‌ସନ୍, ଏକ ନାନାବାୟା ଗୀତ ଓ ଆମେରିକାର ଦୁଇ ସୁର।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Charles Wesley wrote the words in 1739. In 1856 an English organist set them to a tune from a choral piece by Felix Mendelssohn, and the carol has been sung that way since.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Charles Wesley 1739 ରେ କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। 1856 ରେ ଜଣେ ଇଂରାଜ ଅର୍ଗାନ୍ ବାଦକ Felix Mendelssohn ଙ୍କ ଏକ ସମବେତ ଗାନର ସୁରରେ ତାହା ବସାଇଲେ; ସେବେଠାରୁ କ୍ୟାରଲ୍ ଏହିପରି ଗାଯାଉଛି।

strings.source: Open D, open G twice, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, then open B twice and A at fret 2 on string 3.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D, ଖୋଲା G ଦୁଇଥର, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, G, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା B ଦୁଇଥର ଓ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Her-ald is long-short: her- lands on three and holds, and -ald slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Her-ald ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ: her- ତିନିରେ ପଡ଼ି ରହେ, -ald ଚାରିର “ଓ” ରେ ଆସେ। ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଚାରି-ଓ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 7 (explain) · title

strings.source: The chorus moves C, A minor, D7 and G. Change on the word that starts each half bar, and keep the strum light under the high E.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମୁଖଡ଼ା C, A ମାଇନର୍, D7 ଓ G ରେ ଯାଏ। ପ୍ରତି ଅଧା ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରୁଥିବା ଶବ୍ଦରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ; ଉଚ୍ଚ E ତଳେ ଝଙ୍କାର ହାଲୁକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: These words first appeared in an American children's book in 1885, and James R. Murray gave them this gentle tune in 1887. It rocks in three, like a cradle.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି କଥା ପ୍ରଥମେ 1885 ରେ ଆମେରିକୀୟ ଶିଶୁପୁସ୍ତକରେ ଆସିଥିଲା; James R. Murray 1887 ରେ ଏହି କୋମଳ ସୁର ଦେଇଥିଲେ। ଏହା ଦୋଳି ପରି ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୋଳେ।

strings.source: It starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, then steps down C, B, A, G and F sharp all the way to open D.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଏହା ଉଚ୍ଚରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D, ତାପରେ C, B, A, G ଓ F ଶାର୍ପ ଦେଇ ଖୋଲା D ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଓହ୍ଲାଏ।

strings.source: The first line walks down from high D to low D. How far is that?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି ଉଚ୍ଚ D ରୁ ନିମ୍ନ D କୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଏ। ଏହି ଦୂରତା କେତେ?

strings.source: D down to D is an octave: eight steps of the scale, the same note name, one register lower.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: D ରୁ ତଳ D ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍: ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଆଠ ସ୍ୱର, ସ୍ୱରର ନାମ ସମାନ, ଗୋଟିଏ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରସ୍ତର।

strings.source: Hold G for most of a line, C for crib for a bed, and D7 to lead home. In three, strum down on one and lightly on two and three.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ଅଧିକାଂଶରେ G, crib for a bed ରେ C, ଓ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରିବାକୁ D7 ଧରନ୍ତୁ। ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଏକରେ ତଳମୁଖୀ ଝଙ୍କାର, ଦୁଇ ଓ ତିନିରେ ହାଲୁକା ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
strings.translation: ଅଜ୍ଞାତ ରଚୟିତା (1885); ପଦ 3 John T. McFarland (1892)

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Phillips Brooks wrote these words in 1868 for the children of his Philadelphia church, and its organist, Lewis Redner, wrote the tune for their Christmas service.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Phillips Brooks 1868 ରେ ଫିଲାଡେଲ୍‌ଫିଆର ନିଜ ଚର୍ଚ୍ଚର ଶିଶୁମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏହି କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ; ଚର୍ଚ୍ଚର ଅର୍ଗାନ୍ ବାଦକ Lewis Redner ସେମାନଙ୍କ କ୍ରିସ୍‌ମାସ୍ ଉପାସନା ପାଇଁ ସୁର ରଚିଥିଲେ।

strings.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then D, C and a drop to E on string 4.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B ତିନିଥର, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ A ଶାର୍ପ, ପୁଣି B, ତାପରେ D, C ଓ ତଳକୁ ତାର 4 ରେ E।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 leans into open B, a half step up. It gives O little town its gentle sway.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର A ଶାର୍ପ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରର ଖୋଲା B ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ। ଏହା O little town କୁ କୋମଳ ଦୋଳନ ଦିଏ।

strings.source: Which word dips down to the low D in the first verse?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ପଦରେ କେଉଁ ଶବ୍ଦ ନିମ୍ନ D କୁ ଖସେ?

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: How still we see thee lie: the tune falls to open D on thee, then lifts to B on lie.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: How still we see thee lie: thee ରେ ସୁର ଖୋଲା D କୁ ଖସେ, lie ରେ B କୁ ଉଠେ।

strings.source: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · title
strings.translation: ଇଟ୍ କେମ୍ ଅପନ୍ ଦ ମିଡ୍‌ନାଇଟ୍ କ୍ଲିଅର୍

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Edmund Sears wrote these words in Massachusetts in 1849, and Richard Storrs Willis wrote the tune a year later. It swings in two big beats a bar, each split in three.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Edmund Sears 1849 ରେ ମାସାଚୁସେଟ୍ସରେ ଏହି କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ; ବର୍ଷକ ପରେ Richard Storrs Willis ସୁର ରଚିଥିଲେ। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି ଭାଗବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଏହା ଦୋଳେ।

strings.source: In six-eight a quarter and an eighth make one big beat: long, short. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, and play on one, three, four and six.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଛଅ-ଆଠରେ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ଓ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ମିଶି ଏକ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରା: ଲମ୍ବା, ଛୋଟ। ଏକ-ଦୁଇ-ତିନି, ଚାରି-ପାଞ୍ଚ-ଛଅ ଗଣି, ଏକ, ତିନି, ଚାରି ଓ ଛଅରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Open G, a leap to open E on string 1, then B, D, C, A, and back to G with a turn through A.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G, ଡେଇଁ ତାର 1 ରେ ଖୋଲା E, ତାପରେ B, D, C, A, ଓ A ଦେଇ ବୁଲି ପୁଣି G।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: The middle of the verse drops to low E and climbs through G sharp, at fret 1 on string 3, to A. Under it the chord moves from E7 to A minor.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପଦର ମଝି ନିମ୍ନ E କୁ ଖସି, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର G ଶାର୍ପ ଦେଇ A କୁ ଉଠେ। ତଳେ କର୍ଡ E7 ରୁ A ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ବଦଳେ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

strings.source: The four carols from this unit, one after another, each a little faster. Keep the chords soft and let the tune sing.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଏକକର ଚାରି କ୍ୟାରଲ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ, ପ୍ରତିଟି ଟିକେ ଦ୍ରୁତ। କର୍ଡ ମୃଦୁ ରଖି ସୁରକୁ ଗାଇବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which of these carols counts in three?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି କ୍ୟାରଲ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ତିନି ଗଣନାରେ ଚାଲେ?

strings.source: Away in a Manger is a waltz: one, two, three. The other two count in four.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଅୱେ ଇନ୍ ଅ ମେଞ୍ଜର୍ ଏକ ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି। ଅନ୍ୟ ଦୁଇଟି ଚାରି ଗଣନାରେ ଚାଲେ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 “Winter carols” · title

strings.source: King's College's opening carol, Holst's midwinter carol, a folk carol and a grand processional.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 “Winter carols” · unit summary

strings.source: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote these words for children in 1848. Since 1919 a single young voice has sung the first verse to open the Christmas Eve carols at King's College, Cambridge.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Cecil Frances Alexander 1848 ରେ ଶିଶୁମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏହି କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। 1919 ଠାରୁ କେମ୍ବ୍ରିଜ୍‌ର କିଙ୍ଗ୍‌ସ କଲେଜ୍‌ରେ କ୍ରିସ୍‌ମାସ୍ ପୂର୍ବସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା କ୍ୟାରଲ୍‌ର ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଜଣେ କିଶୋର କଣ୍ଠ ଏକାକୀ ପ୍ରଥମ ପଦ ଗାଏ।

strings.source: Open D, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, open G, then a turn: G, F sharp, G, A, A, G.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା G, ତାପରେ ଏକ ବୁଲାଣି: G, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, A, A, G।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Da-vid's spreads each syllable over two eighth notes. Play both, but sing them as one smooth sound.

strings.translation: Da-vid's ର ପ୍ରତି ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଦୁଇ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ବିସ୍ତାରିତ। ଦୁଇଟିଯାକ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଏକ ସୁଗମ ଧ୍ୱନି ଭାବେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: A poem and a quiet tune
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Christina Rossetti wrote this poem in 1872, and Gustav Holst set it to music for a hymn book in 1906. Its lines are short and calm, like snow falling.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Christina Rossetti 1872 ରେ ଏହି କବିତା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ; Gustav Holst 1906 ରେ ଏକ ସ୍ତୋତ୍ର ପୁସ୍ତକ ପାଇଁ ସୁର ଦେଇଥିଲେ। ତୁଷାରପାତ ପରି ଏହାର ପଙ୍କ୍ତିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଛୋଟ ଓ ଶାନ୍ତ।

strings.source: Open B twice, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back down B, A and G.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B ଦୁଇଥର, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ B, A ଓ G।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Many words land on half notes: -ter in mid-winter, i-ron. Let each ring for two full beats before you move on.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଅନେକ ଶବ୍ଦ ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ପଡ଼େ: mid-winter ର -ter, i-ron। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ ପୂରା ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Long ago stretches three syllables over how many notes?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: Long ago ର ତିନି ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ ଖଣ୍ଡ କେତୋଟି ସ୍ୱରରେ ବିସ୍ତାରିତ?

strings.source: Long takes two notes, a- takes two, and go takes one: five notes for three syllables.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Long ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର, a- ଦୁଇଟି ଓ go ଗୋଟିଏ ନିଏ: ତିନି ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ ଖଣ୍ଡ ପାଇଁ ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: Under frost-y wind made moan the chords move A minor to D7, a lean that pulls the line back to G.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: frost-y wind made moan ତଳେ କର୍ଡ A ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ D7 କୁ ଯାଏ; ଏହି ଟାଣ ପଙ୍କ୍ତିକୁ ପୁଣି G କୁ ଫେରାଏ।

strings.source: This carol is centuries old. The song collector Cecil Sharp heard it sung in a Cotswold town and printed this tune in 1911. It dances in three.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି କ୍ୟାରଲ୍ ବହୁ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀ ପୁରୁଣା। ଗୀତ ସଂଗ୍ରାହକ Cecil Sharp ଏକ କଟ୍ସୱଲ୍ଡ ସହରରେ ଏହା ଶୁଣି 1911 ରେ ସୁରଟି ମୁଦ୍ରଣ କରିଥିଲେ। ଏହା ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ନାଚେ।

strings.source: Four open Gs, then a leap to open E on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2 and open B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଚାରିଥର ଖୋଲା G, ତାପରେ ଡେଇଁ ତାର 1 ରେ ଖୋଲା E, ତଳକୁ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D ଓ ଖୋଲା B।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: From open G to open E is a sixth. Keep your pick close to the strings and cross from string 3 to string 1 in one move.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G ରୁ ଖୋଲା E ଏକ ଷଷ୍ଠ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ପିକ୍‌କୁ ତାର ନିକଟରେ ରଖି, ଗୋଟିଏ ଚଳନରେ ତାର 3 ରୁ ତାର 1 କୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.translation: ଏଞ୍ଜେଲ୍ସ ଫ୍ରମ୍ ଦ ରେଲ୍ମ୍ସ ଅଫ୍ ଗ୍ଲୋରି

strings.source: James Montgomery printed these words in his Sheffield newspaper on Christmas Eve, 1816. Henry Smart's tune, from 1867, gives it a grand, marching sound.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: James Montgomery 1816 ର କ୍ରିସ୍‌ମାସ୍ ପୂର୍ବସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ ନିଜ ସେଫିଲ୍ଡ ଖବରକାଗଜରେ ଏହି କଥା ଛାପିଥିଲେ। Henry Smart ଙ୍କ 1867 ର ସୁର ଏହାକୁ ଭବ୍ୟ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ଧ୍ୱନି ଦିଏ।

strings.source: A on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, D at fret 3 on string 2, A, then F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, E and D.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 3 ରେ A, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D, A, ତାପରେ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, E ଓ D।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: This key has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. C sharp sits at fret 2 on string 2.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଶାର୍ପ ଅଛି, F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ। C ଶାର୍ପ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଅଛି।

strings.translation: ଏହି ଏକକର କ୍ୟାରଲ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ। ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଚାଲେ: ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱର ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ ପୂରା ଅବଧି ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · challenge std-medley-winter “Winter medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ତିନି ଗଣନାରେ ଚାଲେ?

strings.source: The Holly and the Ivy is in three. The other two count in four.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · challenge std-medley-winter “Winter medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ଦ ହଲି ଆଣ୍ଡ ଦ ଆଇଭି ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ। ଅନ୍ୟ ଦୁଇଟି ଚାରି ଗଣନାରେ ଚାଲେ।

strings.source: Five great hymns in long, singing notes, from 1708 to 1861.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 “Hymns everyone knows” · unit summary
strings.translation: 1708 ରୁ 1861 ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପାଞ୍ଚ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ତୋତ୍ର, ଲମ୍ବା ଗାୟନମୟ ସ୍ୱରରେ।

strings.source: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · title
strings.translation: ଓ ଗଡ୍, ଆୱର୍ ହେଲ୍ପ୍ ଇନ୍ ଏଜେସ୍ ପାଷ୍ଟ୍

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: William Croft wrote this tune, St Anne, in 1708, and Isaac Watts's words were first printed in 1719. Each verse is four short lines, the plainest hymn shape there is.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: William Croft 1708 ରେ St Anne ନାମର ଏହି ସୁର ରଚିଥିଲେ; Isaac Watts ଙ୍କ କଥା ପ୍ରଥମେ 1719 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ପ୍ରତି ପଦରେ ଚାରି ଛୋଟ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି, ସ୍ତୋତ୍ରର ସରଳତମ ରୂପ।

strings.source: Open G, E at fret 2 on string 4, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2, C, open B and C.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ E, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A, G, ତାପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C, C, ଖୋଲା B ଓ C।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Every line starts on the beat before the bar: O, our, our, and. Count four, then sing the first word on it.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ପଙ୍କ୍ତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ପୂର୍ବ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ: O, our, our, and। ଚାରି ଗଣି ସେଥିରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଶବ୍ଦ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: The chart leans on A minor, F and G7. God, our sits on A minor, and a-ges past moves from G7 to C.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: କର୍ଡ ଚିତ୍ରରେ A ମାଇନର୍, F ଓ G7 ମୁଖ୍ୟ। God, our A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ରହେ, a-ges past G7 ରୁ C କୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.source: Reginald Heber wrote these words, printed in 1826, and John Bacchus Dykes wrote the tune in 1861. Its first line climbs the notes of a G major chord.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Reginald Heber ଏହି କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ, ଯାହା 1826 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହେଲା; John Bacchus Dykes 1861 ରେ ସୁର ଦେଲେ। ପ୍ରଥମ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି G ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.source: Up the G chord: open G twice, open B twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2, held long.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: G କର୍ଡରେ ଉପରକୁ: ଖୋଲା G ଦୁଇଥର, ଖୋଲା B ଦୁଇଥର, ତାପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D ଲମ୍ବା ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Holy, holy, holy climbs which notes?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: Holy, holy, holy କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ?

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G major chord, so the tune climbs the chord itself.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: G, B ଓ D ହେଉଛି G ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱର, ତେଣୁ ସୁରଟି କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରରେ ହିଁ ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 5 (explain) · title

strings.source: This hymn moves in long notes: halves of two beats and a whole note of four at the end. Count every beat, even while a note rings.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ସ୍ତୋତ୍ର ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଚାଲେ: ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରାର ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ଶେଷରେ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍। ସ୍ୱର ବାଜୁଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରା ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Henry Francis Lyte wrote these words in 1847, and William Henry Monk wrote the tune Eventide for them in 1861. Football crowds in England have sung it before the cup final since 1927.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Henry Francis Lyte 1847 ରେ ଏହି କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ; William Henry Monk 1861 ରେ ଏହା ପାଇଁ Eventide ସୁର ରଚିଲେ। ଇଂଲଣ୍ଡର ଫୁଟବଲ୍ ଦର୍ଶକ 1927 ଠାରୁ କପ୍ ଫାଇନାଲ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଏହା ଗାଇଆସୁଛନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then D at fret 3 and E on string 1, back through D and C to B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B ଦୁଇଥର, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A, ଖୋଲା G, ତାପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D ଓ ତାର 1 ରେ E, ପୁଣି D ଓ C ଦେଇ B।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Every note here is a quarter, a half or a whole. Count four steady beats a bar and let the long notes ring.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏଠି ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍, ହାଫ୍ ବା ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଚାରି ସ୍ଥିର ମାତ୍ରା ଗଣି ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Which note leads into the D at the end of the second line?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ଶେଷରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର D କୁ ନେଇଯାଏ?

strings.source: C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2, rises a half step into D, the way a leading note does.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର C ଶାର୍ପ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉଠି D କୁ ଯାଏ, ଅଗ୍ରସ୍ୱର ପରି।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Sarah Flower Adams wrote these words in London in 1841, and Lowell Mason, an American music teacher, gave them this tune in 1856.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Sarah Flower Adams 1841 ରେ ଲଣ୍ଡନରେ ଏହି କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ; ଆମେରିକୀୟ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଶିକ୍ଷକ Lowell Mason 1856 ରେ ଏହି ସୁର ଦେଲେ।

strings.source: Open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G twice, then E at fret 2 on string 4 twice.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା B, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A, ଖୋଲା G ଦୁଇଥର, ତାପରେ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ E ଦୁଇଥର।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Each line has a long-short pair: a dotted quarter, then a quick eighth, as in -er, my and God, to. Let the long note lean into the short one.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ପଙ୍କ୍ତିରେ ଏକ ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ ଯୋଡ଼ି: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍, ପରେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍, ଯେପରି -er, my ଓ God, to ରେ। ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଛୋଟଟି ଆଡ଼କୁ ନେଇଯାଆନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

strings.translation: ଫର୍ ଦ ବ୍ୟୁଟି ଅଫ୍ ଦ ଅର୍ଥ୍

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Folliott Pierpoint wrote these words in 1864, on a spring day in the English countryside. They are sung to Dix, a German tune from 1838.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Folliott Pierpoint 1864 ରେ ଇଂଲଣ୍ଡର ଗ୍ରାମାଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଏକ ବସନ୍ତ ଦିନ ଏହି କଥା ଲେଖିଥିଲେ। ଏହା 1838 ର ଜର୍ମାନ ସୁର Dix ରେ ଗାଯାଏ।

strings.source: Open G, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2 twice and open B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, G, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A, G, ତାପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C ଦୁଇଥର ଓ ଖୋଲା B।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: For the starts with two eighth notes on the: F sharp and G, one syllable sung over both. Play them evenly inside one beat.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: For the ରେ the ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଦୁଇ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ G ଉପରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ଏକ ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଗାଯାଏ। ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ଭିତରେ ସମାନ ଭାବେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

strings.source: The hymns from this unit, back to back, from the oldest tune to the newest. Let the long notes ring and the chords change on the word.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ଏହି ଏକକର ସ୍ତୋତ୍ର ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ, ପୁରୁଣା ସୁରରୁ ନୂଆ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ। ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଶବ୍ଦରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

strings.source: Which of these tunes is the oldest?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ଏହି ସୁରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ସବୁଠୁ ପୁରୁଣା?

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

strings.source: William Croft wrote St Anne in 1708, almost 150 years before the other two.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: William Croft 1708 ରେ St Anne ରଚିଥିଲେ, ଅନ୍ୟ ଦୁଇଟିର ପ୍ରାୟ 150 ବର୍ଷ ପୂର୍ବରୁ।

strings.source: Three songs families sang around the piano, then Holst's Jupiter.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 “Parlor songs and a planet” · unit summary
strings.translation: ପିଆନୋ ଚାରିପାଖରେ ପରିବାର ଗାଉଥିବା ତିନି ଗୀତ, ତାପରେ ହୋଲ୍‌ଷ୍ଟଙ୍କ ଜୁପିଟର୍।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Henry Bishop wrote this tune for a London opera in 1823, to words by the American actor John Howard Payne. Within a few years it was one of the best-loved songs in the world.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Henry Bishop 1823 ରେ ଲଣ୍ଡନର ଏକ ଅପେରା ପାଇଁ ଆମେରିକୀୟ ଅଭିନେତା John Howard Payne ଙ୍କ କଥାରେ ଏହି ସୁର ରଚିଥିଲେ। କିଛି ବର୍ଷ ଭିତରେ ଏହା ବିଶ୍ୱର ସବୁଠୁ ପ୍ରିୟ ଗୀତମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଏକ ହେଲା।

strings.source: Open G, A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back to B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା G, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A, ଖୋଲା B, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି B।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: The verse starts just before beat one, on a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Count four-e-and-a: 'Mid lands on four, and its short turn on a.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପଦଟି ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାର ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ଏଇଥ୍ ଓ ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ଚାରି-ଇ-ଓ-ଆ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 'Mid ଚାରିରେ, ତାହାର ଛୋଟ ବୁଲାଣି “ଆ” ରେ ପଡ଼େ।

strings.source: The chorus begins on one long note. How long is it?
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
strings.translation: ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଗୋଟିଏ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ତାହା କେତେ ଲମ୍ବା?

strings.source: Home! is a whole note: hold D at fret 3 on string 2 for the whole bar.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
strings.translation: Home! ଏକ ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍: ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D ପୂରା ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

strings.source: Hard Times Come Again No More
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · title
strings.translation: ହାର୍ଡ ଟାଇମ୍ସ କମ୍ ଏଗେନ୍ ନୋ ମୋର୍

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 1 (explain) · title

strings.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1854. It asks the listener to stop and think of people who have less, and singers still return to it today.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Stephen Foster 1854 ରେ ଏହି ଗୀତ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଥିଲେ। ଏହା ଶ୍ରୋତାଙ୍କୁ ଅଟକି ଅଭାବରେ ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ କଥା ଭାବିବାକୁ କୁହେ; ଗାୟକମାନେ ଆଜି ମଧ୍ୟ ଏହାକୁ ଫେରନ୍ତି।

strings.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, three more F sharps, then A at fret 2 on string 3 and back to F sharp.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D, ତାର 4 ରେ E ଓ F ଶାର୍ପ, ଆଉ ତିନିଥର F ଶାର୍ପ, ତାପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A ଓ ପୁଣି F ଶାର୍ପ।

strings.translation: ପଦରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଅନେକ ଶବ୍ଦ ଗାଯାଏ। ପ୍ରତି F ଶାର୍ପ ଛୋଟ ଓ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; କଥାକୁ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି ଆଗକୁ ନେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: The chorus lifts to G under the long note on wear-y, then rests on D for hard times. A7 brings each line home.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: wear-y ର ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ତଳେ ମୁଖଡ଼ା G କୁ ଉଠେ, hard times ରେ D ରେ ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନିଏ। A7 ପ୍ରତି ପଙ୍କ୍ତିକୁ ମୂଳ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଫେରାଏ।

strings.source: Thomas Moore set these words to an old Irish air and printed them in 1813. Later, Mendelssohn wrote a fantasia on the tune, and Flotow put it in his opera Martha.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Thomas Moore ଏକ ପୁରୁଣା ଆଇରିଶ୍ ସୁରରେ ଏହି କଥା ବସାଇ 1813 ରେ ଛାପିଥିଲେ। ପରେ Mendelssohn ସେହି ସୁର ଉପରେ ଫାଣ୍ଟାସିଆ ରଚିଲେ, ଓ Flotow ନିଜ ଅପେରା Martha ରେ ତାହା ରଖିଲେ।

strings.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, then a leap to D at fret 3 on string 2, and down C sharp, B and A.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ଖୋଲା D, ତାର 4 ରେ E ଓ F ଶାର୍ପ, ତାପରେ ଡେଇଁ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D, ଓ ତଳକୁ C ଶାର୍ପ, B ଓ A।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: Most beats split long-short: a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Play the long note full and let the short one lead into the next beat.

strings.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ମାତ୍ରା ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟରେ ବିଭକ୍ତ: ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ଏଇଥ୍ ଓ ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍। ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର ପୂରା ବଜାଇ, ଛୋଟଟିକୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ନେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: In the middle, no rosebud is nigh climbs through A sharp to B. The chord turns to B minor there, the saddest moment of the song.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମଝିରେ no rosebud is nigh A ଶାର୍ପ ଦେଇ B କୁ ଉଠେ। ସେଠି କର୍ଡ B ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ବଦଳେ, ଗୀତର ସବୁଠୁ ବିଷଣ୍ଣ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ।

strings.source: Gustav Holst wrote The Planets between 1914 and 1916. This broad tune is the heart of Jupiter. In 1921 he made it a hymn tune and named it Thaxted, after the town where he lived.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Gustav Holst 1914 ଓ 1916 ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଦ ପ୍ଲାନେଟ୍ସ ରଚିଥିଲେ। ଏହି ବିସ୍ତୃତ ସୁର ଜୁପିଟର୍‌ର ହୃଦୟ। 1921 ରେ ସେ ଏହାକୁ ସ୍ତୋତ୍ର ସୁର କରି, ରହୁଥିବା ସହର ନାମରେ Thaxted ନାମ ଦେଲେ।

strings.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, open G, A at fret 2, then C at fret 1 on string 2, open B, G, and up C, D, C, B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ E, ଖୋଲା G, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ A, ତାପରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C, ଖୋଲା B, G, ଓ ଉପରକୁ C, D, C, B।

strings.source: The middle of the tune dips to C at fret 3 on string 5. Reach for it with your third finger, then come straight back up to string 4.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ସୁରର ମଝି ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର C କୁ ଖସେ। ତୃତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାହା ଧରି, ସିଧା ପୁଣି ତାର 4 କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ।

strings.source: Antonio Vivaldi published four violin concertos called The Four Seasons in 1725. Spring opens with this bright tune, then the solo violin plays birdsong and running brooks.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Antonio Vivaldi 1725 ରେ ଦ ଫୋର୍ ସିଜନ୍ସ ନାମରେ ଚାରି ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍ କନ୍‌ଚେର୍ଟୋ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଥିଲେ। ସ୍ପ୍ରିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଏହି ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ସୁରରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ, ପରେ ଏକକ ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍ ପକ୍ଷୀର ଗୀତ ଓ ବହୁଥିବା ଝରଣା ବଜାଏ।

strings.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3 three times, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, E, then open B.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ E, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ ତିନିଥର, ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, E, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା B।

strings.source: The key of E has four sharps. In first position G sharp is at fret 1 on string 3, D sharp at fret 1 on string 4, and C sharp at fret 2 on string 2.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: E ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଚାରିଟି ଶାର୍ପ ଅଛି। ପ୍ରଥମ ଅବସ୍ଥାନରେ G ଶାର୍ପ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ, D ଶାର୍ପ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ, ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 4 (explain) · title

strings.source: Each beat can split into four sixteenths. In the theme, the quick F sharp, E pair falls in the second half of beat two.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରା ଚାରି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ବିଭକ୍ତ ହୋଇପାରେ। ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁରରେ ଦ୍ରୁତ F ଶାର୍ପ, E ଯୋଡ଼ି ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଧାରେ ପଡ଼େ।

strings.source: Mozart published this rondo in 1784 as the last movement of a piano sonata. Its march copies the sound of Turkish military bands, which Vienna loved at the time.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: Mozart 1784 ରେ ଏକ ପିଆନୋ ସୋନାଟାର ଶେଷ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଭାବେ ଏହି ରଣ୍ଡୋ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଥିଲେ। ଏହାର ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ତୁର୍କୀ ସାମରିକ ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡର ଧ୍ୱନିକୁ ଅନୁକରଣ କରେ, ଯାହା ସେବେ ଭିଏନାରେ ଲୋକପ୍ରିୟ ଥିଲା।

strings.source: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G sharp at fret 4 on string 6, A, then C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, C, B and C.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
strings.translation: ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ B, ଖୋଲା A, ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ, A, ତାପରେ ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ C, ଖୋଲା D, C, B ଓ C।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 3 (explain) · title

strings.source: The theme circles A: B, A, G sharp, A. Each circle is four sixteenths. Then it climbs a step and circles again.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସୁର A ଚାରିପାଖରେ ବୁଲେ: B, A, G ଶାର୍ପ, A। ପ୍ରତି ବୁଲାଣି ଚାରି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍। ତାପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ଉଠି ପୁଣି ବୁଲେ।

strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 6 (explain) · title

strings.source: The march moves from A minor to A major: C becomes C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2. The tune sounds suddenly bright.
strings.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ A ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ A ମେଜର୍‌କୁ ଯାଏ: C, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର C ଶାର୍ପ ହୁଏ। ସୁର ହଠାତ୍ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

strings.source: John Philip Sousa wrote this march at the end of 1896, and it was published in 1897. It is the official national march of the United States. This is its big trio tune.

strings.translation: John Philip Sousa 1896 ଶେଷରେ ଏହି ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ରଚିଥିଲେ; ଏହା 1897 ରେ ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଇଲା। ଏହା ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରର ସରକାରୀ ଜାତୀୟ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ। ଏଠି ଏହାର ଭବ୍ୟ ଟ୍ରିଓ ସୁର ଅଛି।

strings.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, open B, then a dip to A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 and back to B.

strings.source: Roots and fifths, as a bass player first backs a band: the chord's root where it starts, its fifth between, low in first position. The song stays in C, where the band plays it.
strings.context: Bass Songbook · Unit 1 · song bass-sb-song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
strings.translation: ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡକୁ ପ୍ରଥମେ ସାଥି ଦେଉଥିବା ବେସ୍ ବାଦକ ପରି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ: କର୍ଡ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର, ମଝିରେ ତାହାର ପଞ୍ଚମ, ପ୍ରଥମ ଅବସ୍ଥାନର ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରରେ। ଗୀତ C ରେ ରହେ, ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଯେଉଁଠି ବଜାଏ।

strings.translation: ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡକୁ ପ୍ରଥମେ ସାଥି ଦେଉଥିବା ବେସ୍ ବାଦକ ପରି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ: କର୍ଡ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର, ମଝିରେ ତାହାର ପଞ୍ଚମ, ପ୍ରଥମ ଅବସ୍ଥାନର ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରରେ। ଗୀତ G ରେ ରହେ, ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଯେଉଁଠି ବଜାଏ।
